tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 44 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig ༵//sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas da bde ྅ mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzis/sa par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes rtsod dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ zugad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb spyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhu pa lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu ring dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod r+ṣa po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhud lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3— ca

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mche / na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhus las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sprungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan sgro 4 cha la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshus du bzhag yod pa bcas khyone bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'brasaskrungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ du 7 5 pa sgyu du 'u glang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 — —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug sgru ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhud bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bzhas gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i brtse/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sdi rla nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas no —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8— —

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khore bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

gleng gzhi/ 1dang po/ myang yul gyi nges tshig bshad pa/ 3gnyis pa/ yul gyi che ba dang 'dod yon bshad pa/ 4gsum pa/ yul 'dzin pa'i gang zag gi skyes bu mi rabs rim par byung bar bshad pa/ 7phu gnod sbyin gang bzang bshad pa/ 8gdan sa chen po dpal ra lu thil 'di thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa bcu gsum ldan pa/ 121 gnas khyad par du 'phags pa'i sa'i dpyad pa ldan pa/ 122 gnas de la gnas pa'i lha khyad par du 'phags pa/ ༷ 133 ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 144 skyes bu dam pas byin gyis brlabs pas khyad par du 'phags pa/ 155 sku rten khyad par du 'phags pa/ 156 gsung rten khyad par du 'phags pa/ 167 thugs rten khyad par du 'phags pa/ 168 rang byon khyad par du 'phags pa/ 18—1—

9 gang dar ba'i bstan pa khyad par du 'phags pa/ 2310 de las 'ong pa'i brgyud pa khyad par du 'phags pa/ 2411 de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu'i khyad par du 'phags pa/ 2512 tshul ji ltar bzang ba khyad par du 'phags pa/ 27gtsang pa rgya ras sogs/ 28kha mo dgon pa dang khu le'i kha mo ze'u ston pa sogs/ 31sgo bzhi'i yul gyi mgon po'i gnas dang sde phu dgon pa sogs/ 33'bras mo dgon pa sogs/ 35'chad mang dang myang stod chu mig ring mo sogs/ 38sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad las yang dag thugs sogs bod du bsgyur tshul/ ༷ 40smri ti dz+nyā na sogs/ 41gling ras dgon pa dang gling ras phug pa sogs/ 44ri nang dpon po'i pho brang ri nang yang dkar sogs/ 45ri khrod dge ldan nam mid pa dgon pa sogs/ 47lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi bka' bab slob ma bzhi sogs/ 48shel dkar rgyal rtse sogs/ 49chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang nas chos grwa chen po —2—

dpa' 'khor bde chen sogs bzhengs pa/ 52bye mda' lha khang sogs/ 65skye med jo gdan sogs/ 66rgyang ro spe'u dmar sogs/ 67'bras khung gtsug lag khang sogs/ ༷ 70do chen dang do chung gnyis sogs/ 71rgyang ro ser sdings sogs/ 72glang pa 'phang thang dgon/ gser gling / lung nag sogs/ 74gru tshul khrims chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs/ 75las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar ba sogs/ 76rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba sogs/ 78gnas rnying gi gnas gzhi'i che ba bcu/ ༷ 80'bre'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum/ 85rba tsho nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ 85mkhan po dbang rin pa sogs/ 86snang sa 'od 'bum gyi 'khrungs yul phas khur dang / lcang ra sogs/ 90sham bu rtse dgu'am rtse chen chos sde sogs/ 94rgyal byed tshal sogs/ 100—3—

khang dmar dang / rtsis gnas gsar gyi gtsug lag khang sogs/ 101lha rje lco ston rgya nag 109mag dge sdings dgon pa sogs/ 110thur la dgon pa sogs/ 113cog ro gsum sogs/ 115myang stod stag tshal sogs/ 116man lung dgon pa sogs/ 118pho rog mdo sde dgon/ ༷ 119pre ta dgon pa dang / nyan tsho'i lha khang sogs/ 119lce dkar nag khra gsum sogs/ 123bse brag g.ya' lung dgon sogs/ 125ku ru lung gi dgon pa dang / bsam sdings dgon pa sogs/ 126gcig pa snam 'dir sngon gyi dus su sprul pa'i rgyal/ po ge sar bzhugs tshul/ ༷ 128gnyis/ pa snam 'dir bstan pa snga dar la lo paṇa gyi bzhugs tshul/ 29gsum/ pa snam 'dir phyi dar la mkhas grub rnams bzhugs tshul/ 131rwa lo rdo rje grags sogs/ ༷ 131gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab sogs/ 132—4—

lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas sogs/ 133zhang brtson bsod nams grags sogs/ 134dge bshes dol pa chen po sogs/ ༷ 137steng shwe1 tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas sogs 137dbyar nyi ma brtson 'grus sogs/ 138gtum ston blo gros grags sogs/ 139sa hor yon mchod kyis bod khri stong la sogs bcas pa/ 139mi nyag grags pa rin chen sogs/ 140stag gzig brag gi slob dpon pad+ma'i sgrub phug byin can sogs/ 140dpyal 'byu1nga gnas rgyal mtshan se/gas/ 141bla ma kun dga' rdo rje sogs/ 142dpyal lo chos bzang sogs/ 144bla ma dam pa rin chen bzang po sogs/ 145bu ston rin chen grub sogs/ 146thar pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso/ 147dpal dgyes pa rdo rje bka' srol chen po mi 'dra ba bzhi/ 147tshong 'dus mgur tsho gtsug lag khang / 149tshong 'dus mgur mo ru g.yu thog pas rgyud bzhi 'chad skabs —5—

a ru ra'i char babs pa sogs/ 150bu ston chos rje bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa sogs/ ༷ 150zhang lo tsā ba grub pa dpal bzang po sogs/ 152lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug 153bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs/ 154zog po mi drug gam mkhas btsun mi drug sogs/ 156mdo smad du bstan pa'i me ro bslangs pa/ 157dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu gnyis sogs/ 157lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis myang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang gzhi bting pa/ 159glang ston byams pas khro phug dang 'om phug mo btang pa sogs/ 160rgya tsho/ stag tsho/ zhu tsho/ 'da' tsho/ mi tsho/ glag tsho/ glang tsho/ u tsho/kyi tsho sogs/ 161dpal zhwa lu gser khang sogs/ 162zhwa lu pa'i ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad sogs/ 169mkhas pa chen po dbus ston seng ge 'od sogs/ 170si tu kun dga' rdo rje sogs/ 171bu ston chos rje/ 174—6—

sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs/ 178sku zhang kun dga' don grub sogs/ 181bsam grub rtse'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par gyis mtho ba bco lnga/ 184gcig phyi gnas la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ 1851 phyi yul sa'i dpyad pa ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 1852 ming khyad par can 'dogs pa'i gzhi yi ngo mtshar phun sdo/ma tsho mogs pa/ 1863 zag med thugs rgyud gtams pa'i dam pa mchog gi ched du bsngags pa/ 1874 'chi med yul ljongs dga' tshal la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i skyed tshal gyi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 1885 stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba kho na 'byung ba'i bsti gnas su nges par bstan pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 191gnyis/ nang rten pa bstan 'dzin sogs la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tsho gis pa lnga/ ༷ 2001 sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs te 'bras bu sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 201—7—

bka' brgyad phug pa/ 202sgrub pa bka' brgyad/ 202rtsa rgyud/ ༷ ༷ 202yan lag gi rgyud/ ༷ ༷ 202gter du sbas tshul/ 203grub thob kyis bton tshul/ ༷ 203gang zag snyan khungs su brgyud de bod yul du babs tshul/ 2042 yang snying rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'khrungs shing bstan pa spel ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 2073 lta ba'i mthar thug thal 'gyur la 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 215pa tshab nyi ma grags pa sogs/ 216rngog lo tsā ba/ pu hrang lo chung grags mchog shes rab sogs/ 216rma bya byang brtson/ 2174 lta sgom gyi mthar thug bka' brgyud grub thob skyes chen gyis sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo sgom pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 218('di'i man chad ma dper med pas rtsom 'phro lus pa 'dra zhu/)sgrig pa po'i mchid/ 229—8—

gyi legs bshad mkhas pa'i 'ju ga ngogs zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/༄༅/ /shrī ya si stu/ tshogs gnyis chu 'dzin stug po'i 'dzum zhal las/ /legs 'khrungs 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i char/ /'gro tshogs srid 'khyams gdung bas cher dub rnams/ /sel byed dam pa'i sman chab thub dbang rgyal/ /de yi brtse ldan zla ba'i 'od dpal gyis/ /sa gsum shugs las srid sgrol gzugs shar ba/ /'phags pa'i zhing mchog ngo mchar gangs ri'i ljongs/ /sa'i thig myang yul lha gnas 'dra ba'i gtam/ /shes bya'i rang bzhin ma lus chos yangs par/1 (gzhi gcig pa'i bsdus brjod kyi rgyan mtshar du dngar ba/) /mtha' yas 'byor pa'i lang tsho rgyas pa mo'i/ /yid 'ong snying khar reg pa'i do shal 'di//dbyod ldan mkhas pa las gzhan su zhig bsten/ /skar tshogs phra mo'ang kun gsal yangs pa'i ngos//nyi zla'i gzi brjid bsnyems nas zol gyi rgyu/ /rnam dpyod rang 'os dpal gyi mdangs bral yang / /shar phyogs ri bo'i phrag par ngoms shing 'char/ /sngon byon blo gros spyan nyid ut+pal du/ 2 (gzugs can 'phar ma'i dkyus dpe rgyan mtshar du dngar ba/) /yangs pa'i legs bshad 'dab brgya lha'i rnga yab/ /'dzu 5 par mtshungs tsam ma yin mkhas rnams kyi/ /snying kha bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rgyas la —1 —

'gran/ /mang thos rig pa'i gnas kyi pha mtha' sa /son zhes ming tsam ma yin dpyad gsum gyi/ /rnam dag blo gros nor gyis ches phyug kyang // snyigs dus skye bos mi shes blun khrod rgyu/ /de phyir dam pa'i ring lugs myang yul gyi/ /sngar byung bstan gzhi de 'dzin skyes bu dang / /sku gsung thugs rten ngo mtshar gyis bskrun rnams/ /rtog bzo spangs te blo yi chu gter las/ /legs bshad nor bu yid kyi re skong du/ /ཿnga yang 'byog po'i blo can rnams la ci/ / dri med ye shes spangs pa blo yi yul/ /'gal 'khrul chad lhag nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /'phags dang mkhas rnams bzod gsol lhag bsam gyi/ /gyon gos legs nyes dpyad nas 'dir 'god pa/ /dam pa'i mdzad mchog cod pan mdzes par bcings/ /bod yul dbus kyi lte ba 'dod rgu 'byin pa'i dpag bsam gyi rkang 'thung la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa/ nor 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i snying po phyungs pa 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi sa'i zhag tu chags pa/ myang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas lha chos dang mi chos kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i yul/ ya rabs skye bo bzang po'i blo can 'ba' zhig dge ba'i las lam bcu la mngon du phyogs pas 'chi ba med pa'i grong khyer du/ rab dkar shel gyi them skas btsugs par legs par 'dzegs pa'i shes pa can gyi skye 'gro sha stag yod pa'i sa yul/ phu ha bo gang bzang zhes pa/ yab gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po gang ba bzang po/ sras nor bu bzang po gnas pa na/ mda' bcug dpe yu ba gdong yan gyi sa dpyad bzang ngan ji ltar ldan tshul/ sngon dus gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs nas/—2—

phan bde'i rtsa lag bstan pa ches cher 'phel tshul dang / mkhas pa la grub pa'i dngos grub mchog brnyes pa rnams 'khrungs pa dang / zhabs kyis bcags nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rten dang gsung rab mang po bzhengs nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi gzhi ma btang tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus rang blor gsal ba rnams bkod pa de la yang thog mar sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes bu dam pas rgya skad rwa rgya zhes pa ro myangs pa'i sgra don gyi nges tshig bshad pa/ yul gyi che ba dang 'dod yon bshad pa/ yul 'dzin pa'i gang zag gi skyes bu khyad par ba rim par byung tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ bya rgod sbungs pa'i ri bo che/ bod du 'dod yon sbungs pa'i ri bo che zhes bshad pa las/ ri bo che 'di nyid kyi rtser slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa phebs te sa gzhi rnams byin gyis brlabs/ de'i dus su lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba zhig bsnams nas byon te bdud rtsi'i bum pa slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul nas lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang du gsol zhus pa dang / slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa zad mi shes par byin gyis brlabs/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la bum pa'i bdud rtsi skyes te/ rigs kyi bu lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ yul gyi ming la lha'i bdud rtsi myang bas myang zhes bya'o/ /de nas lha'i bdud rtsi mang po spel nas slob dpon rje 'bangs bcas pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs te gnod sbyin gang bzang gi rtser bdud rtsi nas blugs te gangs ri 'di yang lha'i bdud rtsis byin gyis brlabs pas/ de dag chu bo chen po 'di la myang —3—

gi chu zhes dang / lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang bzhin pa myang gser gzhung ring mo zhes bya/ sgos yul gyi gangs ri rnams la yang lha'i bdud rtsi nas blugs pa mdzad zer ba yang grags la/ slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob phal cher la bdud rtsi de nas phyag tu ma byung ba med cing / bdud rtsi de la sngags pa che zhing mthong che bas na bdud rtsi gnyer bcag mdzad cing / de'i yang slob ma rnams la bdud rtsi de'i chu rgyun gyi ro myang rgyu byung ba rnams la myang myang zhes gdung rus la yang mtshan gsol bar 'dod cing / de ltar 'thad par go /myang po nas phebs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gis byin gyis brlabs pas myang zhes zer ba ni blun tshig kho na yin cing mi 'thad la khungs gang yang med do/ /bdud rtsi myang pas myang zhes pa yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin lags/ de'i tshe lung dmar yar stabs gangs kyis chod pa dang / gzhan lung pa thams cad nags kyis chod pa yod pa la slob dpon gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis nags thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ gnod sbyin gang bzang gi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun myang chu 'di yang sgang la gtong ba mdzad nas/ chu bo 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa kho na'i rgyur gyur nas yul 'dir longs spyod dang 'bru sna dang shing sna la sogs pa smin cing rgyas pa'i smon lam bden stobs yang dag pa gsungs pa'i mthu yin khu5ga bro//gnyis pa/ yul gyi che ba dang 'dod yon bshad pa ni/ de ltar skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'bru sna lnga smin zhing / ljon shing gi rigs dang / rtsi thog phun sum tshogs pa skye bas 'dod dgu'i dpal yon phun —4—

sum tshogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel bas na chos tshigs kyi yul dbus yin no/ /myang stod gzhung na bstan pa snga dar gyi dgon pa bdun yod/rtsis kyi rgyal po'i lha khang yod/ rgya phibs gsum yod/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yan (spyi yi lugs la mnga' bdag khri ral yan snga dar du bzhed )la snga dar 'cha'/rgya phibs shar ma 'di rgyal po srong btsan sgam po yin/ de'i 'og gyi rgya phibs 'di mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan yin/ de'i 'og gyi rgya phibs 'di rgyal po ral pa can gyi yin/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs yon ljongs lhag ma la/ rtag rtse na rte ra dgon pa lnga/ btsas phu na bde phu dgon pa lnga/ bye ma'i mda' na bye mda' rgya phibs lnga/ rgyang ro na rkyang bu'i lha khang lnga/ rgyang mkhar na ba 'ug lha khang lnga/ rgyal po khri ral gyi skabs yon ljongs lhag ma la/ spos khang gi mda' na lha chung dgon pa yod/ khri ral gyi skabs spas lung dgon pa la lha do lnga/ nyi ma'i nub phyogs na rdo rje gdan lnga/ spos khang na 'ja' lung lnga/ nor bu khyung rtse'i ltag na ga phu dgon pa lnga/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su rgyal po'i mkhar la snga ba bod chos rgyal gdung rgyud rje gri gum btsan pos gnang ba'i pho brang rtse chen lnga/ de rjes chos rgyal gdung rgyud rje dpal mgon btsan gyi mkhar la shel dkar rgyal rtse lnga/ chos rgyal gdung rgyud kyi thog ma dbra rgod gdong btsan gyi lung rgyugs pa/ de rjes dpon yig 'phags pa dpal la rgya rgyal pos gnang ba'i lcang ra lnga/ byang ri se brag pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba 'dra/ de na bla ma snyug ston gyis bsre brag g.ya' lung gi dgon pa btab cing / bya gnam la 'phur ba la sgom thebs/ nam phyed chu gnyid du 'gro ba snyel 'byung ba'i rlung 'og tu —5—

non/ rlung sems la rang dbang thob pa'i bla ma yin/ bse brag g.ya' lung 'di o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ngan dgu bzlog nus pa'i gtor ma 'dra ste sa bkra ngan pa bzlog nas bzang por 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /myang stod la ltas ngan gyi ri bcu gsum yod/ 'brong rtse'i ri 'di 'brong po ra brdar ba 'dra/dran ma'i ri 'di gces phrug thang la bskyur ba 'dra/ sbal gdong gi ri 'di rnga mong gwa pa chu 'thung ba 'dra/ sham bu rtse dgu'i ri 'di glo ba chus bshal ba 'dra/ rje gri gum btsan po'i ri 'di rta sga sked nyag 'dam la bzhag pa 'dra/ spa lung gi ri 'di bal mo phyag 'tshal ba 'dra/ rtsa 'khor gyi ri 'di mdze pho sbra phub pa 'dra/rgyal mkhar rtse'i ri 'di spre'u rgyab lag tu bskyigs pa 'dra/ btsas nang gyi ri chung gsum po 'di 'gong po bal 'dab rgyag pa 'dra/ btsas nang gi ri bo che 'di zangs mo che kha sbubs pa 'dra/ chu rag gtsog po'i ri 'di a dkar po mgo gzhug slogs pa 'dra/ sa bkra dang ri bkra ngan pa thams cad byang ri pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba 'dra la/ bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi rtags mtshan bzang po chang ba 'dis ngan pa thams cad non pas mi rnams tshe ring zhing / mi nor dar rgyas che ba/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi nor rnams 'dir 'dus/ bla ma so so sku tshe ring zhing chos 'phel ba/ bar chad mi ldang ba sogs bkra shis grangs kyis brgyan pas phun sum tshogs tshul ches mang ngo / / byams pa'i rnam 'phrul chos kyi rgyal po chen po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis btab cing / de dag gi thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas bshad sgrub kyi dgon pa khyad par can chos grwa chen po dpal 'khor bde chen dang / dus —6—

kyi 'khor lo'i snyan brgyud zab mo sbyor ba la nying lag drug /nye brgyud ring brgyud kyi nyams len la rtag tu gzhol ba sgrub sde ri khrod dga' ldan dang rgyud brtag gnyis las/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /ces pa'i don ltar chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gnas/ skyes bu mchog ste bcos ma'i 'ching ba thams cad rdog brdzis su mdzad/ de sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par tshangs rgya ba'i chos zab mdzub btsugs su bstan pas/ rdo rje slob ma thams cad 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bsdu tshom zhig /ri'i bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ lto gos la gyong skur/ gtam la gtsigs su mi byed pa/ phyi dben pa/ nang mal stan/ gsang ba lus gnad/ de kho na nyid la dmigs pa gar gtad kyi steng du spang la be phur btab pa bzhin sdod tshugs pa de bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs nas/ srid pa'i rwa ba dum bur gtub pa la mngon par phyogs pa'i dben gnas rin chen sgang / gdan sa chen po gnas rnying dang /gdan sa chen po rwa lung dang / rtse chen chos sde dang / lcang ra lha khang dang /'khrungs yul dpal chen dang / bye mda' lha khang dang / gnas gsar lha khang dang / 'brong rtse chos sde dang / rgyal gnas lha khang la sogs te chos sde dang lha khang yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas shing / de dag gi byin rlabs kyis tshong 'dus kyi 'dod yon che bas yo byad ma tshang ba med pas yul gyi che ba'o/ /gsum pa/ yul 'dzin pa'i gang zag gi skyes bu mi rabs rim par byung ba bshad pa ni/ myang stod 'dre dang khyung gis 'dzin/ myang bar btsad po 'a zhwas —7—

'dzin/ myang smad lce dang dpyal gyis 'dzin/ zer ba'i 'dzin tshul dang / de nas hor gyi khrims byung tshul dang / de nas dpal ldan sa skya ba'i lung rgyugs tshul dang / de nas chos rgyal chen po'i gdung rabs kyi yig cha las gsal ba 'dir ma bris/ de yang phu gnod spyin gang bzang dang / mda' bcug sa yu ba gdong yan myang gser gzhud ring mo dngos bshad pa la/ mtha' yas bskal par rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /rgyal dang gsang bdag rnam mang thos sras kyis/ /bka' las mi 'da' nor spyin bstan pa skyongs/ /gnod spyin dbang po gang ba bzang po'i gnas/ /zhes pa'i gang ba bzang po'i bzhugs gnas gangs ri dkar po gur phub la tog shel dkar gyi mchod rten rtse lnga bzhag pa 'dra ba la myang yul rgya gar gnyis pa 'di la phu gtad/ mda' bcug sa yu ba gdong nya mo chab la 'dzul ba 'dra ba la gzhug gtad pa'i yul 'di la myang stod smad bar gsum du bshad pa'i stod kyi yul ni phu ri nang spang khar la gtad/ mda' gsham phu rtse dgu la gtad pa 'di la tshong 'dus chen po gcig /mi rigs mi gcig pa gnyis/ 'brog sde chen po gsum/ zong sna mi gcig pa gsum yod lags/ tshong snye 'dus chen po ni sngar rgyang ro sa ma na yod/ de rjes gnas rnying du 'dus pa yin/da lta ni myang stod dang bar gnyis kyi tshong 'dus dpal 'khor chos sder 'dus pa snang / mi rigs gnyis ni drag pa rnams dge ba dkar/ sangs rgyas la dad pa'i shas che/ zhan pa rnams dmyal bar lhung nges pa'i sdig shas che/ 'brog sde gsum ni rgyang ro/ nying ro/ gang ro gsum/ zong sna gsum ni zhwa mo/ rnga ma/ snam bu gsum/ gtsang khad brag gdong yan gyi zhing pas phu'i 'brog pa ma theg ste/ tshag —8—

po khog tshong du byed pa de na yod/ bar gyi yul ni phu sa ma sa phu la gtad/mda' gab phya dkar la gtad pa 'di la tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa sngar thu gu na yod/ phyis 'dus byung du 'dus/ mi rigs gnyis ni drag pa blun la rang 'dod che ba kho na 'dzin pa phyug shas che/ zhan pa spyang la smra chu rgod pa dbul shas che/ 'brog sde gsum ni rgyang / dkyil/ mang gsum/ zong sna gsum ni sle'u dang /grum ze/ 'phying pa gsum/ sku ri yan gyi bod 'brog 'tshogs pas shas phyed tshong du byed pa de na yod/ myang smad kyi yul gyi phu 'khor stod la kha la gtad/ mda' chu sgo'i gzhung la gtad pa 'di la tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa/ sngar tshong 'dus mgur mo na yod/ phyis zhwa lu ru 'dus/ da lta bsam rtser tshong 'dus pa 'di ga yin/ mi rigs gnyis ni drag pa mdzangs shing snying rje che ba sogs shes rab kyi nor bdun tshang ba shas che/ khrel zhan pa ngo tsha gzhung dang phyi thag med pa khram shas che ba/ 'brog sde gsum ni sgro lung pa dang / lcags pa/ ra dang gsum/zong sna gsum ni sked rag dang / ther ma/ lham zon gsum/ bcug sa yu ba ga1sno nga yar stabs kyi 'brog pas mda'i zhing pa'i gya ma theg ste sha gzug tshong du byed pa de na yod/ de ltar yul ljongs gsum gyi phu shar la gtad/ mda' lho nub la gtad yod lags/ de yang phu nas bltas na/ mda' mthong / mda' nas bltas na phu mthong ba'i gser lung rig pa'i 'byung gnas 'di la grong brdal dang / grong khyer bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i yul ljongs khyad par du 'phags pa yin lags/ 'di yan gyi lung bshad bdag chen rab 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa yin lags/ phu ha bo gang bzang zhes gnod spyin mched gsum —9—

ni/ gang ba bzang po/ cho bo bzang po/ nor bu bzang po dang gsum mo/ /sras mkha' ro'i stag btsan lnga brgya dang bcas gnod sbyin chen po bzhugs pa'i bsti gnas gangs ri dpal dang ldan zhing / yid 'ong lhun sdug rab dkar mdangs su bkra ba'i mchog sa 'dzin gyi gtso bor ming du grags te/ 'brug pa thams —cad mkhyen pas/ /sa ya gi'i nyi ma nub kyi phyogs/ /sprin dkar po lding zhing 'khrigs pa'i 'og /gangs gru gsum gnam la 'phyong 'dra ba/ /lha gnod sbyin dbang po gang ba bzang / /zhes byang shar ngos su tsha lam tsam phyin pa'i gang bzang 'di nyid/ (gangs ri 'di la shes rab bzang i slob ma dus wor sbyor drug gi nyams mthar phyin pa zhig gis ga mo lung du sgrub pa mdzad/ mthar sku lus ma spangs par 'ja' lus su grub nas gang bzang gi chos gnas su bzhugs/ rtogs ldan sngo nyal mar grags/ phyi ru yul la cer gyi ltos dang / snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan ma 'di shes so/)ri 'di'i nub ldebs la slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis yang dag thugs kyi sgrub pa la rgyun ring bzhugs pa'i gnas ga mo lung na pad+ma'i sgrub phug dang / sgrub chu tshe chu mar grags pa dri zhim 'o ma'i kha dog 'dra ba rgyan du 'bab pa/ lho stod gu ru lha khang gi jo bo thugs rje chen por grags pa rang byon byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi'i gter rgyar 'dzum pa'i khyad par can de/ rgya gar nas spyan drangs nas nying ro sna thod seng phug sman chu zer ba'i sa skor der gter du bzhugs pa/ slar pad+mas jo bo rin po che gter nas spyan drangs te ga mo lung du gter du sbas pa de nyid chos dbang gis kha byang rnams slob ma la gtad/ gter bdag rin chen gyis bkug nas bka' bsgo 'di la gtod gsungs/ len mi la bka' lung gnang ba/— /0—

g.yas ri btsan dmag chas pa 'dra ba/ g.yon ri bdud dmag chas pa lta bu/ rdza ri phyugs glu len pa/ mtsho maṇ+ḍal lta bu/ gangs kyi sbugs 'dom bco brgyad tsam bgrod pa'i sgrub phug lho bstan gyi nang nas rdo sku'i sgrub thabs/ lhung bzed/mkhar gsil/ po ti/ chos gos sogs rab byung mdzod lnga'i sgrub thabs gdan drangs/ jo btsun sogs ra lung pa rnams kyis sa bcud 'chor bas ma ston zer bkag na yang bgegs med du thon/ chos dbang rang la phul/ nang rwa lung pa kha drag pa re zhig kha mo khyung dkar gyi khyung chu'i 'og tu sbas/ de rang la bka' babs dang / nga rang dang slob dpon sbed mkhan yin pas rang nor rang gi len pas khyed rnams kyi bkag pas mi khegs gsungs/ thong lcags rdzong gi byang 'bum thang du bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pas/ sa bdag rgan po zhig la 'dir rten khyad par can 'di 'gro ba sems can tshogs gsog pa'i rten du bzhugs pa'i lha khang zhig rtsig pa'i sa blangs pas/ rgan mo la dris yi zer nas rten 'brel ma 'grigs pa sogs lho stod gu ru lha khang bsam 'grub bde ba chen po'i lha khang du bzhugs so/ / (zhib par chos dbang gi gter 'gyung du gzigs shig)gangs ri 'di la slob dpon gyi sgrub phug dang gnas gzhi yod pa ste/ nub na ga mo lung / byang na zam 'dra/ shar na mkha' ro la skya phug gangs nyug gi mda'/lho na chang g.yo ste bzhi'o/ /mnga' bdag gu ru chos dbang gis gter nas bton pa da lta lho stod gu ru lha khang gi rten gtsor bzhugs pa de yin no/ /nub chu ldan ma'i phyogs mi ring ba'i sa na gnas mchog ra lung zhes pa de/sems nyid lta ba gnam gyi she mong des/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go sar dbang — 11 —

bskur ba/ /dus gsum chos kyi rgyal po ra lung pa/ /phan bde'i lung rnams 'gyed mkhan de la bsngags/ /grub gnas gang ba'i zla rgyas 'di nang du/ /sbyin pa'i spyan ras drang srong la gzigs de'i/ /ngang tshul ri mo thugs rje lha'i nor bus/ /bris pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal cis min/ /'di skor mi zad 'khor ba'i 'jigs bral par/ rdo la bris mtshungs dam pas zhal bzhes pa/ khres ldan dge ba'i gter 'dzin thams cad dang / /'dir shog legs byas kun gyi dga' ston dpal/ /zhes bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing mchog dam par gyur pa ni gdan sa chen po dpal ra lung thil zhes bya ba grub pa'i gan+dho la (bod skad du dri'i gtsug lag khang zer/) chen po 'di thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa bcu gsum gyi ngo mtshar bar gyur bas so /dang po/ gnas 'di khyad par du 'phags pa'i sa'i dpyad dang ldan pa ni/sa gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha bye ba lta bu/ gangs dang / rdza dang / she dang / spang gi ri thams cad kyi kun nas bskor te 'dud pa lta bu chu phran brgya phrag du ma nang du 'du ba/ de'i gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad par grub bo/ /logs bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan pa yin te/ dgon sde'i gdong ri dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba lta bu/ rwa la'i rtse mo rin po che'i gdugs phub pa lta bu/ spos skya'i rgyab ri bum pa gang ba lta bu/ btsan chu'i ri rgyal mtshan sgreng ba lta bu/ yang dgon gyi ri dang de'i mdun gser nya ma 'khyil lta bu/ sgo mo'i thang gser gyi 'khor lo bskor ba lta bu/ spen thang phyogs kyi ri pad+ma'i sdong po kha bye la chu phran rgya bya kha sprod 'gying ba lta bu/ rgya mo na ga thugs —12—

dpal be'u lta bu/ de lta bu'i sa gnas la rten nas sgrub gnas 'di chags/ de'i rten 'brel las kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir snying po don gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i sgrub grwa bye ba snyed chags pa yin te/ chos rje'i gsung las kyang ngas dgon pa ngam shod du btab na kha drag /skyid shod du btab na 'du long che/ khu le na mthil du btab na nor che yang bstan pa la de tsam phan khebs ma mthong /'dir btab na sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar 'gyur ba yin gsungs pas khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /gnas de la gnas pa'i lha khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ sgrub gnas chen po de'i rgyab 'om thang nas stag ma'i bar gyi gangs ri'i 'phreng ba la gnod spyin nor bu bzang po zhes grags te/ de'i rgyu mtshan byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po bskal pa bzang po 'di'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung ba la/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi rgyal po gang ba bzang po'i sras su legs par 'khrungs shing / de'i mawo gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po zhes bya ba yin la/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mthu stobs kyi rdo rje lag tu gtad nas/ gsang ba thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba'i gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po des bod kha ba can gyi 'dre srin gdug pa can gyi kha non du sprul pa'i sku re bzhugs shing de'i dbang gis gnas 'di byin rlabs kyi mthu che zhing bkra shis lags/ g.yang chags pa yin no/ /de'i yab gang ba bzang pos kyang ha 'o'i gangs mdun sar mdzad pa gnyis kyis — 13—

'dir bod khams thams cad longs spyod 'gyung ba la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la bkod pa dang mtshungs pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ yul 'di la 'brog khu le/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu'am bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan tshong khe shes rab seng ge myang stod khu le btab cing bzung zer ba yig cha khungs thub na yod pa de/ yol thog 'bebs kyi khu le'i ri la rmog pa'i dgon pa btab pa de nye logs shig na yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa kun dgas blo gtad kyi jo mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nang tshan jo mo chos skyabs ni yul myang stod khu ler 'khrungs/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas dang mjal/ gdams pa thob/ dka' thub chu thung kho na la lo bcu gnyis byas/nyams su blangs pas grub pa thob bo/ /jo bo rje a ti shu'i slob ma yol ston sku mched gsum du grags pa'i yol chos dbang / drang srong / thog 'bebs gsum gyi khu le'i ri la rmog pa'i dgon pa btab/ khu le'i 'brog pa chags/ ri rgya klung rgya dam po btsugs/ bod 'brog de rnams dang yon mchod sbrel zer ba gnas rnying pa'i gang mdo na yod cing / dgon ro yang da lta yod do/ /rtsa'o nang gi 'dre yul e kha la btsas yan la khu ler ming du grags/myang stod 'dre dang khyung gi 'dzin ces zer ba/ bod gnam gru bzhi na 'dre'i ma ṇi zer ba'i byin rlabs can yin pa 'dug na'ang / phyis blon po rnams kyis rmog 'dre can gyi dpes bgegs la ngos 'dzin par gnang / zhes ming du chags pa las phyis sprul pa'i ra ma dkar mo zhig phyugs rdzis nyin gyi ri la brlags pa nam zhig rtsad chod pa na/ da lta'i gtsug lag khang chen mo yod pa'i thad 'dir rdo —14—

zhig la 'o ma 'thor/ de drod kyis bsro kyin 'dug pa mthong nas/ der phyin pas yi ge ā:hūṃX rang byon 'bur du dod pa rnyed/ de dus grub thob gling phebs pa dang 'grigs nas de la phul/ gad ngos la sgrub phug bzos nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po der bzhugs/ sprul pa'i ra mas lung bstan pas/ (byon pa'i rdo gzhong da lta mo dgon/ gzhon pa rnams kyis thug sdor brdungs)ra lung zhes de nas grags shing /rang byon 'di sna phu chos lung gi khyad 'phags gsum gyi gral du da lta yang bzhugs so/ /skyes bu dam pas byin gyis brlabs pas khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ grub thob chen po gling chos kyi rgyal po gtsang pa rgya ras nas dus deng sang gi bar zhing 'di nyid kyi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas tshe gcig lus gcig gi rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag skyes bu chen po de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas khyad par du 'phags pa rgya gar rdo rje gdan bzhin no/ /nang rten khyad du 'phags pa la/ sku rten ni/ chos rje'i sku 'bag khams gsum zil gnon dge ba dang mi dge ba'i ltas zhal ras la mngon sum du bzhugs pa lta bur gsal ba/ tshe 'di'i zhen pa can gyi skye bo la yang yud tsam chags pa med pa zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin skyes nus pa de dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dbon la sogs pa'i zhal ngo'i nang rten/ smad 'brug gi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba lo ras pa'i nang rten mgon po tsa ri ras chen gyis bzhengs shing rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa dang / stod 'brug gi bstan pa'i mnga' — 15—

bdag rgyal ba rgod tshang ba'i nang rten grub thob o rgyan pas bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad pa brtsams te/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi thugs dam mgon po'i rdo sku dpal rga los sbyan drangs pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dngul ljang brdungs kyi sku rgyan rnams gser ljang brdungs dang g.yu sbyang spel legs kyi phras mdzes pa/ rgyab tho lnga pa pad+ma dkar pos bzhengs pa'i bar gyi gtsug lag khang gong 'og til gyi gang bu ltar bkang ba rnams so/ /gsung rten ni/ rin po che skra rje bya sngon pos bris pa'i glegs bam/ gan shog mthing shun la gser bzang pos bris pa'i bka'u 'gyur/ 'bum shog mo che la sogs pa'i skya pod brgya phrag mang po dang / khyad par rgyud sde bzhi'i khong pa'i snying lta bu'i man ngag rnams o rgyan gyi dharmā gañji dang mtshungs par bzhugs pa yin pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /thugs rten khyad par 'phags pa ni/ chos rje'i zhal nas kho bo'i shul tu rten bkra shis sgo mangs su bgyis na dkar rgyud kyi bstan pa mtha' rgyas su 'gyur ba yin/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas dbon gyis gser 'bum 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan bzhengs pa'i nang na chos rje'i thugs dang / dbu stod la byon pa'i rigs gsum mgon po dang / dkar rgyud gong ma la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten tshad med pa bzhugs pas/ 'di'i rten 'brel las sgrub gnas 'di gdan sa mar gyur pa yin no/ /phyi rten du mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs 'di bzhengs pa yin zhing / 'di phal cher grub/ gañji ra nyi ma'i snying po zhag 'ga'i bar du bzo bos skyon ma tshugs shing / tha ma'i nyin de dag gro la log pa'i —16—

shul du sangs rgyas dbon ltag rir bzhugs dus mngon par mkhyen pas gzigs nas/ rkyang mo grus ma zhig la bcibs te rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir byon no/ /gañji ra legs par skyon/ phyir yang rkyang la bcibs nas thegs la khad pa khong rnams gro grol bas mthong ste rgyugs pas ma zin/ chibs pa'i pha bong de la rkyang gi rmig rjes gsal bar byon/ de rnyed pa da lta'i bar du yod do/ /de nas rab tu gnas pa'i dus su gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad nam mkha' la lhags nas shis pa brjod pa kun gyis mthong ba byung / zhes grags shing mchod rten de'i sku che ba'i yon tan rgyal ba rgod tshang pas nga'i sgom ma sle'u thul can 'di rnams nyin mo nga la chos zhus/ nub mo ra lung gi na ro pa'i phyi rten la skor ba bskor nas/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du tshogs kyi bskal pa len pa la rgyun du 'gro ba yin zhes gsungs pa ltar du grub chen o rgyan du byon pa na yul de'i bu mo rnams kyi ngang tshul rgyal ba rgod tshang bas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar du gzigs nas/ mchod rten 'di'i bsngags pa che cher brjod par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba yang dgon pa ra lung bskor la phebs dus mnal lam du mchod rten chen po 'di'i bum nang du rdo rje 'chang nas rgyal ba rgod tshang ba la thug gi bar du dkar rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad gral mthar chags su bzhugs pa las mi la ras pa'i bzhugs khri stong par 'dug pa la khyod sdod rgyu yin zhes gzigs pa sogs kyi che ba brjod par mdzad cing / da lta skor mi nyung dus su yang skor lam mang pos phyin pa ltar byang bar 'gyur ba kun mthun snang —17—

grub pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rjes bzhengs pa'i rgyal dbang rje'i dngul 'bum dang gser 'bum/ rgyal tshab dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tswa'i rnam 'phrul man ngag lan cig thos pas kyang srid pa'i rgyud pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gdung ril po gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gser 'bum bkra shis dpal 'bar thog tshad gsum lhag pa rgyu dang bzo dang rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa phul du phyin pa de la sogs pa'i mchod rten spos skya'o gtsug lag khang chen mo yongs su gang ba rnams so/ /rang byon khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig la spyan ras gzigs nyi shu rtsa gcig byon pa'i gsum rang byon khyad 'phags kyi gral du bzhugs/ gzhan gdan sa 'di nyid kyi phyi rten nang rten gnyis su re re/ chos rje gzhon nu'i nang rten dgon khang gi mchod sdong gser ra bre gang gsol ba'i nang du gcig 'brug gi lha mo ched dang mchod rten gnyis su re re/ mdo mkhar dang chos rdzong gi gdung rten la re re/ byang u ri dang lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du re re yod pa'i phyi ma da lta bya yul gyi gsal rje'i sgrub sde na bzhugs so/ /sbu tra dang ni ring na re re dang / ti si'i chos (‘sna ka kya dka' dum na gcig yod pa dang da lta gu ger byon zhes grags/ gnas rnying dang chos lung tshogs pa la rten rjes mdzad pa re re/ 'bras mo jo btsun la gnyis yod pa'i gcig 'bras mo'i mchod rten na dang / gcig lho dgon pa yul gyi ljongs pa'i lag nang / dpon grags pa ye shes kyi rten skal du khams rong pa gser bar — 18—

gcig brdzangs/ hor rgyal tho gan the mur gyis chos rje btsun pa bla ma'i mchod gnas su btegs/ hor dud stong dgu brgya 'ja' sa dang bcas gtsug lag khang gong 'og la thig rtsa blangs pas/ ding phon gyis bla bre pad+ma 'bum ldan dang /stong ldan/ dar khra/ a ka ru nag po dang/ nya lcibs kyi lcog tse la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa phul ba'i gdab lan du gcig brdzangs pa rnams yin lags/ de dag las mchog tu gyur pa chos rje nyid dang gnyis su med par rang byon kha sa rla ṇi 'di yin la/ 'di yang sangs rgyas dbon gyi sku thog la zhig po nyi ma seng ges bsnams nas las stod phyogs la 'bul rgyu la byon/ mchod rten chen mo'i gañji ra gdugs za ra tshags dang bcas legs par bsgrubs nas/phyir log khar khrom chen mo'i sar zhig po nyams 'bar bas rten gzigs pa rgan rgon dbul po gnyis kyis rnyed/ de gnyis longs spyod can du gyur/ de gnyis kyis rgyal ba rgod tshang ba la 'bul skabs su rgyal ba rgod tshang ba'i zhal nas 'o skol gyi 'di ru de zhag chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras 'byon par 'dug da lta bsu ba la 'gro gsungs pa dang rgan rgon gnyis dang phrad pas phyag mdzad pa sogs rgod tshang ba'i phyag tu byung / chos rje rgod tshang bas gdan sa ra lung du 'bul chen gsum mdzad pa'i phyi ma ra lung gdan sar phul/ rang byon 'di dang po 'brug lha bas bcom pa'i dus bcar gyis zim pa dang / 'bri khung gling log gi dus su sku sngo sangs su gyur pa byung zhes grags shing / phyis rjes su'ang khrom gyi dbus su yal ba/ zhag bdun gsol ba btab pas slar phebs pa dang / mi dge na sku yo ba dang / nogs pa dang / dge na shel dri ma med pa lta bur yong ba — 19—

dang / da lta kun gyi mthong snang du grub bo/ /da lta'i bzhugs khang ga dza mu tig la sogs rin po che sna bdun las grub pa 'di dge slong pad+ma dkar po bdag gis rgyu sbyar dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs su bkod pa'i khyad par can thams cad kyis 'phags par byas pa 'di'i rgyu la rin thang rtsi na gser zho stong phrag gsum du long pa tsam song ngo / /chos rje'i sku tshig las byon pa'i 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal bzhugs khang bkra shis sgo mangs/ yang sku tshig las byon pa'i 'phags pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhugs khang cho 'phrul mchod rten rin po che spos skya'i sku gdung las byon pa'i khar sa rla ṇi bzhugs khang lha babs mchod rten/ rje kun dga' seng ge'i zhun thigs las byon pa'i dbang po'i sku ngo mtshar ba bzhugs khang byang chub mchod rten/ yang kun dga' seṅge'i zhun thigs las byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa bzhugs khang dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sku gdung zhun thigs las byon pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ bla ma yu mo che ba'i dbu thod las byon pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa bzhugs khang myang 'das mchod rten/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bzhugs khang gnyis med ye shes mchod rten/ 'di rgyal mkhar rtse'i 'phel gdung las mched pa rje mar pa'i tshems gdung logs 'phel gdung gis brgyan pa gdan sa gro bo lung nas byung ba bzhugs khang lha babs mchod rten yang rje mar pa'i tshems logs 'phel gdung bzhugs khang dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ yang rje mar pa'i sku gdung las byon pa'i 'phel gdung 'di gzhis ka sne pa'i phyag na gdung shā ri —20—

ram sran ma sbom shos tsam gcig yod/ phyis sne'u 'thor zhig la song skabs dkon gnyer bas 'khyer nas stod lung sgang du slebs/ de nas 'brug pa rin po ches der phebs dus gzigs phul bas phyag mthil rang du de las ring bsrel bdun cu 'dzag pa ma god par 'dir bzhugs pa yin la/ de nas bzung ma bu thams cad las ring bsrel tshad med 'phel bas/ da lta mar pa'i ring bsrel gar bzhugs yang 'di las mched par snang / bzhugs khang cho 'phrul mchod rten/ chos rje'i 'phel gdung brgyad bzhugs khang bkra shis sgo mangs/ 'di rje 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal pos khyad 'phags bzhugs khang bzo dus kha sa rla ṇi phyag tu bzhes/ sku khrus gsol bas phyag tu ring bsrel dgu babs pas gcig phyi la shor/ lhag ma 'dir bzhugs/ yang chos rje'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang cho 'phrul mchod rten/ yang chos rje'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ yang chos rje'i gdung shā ri ram bzhugs khang dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ yang chos rje'i dbu thod las byon pa'i ring bsrel gsum bsgrigs bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang pad sprungs mchod rten/ rje nyi ma'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge'i tshems las byon pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ rgyal ba'i dbang po sku sogs g.yas pa las byon pa'i 'phags pa kha sa rla ṇi bzhugs khang byang chub mchod rten/ yang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i tshems gsum dang 'phel gdung gsum la bzhugs khang mchod rten/ pad —21—

sbungs/ dbyen 'dum/ byang chub mchod rten/ ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i tshems dung g.yas 'khyil gsum tshogs su byon pa bzhugs khang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa'i tshems la dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gcig byon pa bzhugs khang dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa'i tshems 'phel gdung bzhugs khang rnams rnam rgyal mchod rten/phal cher rje 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal pos bzhengs par 'dug/drug tsam da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rgyal sras dbon gyis bzhengs pa de dag kyang bum pa gser ljang brdungs la g.yu dang mu tig gi phra tshoms bang rim dang /bre dngul dkar/ seng khri gser zangs/ gdugs spos shel las bsrubs pa/phyi ljang gser gyi drwa mig gis bskor ba/ che chung rje 'brug pa rin po che'i phyag tho re ma yin te khru tshad kyis rkang gang ba re 'dug go /zhar la 'gro ba'i mgon po'i sbur khang rdo la 'khrungs pa'i ā gnyis/ hri gcig bzhugs khang zi'u lha khang / sangs rgyas dbon gyi phyag rjes rdo nag la byon pa bzhugs khang zi'u lha khang / rnal 'byor chos 'byung gi dbu thod las āXhūṃX gsal bar byon pa bzhugs khang rgya phibs tog dang bcas pa ljang ser/rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa byang chub ljon shing las grub pa bzhugs khang rgya phibs tog dang bcas pa 'gro ba'i mgon po zhal bzhugs pa'i thugs dam bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa bzhugs khang zi'u lha khang / paṇa chen shākya shrī'i thugs dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs khang zi'u sna khang / na ro pa'i phyag mkhar chu shing nag po sogs so/ /—22rnga

gang dar ba'i bstan pa khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud/ bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor zhes bya ba jo bo na ro pa'i khyad par gyi chos su grags pa rje btsun mar pas bsre ba dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa'i khyad chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes gsungs pa'i gzhung bka' yang dag pa zhes gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gter nas bzhes pa'i chos skor zab mo rnams dang / 'chad tshul las bla med kyi rgyud sde brgya phrag gcig gi lam rim brgya phrag gcig gi khongs su gnas pa dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag snyan rgyud nor bu skor gsum zhes grags pa'i khyad par can de dang / kye'i rdo rje rdzogs rim 'byung bar ro snyoms zhes grags pa dang / pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim lnga'i khrid/ ('di mar pa'i thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i rdzogs rim brgya rtsa brgyad las gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs 'di shin tu zab ste mar pa lo rnye'i gsung las rim lngar dmar khrid ma gtogs pa'i zhes gsungs) ma hā ma ya'i rnal 'byor pa/ (gsung mgur 'dra) (gdan bzhi pa la rdzogs rim chu shing snye ma ) (mar lugs kyi dmar khrid brgya rtsa ) (mar lo'i gsung las khrid chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes grogs sgom chen tshogs kyang da re brod )dang dpal/ (nub phyogs/ o rgyan yul du grub thob o rgyan pas ye shes mkha' 'gro la dngos grub gsan pa'i ) dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag rdo rje gsum dang rdo rje bzhis bsnyen sgrub sbyor ba yan lag drug rgyas bsdus kyi bzhag pa dang gsang ba 'dus pa dang /sam bhā ṭi las byung ba lam zab bla mar bsgrubs pa mdo rgyud gcig tu bsre ba rten 'o brel gyi skor/ grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug la sogs pa'i man ngag gi snying po phyag rgya chen po/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung zin bris las 'phros nas —23—

stod 'brug la grags pa khrid chen brgyad/ smad 'brug la grags pa thub pa lnga/bar 'brug la grags pa dge sbyor bdun pa/ gzhan yang bde dgyes la sogs pa rgyud 'grel dbang dang bcas pa/ gsang ba bstan pa dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brang nas sgrub thabs legs tshogs bcas pa'i gdams ngag thams cad kyi gang zag cig car ba dang / thod brgal ba dang rim gyis pa rang rang gis rdo rje 'chang gi sa cha bkra'i bar mdzad pa yin te/ de ltar yang rgyal dbang chos rjes chos zab dgu 'dus pa'i pho brang la 'brug dang ra lung mi zer ram zhes gsungs shing / skyes bu gsum gyi lam dwags po'i chos bzhi zhes grags pa dag kyang snang ngo / ('di'i 'gab tu mar pa'i gsung mgur 'bri) /de las 'ongs pa'i rgyud pa khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ de lta bu'i chos lugs 'di dag kyang rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa ma chad cing / gzhan la ma bltos pas na/ pha rjes bus zin pa sha stag ste/ rgyal dbang chos rje sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bcos ma ma yin pa zab gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du ngo sprod par byed pa rtogs pa don gyi dbang chog sems la bskur bas/ snang srid sku gsum gyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i dbang gis chu bo gzhung ma nyams pa sogs rgyud pa 'di yang rgya gar yul dbus su bram ze sa ra ha nas brtsams/ pū dril nag sogs dang / nub phyogs o rgyan yul du phyag rdor sprul pa drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin/ rgyal po'i bu mo rol ba mo nas slob dpon lā wa pa'i bar dang / rgya gar lho phyogs su klu sgrub/ sha wa ri dbang phyug sogs dang / shar phyogs su slob —24—

dpon ti lbi pa/ byang phyogs su na ro pa ste rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi phal che ba la brgyud pa kho nar snang / bod du mar pas/ rje bcun la/ bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang / /nying slob nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i bu ni rje zla 'od gzhon nu dang / rje btsun ras chung pa la sogs pa slob ma ni rje sgam po pa dang / dpal phag mo gru pa/ dbu lo/ lo gsum la sogs pa dang / yang slob ni grub chen gling / 'bri stag /tshal pa/ g.ya' bzang pa/ khro phu la sogs par gyes pa rnams so/ /nying slob ni chos kyi rgyal po gcang pa rgya ras pa ste 'di las stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu/ smad 'brug sa'i dregs pa lta bu/ bar 'brug dbu che nyis stong brgya las rgyud pa/ sangs rgyas dbon nas gdan sa rgyud de bzhir gyes shing / 'di'i bstan pas bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad khyab par grags so/ /de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu'i khyad par 'phags pa ni/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rigs kyi che ba ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po bzhugs dus rgya nag yul nas jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i gyad mchog gnyis 'ongs pa'i ming lha dga' dang klu dga' gnyis/ lha dga'i dbon sras las rim rgyud khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su rgya sang shi dang / gsal snang zhes chos bsgyur ba'i ched du dka' las mdzad pas rgyal po'i thugs la gces (gces pa'i ming sba zhes) btags so/ /sba gsal snang rab tu byung nas bsam yas su mkhan po'i dngos kyi gdan sa mdzad/ bod rgyal po'i bla mar gyur/ sang shi'i tsha bo khri ral gyi dus su rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba zhes grags pas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma la sogs pa la gshugs nas rigs —25—

sngags 'chang thams cad kyi rtse mor thon pa byung / des myang stod du dpal skyegs kyi skye gnas btab pas/ da lta gnas rnying du grags pa 'di yin/ de nas dus kyi dbang gis dbon sras stag tshal du 'phos/ de nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su rgya brtson 'grus seng ge zhes bya ba mkhas pa jo bo rje bod du gdan 'dren pa po de byung ba yin no/ /de'i dbon sras khu ler 'phos pa'i rgyud du chos rje 'di 'khrungs pa yin no/ /de yang gu ru chos dbang gi gter ma slob dpon pad+ma dang kha ri'i zhus lan du sa ral zhes pa'i lung gsum mdor/ (sa ral gyi 'og waṃ na ra shag bon ces/ thang yig las ra shag bon po mdos la mkhas pa 'byung zhes lung bstan pa'i 'byungs sa stong gog gcig yod) nor bu 'dzin pa'i sprul pa zhig pha bong sho 'dra'i kha nas chos 'chad rtsom zhes spyan ras gzigs yin pa dang / rat+na gling pa dang pad+ma gling pa'i gter yig tu slob dpon gyis na ro paṇa chen sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur bas/gcang pa rgya ras 'brug dang ra lung du 'byon zhes gsungs shing chos rje brten ras pa las phyis bstan pa la phan par dgongs nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dus su bla ma zhang g.yu brag pas na ro paṇa chen gyi skra gcod mkhan nga min pa su yod/ ces rgod ma dkar mo bzhon nas brgyugs pa dang / grub chen gling gi thol gyi gnas stod du dpral ba'i dkyil na mdongs gcig yod/ /mdongs de gling chen ras pa yin/ /mdongs kyi dkyil nas 'khyug cig byung / /'byug ste na ro paṇa chen yin/ zhes na ro par lung bstan pa dang / chos rje nyid kyis kyang de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i dbon rgyud la gdan rabs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du sdi nga na sgrunang /—26—

de dag gi bstan pa nyag phra ba'i skabs su sngar rgyal dbang rje byon pa lta bu chos rje rang gi sprul pa dgu byung ba yin te/ chos rje'i zhal chems su/ 'dir yang gdung gsob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dgus/ bla ma'i gdung 'dzin bstan pa rgya cher 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa sha stag 'byung ba yin te/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang bas/ sa byang phyogs bod kyi zhing khams su/ /nga thugs rje chen po rgyud pa la/ /khyad par lha yi rnam 'phrul ni/ /bcu phrag brgyad kyi bar du 'byung / /zhes de nyid kyi dbon rgyud la spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa brgyad cu dngos su gsungs shing / /bzhi zhar gyis bstan no/ /de ltar skyes bu dam pa 'ba' zhig ston pa por gyur pa'i nyan pa po'i slob ma dag kyang zab mo'i chos la mi skrag cing / skal pa dang ldan pa la rnam pa tha dad kyang rang bzhin gcig pa rdo rje slob dpon dang rgyud gcig pa lta bus 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /de nang nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka'i gnang ba thob cing gsung gi mdzod 'dzin pa la phra rags gong du dngos sam/ /sbas pa'i grub thob re dang phyogs su 'gran zla med pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed re 'byung zhes gtam du grags so/ /tshul ji ltar bzang ba khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ de lta bu nyan bshad mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gi dang por bla ma dam pa las legs par thos/ de nyan pa'i mdo nyid du sems dpa' dang sgom pa kho nas dus 'da' ba'i mthu dpal gyis bstan pa'i snying po bka' brgyud kyi sgrub pa'i nges pa la gzhol —27—

bas khyad par du 'phags so/ /'jig rten dbang po'i sprul pas byin brlabs pas/ /mchog gzigs mang po'i rim par 'byon pa'i zhing / /gdan sa chen po ra lung mthil zhes pa/ /lha mi'i mchod sde chen po yid 'ong 'di'o/ /des na 'di la mthong thos reg dran pa'i/ /'brel bas sbrel rnam dag pa'i skyo thang gi /sngon las kyis 'phangs de de nas drangs nas/ /mtho ris su bcug thar pa 'dren gyur cig /gtsang pa rgya ras 'brog khu le mthil lding du 'khrungs/ (sa ral rgya grong gi lho/'brog lhas gan log zhes ra lung nas nying ra la 'gro lam la yod/ 'brog pa skyas skyed khar grod phur 'khrungs/ ma 'jigs pas bskyur nas bzhag /na mthil du slebs pa dang a khu ma mdzes kyis khyod kyi skye rgu gar song smras pas/ grod pur skyes par 'jigs nas bskyur tshul smras pa dang / a khus chos gsungs pa'i pha bong sho 'dra ni sa ral slob dpon byang ba zhes grong sngags shig gi khang pa'i byang ba skyor na yod do/ /sgo bzhi dang ra lung gi bar lung dmar gyi shar na/ g.yu thog shes pa rgya brag rkang 'phrang gi nad sos pa'i gtang rag tu bud med mgo rgyan ma'i ro phul ba'i de'i rgyu mtshan gyis g.yu thog ces yongs su grags pa de yod/ lung dmar gyi 'og gzhis sdod ces pa na bon bo'i grub thob kun bzang gi sprul pa lha rje bar sgom zhig po zhes a dkar grub thob kun bzang a bskor gyi rgyud pa'i chu mgo gangs thug sku 'ja' lus su grub pa de 'khrungs pa glang ro gang pa phug ces/bon po mdo khams nas kyang mjal mi yong gi 'dug /ri shing pa dang sman ri ba 'ja' dar sding pa sogs nas mjal mkhan yong bar 'dug) ra lung gi chos gzhis ra thang (dge ba'i bshes gnyen ra thang ba zhes gtsang pa rgya ras rab tu byung ba yin kyang zer )gi thad kyi lha ri'i rgyab ri/ri〉na 'u brag ces pa'i lung par pha dam pa sangs rgyas dngos kyi slob ma sgom pa —28—
