dmar sgom la chig chod gsum gyi gdams pa sogs gnang ba'i grub thob dmar sgom pa khyad par can byung ba de'i dge dzin pa yod/ 'di nyid gong du sgom pa ltar yin cing / dmar sgom gyi mtshan gzhon nu shes rab nye gnas khyad par can dge bshes ngang pa/ 'u brag gi shing rnams lho nas chag gi brdungs pas/ phu khrol la khrol sgra dang bcas babs pas khro lar grags/ dmar stong stong phrag brgyad pa la grwa pa nyis stong brgyad brgya/ pod ti nyis stong brgyad brgya mnyam par byung bas/ de gnyis gang rung zhig mang yang bstan pa 'phel ba yong 'dug pa la/rten 'brel 'phyugs pas dar po ma byung / bde mchog gi lha sku brgya khye'u lo brgyad kyi tshad tsam bzhugs shing / dgon pa gcig la gsung rab 'di las mang ba mi 'dug ces grags/ dmar sgom la bon po zhig gis chags sdang bdud kyi bsdus pas rgan mo la g.yu byin te gsol ba ngan pa zhus nga/sa mkhyen te mi la ngang tshul mthun par phyis te/ nying ro sna thod kyi sman chu mkha' 'gros lung bstan/slob dpon gyis sman chu brgya rtsa sbas pa gter nas bton/ sman chu 'di khyad par du dug la phan pa gsungs so/ /phyis snyun gzhi las grol/ rnam grol gyi lam la gshegs so/ /gser 'bru seng ge rtse bas gdan drangs/ lha khang chen po'i dbu rtse bzhugs/ chos skyong dang gzhis bdag gi 'khu bzlog gi ser ba shor/ seng ge rtse pa gdung rabs chad pa 'di pas lan pa yin kyang zer ro/ /lha khang nang na (bla ma bran gyi dgon pa skyid khung zer ba 'di gzhis sdod par sgom 'khrungs pa'i 'og chu tshan dang nye ba na yod cing / chu tshan 'di nyid kyang pho rog rkang chag gis rnyed cing / bla ma bran don mtha' bral gyi —29—

grub pas khyad par rkang pa'i nad la phan cing / zam gdong gi gad pa 'bru gsum gyi gnas gog 'dir sho sgam bsdus cing lha sa dang lag sprel/ khyad par ra lung pa la shin tu gnod pa 'byung /'brug pa'i bstan pa/ rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad sgo bzhi tshal lam la 'dug pa yin zhes dang /gcang pa rgya ras kyi dbu skra yang skyid khung lha khang gi them pa'i 'og na mnan yod/ 'brug ris rnams rdog pa mi rgyag /phyi sku gnyer 'brug pa la mos pas sgo byang du sbos pas dad skor mi 'gro lha khang 'di na bran gyi sku gsung byon ma thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub la bran mtha' bral don stsal zhes pa'i gsung byon pa re zhig go ba ma byung / mdo smad du rtag tu phebs pa na gsung dang mthun pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs gsung ba 'dug mnga' bdag khri srong gi dus bran ka mu ru ti/ sangs rgyas gsang ba gdan 'dren mir btang ba mtsho ma pham nas log byon pa de dang khri ral gyi dus ban chen po dang /bran kha dpal gyi yon to dang sku rus kyi ming du 'dug cing / bla ma mi snyon zan chung rgya grong phu gsum na yod cing zhing la shwa ba byung dus lha mo dus mtshan ma zhing la shwa pa srungs shog gsungs pa dang / 'ur rdo rtog ge bsrung ba byung zhing / de'i sras bran ston mtha' bral zhes brgya sran dmar gsum zhes phu na bla ma gdugs thogs pa gsum/ bar du bon po rnga thogs pa gsum/ bar sgom/gur sgom da re/ gur sgom/ dgra bo ste bon po rnga thogs pa gsum/ mda' ru bshan pa gri thogs pa gsum/ bran ston mtha' bral gyi phyag nas ma rme ru skyes dang / ri bo 'dzin/ spang leb 'dzin te gshan pa gri thogs pa gsum zhes zer ) bran ston mtha' bral gyi phyag nas ma gtso bo thog sa gang tsam gyi dus gsum sangs rgyas de la deng sang skyid khung gi jo bo zer nas byin rlabs che zhing lo dus kyi skor chen byed/ de'i 'gram du bran ston mtha' bral dang / de'i skye ba man lung gu rle'i sku mi tshad tsam dang / de'i logs bris la man lung gu rle'i rnam thar zhib bkod po ṭa lar phebs pa tshun chad tha gtsang —30—

bal ris dngos shin tu gtsang ba khungs thub yod/ man lung bran ston mtha' bral gyi dgon pa yin la/ deng sang bran ston mtha' bral gyi dbon rgyud dang bcas pa myang stag rtse na man lung zer ba der yod pa yin/ bran ston gyi skye ba man lung gu rus kyang dgon pa 'di'i gdan sa mdzad pas ming man lung du thogs the rgo (mtha' bral gyi sras bran shes rab seng ge la yab kyis lung bstan/ stag rtser mtshan ldan gyi mkha' 'gro ma ban btsun gyi tshul du yod pas des rjes su bzung dang / nga'i skye ba zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ gsungs pa dang mthun par rjes su bzung nas sku lus sprum pa sbas thabs su g.yung gi phu stag lung dgon par man lung gu ru sku 'khrungs/ g.yung ba rnams dus bzang la mjal/ dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa la mthong skor gyi gnas rdzong 'dis ra lung pa la sogs 'gro ba mang por gnod pa 'dug pas skyes gsungs pa la grwa pas ma nyan pas thugs nges par 'byung ste rgya gar la gshegs/ phyis grwa ris dad pa can dang / slob ma yon bdag rnams la zhal ta tha tshig gsungs te slar rgya gar dang po ta la ru gshegs pa gda'/ man lung nang rol stag tshang na yod cing /bka' bsrung kyang a lci ma zhes gshin rje dus mtshan ma/ 'od can 'bar ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas khram shing dang / g.yon nad rkyal dang zhags pa bsnams pa gcig 'ong gi 'dug /rjes gnang bka' gtad zhu ba la yang gri re phyag rten du 'bul gyi 'dug pa skabs shig tu rgyud pa chad 'dug na/ zhal snga nas dbye ba zhes dge ldan ma'i bla ma zhig gis khams nas rnyed de rgyud pa gsos gda'/ zhib par man lung gu waṃ rnam thar du gzigs shig) /de'i 'og cig na kha mo zer ba'i dgon pa 'di ka ma ba'i zhang bu gcig pa'i slob ma'i mchog lum pa ba ye shes byang chub zhes sam/ khu le'i kha mo ze'u ston zhes kyang bya/ chu mig pa chen po zhes grags pa mtshan dngos shes rab grags dang gnyis byung / khu le'i kha mo —31 —

ze'u ston pa zhes bya ba khong rdza rar ze'u rgyud du 'khrungs/ (ze'u pag shi ni sgo bzhi rgya ri gdong gi phar thad ze thang du gzungs/ dgon pa yang rgyal rtse'i chu lto rin wo gling na yod cing /chos skyong phyag bzhi pa rtse 'dzub shin tu che ba yod cing / chu mig na ze'u rang gi sku gdung bzhugs pa'i sa 'bum dang / gsung rab mang du bzhugs/ chu mig ni rtsa bo nang 'brel yul gyi byang na yod/'di'i nub lung chung gling bu na paṇ+ḍi ta smi ti'i phyag bzo ma kham pa las grub pa'i dpal chen gyi sku ra mas rnyed pa/ smri tis lug rdzi mdzad nas nga rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍita yin pas/ lha bzo brjod dam ma brjod gzigs nas phyag dal du sgrub pa 'jim khung du sbas/ phyis ra mas rnyed pa de bzhugs)'bre shes rab 'bar la rab tu byung / khyung rin chen grags la dbu tshad dang spyod phyogs gsan/ rgya dmar sa stag pa kha che la'ang rgya cher gsan/'bre la phar phyin lo drug gsan/ de nas dge bshes lum pa ba lo lnga bsten/ de nas sha ra ba lo gsum bsten/ dge bshes brag dkar ba lo nyi shu bsten/ de nas rang yul gyi ri shes slas kha dang sram bu la sogs par bzhugs/ de nas kha mo dgon pa bzung bas kha mo ze'u stong du grags/ (kha mo ni phyis chos dbang gis bzung yang dgon bdag rang bla ma se 'bre ban khyu yin zhing / yang dag gis sgrub pa mdzad pas bum chu khol bas bum pa bsnams te bar snang la 'phur te bum chu thigs pa re la shug pa re 'khrungs/shug sdong bcu gcig yod pa phal cher skams/ da lta gsum yod/ bcu gcig yod pa'i mthar lcam mo zhig la sku sgren mor yod pas zhal skyengs te phyir log pas shug pas ma 'khor/ gong du smos pa'i sgur sgom sgra 'od ces bon po'i grub thob phur pa za hor dbu dgu la grub pa brnyes pa dang 'bras pas sgur sgom gyis khyung dkar zhes pa'i brag rtsa nas phur pa gdengs pas ser ba phab ste bla ma rang gi sgrub phug la 'byer/ nye bskor grog por btang / phyis rgyud 'dzin med pas yang dag gi dpe —32—

rnams shog dril du bsgril nas rdza ma gsum bkang kha yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rdo g.yam la mtshal gyis bris pas bcad/ glegs shing rnams sha rkyal du bcug nas lha mo nam gru ma la gtad de gter du stsal ba/ phyis sngags brtsegs pa gur sgom sgra bo'i rgyud pa zhig gis rnyed/ gter rnams 'jol nyog tu byung pas mi ngo la gron chad dang 'khu ldog shin tu che ba byung bas/ gter chab ci rigs sbas 'dug na'ang da dung rgyud pa de la ston dus kyi zla ba la bskangs bshags rgyas pa dgos so/ ) de nas gtsang po nang du ston mo zhig gi gral dbu la byon pas/ 'di'i phu na bsdad pa ltar yod dris pas/ 'di lta bu yod zer chu mig bzung ngo / /snar thang gi rdor ston chen po yang 'di'i slob ma yin no/ /deng sang kha mo 'di gu ru chos dbang gi gdung rgyud kyi 'dzin pa de gtsug lag khang gsar du bzos pa gcig dang / der gu ru chos dbang lho stod la byon nga/ la yon bdag dad pa can gcig shin tu 'phreng ba dang de la chu 'gram nas rdo longs shig gsungs/ de la zhabs gnyis kyi rjes yod/ nang mjal kyang kha shas yod/ dgon pa ma de dpal rnam gyi gur sdings yin no/ /de'i 'og tsam na sgo bzhi'i yul 'di na/ (sgo bzhi ni shar sgo ra lung chos kyi sgo/lho sgo nying ro shing gi sgo/ byang sgo rdo lcags lcags kyi sgo/ nub sgo rgya brag nas kyi sgo'o/) mgon po'i gnas rang bzhin lhun grub yod do/ /sa yul 'di chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbyibs sa gru gsum/ gnam gru gsum/ chu 'bab gru gsum/ phyi mi 'gyur ba'i rtags la lho phyogs kyi ri la gur lha brgyad gsal bar bzhugs pa/ nub phyogs kyi ri la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ byang phyogs kyi ri la byang chub mchod rten/shar phyogs kyi ri la gtor ma ru gtos rgyan 'dra/ zam pa'i 'khris kyi ri 'khor —33—

bshan pa gri thogs sogs kyis dbyibs la dgongs nas/ thong lcags rdzong gi mgon khang na bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gtor gzhi rtags gtor las khungs zer ba/ (dpal ldan sa skya pa la mgon po'i bka' babs tshul ches mang yang bsdus tsam brjod na/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi srung ma chen po/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra las 'brog mi las rim par brgyud pa'i lha lnga dpa' bo gcig pa dang / ba ri lo cwa nas brgyud pa'i mgon rkyang dang zhu chen gyi lo cwa ba rin chen bzang po nas brgyud pa'i rkyang sgrub lcam dral sbags te sgrub pa/ spyir mgon po tshogs bdag ltar sgrub pa/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa/mo rkyang du sgrub pa/ lcam dral du sgrub pa/ mkha' 'gro ltar sgrub pa/ gur lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi ljags lung / gur lha brgyad kyi steng du sgo ma bzhi bsnan pas gur lha bcu gnyis kyi dbang klu sgrub lugs/ gur lha lnga ma zhes pa sku dang gsu rnga thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi mgon po'i dkyil thang la dbang bzhi len pa'i rgyun bo dong par yod/ yongs grags gur lha brgyad ma'i rjes gnang / mgon po gur la phyi khrid nang khrid/ gsang khrid phyi khrid gsum/ 'khor drag rdzong ma la yang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi khrid/ mgon po'i dbang lnga mal gro blo gros grags pa ste mal lo tsā ba chen pos sa chen kun snying la gnang ba ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang sgo'i srung mar sangs rgyas kyi bka' bsgos pa'i rdo rje gur gyi mgon po dngos su bzhugs/ 'dra 'bag mgar chos dar sar srung ba la nam mkha' la 'phur te phebs par yongs la grags pa de sku'i rten du bsre 'bag nag po 'phur shes/ gsung gi rten du dar nag la sha sa na'i sngags bris pa/ thugs rten lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa rnams gnang zhing sa chen dang bsre 'bag gnyis kar bka' bsgo mdzad/ ta thā ga ta/ rak+ṣi ta/'bum phrag gsum pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma las brgyud pa'i gnyan mgon gdong bzhi'i chos skor/ zhal la 'khrid gnyis/ nag po chen po bya rog gdong / dkar mo nyi zla'i 'phreng ba can/ bdud —34—

rgyal dur khrod bdag po sogs/ sa skya par bka' babs so/ /las mkhan pu tra la/ gter ka ba nas bton pa'i pu tra kol ma/ pu trere las tshogs kha che paṇa chen paṇ+ḍi ta la gnang ba) las bzhi mdzad pa'i khungs yin gur gyi sku thang dang / bdag chen rin po che rang gi sku 'dra thang sku gsol phod sogs cha tshang yod/ gzim mal chas phyag rnga sogs mtha' tshang bzhugs so/ /sgo bzhi'i chu 'bab pa'i phu nying ror/ (lung pa 'dir phu shar na bon ri khyu nag zhes bon gyi grub thob chen po 'bri khung spyan snga dang dus mtshungs bon po g.yung drung nyi shar ba'i yab mes bran ston mtha' bral dang 'bras pa de nying ro chu bzang du byon/ 'di ni bon phyogs la grags so/ /de zhabrungs sa yod pas bon po rnams la dris shig) /stod lung ba rin chen snying po'i slob ma khyung khams pa chen po la stod lung pa'i zhal nas khyod kyi gdul bya gtsang na yod pas der song / dgon pa thobs la slob ma bsdus la bden gnyis shod gsungs/ gtsang la 'byon khar stod lung ba'i zhal nas bden gnyis dang khyung khams gtsang la bzhud/ bden mi bden pha bong phen g.yag la dris gsungs/phyag 'khar brdabs pas pha bong tshal par gas/ de nas gtsang la byon nas nying ro thal ba tshal du sding phu dgon pa btab pas dge bshes sding phu bar grags/bden gnyis chos tshan bcu gnyis su bsdus nas gsungs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa yang 'di yin no/ /gtsang pa rgya ras kyi slob ma dang por che ba spa rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis las/ bar du che ba'i rgya 'bras kyi 'bras mo ba'i dgon pa ('bras mo dgon pa'i mda' na/ rgyal rabs na lhor smyal snang grol —35—

lha khang me'i kha gnon du bzhengs zer ba'i grong gling rlung mtsho'i lha khang zhes pa stong gog tu song / jo bo sku stod li dkar/ phyag sen rdzi khyim/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che las chung rgyu med pa khyad can/nyams can rnams 'di 'dra lung kyog tu bzhugs pa ya mtshan/ ‘sna di la dkar chag lo rgyus sogs yong thang zer ba mang bar gda'/ da lta jo btsun gyi dgon pa 'bras mo na bzhugs) yod/gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku tshigs nyer gcig la spyan ras gzigs nyer gcig byon pa/ 'bras mo jo btsun la gnyis yod pa'i 'bras mo dgon pa tsho zer dus/gcig 'bras mo'i mchod rten nang du bzhugs/ gcig sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzungs bzhugs la zhugs pa/ deng sang 'bras mo'i jo bo zer/ ra lung ba tshos zer dus/ gnyis yod pa la gcig 'bras mo'i mchod rten nang na yod/ gcig lho dgon pa yul gyi yon rdzong pa'i lag na/ dpon grags pa ye shes kyi rten skal du yod pa de hor rgyal po thog gan the mur gyi phyag tu yod pa/ ming swa khrab tu grags pa de yin/de'i 'og tsam na lum pa'i phu gra'u lung gi sbug na grub thob gling ras kyis gzong gis brkos pa'i brag gi phug pa byin rlabs can de la gzong chung phug tu grags/ de gra'u lung gi phu na yod/ rnga 'dogs sa chu bsags sa sogs phyag gis brkos pa'i phug pa ngo mtshar la byin rlabs che ba yod/ chags ma'i lho phyogs na lung pa'i ming la g.yu shel ri dkar po glang ri rgyal chen rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ ri 'dir bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang / slob dpon pad+ma'i bzhugs phug sgrub khang zer ba yang yod/ 'dir slob dpon pad+mas rtsa gsum dril sgrub gter du sbas pa/ gu ru 'jam dbyangs bla mas bton te/ de'i lo rgyus —36—

zur tsam gleng ba/ gzong chung phug gi mda' na chos dbang rgyud pas 'dzin pa'i gra'u lung zhes pa'i dgon pa'i brag phug na sgrub pa po bzhugs pas gtor ma ma chag par gtong ba la rgya phyed brag nag pa sgrol byed nag po gtor ma la yong ba la 'jam dbyangs bla mas khyed kyi gtor mas mgo skor zhig nga yis gter sbyin ('byin ka zhes bgros nas brag nag pa gtor mgron la yod skabs gter stsal bas/ khos zag bcas kyi mngon shes kyis shes te/ 'od zer de myur bar log pas gter mjug lus par byed/ 'di gsol 'debs las byang gi tshul du sgrub pa de yin par 'dug /'di la chos tshan mang bar yod par shes te ma grags 'dug /lcags phur byin rlabs can zhig da lta gra'u lung na yod pa 'khyar nas 'ga' zhig gi lag tu 'khyar/ gu ru 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i sku skye 'am sprul pa zhig rta nag sgrol ma ba la 'byon par 'dug / rgyad phyed g.yu sher gyi so ba zhes pa'i grong na 'jam dbyangs bla ma 'khrungs/ phyis kyi grong der gnas snying gi shar na chos dbang brgyud pas 'dzin pa'i bsam gtan sgang gi dgon pa zla char (mda' phyar ka gyi phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i sgrub phug gi sgo'i ru bzhi zhig po pa'i sgo sgrib la yod pa/ phyis 'khyar bas ri thag nye bas kyog rar lug bzhag pa la spyang ki sdang bar byung / sgo sgrib yod dus dgra jag chom rkun gcan gzan sogs ma byung zhes zer/ da lta phur pa 'dom pa gang la rad pa bskon nas bsam gtan sgang la bzhugs/ so so'i khang ltag na 'ban gung rgyal gyi ber sro ma can bzhugs pa'i 'bum pa yod/ de da ltar 'khyar/ 'ban gung rgyal gyi 'khrungs yul chos rgyal gyi gdung yin cing / 'ban grong zhes sngo tshal 'og na —37—

yod/ 'ban grong gdung rin po cher grags/ rtsa rnams (btsad rnam)rin po che sde bzhi la 'ban grong rin po che/ rtsa rnams bde chen gyi mchod rten na/ rin po che gser gyi glegs bam bzhugs pas bde chen chos rin chen/ gro sa na gser gyi gnya' shing yod pas gro sa gser rin po che/ nyi thi na g.yu g.yang zhag 'khyil ba yod pas nyi thi g.yu rin po che zhes grags/ myang stod gzhung gi ri bkra ngan pa rnams 'dis non zhing ri bkra shis shing phun sum tshogs pa yin/ gtsang po nang du 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi 'khrungs yul yin no/ /'chad mang 'di klu mes kyi bu bzhi'i nang tshan/ rngeg byang chub 'byung gnas kyi mkhan bu bhe khusko pa ka po skor ba yin/ bhe khwa skom ka mkhan po/ ('chad mang zhes ming du btags pa yang 'bres mngon pa 'chad pa la mang bas 'chad mang po/ bye mda'i dgon lag yin zhing / nying ro gzhong mgur na bla 'bum skya pod sgam bzhi zhes/ 'bre'i phyag bris kyi 'bum dum pa bzhi la 'dus pa da lta bzhugs/ rgyab ri bon po'i sgrub gnas rgyal chen rmug ri zhes gur sgom 'ja' lus su grub byas )yam shud kyis slob dpon byas nas grwa pa mngon shes rab tu byung / de nas g.yo ru gra thang btab grwa pa mngon shes kyi mkhan po 'be g.yo rong btsun bya bas myang stod 'chad mang btab/ der 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis chos shin tu mang por bshad cing /me tog gi char chen po babs so//'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis chos 'chad pa 'di las mang ba med pas 'chad mang du grags/ (gnas rnying pa'i gyed mdo na/ yol thog 'bebs kyis phyo mda' dang rmog pa'i bar la gshegs bzhud yang yang mdzad dus gra ma yod pa gcig tu gro gsol ba lan 'ga' byung bas gro sa dgos pa 'dug gsungs nas grwa thang btab/ btsad rnam sde chen yin/ zhag sa —38—

dgos pa 'dug gsungs nas 'chad mang dang ze thang gnyis btab bo/ /'chad mang dang ze thang dang /grwa thang dang / gshong mgur rmog po rnams la lcags ri dang khyams sogs rgya chen mdzad pa las stod dkon mchog mkhar ba chen po yin no/ /de'i rjes su 'chad mang du gnas rnying mkhan po dbang phyug rin chen gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhengs/)g.ya' bzang lha mo yang / chos rje snubs 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po la g.ya' bzang ba zer ba des lha mo 'di nas spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus zhus pa ste/bud med gzhon nu zhig gson por pags bshus byas kla 'i tshigs pa re re'i mtshams su mda' re 'gags pa'i pags pa de g.ya' bzang na da lta yang yod do/ /de'i thad 'og lho phyogs na g.yu thog pa 'khrungs pa rgya phyed kyi(rgya phyed thang du da lta/ sman pa yod pa sku rgyud du byed na/ shel rtsag dang / sman skyongs rus sbal ma 'byar 'dug/g.yu thog rang de lung dmar ltag gong du smos pa de yin/ lung dmar dpon po 'di yang brgyud par ngos 'dzin cing khungs btsun)g.ye mdzod du 'khrungs/ der mjal rgyu g.yu thog pa'i dbu zhwa sogs yod do/ /de'i 'og tsam na myang stod chu mig ces rgya gar gyi paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa phebs pa de yin/ rgya 'dul 'dzin gyi dgon pa chu mig lung 'dzin pa mdzad/ chos gzhis mang du bskor ba/ 'dul ba'i bshad pa rgya chen mdzad/ ne ring pa kyi ston chos grags kyis rgya 'dul la chu mig ring por zhabs la gtugs pa yin/ khu le'i kha mo ze'u ston pas chu mig bzung dar rgyas chen po 'byung ba yi na zhing / chu mig dgon pa de'i sngon du yod pa bzhin la yin no/ (zhwa lu bu ston rin po che'i dgung lo drug cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa lcags mo yos bu lo la g.ya' phag gnyis 'khrug —39—

'dum la nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams la bshad nas byon pa'i lam du myang stod chu mig tu theg pa che chung gi chos mang du gsungs/ rgya gar paṇa chen dang bod mkhas pa 'bre'i dgon pa ru nga 'gro ba la ches rings yang sdod pa la spro gsungs nas zla skor zhig bzhugs so/ /'di la yang chu mig ring mo zhes grags pas snar thang nye 'gram gyi chu mig dang 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /)de'i 'og na smri ti'i phyag bzo dpal chen po'am yang dag byin rlabs can yod do/ /rdo gzhi ma nag po la rdo dkar pos/ ru lu ru lu rang byon du gyur pa khyad par can bzhugs/spyir sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi nang nas yang dag thugs 'di la khrag 'thung 'dus/ ru lu rang byon 'di rdo kha skya la brkos pa 'dra zer ba'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdo dang khra bo sun dha ri ka'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / he ru ka gal po'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / yang dag sgrub pa'i rgyud le'u bcu pa/ rdo rje gsang ba las kyi rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa/rgyud sde rnams la brten pa'i sgrubs thabs ni/ zla gam drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ zla gam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ zla gam dgu pa/ zla gam gcig pa/ srin mo ma tram zhal/ dug gsum bang rim gsum pa rnams bod du bsgyur ro/ /sngags gsar ma la yang / yang dag (kha che paṇa chen gyi zab chos la bde mchog dkar po la brten nas mchog sgrub pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po la brten nas shes rab sgrub pa/ yang dag ma gcig lha gcig la brten nas ras thub pa/ dzam bha la nag po la brten nas nor sgrub pa'o)gcig lha gcig dgu la sogs kyi sgrub skor zab mo dbang dang bcas pa yod do/ /bod du sgyur tshul ni/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis snubs nam mkha'i snying po/ 'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros/ lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas sogs —40—

dge slong mi lnga dpon dang bcas pa drug brdzangs/ rgya gar yul du slob dpon hūṃ ka ra dang mjal/ slob dpon hūṃX ka ras zla gam drug cu rtsa brgyad po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas dbang bskur/ khrag 'thung drug cu rtsa brgyad po'i zhal bstan/de nas zla gam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad nas zla gam dgu pa/ zla gam gcig pa/ dug gsum bang rim gsum pa dang / lnga bcu rtsa brgyad zer/ dkyil 'khor rim par zhal phye nas bstan/ sman gyis sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang tshe sgrub pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang dbang bskur bas/ byang chub sems kyi sgrub pa gsum gsang sngags spyod pas dbang bskur ba sogs yang dag rdzogs par gnang nas/ yang dag sgrub pa rtsa ba lta bu la ('grel ) chen sgron me lta bu khog snying dang 'dra/ me gcig thod gcig gnang nas snubs nam mkha'i snying pos bod du dar bar mdzad pas/ bod kyi grub thob bstan pa snga dar la ches mang ba de yang dag gi khyad chos so/ /phyis su bi ma la mi tra dang / lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na tsha ba rong nas spyan drangs te/ khams lhung byang chen gyis kyang dben du lo paṇa gnyis kyi yang dag bdag don sogs sgrub sde'i chos mang du bsgyur ro/ /yang dag gi sku bzhengs mi paṇ+ḍi ta smi ti ni shun ti pa dang na ro pa'i slob ma yin/ rgya gar shar nub gung gsum na mkhas pa rtsod bral dpyal lo'i gsung las 'di shin tu mkhas pas mu stegs tshogs kyis rtsod par mi nus/ mu stegs kyi bstan pa bsnubs dgos pas na/ mu stegs pa ngan sngags bskrad 'khor gyi skyon gyis paṇ+ḍi ta/ (phra la ring mo dang bsdebs bod la byon pa/ lo tsā ba la phug zos pas pho log gis bal bor shi pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta) gnyis 'khyams dgos pa byung dus/ (nges don du smri —41 —

ti dz+nyā na de nyid la mngon shes thogs med mnga' bas des yum gyi don du bod du byon skabs gung thang du phyug rdzi'i tshul bzungs/ de'i dgos pa ma grong pa gcig gis skyed pu'i nang du sdig par skyes pa 'don phyir du brdzus pa yin/ de'i tshe dpal 'byor rgya gar nas 'khor ba la thams cad dad dad rub rub byed/ paṇ+ḍi ta la mthong mi byed pas gung thang gi sgo'i ya them la sam sgri ta'i skad kyis/ ri bong 'dzin pa rgyu skar 'phreng ba can/ /mtshan mo mkha' la rgyu ba 'di dor nas/ /dwangs pa'i chu nang 'di na zla ba bzhin/ /gzugs la tshad mar 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ /zhes te glan/ de lo tsā bas gzigs nas lañcha shin tu legs pas yig ngo mkhyen/ smri ti yin snyam phyugs 'khor ba gdong du bsgugs pas mjal/ sngar slob dpon du song bas lo tsā bas bshums nas 'di lta bu'i 'o rgyal ba zhus pas/ ngas ma'i don du de ltar byas pa yin/ ma ga re/ 'di na'o gsungs/ /der lo tsā bas khong rang gi nor gyis bslus so) /yang yum gyi don du rta nag tu phyugs rdzi mdzad skabs su gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ ri khud kyi rnga bo che sogs shangs phu lha bu'i sa phyogs shangs skyor mo lung du yum khyi mor 'khrungs pa/ khyi mo de tsha ngar rtsub 'gyur che zhing sems rgyud ma rung zhing mi sdug pa dang ldan pas na yum khyi mo la brtse dung che bas khyi mor skyes/ de 'dren phyir yang g.yag rdzi mdzad skabs/ nyin mtshan thugs dam skyong pa la sgrub phug tu bzhugs pa'i sku sked man gyi rjes brag la gsal bar yod cing / smri ti'i zhabs lham dang dom ra shangs skyor mo rdzong na yod do/ /yang yum khyi mo nas tshe 'phos nas/ thob rgyal mdar me thab ces pa'i sa yul yum skyed pu'i nang du skyes/ de 'don phyir lug rdzi mdzad skabs/ chu bo lo hi ta'i nye 'gram bye ma g.yu'i zur phud can nas rang byon jo bo mched gsum dang ma ṇi rang byon sprel sogs sprul pa'i ra mas 'o ma'i mchod pa phul ba la

brten nas de rnams rnyed kyang spre'u la tso rdo phog /de nas smri ti spyan drangs pa'i skabs/ jo bo gcig dga' ldan la phebs/ jo bo gcig thog mar gtsang 'gram bye ma'i lha khang du re zhig bzhugs/ de nas/ zhwa lur phebs/ jo bo gcig dang ma ṇi thob rgyal na bzhugs pa de yin/ (spre'u rang byon du byon pa'i rgyu mtshan na sku rten spyan ras gzigs/ gsung rten ma ṇi/ thugs rten spre'u ste 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo spre'u byang chub sems dpar mdzad nas zo dang gong po ri'i phug par bzhugs pas/ spre'u phug par thog /bod du ma'i 'gro ba spel nas dam nga/'i chos tshul phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi bting nas slar 'phags pa'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de'i ngo bor spre'u byang chub sems dpa' thim pas thugs rten yin zhing / bod la rten 'brel zab mo 'gyung ba la dgongs nas bod 'gyung ba'i gleng gzhi spre'u rang byon du byon pa'o/ /dbon po smon skyid nga/'i gsung dngos las shog bur bris pa'o/) /yang yum byi mo nas tshe 'phos pas myang gi khyim thab phyug po me nyin mtshan 'khor yug gtong zhing rgyun du bkal nas 'jog pa'i khro chen po zhig gi khro zhabs kyi srubs shig tu las ngan pas 'khrungs/ de 'don pa'i phyir myang stod du phyug rdzi mjad skabs su phyugs gla sogs la brten pa'i yang dag gi /sku 'di phyag bzo mar bzhengs shing / yum yang mtho ris su 'dren thub pas deng sang yul de la blo bder ming thogs/ de nas nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams la thegs so/ /smri ti las brgyud pa gsang 'dus 'grel pa dang gsang 'dus lha nyi shu rtsa lnga ma'i dbang / smri ti nas tshong dge ngag gi dbang phyug la/ des rngeg chos rdor la brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dbang /mtshan brjod 'grel pa/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa/ man ngag dang bcas pa —43 —

gzhan yang dbang brgyud phyag len sogs ches mang bar dar ro/ /de'i 'og na blo bde'i gong tsam gyi 'ban grong zer bar gangs pa she'u gdung ril por bzhugs pa sa 'bum yod pa de yin no/ /'dir stod kyi 'ban gung rgyal 'khrungs sa yang 'di yin no/ /smad kyi 'ban gung rgyal 'khrungs sa phan yul rgyal 'di yin no/ /de'i 'og na ri bo cher grags pa'i khyad par can slob dpon pad ma rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa ri de'i rtser phebs pa lta bu'i bdud rtsi sogs kyi rgyun myang chu la yod tshul gyi lo rgyus gong du bkod pa ltar yin no/ /ri de'i sked 'og tsam na sgrub pa bka' brgyad gnang ba'i bzhugs gnas dang stegs bu yod/ 'di'i ri nas blangs pa'i 'jim pa byin rlabs byed mi dgos pa sogs ri 'di byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od ches 'phro ba'o/ /de'i 'og tsam gyi lung pa'i phug gi ri nang na ri'i ldebs la da rang byon yod pa dang / mi la dang rong ston lha dga' mjal ba sogs/ (nu ma chos lung na mi la'i phug yod/ dgon pa'i rgyab ri la brag khyung dkar po da 'greng bu 'dra ba yod/ lung pa de 'dra ba'i nang du mi de 'dra ba yod zer/ lung pa nu ma de 'dzin pa mi gzhan pas rgod pa yod zer ba rgan po'i ngag rgyun la 'dug)ches mang ba yod do/ /de'i 'og tsam na gling ras kyi dgon pa chos lung zhes gling ras dgon pa dang gling ras phug pa yod/ lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ rtogs pa phul du byung ba skyes pa na gnas 'di byin rlabs shin tu che ba (chos lung gi nub rin r+ṣa sgang 'dir bla ma a rgyas gdan sa yang mdzad 'dug /bla ma 'phags pa hong yul du phebs pa'i gsol ba 'debs mi dran shes seng ge'i grogs kyi bla ma de'i dgon pa yin 'dug)yin no/ /rtsa rnams —44—

ri bo che'i byang gi lung pa ri nang du grags pa de'i phu na 'bri khung spyan lnga'i slob ma la drug pa rje 'dzam gling mgon po'i dgon pa las drug ces grags/ 'di nas rtsa ri ma chen 'dzin pa'i ri sa rdzong sa yang byung zhing / sgom chen las drug ces pa'i gu ru chos dbang gis chos drug sras mkhar ma'i gter gyi kha byang bskur te gro bo lung sras mkhar mar grags pa dang / 'khol po dar thod can gyi sgrub pa dang dud sol ma'i skor rnams spyan drangs chos dbang la phul/ de'i phu shangs dkar mgon dkar sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas snyan bra bas zos pas khyod za bar 'dod na nga'i lus 'di chos phyir du gtong ba la 'gyod pa med pas zo zhig gsungs pas/ snyan g.yas pa bra bas zos pa de byon/ 'dzam gling mgon po 'di nyid dang / dran don shes rab seng ge dang / rin chen sgang pa sogs kyis sems can gyi bde thabs la 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa hor yul du byon pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab pa la drug pa ston shag ces pas gnas rnying chos grwar gsan sbyangs mdzad/ phyis dge ldan par gyur 'dug /'bri khung skyob pa yan gyi dkar rgyud kyi bla ma'i sman sku shin tu mtshar ba dang / shar phyogs kyi chos skya pod yig shog dpe thub las drug legs pa ma mthong zer ba'i gsung rab mang po bzhugs/ zhal ngo gcig gi dpal 'khor chos sde dge 'phel grwa tshang gi bla ma mdzad/ phyis las drug grwa tshang du grags/ lha mo yang ri ma ti shin tu 'tshub pa bzhugs/de'i 'og tu ri nang dpon po sgra chen po'i pho brang ri nang yang dkar zhes snang sa 'od 'bum gyi gyon pa de yod/ de'i lho logs blo sbyong gi brgyud pa'i bla ma —45—

lha lding dbon gyi dgon ro dang rngeg ye shes khrung gnas kyi dgon ro yod/ de'i 'og na rngog tsha chos skus man lung dran don mtha' bral la phul/ dran gyis rngog tsha chos sku la kyai rdor gyi dbang zhus/ phyis dgon pa de la sbyang lung zer/ cho 'phrul zla ba la me tog gi char nyi ma re bab kyi 'dug /tshes grangs la nges pa mi 'dug /de'i 'og na sbas chos btod pa'i dgon ro yod/ gnas gog shin tu che/de'i lho tsam na blon po sbas stag pa'i rgyud du sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen de mdzo chad stong gog tu 'khrungs zer kyang lho'i dung reng byung bas ri bo cher 'byud/ ri rtser nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du 'khrungs/ de'i lho kun zhes pa'i lung chung du jo mtsho zhes par zhwa lu'i bla ma 'phags pa 'khrungs/ ri nang gi byang gi phug gnyis yod pa'i byang gi ser 'phreng ba ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis dgon pa ser 'phreng dang lho'i lung pa'i phu na mes ston gyi dgon pa rdzi lung zhes na mahā ka la phyag bzhi pa byin rlabs can bzhugs/ lung pa de gnyis la pho lung mo lung du grags/ de'i 'og na tshul chen zhes rgyal ba rigs lnga sku mched khye'u lo bcu lon pa tsam bzhengs/ sku shin tu ngo mtshar ba bzhugs/khro phu dkar rgyud ces phyag rdor ge bor chen gyi grub thob dgon lag rong gnas rnying / rgyal ri khrod gtsang po nang gi bu gnyis rnams yin/ de rnams na bal mo spyang rgyal lha mo re bzhugs/ tshul chen 'dir gling ras kyi zur pa bcu gsum bsrungs pa de yin/ 'di'i 'khris na gtsang na 'gying mchog seng ge sgang yod/ rong na nag po seng ge sgang / dbus na 'phrang po seng ge sgang /—46—

de'i 'og tsam na rgod po lung du grags pa'am ri khrod dge ldan/ (sngon rgyan dkar gong ma'i mid pa dgon pa yang zer/ phyis 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar la rgod kyi khung bstan pas dgon pa'i ming la rgod po khung zer/ slar chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi ri khrod dge ldan du ming btags pa yin no/)zhes pa 'dir sngon 'ban sna bo che zhes kyang bya/sna nag pa zhes kyang bya ba'i dge slong sa bdag klu gnyan gyis gnod pas shin tu sku bsnyel bas rgya gar la phebs/ nā len dra'i gtsug lag khang du jo bo a ti sha dang mjal bas snod ldan du gzigs/ dpal phyag rdor mdo lugs kyi chos skor/ (dpung bzang las gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du bshad kyis nyon zhes bya rgyud la mdo sde zhes ming du btags pa'o/) gdams ngag dang bcas pa gnang ste/ rgya brtson seng ge lo tsā bgyis/ 'ban sna bo ches zhu ba po bgyis nas len drar bsgyur/ dbang dang rjes su gnang ba mdzad/ chig brgyud du gdams/ 'ban sna bo ches pu hrang gi zher bya ba'i gnas gzhi yod par bzhugs/ sgrub pas nad las grol zhing phyag rdor gyi zhal gzigs/ des rta sgom dkon mchog 'byung gnas la gsungs/ rta sgom gyi yul ni myang stod yin/ sku mched gnyis yod pa'i rta sgom dkon mchog 'byung gnas la klu nad byung nas rgya gar la gshegs pas/ lam du mi gzhan gyis khungs bstan/ slar log nas pu hrang gi zher du grub thob 'ban sna bo che dang mjal/ phyag rdor gyi gdams pa zab mo chig brgyud du gsan/ lha sgom gyi yul du byon/ rgyan dkar gong ma'i mid pa dgon pa bya'am rgod po khyung (khung )yang zer/ rgod po lung yang zer/ deng sang ri khrod dge ldan gyi dgon pa bya bar bzhugs/ sgrub pas phyag rdor yang nas yang du zhal gzigs pa 'di yin/ grub —47—

pa brnyes pa yang 'di yin no/ /bla ma gru go cha rdo rjes lha sgom dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang mjal ba'i thog ma yang mid pa dgon pa 'dir yin/ rtogs grol thob pa yang mid pa 'dir yin/ don la ri khrod dge ldan gyi ming gi rnam grangs yin no/ /de nas gru go cha rdo rjes lo gsum mtshams bcad pa khyung ri na yod pa'i dug lung phu ru sku mtshams lo gsum mdzad kyang rtogs pa don gyi mthar thug /rtogs pa ri khrod dge ldan gyi gnas 'di rang yin no/ /lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi bka' babs kyi slob ma bzhi ni zhang tshes spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ khyung rin chen grags pa/'bre shes rab 'bar dang bzhi las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bka' babs pa/'bre shes rab 'bar gyis/tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan gyis//sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying po ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub pa mdzad dgongs pa kho na thugs la bzhugs dus/ bye mdar chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ de skabs thugs dam gtor ma'i sa teb bya rgod kyis khyer nas gnas 'dir bzhag pas sgrub pa byed pa'i gnas khyad par can du dgongs/ sgrub pa mdzad pa yang ri khrod dge ldan 'di nyid yin pas 'bre'i bzhugs khri dang thugs dam 'bum pa yang mngon sum mjal rgyu yod pa 'di yin zhing / (paṇa r+ṣa nags kyi rin r+ṣa mid pa bya ba'i nang rgod khung du bzhugs pa'i tshe mtshan mo rmi lam bzung nas grub chen kun blo dgon pa lhun spre bde chen na bzhugs pa der phebs pas zam chung de tshun dgon pa'i skor rnams dus 'khor gyi —48—

gzhal yas khang dang der gnas pa'i mi rnams dus 'a/lor gyi lha tshogs de'i dbus kyi gtso bo la chos rje grub chen nyid bzhugs 'dug pa la paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen gyis re zhig bzhugs shing rmi lam bzung bar mdzad pa yang ri khrod dge ldan 'di nyid yin no/ ) kun mkhyen dol bus nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams kyi skye 'gro smin grol du bkod nas yar byon/ myang stod lcang rar sku sha 'byor bas skas la ma phebs par g.yul thang du bzhugs skabs lung bstan pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du/ (sgrub pa bsam gto gyi 'khor lo'i bsti gnas 'debs par dgongs nas paṇa chen shrī shā re pu tra phebs pa'i dus su sa 'dul ba dang bum gter 'jug pa sogs byin rlabs legs par mdzad pa'i gnas 'dir) sbyor drug gi nyams len kho na skyong ba'i dge 'dun gyi sgrub pa ba brgya dang brgyad sogs sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa btsugs/ sngon mnga' bdag rgyal po'i pho brang btab pa'i sa yul 'dir rmad du byung zhing bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan gyi dpal dang ldan nga/'i ri bo chen po/ shar phyogs 'bras lugs 'gel ba 'dra ba/ lto bltas seng ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra ba/ nub dar dkar gyi yol ba brkyangs pa 'dra ba/ byang phyogs hor phrug zhe sa 'bul ba 'dra ba'am/ de'i mda' na sngon bod chos rgyal dpal 'khor bcan gyis bzhugs sa/shel dkar rgyal rtse zhes grags pa (rdzong ri ngos rin chen shel las grub pa'i brag /dbus rin po che sna tshogs du ma'i gter gyis yongs su gang ba'i rtser pho brang chen po rgyal mkhar rtser grags pa 'di nyid nang chen 'phags pa dpal dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad zhes pa sna tshogs dbyig gam/ shing mo sprul gyi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu la pho brang )'di nyid btab/myang stod gser gzhung ring mor grags pa'i mthil/ /sna tshogs 'bru dang me tog —49—

rgyas pa'i gling / /byang chub ljon shing tshul du nags tshal dbus/ /bkra shis brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams brgyan pa yi/ /gser khyim brgya phrag brgyad kyi mdzes pa'i rtser/ /dpal 'khor btsan gyi pho brang gyi gter gyi mdzod/ /brag ri rdo rje sgrungs 'dra'i gdengs can 'di/ /tshangs pa dbang po'i grong khyer skyengs byed pa/ /zhes dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ skye dgu mdzes par byed pa'i mgul rgyan du/ /rnam rgyal lha yi grong khyer sa gzhi la/ /gsar du babs pa lta bu'i rgyal mkhar gnas/ /yid 'ong pho brang grangs med gser khyim la/ /mtshungs med rgyal ldan blta bas chog mi shes/ /'dzam gling sa yi thig le lta bu'i gnas/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa can/ /mkhas grub dang po dpag med 'du ba'i gnas//rgyal mkhar rtse mor son pa 'di nyid yin/ /zhes nang chen 'phags pa dpal dang nang chen 'phags pa rin chen pa sku mched kyi sras ma gcig pad+ma pa dang / bdag po chen po nang chen kun dga' 'phags 'khrungs pa de nyid kyi dgung lo so bzhi bzhes pa lcags pho rta la 'di nyid kyi thugs dam du rgyal mkhar rtse'i gtsug lag khang bsam 'phel rin po che'i gling bzhengs shing grub par mdzad/ rten gtso thub dbang dgung lo brgyad kyi tshad/thugs rten rin po che las grub pa'i lha babs pad+ma spungs pa/ bya chen cho 'phrul/rnam rgyal sgo mangs/ dbyen zlum/ myang 'das bzhengs/ /khri rgyab yol rnams kyang brkos ma gser gyis spras pa bsgrubs/ gzhan logs bris gtsang khang du sangs rgyas so lnga/ ri khrod ma/ 'od zer can/ rnam thos/ dzam lha/ lam 'bras bla brgyud/ khyams la bris pa sku chen mo mthong ba don ldan/ 'das pa'i sangs —50—

rgyas mar me mdzad/ ma byon byams pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ mngon dga'i zhing bkod sangs rgyas sman bla/ thub dbang gnas brtan/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ skyes rabs/ gzhon nu nor bzang gis bla ma bsten pa'i tshul/ sgrol ma/rnam rgyal/ sgo bsrungs rgyal chen bzhi sogs la 'khor tshogs ji 'os pa sgrub thabs dang mdo rgyud las bshad pa dang mthun pa/ bskor khang la'ang rigs lnga/rigs gsum mgon po sogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku gzugs du mas bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang du dpal dus kyi 'khor los thogs drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams ri mor bkod/ mgon khang du chos skyong lcam dral rnam sras sogs 'cham sku'i tshul du bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod mdzad pa thams cad ni 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan yin/ rab gnas mkhan po mkhan chen rin po che grags pa bshes gnyen pas mdzad do/ /phyis su rten gtso thub dbang gi sku'i g.yon du thugs dam gyi rten 'od dpag med kyi gser sku sku chad gtso bo dang mnyam pa khri rgyab yol gyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ rten de rnams kyi spyan sngar mar me khor yug tu 'bar ba bcu phrag gcig 'bul ba'i sa gzhi rgya chen po btsugs so/ /mdzad 'phrin 'di la dgongs nas bo dong phyogs las/stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal brgyud dang / gsung gi rdul tshub nyi ma'ang pham byed pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs po che/ /mchog gyur mi dbang kun dga' 'phags de nyid/ /ces bsngags par mjad do/ /nang chen kun dga' 'phags de nyid dang / yum byang sems bzang mo dpal la sa mo sbrul lo hor zla drug pa'i yar gyi ngo la chos rgyal rab brtan kun —51 —

bzang 'phags 'khrungs/ mtshan 'di nyid dpyal ston chen po kun dga' rgya mtsho pas 'dogs par mdzad do/ /mkhas grub blo gros mi zad pas chos rgyal rnam thar las/ dpal ldan shar kha'i gnas 'dir dgra las ni/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal chen mang byung yang / /chos dang 'jig rten phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /kun bzang rab 'phags rgyal chen 'di nyid yin/ /zhes sku gzhon nu'i dus su bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dam pa rnam pa gsum la brten pa'i thugs brgyud sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rin po che snum par mdzad/ yang bdag po chen po nang chen kun dga' 'phags kyi thugs dam rten thub dbang gser sku dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i gling gi rten gtso thub dbang gi g.yas na bzhugs so/ /chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang zhes chos kyi rgyal po de nyid dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes pa rgya gar ba rnam rgyal zhes pa'i lo la lcang rar chos gzhi bting /lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bzhi'i gtso bor sngon gyi mkhas grub chen po lha'i dbang bo sku skye ba mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba byang nas gdan drangs te chos dpon du mnga' gsol/ yab kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs la rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor zab mo rnams zhal phye ba'i gsang sngags kyi sgrub mchod khyad par can mdzad pa 'di tsho thog mar lcang rar 'dzugs par mdzad pa yin no/ /chos rgyal dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug bzhes pa shing pho rta'i lo —la rgyal mkhar rtse'i mdun gyi myang chu la zam chen mig drug dang ldan pa'i dbus na byang chub chen po'i mchod rten khri lam can du bzhugs pa'i nang na dkyil 'khor chen po dgu yod/—52—

logs rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku bris yod do/ /rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shā ri'i pu tra de nyid rgya nag rgyal po ta zhin gyis spyan drangs skabs lcang rar zla ba gnyis bzhugs pa'i bar la zam chen la rab tu gnas pa mdzad do/ /chos rgyal de nyid dgung lo sum cu pa sa pho khyi lo la theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' shog phebs/ sa skyar phebs nas two'i si tu/ nang chen/ thus dkon rnams kyi 'ja' sa bsgrags/ sa khyi zla ba gsum pa'i gnam gang gi nyin nas bzung gos bzo ba sum cu so bdun gyis zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun bar la gos sku chen mo mthong ba don ldan bzhengs/ dbus su ston pa sangs rgyas khru brgyad cu pa/ 'khor mchog zung gnyis/ lha mgron/ mar me mdzad/(mthong ba don ldan du ming btags pa yin gyi bris sku mthong ba don ldan gyi bkod pa bris pa ni ma yin no/)byams pa gnas brtan bcu drug /steng phyogs thad lha'i bu ba dan 'dzin pa/ khri'i dkyil na mgon po beng gi sku bzhugs/ rab gnas 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad skabs shig na chos grwa dpal 'khor bde chen 'di nyid 'debs pa'i thad kyi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i lha 'ga' zhig gis sa gzhi la spos chus chag chag 'debs shing / me tog gi char 'bebs pa la sogs mngon sum gzigs pa'i bkod pa'i tshul cung zad tsam gzim khang mkha' spyod g.yab kyi shar skya la bris yod pa ltar dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gnas/ ri bo rtse lnga dang ldan pa zur phud lnga pa'i bsti gnas/ dbyibs pad+ma 'dab stong kha phye ba lta bur 'di rgya gar ba rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gnyis rgyal phur 'dzoms par —53—

chos sde 'di nyid gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i 'gram bting / lcang ra'i chos gzhi btab tshul sngon du smos pa dar rgyas su bzhugs pa'i chos gzhi 'dir bzhugs par mdzad de/ mkhas grub 'jigs med grags pas skye rgu mdzes byed mgul rgyan du/ /phan bde ma lus kun gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yin par rab dgongs nas/ /'jig rten skyes bu dpag med 'du ba'i gnas/ /chos grwa chen po dpal 'khor bde chen bzhengs/ /rgya gar ba sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag lo chos rgyal dgung lo so gcig bzhes pa'i dus na nag zla bco lnga'i dus chen nyin nas gan gos gser ma yug bcu phrag gnyis dang gsum/ kha 'khyar dgu /nang gi gzhi la gos yug gnyis kyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag gnyis/mtshams sbyor sku rgyu la gos dar kha bzhi bcu zhes gnyis rnams las grub pa'i gser 'phan chen mor dpangs su rtse khru so gsum/ zheng du gan gos brgyad bsgril yod pa'i dbus na byams pa bzhengs/ sku dpangs khru bco brgyad/ldebs spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs/ nyan thos shes rab can gyi mchog ye shes 'od/ rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog brtson 'grus brtan dpung zur gnyis na lha mgron thub pa/ mi 'khrugs pa/ khri'i 'og na mgon po gri gug ma ste gtso 'khor bdun bzhugs/ gzhan yang gos dar kha stong phrag gcig dang gnyis kyis lhag pa'i brgya phrag lnga sbyor byed kyi skud rgyu khal drug cu re lnga rnams las grub pa'i 'phan khyad par du 'phags pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku bzhugs pa sogs gnyis/ dbus kyi gser 'phan dang / bcas pa zla ba gcig dang theg brgyad kyi bar la bzhengs pa ni/ sngon chad skye bo kun gyi blo yul du/ /gang gis/ —54—

bkod pa tsam gyis mi shar ba'i/ /gos bzang du ma las grub mdzes pa'i sku/ /yid 'phrog 'phan gyi gzugs su bzhugs pa rnams/ /phun tshogs bco brgyad pa yi brgyad pa sa /byams chen mtshungs pa med pa'i gser 'phan dang / /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyang mngon sum byon/ /'di ni phun tshogs rnams kyi brgyad pa yin/ /zhes dang / lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang du rin chen rtser phyag phebs/dgon logs kyi grwa ba lho pa'i nang du bzhugs mtsher mdzad/ thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i sgang la sku dpang du shog ril rgan song ba zhig byung / gzigs pas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi bzhengs tshul sku'i tshad rgyu song sogs zhib par 'dug pas brda'i sgo nas lung bstan par dgongs/ rang re'ang chos sde gsar du bzhengs pa'i rten gtso'i sku tshad kyang 'di dang mthun par bzhengs/ de bzhin du gtsug lag khang sngar brtsigs pa khyon chung 'dug pas slar khyon ma chung ba zhig bsgrubs pa ni da lta'i gtsug lag khang nyid de gtsang khang ka chen brgyad/phibs brgyad chos su mdzes shing / khyams ka ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyi sa/ glo 'bur shar nub ka ba drug re dang ldan pa/ yongs su ka ba brgya dang lnga bcu'i sa phyi 'bur chen bcu gnyis mda' g.yab kyi khor yug tu mdzes pa gtsang khang chen mo'i dbus seng ges btegs pa'i khri byang chub chen po'i sku 'di rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi'i sku tshad ji lta ba/ rgyu zangs khal stong phrag gcig /gser zho brgya phrag brgyad las grub pa/ thugs kar paṇa chen shā ri pu tras spyan drangs pa'i rgya lha thub pa'i sku ngo mtshar ba sogs gzungs bzhugs brjod kyis mi langs pa bzhugs so/ /—55—

phun tshogs bco brgyad pa'i dang po la/ gtsang khang dbus na thub chen 'dzam gling rgyan/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar srid gsum 'od kyis 'gengs/ /mtshungs med byang chub chen po de nyid ni/ /phun tshogs bco brgyad rnams kyi dang po yin/ /de lta bu'i sku'i rgyab yol du na drug rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes pa'i gan+dho lar g.yas g.yon ldebs 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs gzer zangs las grub pa/ gzhan yang g.yas g.yon gnyis su khri rgyab yol dbus na 'das ma 'ongs kyi sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang byams pa/ shar nub kyi ngos pad sdong bcu drug la 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug bzhugs pa rnams kyi rab gnas 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis mdzad do/ /nub phyogs kyi glo 'bur rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang gi dbus na chos rgyal dgung lo so bzhi bzhes pa chu pho stag la thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa brgyud/ de nyid 'dus pa la dum bu bzhi yod pa'i dum bu dang po 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags spangs pa'i phyir bstan pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dum bu la yang gsum yod pa'i dang po rgya chen po la dga' ba'i sems can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor rgyas pa phyag rgya chen po gtso bor gyur pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs te/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can bzhugs pa'i phyogs bzhir sems ma bzhi/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la rdo rje rigs kyi sems dpa'/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs kyis bskor ba/ bcom —56—

ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan la rin chen rigs kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje rin chen sogs bzhis bskor ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la nga/tra'i rigs kyi sems dpa' rdo rje chos sogs bzhis bskor ba/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa la las kyi rigs kyi sems dpa' rdo rje las rab sogs bzhis bskor ba dang / sgeg mo ma/ 'phreng ba ma sogs nang sgeg bzhi/ bdug pa ma sogs phyi sgeg bzhi/ sgo ba rdo rje lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi/ rdor dbyings rtsa ba'i lha so bdun 'bur du dod par bzhugs so/ /mgron thabs la bskal bzang gi sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu po thams cad rdo rje rin chen sems dpa' 'dra ba/ spos kyi glang po sogs lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu po thams cad rin chen 'dra ba/ 'od dpag med sogs nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu po thams cad rdo rje chos 'dra ba/ rdo rje snying po sogs byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu po thams cad rdo rje las rab dang 'dra ba/ de sngar bskal bzang gi sems dpa' stong du bzhis ma tshang ba logs bris la bzhugs so/ /mdor na dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i lha tshogs stong dang sum cu so gsum tshang bar bzhugs pa 'di tsho'i rab gnas zhwa lu pa sku zhang chos rje nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad do/ /phun tshogs bco brgyad pa'i gnyis par/ /ri rab rtse mor lha yi gzhal yas khang / /rgyal chen rdo rje dbyings sogs gtso bo lnga/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i blon chen bzhi bzhir ldan/ /'khor bcas phun tshogs bco —57—

brgyad gnyis pa yin/ gtsang khang gi g.yon phyogs shar gyi 'bur chen chos rgyal lha khang gi dbus su chos rgyal dgung lo so lnga bzhes dus chu mo yos lo zla ba gsum pa la thugs dam du bzhengs pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal klu sgrub lugs rtsa phyag zhe gnyis pa 'bur sku 'khor gyi lha dang rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang bcas pa ri mor bris pas bskor ba'i g.yas phyogs su 'jam dbyangs/mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ka ma la shī la/ a ti sha/g.yon phyogs phyag na rdo rje/ kha che paṇa chen/ srong btsan sgam po/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ khri ral rnams kyi sku gzugs 'bur dod pa/ ngos g.yas g.yon rnams la mgon po tshe dpag med sogs sku stong rtsas bskor cing / lho byang gi stod kyi cha la sangs rgyas so lnga ri mor bkod pa bzhugs/ rab gnas 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad do/ /klu sgrub blo mtsho dwangs par shar ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i gzugs gcig pu/ /blta bas mi ngoms zhal phyag yongs rdzogs pa/ /'di ni nye ba'i phun tshogs gsum pa yin/ de rnams bzhugs pa'i phyi'i rim pa khyams bskor khang dang bcas pa la sku gzugs bris pa'i tshul bzhugs pa ni rnam thar sgo gsum gyi g.yas kyi gdong la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i ras bris mthong ba don ldan rgyas pa'i zhing khams/ 'di dang bskor lam gyi g.yas ngos su sangs rgyas rnam par snang mjad sprul sku la 'khor sras dang slob mar bcas pas bskor ba'i zhing khams/ gung gi sgo gdong g.yon la byams pa la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba'i zhing khams sogs sa ngas rgyas byang —58—

sems kyi zhing khams dang mdo lung so so nas gsungs pa'i zhing bkod bsam gyis mi khyab pa ldebs ris su bkod pa 'di rnams chos rgyal dgung lo so bzhi pa chu pho stag gi lo la bzhengs so/ /rab gnas gnas rnying mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal bas mdzad do/ /gtsug lag khang rtsegs 'bur chen bzhi yis mdzad/ /rin chen shing rtsegs brgya yis rnam bkra ba/ /gzhal yas khang pa skyengs par byed pa 'di/ /phun tshogs bco brgyad rnams kyi gsum pa yin/ /gtsang khang gi steng gzhal yas khang chen mo ka ba brgyad dang shing rtsegs rim pa bcu dang ldan pa'i ri mo la chos rgyal dgung lo so bdun bzhes pa shing mo sbrul la thugs dam du bzhengs pa ni rnal 'byor gnyis su med pa'i thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsungs pa'i dpal dus 'khor sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor g.yas phyogs rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud gtso bor ston pa'i dkyil 'khor ni dang por dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje 'phags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gnyis ma/de'i g.yas ngos sku'i rigs rdo rje 'jigs byed spyod lugs lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i g.yas nub phyogs kyi ngos la/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje ye shes zhabs lugs lha bcu dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor/de'i g.yas ngos rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor/de'i g.yas su de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs gshin rje gshed dmar po dpal 'jin lugs lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i g.yas sku'i rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed 'jam dpal zhal drug gi gdong drug lha bcu gsum ma'i —59—

dkyil 'khor/ de'i g.yas yar khyu'i cha la phur pa rtse dum gyi rgyud las bshad pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'am phur pa sa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ gong du bshad pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i g.yon ngos la shes rab gtso bor ston pa he ru ka'i rigs rnams bzhugs te/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gi thun mong min pa'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho le'u nga gcig pa/ nga gcig pa de nyid la'ang rab byed nyi shu rtsa lngar phye ba'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa las byung ba'i dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho he ru ka zhal bcu bdun phyag bdun cu don drug pas gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha brgya dang bzhi/ mgron thabs bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgo bzhi sbrags ston pa/ de'i g.yon bde mchog grub chen lo hi pa'i lugs lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor/ de'i g.yon shar phyogs kyi ngos la bsdus rgyud dam thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las rigs bsdus dang / rigs rkyang gnyis gsungs pa'i rigs bsdus mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor sa lugs/ de'i g.yon du rgyud gur brtag gnyis las 'byung ba snying po kyi rdor lha dgu ma grub chen bir wa pa'i man ngag lugs su grags pa'i dkyil 'khor/de'i g.yon ngos su rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kun gyi rtsa ba rigs drug mnyam par ston pa sku drug lhun grub mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i g.yon du rnam snang gi gdan bzhi'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i gdan bzhi lha mang gi dkyil 'khor slob dpon bha wa bha dra'i rgya gzhung la brten/ bla ma dam pa grags pa rin po che yi dgongs —60—

pa dang mthun par bzhugs/ de'i g.yon ngos yar khyu'i char rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud thams cad kyi bshad rgyud/ sam bhu zhi' brtag pa gsum pa'i rab byed bzhi pa nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje dbyings dang dur khrod la dges pa'i he ru ka (kyai rdor mtshon cha can gyi ming gi rnam grangs ) he ru ka drag po gdon can gsum gsungs pa'i nang tshan rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha so bdun ma rnams bzhugs/dkyil 'khor chen po de dag gi bar mtshams g.yas phyogs stod kyi cha la gshed dmar lha lnga ma grub chen bir wa pa'i lugs/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs lha dgu ma jo bo a ti sha nas lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi ngor gnang ba jo bo lugs 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor rgyud dang 'brel bar bshad kyang deng sang sa skya pa'i lugs srol du grags/ dus 'khor las gsang 'dus rigs drug tu bshad pa'i nang tshan gsang 'dus lha dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor/ phyag rdor 'khor chen lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsang 'dus rigs drug tu bshad pa'i nang tshan gsang 'dus lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ dus 'khor las sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rigs gsum gyi nang tshan sgyu 'phrul dra ba lha zhe gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor/'phreng bar gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor/ 'phreng bar gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang / 'og star la phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga ma/ ras chung bas grub chen wa la tsan dra la zhus bla med du bkral ras chung lugs dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma rwa lugs/ rdo rje phreng ba las bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu ma/ phag mo mngon byung las bshad pa'i phag mo lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor bshad brgyud bde mchog sdom 'byung las 'byung ba'i —61 —

gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug lha bcu ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dus 'khor las bshad pa'i 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lha zhe lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ dus 'khor las bshad pa'i gsang 'dus lha so gnyis ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dus 'khor las bshad pa'i gsang 'dus lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor/ phreng bar gsung pa'i bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ gsum las bdud rtsi hūṃX mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor/bde mchog reg tshig rnams kyi dkyil 'khor/ g.yon phyogs stod kyi cha la bde mchog nag po spyod pa'i lugs lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ mai tri lugs bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor ra/ brtag gnyis las gsungs pa'i sku kyai rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung gi rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i dkyil 'khor sam bhu zhi'i brtag pa gsum pa'i rab byed dang po ni rab tu byed pa dgu pa las gsungs pa'i kyai rdor mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor/ snying po kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa rtsegs gdan steng na bzhugs pa 'grel pa lugs lha dgu ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud rang las bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga ma/ 'phreng ba nas bshad pa'i ku ru kul+le lha bco lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen la bu ston rin po che nas zhwa lur gsan pa'i bla med thugs rje chen po pad+ma dra ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor 'og star la bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ slob dpon dril bu lugs lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ rngog lugs ma hā ma ya lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor thugs kyi rdo rje/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i dkyil 'khor brtag gnyis las gsungs pa'i bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ sgrol ma bla med lha —62—

bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sam bhu zhi'i rtogs pa gsum pa'i rab byed gnyis pa'am rab byed bcu pa las gsungs pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro lha bcu gsum ma/ 'phreng ba nas bshad pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma lha gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor/'phreng ba nas bshad pa'i hūṃX mdzad khro bo bcu gcig gi dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor sogs yongs sdoms lnga bcu rtsa lnga bzhugs pa'i grwa rnams nas rang rang gi dbang bka'/bshad bka'/ man ngag gi bka' babs pa'i bla ma rgyud pas bskor zhing mdor na go mtshams med pa til gyi gang bu bzhin yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de'i phyi rol bskor lam gong ma'i g.yas g.yon gyi ngos thams cad la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong la mdo sde bskal bzang las bshad pa ltar re re la'ang yab yum sras rim gro ba/ rdzu 'phrul can sogs bcu gsum bcu gsum gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ nub kyi glo 'bur gyi steng lam 'bras bla ma rgyud rim 'bur dod de rnams gong dkyil na lu i lugs kyi bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po blos blangs rgyu rin po che las grub pa/ steng phyogs kyi ngos kyi ri mo la grub thob brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/ sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud bzang rim byon pa rnams gdung rabs chen mo dang mthun par bzhugs/ byang phyogs ngos kyi ri mo la paṇa chen gyis mu stegs 'phrog byed tshar bcad pa'i bkod pa/ lho phyogs kyi ri mo la chos rgyal 'phags pa'i rnam thar/ mar khyu'i byang gi char rnam sras zhi ba bde byed 'khor lo bcas pho brang dbus na bzhugs pa dang / de'i g.yon na mgon po yab yum las ma/khan lnga/ gaṇ+ḍi las sprul pa'i khro tshogs kyis —63—

bskor ba/ yar khyu'i sgo'i g.yon la lha mo ru 'dren bzhis bskor ba'i g.yon du dkar mo nyi zla/ bdud rgyal nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum ri mor bzhugs pa 'di thams cad cung nang chen rab 'byor bzang po'i drung gi thugs dam du bzhengs/ rab gnas bsam lding rin po che chos dpal bzang pos mdzad/ dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ni rten dang brten pa rin po che las grub/ mkha' spyod gnas kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin gang 'di nye ba'i phun tshogs bzhi pa yin zhes shar gyi 'bur chen chos rgyal lha khang gi steng gnas brtan bcu drug 'bur dod par bzhugs pas gnas brtan lha khang zhes par thogs/ gzhan yang 'bur dod 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge gtso 'khor lnga/ seng ldeng nags sgrol la 'jigs brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma rnams dang / rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyi sku gzugs 'bur dod par bzhugs/ steng phyogs kyi che'i ri mo la jo bo rje'i byang chub lam rim gyi bla rgyud rnams dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ mi 'khrugs pa/'od dpag med/ sras byang chub sems dpa'/ sgo srung rgyal chen bzhi rnams ri mor bzhugs so/ /khyams chen gyi steng 'khor rnams gnam g.yab/ bar bskor gyi logs dang bcas pa la sku gzugs ri mor bzhugs pa ni gtsang khang lha khang gi zhal ras lha khang gi g.yas phyogs zhal shar gzigs kyi gdong chung la kha che paṇa chen la bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa'i bla ma rgyud pas bskor ba/ de'i g.yas kyi gdong chen la sangs rgyas la ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod kyis bskor ba/de'i g.yas phyogs na thub dbang la bstan pa'i gtad rabs kyis bskor ba/—64—

nub kyi gung lam 'bras lha khang gi sgo'i g.yon ngos la thub dbang la dpag bsam 'khri shing las byung ba'i sprin bzhon rtogs brjod/ sgo gong na mdo mdzangs blun las 'byung ba'i gser gyi 'bum pa'i rtogs brjod/ lha khang gi sgo'i g.yas ngos la thub dbang la gzhon nu ku na la'i rtogs brjod/ de'i g.yas phyogs su da ltar gyi sangs rgyas la rtag tu ngu sher phyin tshol ba byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags las thob sogs kyi bkod pa/ zhal ras lha khang gi g.yon nub tu phyogs pa'i gdong chung la jo bo a ti sha yab sras la blo sbyong rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ de'i g.yon gyi gdong chen la thub dbang la cho 'phrul tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar bstan/ mu stegs btul ba mdzangs blun dang mthun pa'i bkod pas bskor ba/ de'i g.yon phyogs na thub dbang byang sems sdom rgyud bla mas bskor ba/ shar gung gnas brtan lha khang gi sgo'i g.yas phyogs la thub dbang la rgyal po dpal sde'i rtogs brjod kyis bskor ba/ston pa thub dbang la rgyal byed tshal yongs su bzung ba'i gtam 'dul lung nas 'byung ba ltar bkod pa/de'i 'og tsam na sngon khri ral pa can gyis bye mda' lha khang bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod pa rgya 'jam pa'i gsang ba yin zer ba 'dug / bye mda' 'dir 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis chos 'khor skor ba'i mthil rang yin no/ /yang 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis myang stod bye mdar chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor dus sngags 'chang rin chen 'byung gnas des shangs kyi gad phur du yang phur sogs chos bka' mang du gsan du byon/ de'i phyag phyir jo mo —65—

chung ba'i sras dkon mchog mkhar mched gsum po 'bre shes rab 'bar la rab tu byung / lhag par dkon mchog mkhar pa la bum pa gang byo'i slob ma'i mchog yin no/ /sngon gyi dge bshes mang pos 'chad nyan mdzad pa/ bye mdar grags pa/ rwa los bye mda' pa/ la mdo sde sna grangs pu ti brgya dang sgron zan rgyun gyi cha rkyen khal khri tsho gsum sbyar ro/ /bye mdar jo bo a ti sha byon pa'i lam khar rgya brtson seng ge yul phum bu ri bgyi ba pha gi lags so bgyis pas slob ma'i yul du slebs pas slob ma med pa gsungs nas spyan chab 'byung ngo zhes bye mda' yang jo bo a ti sha phebs pa dang nges can yin no/ /las stod dkon mchog mkhar gyis lha khang gsos/ bye mdar nya mas lha khang bzhengs nas phul/ lcags ri mdzad 'dir sdod pa dga' gsungs nas shong mgur btab/ der yol sku mched gsum gar gyis bzhugs so/ /'bre chen pos kyang gtso cher shong mgur rang du bzhugs so/ /phyis yol thog 'bebs kyis bye mda' dge rgyas bzhengs/ gnas rnying mkhan po sangs rgyas rin chen pas bye mda' lha khang gsar 'chor bar bzhengs/ de'i gdan sa mkhan po bzang bzang nga/khru rin chen bas bye mdar khyams mchod bzhengs/ deng sang gtsug lag khang gi shul dang / bye mda' sngags pa zhes zer ba'i lce dmar gyi rgyud sngags pa gcig yod/shel dkar rgyal rtse'i lho nub kyi phyogs lung nag zhes pa'i sa yul na zhang skye med dam/ skye med jo gdan du grags pa ni skam ye shes rgyal mtshan dang de'i bla ma chags brag dmar ba gnyis ka'i slob rgyun la skye med zhang byon/ khong —66—

dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed la shin tu mkhas shing thugs su chud/ snyan rgyud bzhi tsho dgu'i gdams pa la yig cha mdzad pa sogs khyad par can gyi skye bo dam pa skye med zhang gi sprur ril por bzhugs pa'i sa 'bum yod/ ma gcig gi dgon pa khams chen gcig kyang yod/ myang chu nub phyogs rgyang ro'i sa khul du gtogs tsam thag ring po na rgod tshang pa'i sgrub tshugs rang dang mnyam pa'i ba ri spyi dkar bas btab pa'i 'gos yul 'bri mtshams kyi dgon pa dang / khong rang gi sku 'dra'i sku la rdul mi chags pa yod/ myang stod rgyang ro'i thag ring sar gtsug lag khang gcig na klu yul nas spyan drangs pa yin zer ba'i 'bum gcig bzhugs/ de'i 'og tsam na bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos btab pa'i rgyang bu'i lha khang thog snga la byin rlabs che'o/ /phyis su rgyang ro spe'u dmar gyi rkyang (rgyang 3bu chos blo lo chen rin chen bzang pos kha che nas lan grangs dang po 'khor nas ring por ma song ba dang mjal nas lo chen rin chen bzang po la rdo rje 'byung ba'i dbang bka' sha ju ka ra nas brgyud pa de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan btags pa gsan/dpal mchog hor kong can phreng chad ma bsabs pa de'i dbang bka' lung bka' mtha' dag gi lag len dol po sgom chen la zhus/ bshad pa lo chung legs she la zhus/ phyis su lo chen rin bzang gis kha che nas lan grangs gnyis pa 'khore nas mjal te dpal mchog gis phreng chad pa bsabs pa gsan no/ /dge bshes rkyang (rgyang 3bu chos blos bzhengs pa'i myang stod kyi rgyang ro spe'u dmar gyi dgon pa rkyang (rgyang 3bu zer ba'i gtsug lag khang 'dir yo —67—

ga dang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi bshad grwa rkyang (rgyang 3bu yang myang stod rgyang ro spe'u dmar gyi mkhas pa rkyang (rgyang bu chos blor grags pa de'i 'khrungs yul kyang rkyang (rgyang ka bu'i nye 'gram gyi grong kha shas spe'u dmar zer ba de yin no/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la bka' drin shin tu che ba'i zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyis lo chung legs she/ zur chos pa an ston/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu bum pa/ dz+nyā na shrī sogs bsten nas mkhas par gyur nas zangs dkar gyi rtse mo la 'grel pa mdzad pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta thugs rje che na po dang zangs dkar gyi smad 'grel dum bu gsum pa bsgyur ba yang myang stod rgyang ro'i spe'u dmar gyi dgon pa rkyang (rgyang bu yin no/ /rgya gar paṇa chen gzhon nu bum pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa'i mthil yang rkyang (rgyang bu yin zhing / de nyid 'dus pa'i stod 'grel ni sngon du lo chen rin chen bzang gis bsnyur zin na/ de nyid 'dus pa'i smad 'grel ni paṇ+ḍi ta bal po thugs rje chen po dang zangs dkar lo tshwas myang ro'i sa'i cha dgon gnas g.ye thang zhes bya bar jo sras lte'i 'bar gyi yon bdag byas nas bsgyur ro/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa 'di nyid snang ba kun snying gis mdzad pa de yin/ sho lo ka stong phrag bco brgyad yod pa'i 'gyur byang du 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bu'i myang ro g.yu khams kyi pad+ma'i snying po lta bu'i dgon gnas g.yar (g.ye thang du mgon po byams pa lta bu'i mkhas pa thugs rje la tshangs pa'i rgyal po lta bu'i lha rjes gsol btab nas tshong dpon nor bzang bzhin du —68—rī

dga' bas bsgyur ba lags zhes dang / ra los (yo ga la mkhas pa mi gsum gyis yo ga de nyid 'dus pa la 'grel pa rtsis pa ni de nyid gnang ba a wa ra ra/ ko sa la'i rgyan no/)thugs rje chen po rgya gar la thegs khar gser srang stong 'bul sa yang rkyang bu yin/ tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i za ma tog de'i nang na zangs dkar lo cwa'i thugs bzhugs/ byang sems zla rgyal gyi slob ma grub thob nyi phugs pas zangs dkar lo tsā can du bde mchog dang / rnam sras sogs lo drug bzhugs nas chos rgya che gsan pa yang rgyang ro spe'u dmar gyi dgon pa rkyang (rgyang 3bu yin no/ /kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rgyal sras lam rim bsdus pa chung ngu gcig dge bshes rkyang pos (rgyang ka lha khang der brtsams so/ /snar slas mo cher 'di rgyas par brtsams so/ /rkyang bu zer ba'i gtsug lag khang du grub chen kun dga' blo gros kyis kyang bzhugs pa mdzad/ nyams rtogs dpag tu med pa gnas der 'khrungs shing / /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa la/ /khyed mkha' 'gro chos skyong dgyes par mdzod/ khyed dgongs pa can kun dgyes par mdzod/ /thams cad dgyes pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par shog /ces dgyes mdzad bsam don 'grub pa'i mgur 'di lo paṇa mkhas grub du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog rkyang (rgyang bu lha khang du mtshams dam por bzhugs pa'i tshe smras pa dge legs su gyur cig gsungs so/ /btsan po sad na legs mjing yon gyi blon po dpyal pa g.yu sgra dpal legs kyis rgyang ror byon/ rkyang chu'i sman chur sku mkhar btab nas bzhugs/ sras chung bzang dpal dkar po/ dpal legs —69—

'phen nag po/ 'phen legs rtsegs gra bo gsum yang 'dir 'khrungs/ rgyal po sad na legs mjing yon kyang sku mkhar 'dir spyan drangs nas rgyal pos sras gsum la gos dkar nag khra gsum la brten pa'i lung bstan mdzad pas dpyal pa'i chos dang 'jig rten gyi mdzad srol bzang po'i lung bstan pa yul 'di ru thob bo/ /de'i 'og tsam na 'bras khung zer ba'i gtsug lag khang yod/ de'i 'og tsam na rgya gnas zer ba'i gtsug lag khang yod/ de'i 'og tsam na kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sku gong ma lha rje chos byang gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang yod pa'i rgyu mtshan lo rgyus ni gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir myang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas su grags pa'i cha rgyang ro g.ye dmar zhes bya bar kha che paṇa chen lha rje chos byang zhes bya bar sku skye ba zhes bya ste de'i tshe la'ang mdo sngags bsdus pa'i yon tan gyi rgya mtshor bstan la bstan pa rim du gnas pa'i gzhir dgongs nas phun sum tshogs pa'i lha khang bzhengs shing / gsung rab mang du bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas phan pa rgya chen po mdzad de/ khyod sngon chos byang 'od stong can du gyur/ /rgyang ror lhag bsam 'od zer rab bkye nas/ /gtsug lag dam pa'i chos rgya rab rgyas te/ /gdul bya bung ba tshims par mdzad la 'dud/ /lha rje chos byang gi skye ba rting ma kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī yin/ de sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal yin te khro los/ bde legs 'byung gnas bstan pa rin chen sgron/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi bdun par grags/ /sa chen steng na 'gran gyi zla med pa/ shwakya'i mtshan can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces kha che paṇa chen —70—

tshur bod du phebs skabs rgyang ro lung par phebs pa dang / lung pa 'di na nga'i skye ba snga mas lha khang maṇ+ḍal tsam zhig bzhengs pa yod/ de tsa na skye bo rnams dad pa lhag par che zhing 'bri klog nyan bshad kyang dar na deng sang paṇ+ḍi ta 'ongs pa la bsod snyoms 'bul zhing nga'i thad du 'ong par rigs na dad pa nyams par 'gyur ba zhig gyis zhes gsungs so/ /thams cad bsnyel gsos te rgyang ro yul stod smad kyis sna byas/ thams cad kyis chos 'brel zhus/ /rgyang ro gru'i lha chen rdo rje sems dpa'i rab gnas mdzad de srin lag las bdud rtsi 'dzags par grags so/ /de'i 'og na khro lo byams pa'i dpal gyis kha che paṇa chen spyan 'dren gyi phyir lam du bzhud dus/ rgyang ro gud chung na dge bshes rgya bya ba bla ma zhang gi dngos slob la zhang gis chos bskor zhus shing don 'grub pa'i lung bstan no/ /do chen dang do chung gnyis su grags pa'i gnas gzhi'i shul yod pa de khro lo phar byon dus bzhengs so/ /de'i 'og na rnying ma'i gnas gzhi yin zer ba'i man lung zer ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig yod/ de'i 'og na zho nang gi gtsug lag khang / de'i 'og na gzhon nu 'od ni sum pa skyil mkhar ba'i grwa pa/'dul byung dkar mo la bsnyen rdzogs mkhan po zhus/ gtsang nag pa yang bla mar bsten/ kha che paṇa chen slas mo cher mjal/ gtsang ba sar rbos rnams bsten/gsang 'dus kyi rgyud kyang man ngag tu 'dril nas gnang ba'i bla ma thang se ba 'phags pa skyabs yin/ ser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyis ser bu dben tshar bzhugs te rgyang ro ser sdings btab nas rgyud man ngag bshad do/ /—71—

rgyang ro ser sdings kyi gnas gzhi 'dir ser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/de rjes de'i sras su brdzus kyang zer/ sras don po yin yang zer/ ser sdings btab nas lo dgu song ba na slob ma mgar grags pa dbang phyug gi sring mo la sras bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad nas kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer byung yang zer/gang ltar na kha che paṇa chen gyi skye ba kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer mtshan 'dogs mkhan bla ma 'phags pa yin kyang zer mkhan yod pa sogs gsang 'dus kyi rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi 'byung gnas gcig pur gyur pa/ rgyang ro ser sdings pa/ 'dir byon pa yin la de'i lo rgyus tsam smos na kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dras rgya gar nas rgyang ro na mar byon dus ser ldings kyi ri nang pad+ma kha phye ba lta bu la gzigs nas ma 'ongs pa na 'dir ngas skye bo rnams la lam ston pa 'gyur ro/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin rgyang ro ser sdings zhes bya bar/ser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od zer zhes bya ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa zhig sras su 'khrungs tshul 'og tu bshad pa ltar yin/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la gnas rnying mkhan po chos rje rin chen dpal drung du rab tu byung / mtshan chos sku 'od zer du gsol/ de'i tshe bar snang du 'ja' 'od me tog dang bcas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma byon te e ma ho/ bde legs su gyur cig /bskal bzang bdun pa 'jig rten du/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ /'di na chos sku 'od zer 'gyed/ /ces gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de rjes 'dul 'byung rkyang 'dur du chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma la gshugs/ gshed dmar gyi dbang zhu dus bla ma gshed dmar du gzigs/ dbu —72—

tshad byams pa'i chos lnga/ dus 'khor 'bro lugs rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsan nas mdzad pa mdzad pas kun ha las zhing / chos rje pas rang brgyud par mi 'dug gsungs nas shin tu mnyes te 'chad par gyur na thub pa'i dbang po bzhin/ /rtsod na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyang 'dar ba 'dra/ /rtsom la kun gsal kun mkhyen chags thogs med/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la mkhas pas bsngags/ /zhes de'i tshe kun mkhyen du grags so/ /sa paṇa la'ang kyai rdo rje'i skor sogs mang du gsan/ chos rgyal 'phags pa la phar chos gsungs pa dang nyan pa dang / chag lo/ lo ras/ rga lo sogs la chos zhus/ lha sa'i jo bo'i gsung dngos su byon nas lhas bskor rgyal bas bka' bstsal pa/ khyod kyi dang po bsam pa na/ /brtson pas bsgrubs na lus 'di yi/ /sangs rgyas mchog thog 'gyur ba la/ /brtson pa dar ba ma legs so/ /slar yang spyin bsreg brgya rtsa brgyad/ skye bo mang po tshogs par sku bzhengs pa gsang sngags kyi gzhung mang po bshes gnyen bzang la lung thob bya/ /mi rna che/sa kyis ni mgon skyabs bya/ /de ltar byas na las grib sel/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang / /'gro ba'i yid bzhin nor bur gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar ser sdings su spyin bsreg brgya tshar/ dge sding du gtsug lag khang gi 'gram bting / jo bo shākya'i sku 'jam pa'i rtsa rgyud bzhin gtso bo'i lha tshogs dang bcas bzhengs/ slob ma btsas pa'i bu bzhi ni/ /che ba thugs rje brtson 'grus dang / /chung ba yon tan rgya mtsho gnyis/ /bar ba rin chen gangs pa dang / /blo ldan seng ge bzhi ru yod/ /chen po'i slob ma bsam mi khyab/ /ces mkhas grub —73—

de rnams dgon gnas ser sdings na kun mkhyen chos sku'i ljags ser sdings gdung khang na bzhugs so/ /de'i 'og tsam na rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi bka' babs kyi slob ma bzhi'i nang gi dbu tshad la bka' babs shing / mkhas pa mchog tu gyur pa khyung rin chen grags kyi bzhugs pa'i mthil dang 'chad nyan bskyangs pa'i gnas glang pa 'phang thang (glang pa gser gling gi nye 'gram na yod) dgon pa yin la de 'dzin mi bla ma su byung yang khyung gi gdan sa zer ro/ /'dir bshad nyan gyi mthil mdzad pa'i slob ma stod lung rgya dmar ba dang / rtag pa kha che sogs mkhas pa mang du byung ba yang yin/ grub thob nyi phug pas kyang khyung rin chen grags la mkhan po zhus/ rab tu byung nas mtshan chos kyi grags par btags pa yang glang pa 'phang thang yin/ phyis gnas rnying mkhan po chos kyi rin chen gyi dgon pa'i kha gso yar 'phel mdzad nas dgon gnas 'phang thang du mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i 'og na gser gling gi gdong lung nag rgyang ro gnyis kyi mdo na kha che paṇa chen gyi sa 'bum rdo phud la bzhengs zer ba'i sa phud lha khang /de'i phu na gnas rnying dgon lag 'phur lding dgon pa yod/ 'di jo bo a ti sha'i sprul pa'am skye bar grags pa mkhan po chos kyi rin chen gyis btab bo/ /de'i 'og tu lung nag tu sbas khang rin chen rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ lung nag glang pa gser gling 'debs mkhan spos khang pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan ma yin/ rje btsun grags pa tsam gyi dus sa skya pa'i dge bzhas rin

chen rgyal mtshan gyis btab pa'i glang ba gser gling zer ba'i gnas gzhi btsugs yod/ deng sang grub mtha' dge ldan pa yin/ de'i 'og tsam na ri bo dge ldan pa'i dgon pa gtsang brag zer ba gcig yod/ spyir ni rgyang ror bla ma khyad par can shin tu mang bar 'khrungs pa zhabs kyis bcags pa yin te/ rngog blo ldan shes rab dang / pa tshab nyi ma grags gnyis ka'i slob ma gang pa she'u'i bzhugs yul dang 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i mthil rgyang ro zhwa ma'i ming po rje mkhon bur grags pa'i slob ma khyad par can yang rgyang ror byung / dgon gyi bu bzhi'i nang tshan rin po che sno'u zur pa'i slob ma rgyang ro dar brtson yang rgyang ror 'khrungs shing dgon pa yang yod/ zhang ston gnyos sgom gyi slob ma se ston jo khro gtsang gi rgyang ror 'khrungs/ rgyang ror gzhon rin yang 'khrungs/ snubs 'dul 'dzin nam g.ya' bzang pa'i bla ma rgyang ro dar mgon khyad par can du grags pa de yang rgyang ror 'khrungs/ bla ma gru'i gdung rabs 'di dang po khams kyi klong thang sgrol ma'i lha khang na bzhugs shing mi rabs mang po nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyud pa yin/ de nas bod rgyal btsad po'i mchod gnas la spyan drangs/ de nas rim gyi myang stod rgyang ror gdung rgyud rim par bzhugs so/ /de'i rgyud la gru tshul khrims chos kyi 'byung gnas bya ba gsang sngags rnying ma la shin tu mkhas pas myang stod rgyang ror grwa pa mang po bsdus nas bshad pa mdzad cing / lha khang dmar po bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de la sras gsum byung ba la bla ma gru nag byang chub rgyal mtshan bya ba'i rgyud yin/ bla ma gru —75—

go cha rdo rjes nya ri sgo phug gi mda' tsha sto po la phyag rdor mgon po lha lnga'i dbang lung zhus nas/ myang stod rgyang ror lo bcu bzhi lon pa gcig gis/ zer mo lung bya ba'i brag gseb tu bzhugs te sgrub pa mdzad/ slar bla ma rta sgom dang /mid pa dgon pa ste rgyal rtse'i rgod khung yang zer/ rgod lung yang zer ngo bo ri khrod dge ldan du mjal nas phyag rdor la brten pa'i grub thob tu gyur/ yang bla ma gru go cha rdo rjes yi dam gyi lha'i zhal mang du gzigs pa dang / ye shes kyi me ljang dmar du 'bar ba'i gseb na phyag rdor dngos su byon nas dbyangs dang tshigs bcad gsungs pa yang rgyang blo'i brag dmar rdzong chung du bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su'o/ /yang gru ban nam mkha' rdo rjes rgyang ro'i bu lung dben rtsa ru 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga dngos su zhal gzigs/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lum the ba bya ba rgyang ror byon pa des gru ban nam mkha' la mjal nas bod kyi grub thob chen po zhes gsungs pa'i lo rgyus rgya cher (grub kyang 'di la bde mchog gsan no/) yod do/ /gru jo bsod kyis rgyang ror spe mo che bzhengs/ gser 'bum bzhengs/gtsang brag zer ba'i 'og tsam na/ gnas rnying gi stod tsam na/ gnas gog ces par sa 'bum nang na dkon mchog mkhar gyi spur ril por bzhugs so/ /las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar zhes mkhas grub khyung po'i bla ma mchog tu gyur zhing mgon po'i bka' babs nas/ bla ma khyung po'i mi 'bral pa'i rten mnga' bdag mi tri'i shangs mtshal 'bri ba po yang mai tris mdzad pa'i ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i zhal thang rgya ris rtsod med phyag drug ye —76—

shes mgon po dang yum 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa'i khyad par can de khyung pos gnang ba/ mi 'bral ba'i bla ma'i rten slob mas 'khur ba mi yong dgongs/ ma bsnams pa shangs mgron khang du phebs pa'i dgong mo nam mkha' la 'phur nas pang du byung bas na/ dus deng sang 'phur thang du grags pa de gnas rnying gi li ma lha khang na bzhugs so/ /spyir las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar la bka' babs pa ni gu chos drug gi dbang byin rlabs khrid bcas dang 'brel ba bka' srung mgon po'i skor la/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi byin rlabs/ grib sel/gnas dbab lha bzhi bla mar dril nas sgrub pa/ mgon mthing / gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po/ mgon ljang tshe'i bdag po/ mgon ser gur gum mdog can/ mgon po 'ching kha/ gsang sgrub yum can mgon po rgyan can sogs mgon bka' bcu gsum/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi khrid/ rā hū la nas brgyud pa'i sku dngos la rten pa'i lnga khrid/ mai tri pa nas brgyud pa'i 'khor lo bzhi khrid/ mai tri nas brgyud pa'i mkha' spyod dkar mo dang mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu gnyis kyi 'khor lo bzhi la rten pa'i tshe khrid sogs dang / phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i rnam grangs tsam zhig bshad na/ slob dpon mdog stod pa dang dge slong lhun grub grags pas bsam yas mchims phu'i brag rta mgo gdong gi 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin bde gshegs 'dus pa zhi khro rigs 'dus bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs su bsgrubs pa'i skor gyi cha lag la phyag drug pa yong ste/ rgyas pa dzam bha la dkar po 'brug bzhon lha zhe lnga/ rgyal po khams gsum rnam rgyal —77—

dang / shākya thub pa sogs thog mar dge ba'i lha drug /las kyi rta mgrin dang /sras rta phur te bar du dge ba'i lha gnyis/ lha mo rig byed bzhi sogs mtha' mar dge ba'i lha bcu/ gsang ba ma hā ka la la/ phyag drug pa lha bcu gsum gyi dbang sogs so/ /las stod dkon mchog mkhar nas mkhas grub khyung pos kyang thugs sras dang bka' babs kyi slob ma 'bre chen po yang thugs sras kyi mchog yin no/ /de'i 'og tsam na myang stod rgya gar gyi gling gnas rnying rdo rje gdan mtshungs/ dog sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'dra ba'i steng / gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dra ba'i 'og /logs bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa'i sbubs/ rgyab ri glang chen nyal ba 'dra ba'i mdun/ dbus nas dpal 'bar zhing / mtha' nas g.yang lud pa'i gnas/ skyegs kyi gnas rnying zer ba/ sngon bstan pa snga dar gyi dus bsam yas su rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas kyi nye 'gram ri zangs mdog nas sngags pa bza' mi rnyed nas rgyal po'i sku rim pa mdzad pas rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba zhes grags/ rgyal pos sad na legs kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mdzad/ bsam yas kyi mdo sngags kyi sde gnyis yod pa las sngags kyi dbu sde'i gtso bo ste bla ma mdzad/ de'i sras mnga' bdag khri ral can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ rgyal pos 'on 'chang rdo (cang do )dpe med kyi lha khang rgya phibs dgu thog mas gtso byas gtsug lag khang stong rtsa gnyis bzhengs pa'i dus su/ zhal bkod gnang mkhan dang rab gnas thams cad rgya 'jam pa'i gsang bas mdzad nas/sgrags kyi phu zangs mdog tu sgrub pa mdzad skabs/ sngon rgyal po khri srong lde'u —78—

btsan gyi nang blon chen po 'gos khri bzang / ('di 'gos pad+ma gung btsan yin pas dpyad par zhu/ sngon rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi nang blon chen po 'gos khri bzang spo 'gos khri 'bring khang bzang zhes pa yab yin la/ chos blon de'i bu 'gos kyi pad+ma gung btsan ces blon po byed pa 'gos pad+ma gung btsan yin no/ /yang 'gos khri bzang yab lhag de nyid pad+ma gung btsan gyi mes po yin ṣ+ka khri 'bring khang bzang gi pha'o/)yab lhag la/ dang po khyod kyis bod yul 'dir chos dar ba'i thabs kyi blo bton/ da res khyod kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang mchod rten kho na ngo mtshar bas da khyod kyi bya dga' la mon skyer chu lha khang tshun/ ka la mtsho gzhug yan chad/ 'bri mtshams smug po tshun gyi sa cha rnams gnang ngo / /blon po 'gos kyis bzung ba la brten nas 'gos yul stod gsum zhes grags so/ /blon po 'gos kyi sras khyung rgod rtsal spyan 'dren la brdzangs pas slob dpon pad ma'i dngos slob yin nges shes/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba sgrags kyi phu ri zangs mdog nas spyan drangs/ rgya 'jam dpal gyis rgyal po khri ral gyi sar byon nas/ nged la gzhi 'cha' ba'i sa cha gcig zhus pas rgyal pos stod na ru lag khang gsum/ smad na she'u lung gsum/ bar skyegs ru gsum sa cha dang brtas pa 'bre khyung rje 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams bla ma brgyud bcas la shes su chug gsungs 'ja' sa gnang nas 'gos kyi sras khyung rgod rtsal gyi nye gnas kyi tsha ba mdzad nas/ skyegs gnas snying du gnas gzhi brtsigs shing gnas rnying lcags ri dbu mas bskor ba dang/ bla ma'i gzim khang lha khang dang bcas bzhengs/ dben dgon du dbus lung thang khung la gzim khang brtsigs/ skyid sgor bla ma'i sgrub khang brtsigs/ rgya'i las thabs chen po gsum mdzad/ rgya —79—
