'jam dpal gsang ba'i nang rten/ sras yang dag skyabs kyis spyan ras gzigs kyi sku li ma bzhengs/ da lta gnas rnying 'du khang steng gi man khang na yod pa de yin/ phyi rten gnas rnying lha khang nang gi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs bzhengs pa'i nang na sku gdung ril po bzhugs/ de'i nang na mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i ma mgal dang khri ral gyi 'ja' sa yang der bzhugs/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'i sras yang dag skyabs/ de'i sras jo sras bdud 'joms/de'i sras gnyis las che ba phur pa skyabs sam/ jo sras rdo rje dbang phyug gzhon pa la jo sras phur pa 'phel lo/ /gcen gyis grub pa thob nas da lta tsha mo dang gnyis ka bse rag brag la sku lus ma spang par bzhugs/ gcung phur pa 'phel kyang grub thob tu gyur pa de'i tshe dbus lung thang khugs kyi ri sna gnas rnying mthong sar gzim khang phyi rten dbus lung ri gdong gi 'bum pa thog phub ma'i nang na gdung ril por bzhugs so/ /gnas rnying gi gnas gzhi 'di che ba bcu'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags te bcu ni/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis 'ja' sa gnang / rgya 'jam dpal gsang bas lung bstan/ jo bo rin po che dī baX ka ras lung bstan rab gnas gnang / yol ston mched gsum gyis grub rtags bstan/ spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i bka' babs/ 'bre chen ngo/ shes rab 'bar gyi gdan sa/ bstan srung ma hā ka la'i zhal bzhes/ slob ma'i mchog gyur grub thob rnam gsum/ brgyud pa'i mchog gyur byang sems byon tshul lo/ /che ba dang po 'ja' sa gong du bkod grub/ che ba gnyis pa rgya 'jam dpal —80—

gsang bas gos chen kha gang la dbus su kho rang gi zhabs gnyis kyi rjes bzhagamatha' la dgung lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa bla ma'i sku brgyad cu gya brgyad byon/gdugs yod pa so gnyis/ pad+ma yod pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gdugs dang pad+ma med pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ /ci'i ltas lags zhus pas/ ma 'ongs par gnas rnying 'dir spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa brgyad cu gya brgyad bar ma chad par 'byon pa'o gsungs/ zhabs rjes dngos bya mo mgul na bzhugs/ gnas rnying na yod pa zhal yin no/ /che ba gsum pa/ yol mched gsum la jo bo a ti shas lung bstan te myang chu'i rgyud la bzhugs la yar rgyugs/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyab ri glang chen nyal 'dra yod/ der rgyugs la gnas rgyobs/ phyis bstan pa'i rgyun la phan gsungs pa la brten/ mched gsum gyis yar byon nas yol chos dbang gis lung bstan gyi sa cha 'di yin par 'dug dgongs nas gnas rnying du byon/ jo sras phur pa 'phel la bsam gtan sgoms pa'i sa cha gcig bslangs pas ri gdong ya gi yol tsam nas phug gcig bdog pas der bzhugs zer/ sa phug de la a mes yol 'es deng sang gi bar du grags pa de yin/ de nas jo sras phur pa 'phel sogs gnas rnying pa rnams kyis grogs dan yol chen pos mdzad nas/ jo bo dī paX ka ras rab gnas nyan 'tsho nas mdzad pas dus tshes steng rab gnas kyi me tog gnas rnying du babs so/ /thugs dam tsha tsha mang bar bskur bar mdzad do/ /tshos kyi dbang phyug gis jo sras phur pa 'phel la khyed kyi dgon par nged kyi dge 'dun gyi sde zhig btsugs na mi mnyes pa mi 'byung —81 —

ngam zhus pas/ jo sras shin tu dgyes/ nga'i bsam pa'i don grub gsungs nas/skyegs gnas snying gi sa cha ma lag dgon pa rten gsum nang gi rten dang yon bdag dang bcas gtad/ rgya'i las thabs gsum gyi srol mi nus pa'i brjid bkal ba sogs yol chen po'i phyag tu phul lo/ /yol gyis bka' gdams kyi grwa sa bzang po gtsugs/ rba tsho nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkhan po mdzad/ 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis yol chos kyi dbang phyug la rab byung zhus shing chos dang gdams pa mtha' dag gsan no/ /che ba bzhi pa chos dbang gis chos gos nyi zer bkal/ sha sbu'i rtsa brgyad 'grol lam du khrid/ yol drang srong gis ljon dmar gyi rdo rje bcu pas khrag byung / yol thog 'bebs kyis brag dkar gyi ri seṅge kha gdangs pa 'dra ba la rta zla la thog ma smad dgu phab nas brag dkyil nas shel gyi mchod rten mi gang pa gcig dang khru gang pa gcig byung ngo / /yol sku mched gsum ka'i nang rten gnas rnying gi gtsug lag khang rnying pa dang lcang ra gnyis na bzhugs so/ /yol chos kyi dbang phyug la slob ma'i mchog du ma zhig yod kyang 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar slob ma'i mchog tu gyur zhing / 'bre chen po'i bla ma rgya gar gyi 'bum phrag pa rngog blo ldan shes rab sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma bsten/ byams pa mgon pos rjes su bzung ba'i skyes chen de la yol chos dbang gi gdan sa rba tsho nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / jo sras phur pa 'phel gyis phul ba'i sa cha dbang rigs thams cad gtad nas gdan sa bskos so/ /'bre chen po de la slob ma mchog gyur khyung rin chen grags/ ar byang —82—

chub ye shes/ gnyal ba bsregs ston/ mdog pa byang chub grags/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar sogs grwa pa dpe 'grem pa stong phrag tsam byung ba'i dkyil gyi slob ma'i mchog gyur la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar yin pas khongs la 'bre'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum gyis thog drangs/ gnas rnying dgon pa ma lag sa cha yon bdag dang bcas pa la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar la gtad nas gdan sa bskos so/ /la stod dkon mchog mkhar gyi gdung dpyal yin/ dang po la stod byang gi sa thub de'i ri khrod du sngags 'chang dpyal rgyal ba grub pa nas bzung sngags 'chang nus pa can gyi rgyud pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa gdung rgyud la bar ma chad par brgyad cu gya brgyad du byon pa'i ltas ni/ dpyal zhang khrom rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 'od gsal dag pa'i snang ngor thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa mi dkar po zhig 'ongs nas/ sa byang phyogs bod kyi rgyal khams 'di/ /nga thugs rje chen po'i gdul bya yin/ /khyad par lha yi rnam 'phrul dngos/ /skal ldan khyod kyi rgyud la 'jug /byang skyib sems dpa'i gdung rgyud bzungs/ zhes mi dkar po de sngags 'chang dpyal rin chen 'byung gnas la thim pas la stod pa'i gdung rabs de thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin par the tshom byar med do/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs dpyal zhang khrom rin chen 'byung gnas sam sngags 'chang rin chen 'byung gnas kyis shangs kyi gad phur du yang phur la sogs zab chos mang po gsan du byon/ de'i phyag phyir jo mo gzhon pa la 'khrungs pa'i sras dkon mchog mkhar sku mched gsum po yang khri byon dus 'bre chen po mkhas pa'i snyan —83—

grags dbus gtsang khams gsum la khyab 'dug pa la yab kyis dkon mchog mkhar sku mched gsum rab tu 'byung bar brdzangs/ de'i tshe 'bre chen po bye mdar chos 'khor bskor ba dang mjal/ mched gsum rab tu byung / thos bsam mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar gyis gzhan yang bla ma lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po bsten zer rnam thar la bkod 'dug kyang dus mi 'grig /khyung rin chen grags bsten/ sa skya pa kun dga' snying po bsten/ shangs zhong zhong du mkhas grub khyung po'i slob ma'i tshogs khri tsho brgyad yod pa'i nang nas bde mchog dang mgon po gnyis la bu chen gyi mchog tu gyur/mai tri pa'i thugs dam chos skyong thang sku shangs lo mar grags pa de gnang nas ma bzhes pa la thang sku nam mkha' la byon nas bye mdar gro gsol gyin bzhugs pas thang sku thu bar byon pa sogs phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i bka' babs kyi che ba yin no/ /slar phyag drug pa'i zhal dngos su bstan nas thugs 'khrigs mi 'tshal/ /dgon pa'i bdag gnyer dang rang gis byed gsungs pas lha'i zhal bzhes kyis che ba yin/ la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar pas jo sras dpal chen skyabs kyi brag mo'i mgron khang yod pa de chu mdo pas der dgon pa btab/gnas gzhi brtsigs/ lcags ri dang gtsug lag khang sogs mdzad pa 'di la gnas gsar ram gnas gog tu yang grags/ la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar gyi slob ma dpal phag mo gru pa/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ mkhan po dbang phyug rin chen sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i slob ma'i che ba'o la stod pa go dgu la gshegs pa yang khong rang gis btab pa'i dgon pa gnas —84—

gsar ram gnas gog tu yin zhing / sku gdung yang ril por mchod rten du bzhugs shing / da lta gnas gog tu grags pa'i lha khang chung ja'i nang na mchod rten gnyis bzhugs pa'i gcig yin no/ /mchod rten gcig gi nang na 'bre las rab tu byung ba rang gi gcen po dkon mchog mkhar mched la sde snod mtha' dag gsan pa mkhan po kun seng gi sku gdung ril por bzhugs par yin no/ /'bre'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum ni rgya gar gyi lha gser sku thub pa dmar po/ bla 'bum skya pod rnam bzhi gser 'bum gyi byin rlabs char 'bebs/'bre'i gdugs dkar po/ mchod dung bkra shis dar lung / bla yol 'gran zla kun bral/ sbub chal nyi ma rgyang grags/ bum pa bkra shis 'gying ring / ber seng ge 'gying bsnol/ dkar yol zla ba khron chung / grum tse gnam sngon po/bse sga bkra shis 'od 'bar/ chibs pa ngang pa 'phur shes/ thog ma'i mkhan rabs ni yang phur grub thob 'jam dpal gsang ba/ rigs gsum sprul pa yol ston mched gsum/ rgya gar paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ byams pas rjes bzung 'bre chen shes 'bar/ spyan ras gzigs sprul pa/ la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ sems dpa' chen po'i rin chen rgyal mtshan/ de la sogs te gnas rnying mkhan brgyud do/ /rba tsho nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni skyegs gnas rnying nas mched pa tsho la rba tsho stod pa/lcang ra dang stse spe gnyis nas mched pa tsho la rba tsho bar pa/ rtsis nas mched pa tsho la rba tsho smad nga/ zer ro/ /—85—

de'i mched pa'i khungs kyi rtsa ba ni jo bo a ti shas chos rgyags gnang nas yol sku mched gsum pos rba btsun bsod nams dbang phyug la bslab pa len du bcug /rab tu byung / 'di'i sdom brgyud thub pa / shā ri'i bu/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ klu sgrub/ legs ldan 'byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho/ rat+na gar+bha/ g.yo dge 'byung / dgongs pa rab gsal/ ya (spang ka gong ye shes g.yung drung / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/tshong btsun shes rab seng ge /rba btsun bsod nams dbang phyug /yol ston chos kyi dbang phyug /'bre chen/ la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar sogs so/ /gnas rnying mkhan po dbang phyug rin chen pa'am mkhan po dbang rin pa'i bla ma bka' drin mchog tu che ba/ rang gi khu bo la stod dkon mchog mkhar la mdo sngags mtha' dag gsan sbyangs mdzad/ sur lte lo tsā ba la lo tsā bslab/sa skya grags pa rgyal mtshan la brgyud gsum sogs/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan la don zhags dang bka' gdams lam rim/ shangs pa gter ston du gu rin chen la gsang snying sogs gsan/ yang phyag drug ye shes mgon po dngos su byon zhabs gcig gur cog rtse la bzhag nas thugs zem mi 'tshal/ dgon pa gnas rnying 'di nga rang gis bdag gnyer byed gsungs pa la sogs gnas rnying dgon pa 'di gzhan ma spyi dang gto mi 'dra ste/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pas bdag mdzad/ lha mi gzhan la dbang rigs med pas khyad par 'phags so/ /mkhan po dbang rin pa dgung lo brgyad cu skor la dbu skra nag por song —86—

ba dang zad par ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes shing rlung sems dbang du 'dus pa dang / bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs lha mang po'i zhal gzigs sogs ngo mtshar gyi gtam mang zhing / 'dis zab mo'i gtsug lag khang du rten spyan ras gzigs gser sku dang / 'jam dpal gyi sku mdo nas spyan drangs so/ /de'i gdan sa bzang bzang pa pad ma rin chen gyis gnas rnying du mkhan po dbang rin pa'i phyi rten khyad par can de bzhengs/ grogs rar mkhar lan mdzad/brag chung gzhi nas (gnas) brtsigs/ gzhan yang wa ri/ shab tsha/ sle ra/ yu lu chung / chos sdings rnams btab/ gyu mo/ mthing chung / glang ri/ rta rnga/ dben pa rnams kyi 'khyams chos legs par mdzad/ brag tu gser sku bkra shis 'od 'bar bal yul nas spyan drangs/ de'i gdan sa slob dpon chos kyi dbang phyug pa/ de'i gdan sa mkhan po chos kyi rin chen ni jo bo a ti sha'i sprul par slob dpon pad mas lung bstan nas/ cung pa mchog dkar zhes bya sa /chos kyi rin chen zhes bya ba/ /jo bo rje'i bdun mthar 'byung zhes/ des lha'i bu'i bdud gcig 'dul bar lung bstan/ 'di'i thos bsam mdzad pa'i bla ma bka' drin che ba/ bzang bzang ba'i yab bzang jing yol thang / ston bsod/ spyi bo lhas pa/ byang chub 'od/ don mo ri'i dge bshes bzang kha ba/ khro lo byams pa dpal/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhang rgyal ba dpal/ snar thang pa sangs rgyas sgom pa/'jam dbyangs gsar ma sogs mtha' yas pa bsten zhing gsan sbyangs mdzad/mkhan po chos kyi rin pa 'di nyid kyis dbus gtsang du hor dmag snga ma dor rtas skyegs gnas gsar du mkhar phab/ mi mang po bsad/ gtsug lag khang

zhugs la song ba'i rten rnams kyi dod la thub pa chen po sku rgyab mtho bcu bzhi yod pa gcig bzhengs pa'i nang rdzongs la bram ze dri med snying po'i sbur sha dang /mkhan chen dbang phyug rin chen la byon pa'i dung g.yas 'khyil/ yol ston chen pos nyi zer la bkal ba'i chos gos/ drang srong rdo rje bcus pas khrag byung ba'i rdo rje/ thog 'beb kyis thog phab pa las byung ba'i shel gyi mchod rten khru gang pa sogs bcug pa de dbu rtse so ma'am gsar pa na bzhugs so/ /gsung rab rnams kyang bsab bo/ /'bri khung nas kyang chos spyan drangs/ mkhan po chos dbang gi phyi rten gnas gsar du 'bum mo che bzhengs/ 'phang thang du gzim khang / grong chung du dkar 'phigs/ ri khrod du phur sdings dang lha do btab/ slob ma'i mchog rgyal ba rin chen gangs pa dang gser sdings pa kun mkhyen chos kyi 'od zer sogs mkhan chen rin chen dpal bas bka' drin che ba'i bla ma kun mkhyen bzang bzang ba/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ mkhas pa bu ston/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs ches mang zer yang bu ston de rnams dang thog mi mtshungs pa 'dra/ bu ston seng ge 'od ces pa byung yang de'i sngon du byon grub bo/ / mkhan po 'di'i ring la gnas rnying pa la stong skor gcig tu bcas so mkhan po rin chen dpal ba 'dis gnas rnying gi lcags ri mchod rten brgya phrag mang pos skor ba'i lcags ri bzhengs/ tshogs pa thams cad thos bsam sgom gsum gyi srol du bcug dge 'dun gyi bca' khrims dam du bcas/khong gi zhal nas gnas rnying pa skyed pa nyag dus su nga rang yongs gsungs/—88—

'di'i dus chos ston du grags pa de yin no/ /mkhan chen bdag nyid chen po byams pa dpal ba'i gnas rnying du phar tshad kyi grwa sa bcugs/ dpe 'grems/brgya skor bsdus so/ /mkhan chen rin chen bzang po bas skyegs gnas rnying du gtsug lag khang chen mo bzhengs/ dbus ri lha dor lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa la bzhugs so/ /'di'i dus chos da lta gser chos su grags pa de yin no/ /gdan sa bka' bzhi pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas dpal bzang pos bkra shis ldings/ glang zas/lha khud/ lcags gzhong / dkru bzhi chu skyar rub mo tshal rnams bzhengs/ 'or kha rnams su chang ma'i tshogs rnams bton nas chang khrims bcas zul phur 'dul ba gsan nas gnas rnying du 'dul ba'i bshad grwa btsugs/ bshad pa'i rgyun zul phu la thug pa yin no/ /slar bka' bzhin bshad pa mthil phyin pa'i grwa sa tshugs so/ /'on kyang gtsug lag khang rnying pa 'di bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin gsungs nas spen bad gog pa rnams gsos/ yol chen po'i sku 'dra dang logs ris la sogs pa mdzad/ sde dar ba'i rten 'brel du ba gzhug gi ka ṇi yang mdzad/ mkhan chen rin chen dpal bzang po 'di shar kha ba'i zhal ngo ta'i si tu 'phags pa sku mched kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu bzung / 'di'i gnas rnying gi lcags ri chen mo lo gsum la grub par mdzad/ dus mchod ri spe mchod par grags/ 'di'i nang rten gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe dpag med khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa bzhengs/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi 'dzin pa rin chen bsam gtan 'phel bzang po 'di rgyal ba rin chen gangs pa'i skye ba shin tu gsal/ 'dis —89—

gnas rnying du bstan 'gyur bzhengs shing / de skabs dbus pa'i khri skor drug gis lcang rar dmag drangs/ yon mchog gcig yin zer ba'i logs phog par brten/ gnas rnying par bstan pa nyams shin tu smad yid 'byung du gyur pa'i tshe mkhan po 'dis gsos pas yar ldan sngar lugs bzhin du shin tu dar che bar mdzad pa sogs skyegs gnas rnying sngon rgya 'jam dpal gnas gzhi/ yol sku mched gsum gyi bsti gnas/ la stod dkon mchog mkhar bzhugs gnas/de'i rgyud 'dzin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa brgyad cu gya brgyad byon pa/ skyegs gnas rnying gi rgya sgo'i nang tsam na 'bre chen po'i bzhugs khri/ sa paṇa gyis thugs bskyed mdzad pa'i bzhugs khri/ mkhan chen chos rim pa'i bzhugs khri yod cing / rgya gar gyi paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pas 'di'i mkhan go mdzad/ 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyis 'dir bshad grwa bskyangs/ khyung gis kyang bskyangs pa sogs mkhas btsun bzang gsum rim par byon pa sogs lo rgyus dang gdung rabs rgyas bsdus gnyis las shes par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tsam nas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod la gshegs pa'i skyes bu khyad par can snang bza' 'od 'bum gyi 'khrungs yul phas khur yod/de'i 'og tsam na grub thob gling ras 'khrungs pa zhang gi glang po sna na/ gling stod gling smad gnyis las smad par 'khrungs pa yin/ de'i nye logs na rgya grong gnas zer sar yum ma gcig bzang mo dpal gyi bzhugs sa chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags 'khrungs shing / grub chen kun blo yang 'khrungs pa yin no/ /—90—

de'i 'og tsam na lcang ra zer ba 'di thog mar yang phur gyi grub thob rgya 'jam dpal gsang bas gnas gzhi bzung / nang rten byin rlabs can bzhugs shing / de rjes jo bo a ti shas slob ma ol drang srong gi lce spe lha khang brtsigs/lcang rar dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ 'du khang lcags ri mdzad/ gtsug lag khang yol sku mched gsum gyi nang rten gyi byin rlabs bzhugs/ lcang ra 'di/(dpon yig ma gcig mkha' 'gro rgya gar zhes ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mor grags pa de'i sras mo lha mo dpal khab tu bzhes pa la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i gcen dpal ldan bzang po yi ge legs par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la sa skyar phebs/ bla ma khang gsar pa'i zhabs la gshugs/ khang gsar bas bzhi thog bla brang pa'i phyag phyir bsgrags nas yig mkhan gyi 'go mi 'gyur bas dpon yig 'phags pa dpal bzang thog 'phags pa zer ba bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dpyal ston r+ṣa po 'phags rgyal ba'i mawo gyi zur bcug pa yin/) dpon yig 'di nyid sa skya ba bzhi thog bla brang nas bdag chen don yod rgyal mtshan bzhugs pa de'i bka' gnang nas lho dung khang gnon la bskos pa lhar dung rengs rnams dbang du 'dus/ gdan sa'i khams pa'i las mtshan bzhi'i nang nas shar kha las mtshan bskos pas dpal ldan shar kha pa grags/ phyis ta'i dbon blo gros rgyal mtshan pas bzhi thog bla brang gi nang / (gon gyo/ gling tshang / shar kha/ 'dan ma) chen pa bskos pa'i nang chen thog dpon yig nang chen 'phags pa dpal bzang dgung lo so gsum pa la zhwa lu sku zhang hor rtsa kun dga' don grub kyi sras mo pad+ma khab tu bzhes pas lcang ra'i gzhis gtsug lag rten mchod kyi gtso byas pa rnams bu mo pad+ma'i nor skal gyis gsungs nas gnang / gcung 'phags rin —91—

pas lcang ra'i gnyer mdzad/ yos lo la phag ri rnam rgyal dkar po brtsigs/'brug lo la gan pa lhun grub rdzong brtsigs/ ma gcig pad ma'i sras kun dga' 'phags lcang rar sku 'khrungs shing / lcang ra'i bde yangs sogs mang par bzhengs nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub spyan drangs/ rab gnas rgyas pa mdzad gser srang dgu'i tshom bu bkod nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang zhus/ 'phags pa dpal rgya nag rgyal pos gnang ba yin la/ lcang ra lha khang gnas gzhi dang bcas pa 'dir 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhabs kyis bcags pa'i sa yin pa'i lo rgyus yod cing / 'dir 'bre chen pos chos 'khor bskor ba dang / nang chen 'phags pas bu ston myang stod lcang rar gdan drangs nas/ gser 'bum gyis thog drangs pa'i gsung rab mang po'i rab gnas mdzad/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed cho ga mdzad/ mkhan chen gnas rnying pa dang nang chen pa sku mched la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i chos kyi thugs tshim par mdzad pa dang / khyad par bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas rgyud sde zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mang po'i zhal phye bar mdzad pa'i gnas yin pa dang / byang sham+bha la'i rigs ldan chen po jo nang ba chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dol po zhabs kyis dbus phyogs phebs pa'i rting ma rong nas lha sa yan la sbyor drug khrid mi stong lhag la bskyangs pa'i phar lam ye 'brog nas nying ro smad chab pa la byon pa'i tshur lam bsu ba mdzad/ de'i gong du'ang nang chen 'phags pa dpal bzang sku mched kyi chos 'brel zhus mod pa chud yod par snang bas lcang rar gdan 'dren pas skas la 'o rgyal nas rdzing khu'i g.yul thang du dpal dus kyi 'khor —92—

lo'i dar dkyil che mo zhal phye nas sgrub mchod mdzad/ dbang rgyas par gnang zhing lcang rar rgyun ring bzhugs shing / rtse chen gyi ri ldebs la sham bha la'i pho brang yin pa'i mthong snang shar ro zhes rtse chen chos sde byung bar lung bstan pa lcang ra'i g.yul thang yang yin no/ /nang chen 'phags pa dol po zhabs gnas sar bar skyel ma mdzad dus sangs rgyas rtag pa dang / chos bden pa/ dge 'dun mi bslu ba la bden par gus pa mdzod/ 'phral phug thams cad du phan zhing sde srid kyang brtan par yong gsungs mchid gnang nas jo nang la thegs so/ /rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shā ri pu 'atro sna zhabs kyi lcang rar zla ba gnyis bzhugs shing / pu tra chos drug rgyas par 'dir gsungs so/ /rwa los nyan 'tsho dang / lcang ra gnyis su 'bum gyi pu ti lnga bcu dang / 'gron zan zla ba re'i cha rkyen khal khri tsho gcig sbyar/ lcang ra'i khri rgya 'jam dpal gsang bas bzhengs pa'i rtsa brgyad mchod rten/ (chos rje dpal ldan ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dbus la phebs pa dang mthun nang chen 'phags pa lcang rar spyan drangs rab gnas mnga' gsol gnang zhing gnas rnying tshogs pa'ang spyan drangs nas 'ja' sa bsgrags) lcang ri'i phu yin par gangs zhes par pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags kyi slob ma ka ba bzhi'i tshig la mkhas pa gangs pa she'u'i dgon pa dang phug pa byin rlabs can dang / ri rtser mchod rten yod la mi ma yin gyis skor byed zer lam byang bar yod/ gangs pa she sgyu 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i mthil rgyang ro/ de slob ma zhwa ma'i ming po rje 'khon bu bar grags pa'i gang zag khyad par can yang rgyang ror byung / gangs pa she'u'i gdung ril por bzhugs pa —93—

blo bde'i gong tsam gyi 'ban grong zer sar sa 'bum yod pa de yin no/ /gangs kyi gangs ro zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang rten gsum dang bcas par yang grub chen kun blos rab gnas rgyas pa can mdzad do/ /de'i 'og tsam na sham bu rtse dgu yang rtse chen yang zer sa 'dir rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i pho brang yod cing / sngon dus bod rgyal po rnams rgyal srid kyi bya ba legs par bskyangs 'grub rjes lha'i dmu thag la byon nas lha lus ro med du byon pa sha stag yin pa la rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i thugs la gdon bzhugs rang gi 'bangs la 'thab zla byed dgos smras nas rang gi ral gri gu zi klad la bskor bas lha'i dmu thag dang rkyang thag bcad pa dang / rgyal po 'thab gral du bkrongs pa sogs sham bu rtse dgu pa 'di byung ba yin no/ /'bangs kyi dpon byas mkhar bzung skabs mdzo pa kyi tu/ (mdzengs kyi ru kal skyes kyi ngar gsos kyi sham bu rtse dgu'i ri la rgod tshang du bsdad nas mkhar phab nas pho brgya bsad/ mo brgya sogs(gsog ka kyi lo rgyus 'gyung ba yang rtse chen 'di'i sngon du brjod zin pa ltar/ (dpon yig 'phags pa dpal bzang po dang 'phags pa rin chen sogs lcang rar bzhugs skabs sa pho khyi lo la karma pa rang byung rdo rje rgya nag thegs/ phyag phyir lcang ra nas dmigs pa pag shi kun dga' dpal ba yab sras dang bcas sham bu rtse dgu'i ri la lha khang bzhengs chog pa'i lung zhu bar brdzangs pas/ hor rgyal po thog gan thi mur gyis nang chen gyi 'ja' sa dang sham bu rtse dgu la lha khang brtsigs chog pa'i lung gnang byin dang bcas snga rim du pag shi chos 'od kyis khyer nas slob pas nang chen 'phags pa dpal bzang po dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bzhes pa/ shing mo sprul gyi lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu la rtse chen mkhar kha pa rnam lhun grub rtse —94—

rnams kyi 'gram gding pa'i skar 'dzin mnyam du mdzad/ khyad par rtse chen chos sde)kun mkhyen dol bus rtse chen 'di sham bha la'i pho brang du gzigs nas des bka' stsal gnang ba/ cod pan du bcings par mdzad pas (nang chen dpal bzang po dgung lo zhe dgu bzhes dus kyi me pho rta la rtse chen chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gi 'gram bting lcags ri dang lcog rnams grub zer/ nang chen 'phags pa dpal bzang po'i gcung 'phags pa rin chen du dben shas/lcags pho khyi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du gcen nang chen 'phags pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan khri thog tu phebs nas sde srid bskyangs/ zla ba lnga pa la rtse chen chos sde'i bla brang tshogs khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa lcags mo phag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du rtse chen chos sder)nya dbon ni sa skya'i mkhas mchog nya brtson gnyis zer ba'i nya dang / dbus gtsang mkhas pa mi drug gi gtsug na zla ba'i zla ba dang / dpal ldan bla mas lam 'bras srol 'dzin mkhas pa mi brgyad zer ba'i brgyad kyi gtso bo dang dol bus 'gran zla bral ba'i slob ma gcig zer ba'i mkhas pa nya dbon kun dga' dpal gyis (zhal snga nas dpon slob drug brgya tsam spyan drangs nas grub chen kun blo'i rnam thar nang na)rtse chen chos sde btab nas gnas/ 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi chos 'khor dri ma med pa bskor nas bshad grwa legs par btsugs/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshan che ba 'dus/ rig pa'i lcags kyu bye rdzing pa shes rab 'phags dang / chos dpal mgon po sogs chen po la bskos/ slob ma yang re mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ (zer ba yod cing / chos rgyal rnam thar las mkhan por mnga' gsol)mtsham (mtshal ka min pa'am gnyags phu ba/bsod nams bzang po/ shangs pa kun dga' rin chen/ shes rab 'od zer/ blo —95—

gros yangs pa/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa sogs mtha' yas so/ /rtse chen chos sde de'i nya dbon gyi gdan sa grub chen kun blo'i dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa shing pho stag gi lo la mdzad de/kun blo 'di skye ba gong ma'i gong ma rim bzhin lha rje chos byang / de rjes kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ (de rjes kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer)de rjes bu ston/ mkhyen brtse rgya mtsho'i pha rol mthar son pa'i/ /bu zhes grags pa dam pa khyed nyid de/ /chos kyi spyan ldan nyi ma'i mtshan can ni/ /'di la tshad mar gyur cing dpang du bzhugs/ /snga ma dran pa'i mngon shes tshad ma dang / /nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa'i lung tshig dang / /dpyod ldan rnams la grogs pa'i tshad ma yis/ /grub pa des na dngos grub rin chen grub/ /bu ston gyi skye ba grub chen kun dga' blo gros de nyid la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma mchog tu gyur pa nya dbon/ de rjes dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bus chos skor mtha' dag khyung po lhas pa/ dus 'khor gong gsum bde chen pa/ jo nang pa'i lugs jo nang phyogs pa/ ge ngon rdo rje rin chen/ chos rje jo bzang ba chen po/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ spos khang ba 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dpyal ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje sogs la mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i chos mtha' dag gi gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ paṇa chen nags rin mig pa bya ba'i nang rgod khung du bzhugs pa'i tshe mtshan mo rmi lam bzung nas grub chen blo dgon pa lhun grub bde chen gyi bzhugs gnas der phebs pas zam chung de tshun dgon pa'i skor rnams dus 'khor/ (gzhal yas khang dang / der gnas pa'i mi rnams dus 'khor gyi lha —96—

tshogs de dag gi) gyi dbus kyi gtso bo la chos rje grub chen bzhugs 'dug pa la/paṇa chen nags rin gyis dus 'khor gyi dbang zhus/ slar ngos kyi mjal bstun grub chen kun blo la dbang thob par los 'gro 'am zhus pas/ dper na grub thob o rgyan pas chos rje rgod tshang pa mnal lam du dus 'khor gyi dbang zhus pa bzhin no/ /slar paṇa chen nags rin pas grub chen kun blo la sbyor drug sems nyid ngal gso/ snying po don grub/ tshe khrid sogs chos bka' mang du gsan no/ /yang khams pa bla ma kun spang ba/ grub chen kun blo grags che bas ci mjad kyin yod dgongs rmi lam bzung nas sku gzhogs byon pas rje nyid ma mthong / re zhig 'ja' lus kyi ngos nas bde mchog lus dkyil gzim mal na bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /de rjes phyag na rdo rje 'khor chen du mthong bas/ ngas rgyal khams ra mtha' mtha' bzhin bskor kyang bod gangs can khrod na chos rje nyid las bzang ba mi gda' zhes/ dang 'dod yid gsum gyi mos pa dang zhib par gleng ba'i lo rgyus yod/ grub chen kun blo 'dis ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mngon par shes pa la dgra bcom pa ltar bsam gzhigs mi dgos par thogs rdugs med/ res zhabs sa la mi reg pa mngon sum du mthong / res snang tshul lha skur mthong /res gtan nas mi mthong / res dgon pa so so tha dad du dus gcig la chos gsungs pa'i sku gzugs thams cad mthong / bskyed rim mthar phyin pas tshems thon pa tsam la yang lha sku rang 'byon du byon pa thig le byang chub kyi sems brtan par mdzad pas ring bsrel yung 'bru lta bu 'byung ba dang / sla dag (sa —97—

drug pa 3thob pa'i rtags/ gangs rdib pa dang chu bo che ba sogs gyen bzlog par yang yang mdzad pa dang / nyi zla phyi rol gnon pa sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pa 'di'i dgon gnas kyi mchog rtse chen chos sde 'di yin no/ /rtse chen gyi 'khris rgyab na mchod rten yod pa yol dbang gis grub rtags bstan nas mchod rten rta chags tsam gyi sar khrid pas/ deng sang rtsa brgyad mchod rten lcang ra'i 'og 'khris na yod/ rtse chen gyi lho na sngags 'chang 'brom pa 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rgyud pa yin zer ba yod cing / 〈rtse chen gyi rtse dang rtse chen chos sde'i gtsug lag khang so sor sku gsung thugs rten dang rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor zab mo bzhengs pa ji tsam yod tshul zur tsam bkod rnga/ sa pho spre'u'i lo la nang chen 'phags pas rtse chen gyi gtsug lag khang khyams ka ba sum cu so drug gtsang khang ka ba brgyad kyi sa rnams bsgrub pa'i gtsang khang gung la thub dbang sku rin po che las grub pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad ldan na drug rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i gan+dho la/ seng ges btegs pa'i khri la bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon du skyid grong gi dze bo'i mched rang byon du grags pa'i tsan dan gyi jo bo gnyis dru bu (gling mun) nas spyan drangs te bzhugs/ de mthun 'bri mtshams rgya rtags nas sgrol ma'i sku spyan drangs pa gser zangs las grub pa'i sku de kha che paṇa chen gyi phyag bzo ba yin pa/ nga rgya gar paṇa chen gyi rgya rtags su bzhengs pas yul de la yang rgya rtags su grags/ gtsang khang gi gung gi dngos la grub chen brgyad cu'i sku dang /khyams kyi ngos g.yas phyogs rnams la sman bla'i lha tshogs tshang mar bzhugs pa'i zhing khams dang /de bzhin du byams pa/ 'od dpag med/ mar me mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/sgo srung rta mgrin/ mi g.yo ba/ sgo gong la grwa lnga'i gtso bo rnams dang / g.yon phyogs ngos la ras —98—

bris mthong ba don ldan/ 'jam dbyangs/ byams pa/ mi 'khrugs pa/ yum chen mo/ sgrol ma/ rnam rgyal/ 'dod can/ ri khrod ma rnams gtso bor bzhugs pa'i zhing khams yar khyu'i g.yon ngos la ma gha dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod dang / so sor 'brang ma/ g.yas phyogs la mdo za ma tog nas gsungs pa'i zhing bkod dang / srid pa 'khor lo/ seng g.yab kyi ngos nang bskor la grub chen brgyad cu sku rnams ri mor bris pa/ rab gnas 'khon gyis gdung rgyud dharma'i mtshan can dang chos rje'i bzung (gzungs) gi dpal pa sogs kyis rgyas par mdzad do/ /nang chen 'phags pa dpal bzaja po'i nang rten/ gcung 'phags rin gyis bzhengs pa ston pa'i sku khri rgyab ma/ gtsang khang ka ba brgyad ma'i gdung (gung ) la sngon du bzhengs pa'i thub dbang de'i g.yon grwal la bzhugs yod/ g.yas ngos na si tu 'phags pa rin po che'i nang rten mchod rten byang chub chen po yod/ yang de'i nang rten thub pa'i khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa bzhugs/ sku rten dang thugs rten 'di gnyis rab gnas mtshungs med 'di dbon gyis mdzad〉de'i 'og na grub chen kun blo'i gdung ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i dgon pa sho ma zhes pa yod/de'i 'og na 'brong rtser bod gyol po'i gdung rgyud 'brong rtse lha btsun gyi dgon pa sku rten thugs rten dang / jo bo a ti sha'i phyag nas phog nges pa can gyi mchod rten yod/ gzhan yang 'brong rtse chos rje nus pa can des bzo bo bkugamagon po phyag drug pa bzhengs rtsis las bzo bos lder bzo la mgon po gur bzhengs pa de la mthu stobs can bdag chen rin po che rgya gar byang chub sems dpar grags pas rab gnas mdzad/ mgon po'i sku 'dis 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa mi pham pad ma dkar po la nga khyod kyi bar chad bsrung ba la 'ong ba yin zer dngos nyams lta bur snang ba thob pa'i byin rlabs can de yang bzhugs/—99—

'brong rtse'i phu na rgyal byed tshal zhes pa sngon mkhas grub gnyis ldan grub chen kur/ blos sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa gnas gzhi btab pa/ gtsang rang gi klu sdings la skyed par grags pa/ se ba dang bskrun shing gi nags yid du mchis pa myang lung pa'i lte ba/ ri bo chen po lha don can gyi zhol bkra shis shing g.yang chags pa la phyi rtogs ldan khyad par can des lung bstan pa'i sa yul der 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pas dgon pa ma btab gong rgyal byed tshal du zhag bdun tsam bzhugs pa'i zhag lnga'i dgong mo mnal lam la de na mtsho chen po zhig 'dug ri ngos kha lhor bstan zhig la nged bsdad 'dug par mcho de'i dbus lbu ba rug rug 'khol ba'i nang nas a tsa ra sngo sing sing ba gcig 'phur te thon/ nged kyi gam du slebs phyag btsal nas nga'i sa cha 'di khyed la 'bul/'dir sgrub sde zhig 'debs rogs mdzod zer nas mtsho la thim song ngo / /de'i sang nyin 'brong rtse sde pa la mgon po'i rjes gnang gnang ba'i skabs bya rog shin tu che ba blo yul las 'das pa zhig gis skad snyan par grags pa kun gyis mthong zhing / de skabs rgyal byed tshal phul/ de lo bla brang dang spyil po nyi shu tsam grub bo/ /yang cho 'phrul gyi dus chen la 'jam dkar gyi bsnyen pa mdzad dus tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs rgyal byed tshal gyi nub phyogs kyi mkha' la 'ja' sprin gyi phub pa'i nang na 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ges lha'i bu dang bu mo la chos 'chad pa gzigs pas gnas 'dir mkhas btsun bzang gsum mang du 'byon no gsung ngo / /yang gnas 'dir gzims spyil gong mar mtshams bsdams de dus lce rtse —100—

rkan sbyar la zin bris byed skabs sha ba ri'i bum chu yin zer ba btungs te skyugs pa rmis/ de nas phag mo lha khrid brtsams de nas phyed grub pa na snyan rgyud yi ger bris pa la rang skye med bsam/ bshol brtsis la rmi ltas bzang bas snyan rgyud tshang ma rgyal byed tshal 'dir bris shing / legs gsungs 'brug sgra 'bum gyis 'bad pa'i shugs/ /mos pa'i rim pa g.yas su 'khyil ba nas/ /dbyangs can ma yis skad gsang mthon po yis/ /pha rol nyi ma'i sbun la zhus pa spyin/ /de yis mtha' bzhi'i dge 'dun kun 'dus pa'i/ /ngur smrig tshon gyis mtho ris sa dang 'og /'jig rten bro gar grags pa'i yig phreng dag /gsal por bris 'di rtag tu snyams pa min/ /zhes rgya gar gyi na ro paṇa chen gyi sprul pa mkhas grub mi pham pad+ma dkar pos bshad sgrub gnyis kyi grwa bzang po btsugs shing /gtsug lag khang rten gsum dang bcas pa bzhugs tshul tsam zhig bkod na de'i phu phyogs na ri chen po de la lha do zer/ bstan pa snga dar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis btab pa sbas lung gi dgon pa la lha do zer ba thogs shin tu snga/gnas rnying mkhan po chos kyi rin chen pas kyang lha do dgon pa btab/ gnas rnying mkhan chen rin chen bzang po bas dbus ri lha dor lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i gnas de'o/ /de'i 'og tsam na khang dmar zhes pa rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi blon po sgro rings ldong btsan gyis khang dmar gyi lha khang bzhengs pa yin la dus deng sang sangs rgyas 'phel gdung bzhugs shing / dpon skya khang dmar ba zhes 'khrug pa thams cad mkhyen pa la dad pa thob pa'i gang zag khyad par can des —101—

'brong rtse pa dang yon mchod du sbrel nas rgyal byed tshal rgyag pa'i rkyen chen po mdzad pa'o/ (zhib tu bshad na bsre brag g.ya' lung gi ri bo/ shar kha ras chen dpal 'bar gyi btab pa'i dgon gnas su chos rdzong mkhan po chos rje bsam gtan dbang phyug pas 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa spyan drangs/ der ded tsho la 'brong rtse sde pa tshe dbang mgon pos ja zhus skyel bar khang dmar pa slebs byung ba de nas mchod yon gyi rten 'brel 'grigs pas gong ltar ro/)de'i 'og tsam na/ rtsis gnas gsar zhes sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs par dam bcas kyang / gtsug lag khang zhe gnyis bzhengs grub pa'i ya gyal gcig yin pa/ deng sang mgon khang chen mor grags pa de yin no/ /mgon khang chen mor grags pa'i khyams rim pa gsum byas pa'i phug na rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kha de la mgon po stag bzhon 'chas kyi yod/ da lta rtsis dgon du grags pa de yin/ lha mo'i mgon khang de'i zur na yod/ mgon po lcam dral de gnyis la 'khor las mkhan rnam gsum du grags pa mgon khang spyi'i rtsa ba/ spyan gzigs kyi nang na rwa co'i phung po la srog bdud gnas/ phyi'i shing sdong gog po chen mo la klu bdud gnas/ nye 'gram zhing zhig gi 'gram na gza' bdud gnas par grags/'khor byings rnams phyi'i lcags ri la gnas par bshad/ rtsis gnas gsar gyi gtsug lag khang shar nub gnyis yod pa'i shar ma de rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang yin/ deng sang hor phig zer/ der yum chen mo la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang / rta mgrin skad mar grags pa slob dpon pad+mas phyag nas phog pa'i byin rlabs can dang / slob — 102—

dpon pad+ma'i shangs mtshal dang / slob dpon rang gi phyag bris ngo mas gyang ldebs su mgon po beng gi sku de 'bur du 'gro yi 'dug pa'i 'bur dod ma'i gtsug lag khang du grags so/ /mgon po beng 'di/ ('di la thog mar yi dam gyi smin byed la rigs snyus nyi shu'i dbang ste rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang / bcom ldan 'das sman bla/ tshe dpag med/ rnam snang / mi skyod pa/ rin 'byung / don grub/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ dme brtsegs/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro /rin chen mkha' 'gro /pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi dbang re re rgyas par stsal rjes mgon po phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang / mgon po 'dun tshogs kyi dbang / beng dmar po 'chi med kyi dbang / gshin rje lag sbrel gyi dbang / drag po gsum dang sde brgyad kyi dbang / bka' bsgo ba dang bcas pa rigs 'dus 'du ba gcig pa'i dbang / 'gro bdun gyi srog dbang sogs rgyas par nos rjes/ lung la/ gu rlu o rgyan rtsa rgyud le'u sum cu pa/ kun snang lha'i le'u bcu gcig pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rgyud la sbyor ba stod la le'u lnga/ smad la skabs gsum gyi gri gug brtsegs pa'i rgyud la le'u gcig pa/ skye rgyud le'u nyer drug pa/ bkol rgyud/ rgyud kyi las thams cad dbye ba/ drag po'i sgrub thabs mthar phyin/ lo rgyus che chung gsang ba mdzod/ de'i las byang / dkyil 'khor gzhung chung / zhal gdams che 'bring chung gsum/ yig snang che 'bring chung gsum/ 'phrin las bka' rgya can/ las lnga'i man ngag dngos dang / 'khor lnga'i man ngag skyog ga ril skor la slob dpon ro langs bde ba'i shog ril bcu bdun/ bram ze'i shog ril la ming gi gab yig de'i brda' 'grel/ bla ma dang mgon po'i zhal lung / rim gnyis kyi gsol btab/ rgyud kyi don 'grel/ phan gnod nor bu'i shog ril/ lag len nyal chog gi shog ril/ dgra bgegs — 103—

gdug pa 'dul ba'i man tra/ gsang ba sdebs kyi man ngag /mgon po 'chi med kyi shog ril/dkor srung dang dkor 'grel shog ril/ brtan g.yo sna tshogs phyag rgya 'dzin gyi 'grel pa/ rdzogs rim kyi man ngag dang 'khrid kyi shog ril/ bdun tshogs kyi shog ril/ de'i 'khor gyi shog ril/bdun tshogs dbang gi shog ril/ khyad par gyi shog ril/ rigs 'dus nyi shu'i mngon rtogs kyi shog ril/ khro bzhi'i khyad par gyi shog ril/ las gshin gyi shog ril/ ngag 'grol gyi shog ril/bram zes man tshul shes la gdams pa'i shog ril/ lus rgya'i 'degs dang 'byung ba rgyas 'degs kyi shog ril/ dam tshig 'dus pa'i dbang gi shog ril/ las gshin gyi shog ril/ drug cu pa'i shog ril/ drag po sgrol dbang gi shog ril nang rgyas zhi bar byed pa'i man ngag gi shog ril/ rtsa ba'i man ngag gi shog ril sogs dang / bod gzhung skor la bla ma rin chen 'od pas mdzad pa'i rigs 'dus nyi shu'i mngon rtogs tho tshe sogs so/) khri ral gyi gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad bzhengs par dam bcas pa'i nang tshan rting ma'i mjug rang du btab nas/gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad tshang ma tshangs kyi grangs rtsis sa yang 'dir yin pas/ rtsis gnas gsar du thogs pa'i gtsug lag khang nub ma 'di khri ral gyis btab pa yin la deng sang rgya phibs zer/ der gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad mi bzhi rgyab sprod dang nye ba'i sras brgyad yod do/ /spyir rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor bzhugs pa/ lha sum cu so bdun te rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bzhi yod pa'i le'u dang po nas bshad/ 'di 'grel byed mkhas pa mi gsum ste tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos 'grel pa de nyid gnang ba ste stod cha smad cha yod pa/ stod cha lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i dus bsgyur/— 104—

smad cha bal po thugs rje chen po dang / zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i skabs su bsgyur ro/ /don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / /tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen gnyis kyi 'grel pa a ba ta ra/ /ko sa la'i rgyan gnyis yod pa las nub ma'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i rnam par snang mdzad 'di ni rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad yin la shākya bzhas gnyen gyi bzhed srol ltar gyi rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod kyi bzhugs tshul lo/ /sngon gter bton gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyis dkon gnyer gyi g.yog tu brdzus/ lo gcig lhag pa g.yog byas rjes mgon khang chen mor grags pa'i phug gi rnam snang gi thugs kyi sku rgyab phyogs nas skye bdun/ (bram ze skye bdun pa'i spur sha da lta'ang yod zer ro/) gyi rtsa ba bram ze'i skrur sha spyan drangs tshul gu gu ye shes khyung grags kyi rnam thar nang na yod la/ gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyis dbon rgyud skyi mkhar gur sdings pa/ gu ru chos dbang gi gter byung las chos dbang mdun ma brtsis nas byung / dngos grub shel bum nang nas byung zhes pa/ gter de spyan 'dren par chos dbang rang dngos su phebs ma thub par gter bdag rtsis mgon bkug ste bka' bsgos nas slob ma gnyen ston dzam bha la dang / sgom chen 'brug pa zhe gnyis la de phyogs rgyus zhib par yod pa la brten nas 'don par gnang / khong gnyis kyi brtsis lha khang gi mgon khang chen mo na bzhugs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i nang na slob dpon pad mas dbang bskur gyi bum pa shel las grub pa nang zab pa skor dgu'i shog ser gyis gang ba yod pa/— 105—

sku'i phyi rgyab nas thig tshad byas bkod nas spyan drangs te chos dbang rin po che'i phyag tu phul/ dbang bum de nyid phyis kyang gter du sbas te ma 'ongs chos dbang sprul pa gu ru chos kyi bshes gnyen zhes bya lo pa zhig gis 'don no/ /zab pa skor dgu skal ldan chos su deng sang bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /rtsis gnas gsar gyi myang chu dang nye ba'i sar khri srong lde'u btsan dus kyi gtsug lag khang khri srong lde'u btsan gyi blon po lte khri bzang lha byin gyis rtsis kyi lha khang bzhengs pa de'i zhig shul zhig kyang yod/ a mes tshong btsun gyis rtsis kyi yang dben bzung ba'i dus su rtsis lha khang phul/ de'i nye gnas sba btsun blo gros yon tan la gtad de des mkhan po byas nas bskyangs pa tsho la sba tsho zer/de'i mkhan po yol chos dbang gis skyegs gnas rnying bzung / de nas mched pa la sba tsho stod pa zer/ yol thog 'bebs kyis lcang ra bzung / stag pa jo btsun gyis lte dpe bzung ba de gnyis la sba tsho bar pa zer/ rtsis nas mched pa la sba tsho smad pa zer ro/ /phyis su rtsis gnas gsar 'dir lce btsun rgya gar nas nam 'khor bar gyi zhwa lu'i gdan sa mdzad pa'i lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyi slob ma'i mchog yin zhing / mkhan po mgo ba ye shes g.yung drung gis rtsis lha khang bzung /de tshun rtsis gnas gsar gyi rab tu 'byung ba'i sdom rgyun sdom pa rgya gar mar grags pa kho na yin/ rtsis gnas gsar de'i phu bstan pa snga dar gyi dgon pa khyad par can btsas phu na bde phu dgon pa shin tu thogs snga'o/ /de'i phu na rtsis phu'i yang dben yod de jo bo a ti shas slob ma sgom pa bu bzhir grags pa'i — 106—

nang tshan jo bos bla mchod du mnga' gsol ba dgon pa ba 'dzeng dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma dgon gyi bu bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan zhang ka ba'am zhang bu gcig par grags pa khyad par can de'i slob ma lum pa ba ye shes byang chub bam dge bshes gangs par yang grags pa/ pu to ba dang karma pa gnyis ka'i slob ma myang stod rtsis phul yang dben du bzhugs nas slob ma sum cu tsam smin par mdzad/ de'i nang nas slob ma'i mchog khu le'i kha mo ze'u ston/ yang rtsis gnas gsar phul yang dben du smin par mdzad/ mtshan lum pa'am gangs nga/ra ya nga grags shing / gangs ro lha khang du chos 'chad dus grwa pa brgyad brgya tsam 'dus zer ba/ pa tshab kyi slob ma gangs pa she'u dang gcig gam snyam mo/ /rtsis gnas gsar gyi 'og na/ sgrol ma brag nas dam rdzas myong grol bstan gnyis gling pas spyan drangs/ de'i 'og tsam na rgyal mkhar lung pa dril bu 'dra ste mda' dga'/skyi mkhar lung pa gdugs 'dra ste phu dga'/ mag nas 'dra ste sked pa dga'/lung pa gsum gyi mnga' thang la mkhar cig brgyab pa ar mo 'dus chung yod/pa tshab bsam grub rtse yi gnya' gnon yin/ 9ga blo ldan shes rab ni mgon po sngon byung gi rgyud las/ shar phyogs rgya mtshor brten nas ni/ /de 'dir 'brog mi mthar thug par/ /blo ldan lo hi ta las gzhan/ /de min shes rab mthar gnas shing / /byang du de bzhin kha ba can/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i rngeg lo cwa ba de rgya gar du rdom bhi he ru ka dang mjal/ stag rgyab tu bzhon mkha' spyod la byon pa la bod mun gling du gzigs nas 'chad nyan gyi nyi ma shar ba lta bur bgyid dgongs/babs nas chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i dang po myang stod 'dul chung / de nas bo dong / /des nas lha sa sogs dang / dbu ru dang g.yon dra'i sa phyogs su chos 'khor rgyas par bskor ro/) 'dul — 107—

chung gi phyogs bzhir sngon dus kyi dgon gnas khyad par can yod de lho na skruskruskru nub rkyang 'dur lha khang / byang na ngang skya lha khang / shar na 'dre lha khang rnams yod do/ /'dre'i lha khang bstan pa snga dar gyi gtsug lag khang yin/ 'dul chung gi nye logs na 'dre lha khang yod de der lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi mkhan bu nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nang tshan mgo ba ye shes g.yung drung gis bshad nyan bskyangs/lce btsun rgya gar la byon par mgo ba ye shes g.yung drung gis zhwa lu bzungs/phyis 'dus chung gis 'dre lha khang bzung zhing bshad nyan bskyangs/ lo ston gyi dngos slob a me'i mkhan bu kong po thar pa rin chen la mkhan bu bzhi byung ste/gzu ston 'phan grags kyis 'dre'i lce mtshams dang / rgya gar stag lung bzung /de nas rab tu byung ba mched cing 'phel pa la gzu tsho zer/ lce btsun dkar pos ang yig bzung ngo / /phu skyin mkhar phyogs na skyin mkhar log pa phu ru mkhas pa na rim byon/ lhag par tri rin chen dbang phyug gsang 'dus rgyud man ngag dgyes rdor rgyud gsum la mkhas pa de byon pa yin no/ /lha rje lce ston rgya nag〈rgyud pa gur sdings pa yin no/〉 gi mes po 'phangs byang brtson bya ba khams su byon nas yar log ste klong thang sgrol ma'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas skyi mkhar lha khang bzhengs/ lha rje lce ston rgya nag ni lha rje sgro phug pa chen po'i thugs zin pa'i slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis byung ba la me bzhi nag bzhi ston bzhi bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan lha rje ste ston rgya nag gi skyis mkhar lha khang der spyir rnying ma'i chos dang khyad par sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang rgyud bcas man ngag dang bcas bshad pas slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon pa'i gnas khyad par — 108—

ba yin no/ /lha rje lte ston rgya nag gi lo rgyus zhib par bshad na zur po che dang zur chung pa gnyis su grags pa las zur chung ba'i ming shes rab grags/ brag rgya bo dgu 'dus su lo bcu bzhi sgrub pa kho na la bzhugs pas/ mtshan la lha rje bde gshegs rgya bor grags pa de la jo mo snga ma btsad mo dar ma bo dhi la btsad tsha lcam sring gnyis 'khrungs/ jo mo rting ma mdar tig jo bo shākya yi lcam mo yin pa chos nyin pa la byon skabs su bla ma zur chung ba'i jo mo ltar song nas sras 'khrungs pa'i ming yang shākya seng ge'am mda' tsha hor po yang grags shing / lha rje sgro phug pa chen por yang grags pa de la slob ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po grwa sa 'dzin zhing / bstan pa skyong ba/ gdugs thogs pa stong thon zhing / de'i nang nas kyang thugs zin gyi slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis byung ba la me bzhi/nag bzhi/ ston bzhi'o/ /me bzhi ni dbon ston lcags kyu/ shab rtse gser ba/byang ston rdo rje grags/ g.yu ston no/ /nag bzhi ni lce ston rgya nag /zur nag 'khor lo/ myang nag mdo po/ mda' nag gtsug tor dbang phyug go /ston bzhi ni rgya ston/ gyab ston/ nye ston/ zhung ston no/ /nag po bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lce ston rgya nag gi mes po 'phangs byang rtson bya ba khams su byon nas yar log ste klong thang sgrol ma'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas skyi mkhar lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sku tsha lha rje rgya nag gis shin tu mkhas par grags pa khyung po grags se/ /'ban thams cad mkhyen pa/ stag pa kha che rnams la phar mngon dbu tshad gsan/ lha rje sgro phug pa'i zhabs drung du bzhugs skabs rgya brtson seng — 109—

dpon g.yog gis rtsod pa btsugs dus rgya brtson pham par byas pas lha rje sgro phug pa shin tu mnyes/ bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi gzhung gdams ngag sogs bum pa gang byo dang / khyad par gyi gdams pa zab mo gnang ba chos kha tshang bas lo rgyus rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /de'i dbon po lce ston jo gzungs sogs lte ston rgya nag gam lha rje khang pa'i rgyud pa skyin mkhar ba sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang bshad bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa rtsa ba sor bzhag dang / spyi lugs rdzogs pa chen po rdzogs lugs dang / slob dpon a ro'i thugs kyi yang bcud rdzogs chen khams lugs kyi khrid dang de'i skor gyi gdams ngag /rdzogs wo bram ze'i skor/ skye tshang ma'i skor/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa rgya nag gis mdzad pas sman gyi pho brang nas lha mo zhig bton nas byung ste dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas nas pho brang la thims pa kun gyis mthong ba sogs gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud lung man ngag gi zab dgu thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dam pa skyin mkhar lha khang dang / de 'dzin pa'i lha rje rgya nag gi rgyud pa 'di rnams yin no/ /lha rje rgya nag gi rgyud pa gur sdings pa yin zhing / gter bton gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyang de'i rgyud du byon pa yin no/ /mag dge sdings zer ba'i dgon pa 'di kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis btab pa (dge sdings kyi gnas gzhi 'di kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis 'gram bting dge sdings kyi jo bo la rab gnas dang po kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ bu rin po che/ grub chen kun blo gsum car gyis rab gnas mdzad pa sogs sku skye ba'i rim pa spyir byung tshul ni mdo sde rgyan las//zag med dbyings nas sangs rgyas rnams/ /mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir dang / /sngon gyi lus rjes — 110—

'brangs pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min du ma'ang min/ /zhes dang por lha rje chos byang / de nas kha che paṇa chen/ de nas kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ de nas bu rin po che/ de nas grub chen kun stso/ )yin zhing mag dge sdings kyi jo bo 'di kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la lha sa'i jo bo rin po ches gsung dngos su byon nas spyir bslab ston gyis phebs sgo mang du bstsal/ lhag par sbyin bsreg brgya rtsa gyis/ mchod rten brgya rtsa bzhengs shig khyad par mag dge sdings su nga yi nu bo 'byon par yod do gsungs pa ltar du rgya gar nas 'phur byon nas mag dge sdings su (grub chen kun blo'i rnam thar nang du sku skye ba gsum gyis rab gnas mdzad/) phebs/ jo bos 'phur byon pa'i sa yul la yang dus deng sang yang 'phur lung du thogs so/ /kun mkhyen chos sku'i thugs ril po mag dge sdings na bzhugs/ gdung phal che ba bya btang gi mchod rten na bzhugs so/ /kun spang chen po kun tu bzang pos dge sdings su nang rten ston pa'i gser sku dang phyi rten rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams da lta'ang yod/mag dge sdings kyi gong tsam gyi dgon pa rdo rje gdan zer ba/ (lcags pho khyi lo la mkhas grub lha'i dbang po'i drung du gcung 'phags pa rin chen gyis dgon pa rdo rje gdan 'debs par gsol ba btab/ spyil po bde ldan brtsigs/ dbang dang chos bka' mang du gsan/) chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi bla ma khyad par can paṇa chen lha'i dbang pos btab pa'i dgon pa yin/ dgon pa der rgyal rtse bdag po rnams kyis mjal bar lo ltar du phebs pas brang khang ming la yang thogs so/ /thur la pa 'khru/ngas sa yang mag thur lha yin/ bya khang pa 'khru/ngas sa yang 'brog pa bya khang ma yin/ mag bya khang yin/ thang spe ba 'khru/ngas sa mag yin — 111 —

zhing / gzhan yang dge bshes mag 'dir 'khrungs pa shin tu mang bas na mag lha yi lung pa zer ro/ /'dus chung gi phu na rgyang mkhar zer ba'i lung par bstan pa snga dar gyi lha khang rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos btang pa/ ba 'ug lha khang zhes thogs shin tu snga/ rgyang mkhar stag lung zer ba der mthu stobs phan grags kyis rgya mkhar stag lung bzung / de nas rab tu byung ba mched cing 'phel ba la gzu tsho zer/ phyis rgyang mkhar stag lung gi dgon pa'i sdom rgyun lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyi sdom pa rgya gar ma yin no/ /rgyang mkhar zer ba'i lung pa na/thug gu nye ba na spe'u zhig la bu rin po ches yo ga mtha' dag gsang 'dus lugs gnyis rgyud 'grel man ngag sogs dang / dus 'khor 'bro lugs kun spangs pa nas brgyud pa sogs mtha' dag gi zab khu gsan pa'i bla ma kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gnas thug gu'i spe'u de yin/ (lo chen rin chen bzang po'i slob ma myang gi stod nas myang stod kyi rkyang bu chos kyi blo gros kyis rgyang ro spe'u dmar zhes pa bzhengs shing / der bzang po lo tsā ba'i gung bzhugs lo chen rin chen bzang po'i slob ma myang smad pa'i slob ma spe'u chung bas myang gi rkyang 'dur na rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i lha khang chen po na dbus na lo chen gyi nang rten shākya thub pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho bco brgyad khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa/ lo chen gyi dbu skra/ rnam sbyar/ na bza'/ rgya gar shar nub kyi mkhas grub du ma'i thugs dam byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ rten rdzongs su bzhugs shing / lo chen gyi nang rten che ba ni bod na 'di kho na yin la/)zhig po bu dgu'i nang tshan dang dus 'khor lo 'bro'i bka' babs pa/ sprul sku 'jam dbyangs gsar ma dang / sa paṇa gyi dgung lo nyi shu pa la rkyang 'dur du rnam nges sogs gsan pa dang bla ma — 112—

bka' drin che ba/ dge bshes mtshur gzhon nu seng ge sogs rnams kyi bzhugs gnas dgon pa'i shul mchod rten dang bzhugs khri'i shul yod pa der rkyang 'dur zer ro/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis rgyun ring du bzhugs nas sprul sku 'jam dbyangs gsar ma la chos mang du gsan no/ /kun spangs kun tu bzang po mtshan dngos thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis kyang rkyang 'dur der 'chad nyan mdzad/thur la zer ba'i dgon pa sde pa 'dus chung gi sa khul na mag zer pa'i lung pa'i phu dang rgyang mkhar gnyis kyi mtshams na yod pa der dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nges/ dang por mdo sngags sogs yon tan gyi gzhi ma bskyed par mdzad pa gzed kyi lce yab sras yin la/ lces zla mgon gyi dus 'khor bsgyur ba'i spyin bdag mdzad cing / yer pa lha ri snying por pha dam pa'i drung du lce tsan+t+ra kirtis byon zhi byed rgyud phran gyi bka' babs dang gzhan gdams ngag brgya rtsa brgyad sogs pha dam pa las thob bo/ /gsang 'dus kyi rim lnga sogs man ngag zab mo rnams lho brag mar pa lo tsā la zhus/ gsang 'dus rgyud bshad 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i bshad pa/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi slob ma'i mchog mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan dang / rngog dbus pa ge sar gnyis la zhib par gsan pa'i mtshur ston dbang nge'i slob ma'i mchog 'khon gang pa ki rtis dang / bya khang pa'i thur lar nga ya grags pa ste gnyis yin/ 'di gnyis yum gcig pa'i sbun yin/ bya khang pas thur la'i chos khang sogs btab/ rgyang mkhar stod du srad pa'i rta bas mi gnod pa'i kha gnon la bya khang pa'i sbur ril po thur la'i — 113—

chos khang na bzhugs pas de phyin gnod pa las grol/ bya khang pas thur la pa tshul khrims skyabs la bshad/ des thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs la/ des ser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od la/ des kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la/ des 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho la/ des bu ston rin po che la rgyud 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pa'i bka' babs so/ /yang thur la'i dgon par stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma gdugs thogs pa bcu gsum gyi zla tshang thur she che chung gnyis kyang byung ngo / /yang tsho stod nas mched pa'i mkhan bu gzhon nu 'byung gnas kyis rgyang mkhar thur la bzung / de las gyes pa la gzu tsho zer ro/ /myang smad kyi sgro lung ser chung pa'i khu lung du gangs par grags pa'i slob ma khyad par can bsam gling rin po che 'khrungs/ bsam gling rin po che myang smad bsam gling btab/ bsam gling zer ba rngog ston gyi dgon pa/ da lta dpal 'khor bde chen gyi khang gsar grwa tshang gis bdag mdzad pa 'dus chung gi nub na yod/ bsam gling rin po ches dpyal chos bzang gi zur 'chad pa yang mdzad/ 'dus chung gi lung pa'i mda' na dpyal mkhan po rat+na shrī yab mes kyi chos rnams mkhyen/snubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i zhabs pad bsten/ gnas rnying ma la mkhas grub tu grags pa/ sna nam yul zhabs su rgya gling lha khang khyad par can bzhengs pa de nor khyung gi stod kyi rgya gling 'di ga yin no/ /nor khyung gi stag gi ri ldebs la sngar mdo sngags la mang du sbyangs/ phyis dus 'khor la chig sgril byas nas bu rin po che dang dbu sngas sbrel nas lo bco brgyad bsten/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel tshar bcu bdun gsan/ dus 'khor rang las mkhas pa gong — /14—

gsum bde chen chos kyi dpal ba'i (gong gsum bde wo chos kyi dpal ba'i dngos slob zhwa lu na mkhas pa'i mchog tu grags pa rin chen bsod nams 'phel yin/ de'i dngos slob zhabs 'bring lo bcu gsum du bsten nas dus 'khor rgyud man ngag sa ris dang / zhwa lu pa'i lugs kyi yi ge na gcig ma lus pa gsan sbyangs mdzad pa'i mkhas pa chen po smra ba shes rab rin chen yin no/) dgon pa gong gsum zer ba de yod/ deng sang dmu rdzing pas 'dzin no/ /nor khyung gi 'og na/ lo tsā ba mchog dam pa 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa/ nyi ma ltar grags pa'i skyes bu gangs can gyi dpal las 'khru/ngas pa/ ska cog zhang gsum gyi nang tshan cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi dgon gnas la cog ro gsum ste dbus kyi cog ro/ shangs kyi cog ro/ myang gi cog ro'o/ /nor khyung 'og myang chu g.yu 'brug 'dra ba'i nye 'gram/ rgyab ri khyung gshe/ga 'dra ba'i ngogs/ rgyang nas bltas na gshe/nga ba/ 'khris su slebs na sa 'bor ba/ dung dkar gyi lto ba der cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan 'khrungs sa yin/gnas gzhi yang yin/ 'khrungs pa'i gang zag gi ming gnas la thogs nas cog ro dgon par thogs shig /lha mo khyad par can kham bug ma yang bzhugs so/ /nor bu khyung rtse ste chen po dbang rgyal 'phags/ nang chen kun dga' 'phags/a chen dpal bzang gsum gyis rgya rgyal po'i phyag nas tshe ring gnam gyi she mong zhus/ 'ja' sa longs pa'i stobs la brten/ rgyal mkhar gyi sked pa ru dbang ldan gyi rtse btab/ mda' ru nor bu khyung rtse btab/ bar du myang stod kyi lte ba la 'brong rtse btab/ dge bcu tshang ba'i ljongs gsum yin no/ /nor bu khyung rtse'i ltag na bstan pa snga dar gyi dgon pa thog snga la byin rlabs che ba phu dgon pa — 115—

yod/ myang stod stag rtse'i phu na/ (nang rol gyi nang na/)stag tshal zer (nang rol gyi nye ba'i mda' na mkhar dga' smon spro zer ba de yod )ba yod de chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi bla'i mchod gnas dge ba'i bzhes gnyen mchog dam pa rnams kyi thugs dam du bzhengs pa/ khyad par rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bla'i mchod gnas dge ba'i bzhas gnyen mchog dam pa rnams kyi thugs dam du bzhengs pa ni pad ma dang bi ma la mi tras dngos slob grub pa thob pa'i skyes mchog myang ting 'dzin bzang po des klung shod zhwa'i lha khang dang / grog gi lha khang bzhengs/ rol mo skyid g.yung drung gis de'i zhal spro byas/ rgyal po chen po sde lnga bcar de'i bka' srung du mnga' gsol zhing pad mas dam la bzhag go /phyis bstan pa phyi dar gyi a mes tshong btsun lo ston gyi dngos slob des stag tshal gyi bya chos mkhar po che bzung nas nga5/da grwa bskyangs/ a mes tshong btsun la mar shul sa yon bdag mo snyos smos smon 'gro phul/ de la mkhan bu mar pa rdo rje ye shes te mtshan gyi rnam grangs smon 'gro lo tsā ba mar pa rdo ye la smon gro gtad/ phyis mar pa rdo ye la a mes phyug mtshams kyis stag tshal dkyus thang bzhengs nas phul/ mar pas bran ma sgang po brtsigs/ lan 'gro'i stag tshang dang bzhi la smon 'gro'i ma dang mnyam pa'i bu bzhir grags pa'i lha khang gnas bzhi yin te de rnams la smon gro skor zer ro/ /mar pa'i bka' babs bzhi'i slob ma gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po'i 'khrungs sa stag tshal yin/myang stod stag tshal der gtso bor khyung rin chen grags kyi slob ma mchog tu gyur pa yang yin zhing / gro lung pas kyang slob ma stod lung rgya dmar ('phags —116—

chos kyi seng ge bka' drin che ba'i bla ma yin/)ba dang / rog mngon pa na gnyis kyis chos 'chad cing chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ chos kyi ཿnga khungs chen po yin zhing / der ras chung pa'i slob ma rje btsun gtsang pa'am sum par grags pa des stag tshal du rab tu byung / thugs gnyer la lo gcig bzhugs/ /ras chung pa'i gdan sa bzung / /chu bo ga d+ma'i rgyun la bzang bar grags/ gdams ngag rgya bod gnyis ka na che bar grags so/ /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma grub thob nyi phug pas stag tshal gyi mar pa lo tsā la byams chos lnga sogs mang bar gsan zer ba de mar pa dngos yin no/ /yol chos dbang drang srong thog 'bebs gsum 'khrungs pa'i sa yul stag tshal yol lcags pa yin/ yol ston chen po chos dbang ni brgyad stong 'grel chen gsung sgrog 'phro la chos khri'i thog de gar sku gshegs/ mchod rten yang de gar brtsigs pa'i nang na sku gdung ril po gcig tu bzhugs so/ /ring bsrel zam ma chad du phyir thon pas phyis gser 'bum du btang nas da lta yol gyi gtsug lag khang byang ma na bzhugs/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gnyis su ma mchis pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs cha lag zab chos dang bcas pa'i bka' babs shing / slob ma'i mchog dam pa grub thob nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ des grang phu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ des skyes mchog par gras/sa pa 'phags pa klu sgrub/ des 'gro ba'i mgon po bka' bzhi pa dkon mchog gzhon nu/ des 'phags pa don zhags pa chen po shes rab brtson 'grus kyis stag tshal bya kan du don zhags — 117—

bsgrubs pa stong phrag gcig smyung gnas res 'jog gis mnyes pa'i brtson 'grus drag pos lo bco brgyad kyi bar du sgrub pa mdzad pas/ skye bo phal cher gyis spyan ras gzigs dngos su mthong zhing / de nas skyegs kyi gnas rnying dben gnas dga' ldan du phebs nas don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i khrus kyi cho gas skye bo'i tshogs la byin gyis rlabs par mdzad pas/ da lta yang phyag len rgyun mi nyams pa'i gnas rnying gi gzungs sgrub ces deng sang yang grags so/ /stag tshal bya kan gyi gnas la po ṭa la zhes yongs su grags so/ /lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge ni thugs gnyer mdzad sa dang grwa sa stag tshal yin/ 'khrungs sa myang stod phum bu ri rgya stod yin no/ /stag tshal du dol pas kyang bde mchog gi rgyud dang man ngag gnyis ka bshad cing / grub thob nyi phug pas kyang stag tshal du rgyun ring bzhugs nas rgya cher gsan no/ /stag rtse'i mkhar kha'i smon 'gror zangs dkar lo rme re bu bzhi'i nang tshan smon 'gro lo tsā ba mar pa rdo ye 'khrungs so/ /man lung dgon pa de thogs shin tu snga ste lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi ma/ban bu kyi ā tsar+ya ye shes dbang po'i mkhan bu phyi tshar bzhi'i nang tshan mon btsun g.yu ston dang / phug ston ye shes yon tan gnyis kyis man lung bzung ngo / /man lung gu rle'i skye ba gong ma myang stod stag tshal gyi man lung pa bshes gnyen chen po bran ston mtha' bral bya ba mkhyen pa che zhing rtogs pa mtho ba/mngon par shes pa thogs med du mnga' ba de'i mnal lam du bla ma na ro pa byon par gzigs nas nang par bang chen pa myang smad phyogs su bltar btang bas/— 118—

rje mi tra chen po byon par shes nas yab sras gnyis kas tshong 'dus mgur mor mjal du byon/ byin rlabs dang gdams pa zhus so/ /yang brag ston gyis khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi drung du byon/ de skabs po tā la'i lam yig rnyed pa tshogs byas rgyas btab nas slar skye ba rting ma la man lung gi dgon pa de bzung zhing / po ṭa lar phebs so/ /de lta bu'i skyes bu chen po bran ston mtha' bral gyi dgon pa man lung zer ba gnas gzhi dang bran ston gyi dbon rgyud dang bcas pa yod do/ /ko brag pa'i slob ma sa chen gyi yang slob ma yin zer/pho rog mdo sde dgon gyis dgon pa bya skyung der khong rang gi sku byin rlabs can phyag na che'i bum pa yod pa las cho 'phrul rta zla la ljang pa skyes pa la lo legs nyes kyi brtag dpyad byed/ dpyal lo chos bzang gcen po ba stag gi sras rnams kyi dang po slob dpon dbang phyug ste shes rab che zhing yid gzhung dad brtson dang ldan pas pho rog mdo sde dgon thugs phrogs te bla ma la nan gyis zhus nas bya khyung gi gdan sar dbang bskur ro/ /mkhar kha'i byang shar phu'i ri la slob dpon pad ma'i gzim sbug nang rol cong stod na yod/ bstan gnyis gling pas spyir gter kha brgya rtsa brgyad 'don par lung bstan kyang / rtsa ba'i gter kha nas sangs rgyas dgongs 'dus spyan drangs pa stag rtse'i phu brag dmar gter khung du grags pa de yin no/ /bstan pa snga dar dgon pa khyad par can srong btsan sgam pos btab pa stag rtse na ste (pre 3 ta dgon pa thogs shin tu snga'o/ /mkhar kha'i nang gi brag —119—

dkar lha bu zer ba de mched gsum gyi gdung rgyud yin no/ /stag rtse'i mda' na bstan pa snga dar gyi dgon pa khyad par can khri ral gyis btab pa nyan tsho'i lha khang dang / dgon pa thogs shin tu snga zhing / byin rlabs can no/ /to tsho de jo bo rin po che a ti sha rgya gar nas phebs gong a mes tshong btsun la nyan tsho phul nas mkhan bu ra blo gros bzang po dang khams pa gnyis la nyan tsho gtad/ ras ngur smrig bzung / khams pas lcags mkhar bzung ste de gnyis la ra tsho dang khams tsho zer zhing / gnyis ka la nyan skor du grags so/ /nyan tshor jo bo rje a ti sha phebs/ chos 'khor zla ba gsum mdzad/ jo bos nyan tshor chos zla ba gsum mdzad pa'i skabs 'gos lo tsā ba khug pa lhas btsas kyis mjal nas chos mang bar gsan pas/ gtsang gi slob ma'i mchog mgar 'gos yol gsum zhes zer ro/ /nyan tshor rnal 'byor pa chen po a mes byang chub 'byung gnas dang mjal/ jo bo'i chibs pa gso ba nang las rnams kyang byas nas chos rnams gsan/ sku dang 'bral med mdzad/ jo bo'i bzhed pa bden gnyis la 'brom las 'di mkhas par grags/ 'brom gyi rwa sgreng gdan sa lo bcu gnyis mdzad/rwa sgreng gi khyams smad kyi mkhar las lhag rnams khong gis mdzad/ slob ma stod lung pa rin chen snying po/ lhab mi chen po/ dge bshes mang ra ba sogs so/ /nyan tshor dgon pa ba 'dzeng dbang phyug rgyal mtshan khams nas byon/ nyan tshor mjal nas dar yug brgya phul/ jo bo'i zhal nas nga'i zan mi za na sgom mi ster gsungs/ de nas bzung ste chos gnas mdzad/ rwa sgreng gi gdan sa lo lnga mdzad/slob ma sgom pa ba'i bu bzhir grags pa sogs byung ngo / /jo bo a ti sha nyan tsho —120—

gnas su phebs dus jo bo'i zhal nas da nangs tho rengs nam mkha' la 'i hāXdakar po sgra dang bcas pa zhig byung / de bcu gcig zhal gyi sku li ma 'di la phog /de las 'od 'phros/ bod thams cad 'od kyis khyab nas de ban chung gzhon nu gcig la phog pas de'i sgyu lus 'od gsal du shar ba rmis gsungs/nyi ma rtse shar la yol chos dbang btsun chung lo bcu drug lon pa gcig gis dar ser po zhig phul/ bdag la thugs rje chen po'i gdams pa zhig zhu zer bas jo bo dgyes nas bcu gcig zhal gyi sku de yang gnang / spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor rnams rdzogs par gnang / de nas rang gi gnas su jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor rnams rdzogs par gnang / de nas rang gi gnas su jo bo spyan drangs te zla ba gsum du zhabs tog mdzad/ de'i tshe tshogs chos su pha rol tu phyin pa gsungs/ lkog chos su yol mched gsum la kṛ ya'i sgrub thabs rnams gsungs/ yol gyis jo bo a ti sha la srung ba zab pa zhig zhu zhus pas ma ṇi gsungs/ des mi 'ong zhus pas mi g.yo ba gsungs/ byin rlabs che ba zhig zhus pas yi ge drug pa dang zhal bcu gcig pa gsungs/ lo tsā bas mthu che ba zhig zhus pas gshin rje gsungs/ sgrub thag nye ba zhig zhus pas sgrol ma gsungs/ yol gyis thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i skor zhus nas sgrub pa mdzad pas zla ba drug nas zhi ba'i zhal gzigs/ de nas khro bo'i zhal gzigs/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor la yol las mkhas pa med gsungs/ yol la brten nas thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi gdams pa mang du 'phel lo/ /rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs de lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ lha btsun byang — 121 —

chub 'od/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs kyis zhus kyang ma gnang ste yol chos dbang la gnang ngo / /yol snying rje che bas 'di snying rje'i lha yin gsungs/gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs sogs gnang bas khong rnam pas zhal 'khang chen po mdzad/ lan pa spyil bur bzhugs tshe bran kas jo bo la bar chad brtsams pas rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs mdzad nas bran ka btul lo/ /nyan tshor yol mched gsum ste yol chol dbang /yol drang srong / yol thog 'bebs gsum gyis chos mang du zhus pa'i gnas khyad par can no/ /rwa los nyan tshor 'bum gyi sna drangs pu ti lnga bcu dang mgron zan zla ba re'i cha rkyen khal khri tsho gcig sbyar/ nyan tshor mar pa lo tsā rgya gar du phebs pa'i rting ma rang la 'dir jo bo dang mjal/ na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs tshul dang nga'i lo tsur sdod gsungs pa'o/ /jo bos gnas rnying la phyag nas 'thor pa yang 'di'o/ /khro lo byams pa dpal myang stod nyan tshor zla ba kha shas bzhugs ring kha che paṇa chen rang gis zhal bskos mdzad pa ltar rgya gar kha che nas paṇa chung gnyis dbu'i gdung thams cad dang ring bsrel gsum bod du gdan drangs/ring bsrel sum cu gsum du 'phel ba dang bcas myang stod nyan tshor lo tsā ba'i phyag tu rtags mtshan khyad par can dang bcas smin pa'o/ /dus deng sang nyan tsho'i dgon pa de mnga' dag myang gi gdung brgyud kyis 'dzin no/ /stas rtse 'i phu mo khar kha dang nye ba na bsam yas thog mar chags grabs kyi deng sang rgyal po chen po sku mkhar chabs cig par gnas pa 'di kho na'o/ /rgyal po gnas pa rang — 122—

myang yul stod smad bar gsum gyi ngo mtshar gtam gyi legs bshad mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs/sngon dus smon 'gro lo tsā ba mar pa rdo ye'i dgon pa stag tshal smon 'gro'i lha khang zer ba de yin/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng 'khrungs yul dngos phum bu re pa yin/ slob gnyer mdzad sa yang myang stod tshal yin/ snar thang pa mchims nam mkha' grags myang stod stag tshal du 'khrungs/ de'i 'og gis mchims blo brtan dang / phyis kyi mchims blo bzang grags kyang stag tshal smon 'gro'i phu kha 'ur 'khrungs so/ /nyan tsho'i 'og na rin chen sgang yod la de'i phu na jo gdan bla ma khyad par can rim par 'phel ba'i spos khang yod do/ /spos khang phu na 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phug pa rta lam dang / de'i phu na slob dpon pad ma'i phug pa yod/ spos khang gi mda' na rgyal po khri ral gyi gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad bzhengs/grub rjes su yon rdzongs lhag ma la gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa lhag chung dgon pa yod/ de'i 'og tsam na bon gyi grub thob bon bzhi khyung nag la snyan brgyud kyi bka' babs pa g.yung drung nyi shar yod/de'i 'og na lce dkar nag khra gsum las lce'i khri dgon pa yang dgon zer ba yod/ lce la dkar nag khra gsum yod do/ /bkra shis rdzong dga'i nye 'gram na 'khor re lha khang yod/ de'i nye 'dabs na lcags mkhar ba zer ba'i sngags pa/ lce dkar nag khra gsum gyi nang tshan lce nag gi brgyud pa yod/ lce nag des sngon sgrol ma drug skor gter nas spyan drangs/ lce dmar gyi brgyud pa bye mda' na yod/ myang ro lung pa na ri bkra ngan zhing bkra mi shis pa'i ri bcu gsum yod pa'i kha gnon la byang ri bse brag pad ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba 'dra — 123—

zhing / ri bkra shis la g.yang chags pa'i sa/ ri bkra ngan pa thams cad zil gyis mnan pa'i byang re bse brag gi ri 'di la myang ting 'dzin bzang po sku lus ma spangs par da lta yang bzhugs par yang grags/ 'brug pa sprul sku mi pham pad ma dkar po la mjal bar dngos su byon pa yongs la grags shing rnam thar du'ang thebs yod/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'i sras jo sras yang dag skyabs/de'i sras jo sras bdud 'joms/ de'i sras jo sras phur ba skyabs/ de'i rgyan gong du lo ston la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus/ mtshan rdo rje dbang phyug tu btags/ sku bgres por byon nas lho brag mkhar chur phebs/ gter thon nas rtag ngu'i bcud len thon/ grub pa thob/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas tsha mo dang gnyis kar bse brag gi ri la da lta yang bzhugs so/ /byang ri bse brag gi rtse la ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gzim phug chu mig dmar gsol du grags pa/ dbus pa ston shāka ni lha rje nya ri ba'am sgro phug pa'i grwa sar yi ge 'brir byon/ dad pa thon nas slob gnyer mdzad cing / dbang lung rgyud gdams ngag gi rgyud smin nas slob ma mchog tu gyur pa bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan ston bzhi ya gyal dbus pa ston shāka gong du smos pa bzhin khyad par du 'phags pa'i skyes bu de lha rje rgya nag gi phyir rjes su 'brangs nas byon/ rgyud gdams ngag thams cad ma lus par gsan nas sgom sgrub mdzad par dgongs te byang ri la dgon pa 'tshol du byon pas/ yol ba brag la/ yol chung ba brag rdo bzhin 'dug skad/ 'dir dgon pa mdzad pa lags sam zhus pas/ yin te/'di min pa bya sa mi gda' byas pas phar ngos kyi brag bse ba kha sprad can de na —124—

'ong ba 'dug zer/ de bas 'di btsan par 'dug pas ngas 'dir byed pa yin/de min pa bya sa mi 'dug ste/ de nas dam pa ston shāka gis brag bse pa kha sprad skyes pa der byon tsa na de'i chu mig 'gram na dbyu gu gcig 'dug gam yang zer/zan rdog lnga 'dug gam yang zer te bzang ltas shig byung / de nas der bzhugs te sgom sgrub mdzad pas dgongs pa tshad du skyol/ lha 'dre dam la thogs/ gdul bya mang po'i don nus pa byung ste dam pa bse brag pa zhes grags pa yin no/ /bse brag g.ya' lung gi dgon pa btab cing / bya gnam la 'phur ba la sgom thebs/ nam phyed chu gnyid du 'gro ba la 'byung lnga'i rlung 'og tu gnon/rlung sems la rang dbang thob pa'i bla ma yin/ bse brag g.ya' lung ni o rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas kyi gtor ma 'dra ste ri bkra ngan pa thams cad 'dis non/de'i nye 'dab na dam pa yul chung pa'i gzim phug nang na a lce snang sa 'od 'bum gyi dbu dang spyi khyab kyi rjes yod pa yo ba shar/ ('di phyis shar kha ras r+ṣa pas btab pa'i deng sang 'brug pa'i chos srol 'dzin/ bse brag g.ya' lung gi ri bo shar kha ras chen pas bde chen dpal 'bar gyis btab pa'i dgon pa yin/ shar kha ras chen pa rgyal dbang rdo rje'i slob ma yin no/ /spyir rgyal dbang rje'i slob ma la rtogs ldan lha btsun pa dang / shar kha ras pa dge slong rnam gnyis/ 'ba' ra ba snga phyi sogs so/ /deng sang 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi chos srol gyi rgyud 'dzin) nub kyi dgon pa yol shar nub kyi gong na dam pa chung pa'i gzim phug gong du bshad pa kho yod/ de'i 'og tu bse brag sgrub sde/ de'i 'og dam pa bse brag pa'i slob ma mkha' 'gro ma 'od 'bum gyis dgon pa brgyabs pa dgon ming bla ma zhang gi btags pa'i chos sdings zer ba'i dgon ro — 125—

yod/ bse brag rang zer ba gcig /lha rje rgya nag pa'i slob ma dbus pa ston shāka gis brgyab pa'i dgon pa dngos gzhi bsgrubs te bla ma zhang spyan drangs pas chos sdings/ lha 'dre dam la btags pa/ deng sang lha dge bsnyen 'bar ra gnas pa/ bse brag rang dang gsum dkar dbus pa ston shāka gis brgyabs/mtshan la'ang dam pa bse brag par thogs/ chos sdings zer ba'i gong du bshad ma thag pa'i nye logs na snang sa 'od 'bum gyi gzim phug yod pa 'di nas mkha' spyod la gshegs/ de'i 'og na pa snam zhol po'i phu na ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub phug byin rlabs can rgyal ba'i dbang po dbang phyug rdo rjes gnas sgo gsar du phye ba yin/ de'i 'og bon gong gi phu na gnyan lo tsā ba'i gnas gzhi gnyan phur grags pa yod/ gnyan phu'i byams pa thog mar rgyal byed tshal du spyan drangs/ de nas pho brang bsam 'grub rtser spyan drangs pa'i gzhis sde'i byams pa 'di yin/ de'i phu na byang bdud zer ba'i ri la bon gyi tshe dbang bod yul ma'i grub thob kyi gnas gzhi dang phug pa yod/ lo ras pa'i slob ma mchog 'jam dbyangs mgon po 'khrungs yul myang stod khams grogs (gangs dang khro zer ba'i nang na yod/)yin/ mkhas pa mchog tu gyur pa/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar yang byon/smad 'brug rnams kyi dgon pa rgyag par gsol ba btab pa'i ngor myang stod smad gnyis kyi mtshams su ku ru lung du dgon pa btab/ da lta bon gong gi ltag tsam gyi dgon ro de yin no/ /khro lo byams pa dpal gyi skabs su dbus dang gtsang gnyis na 'dul ba —126—

'dzin pa chen po mang du yod kyang / mchog tu grags pa myang stod smad kyi mtshams na gtsang na 'dul 'jin bya ba ngo mtshar can gcig bzhugs pas/myang stod smad mtshams kyi dgon gnas de khro los byon/ lo hril po gnyis su 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang / so sor thar pa dang / 'od ldan sogs mthar phyin bslab bo/ /'di ku ru lung gi dgon pa yin no/ /smad de gtsang nag 'dul 'dzin la 'dul pa nyan par stabs cig tu mkhas pa bsod rgyal ba zhes dregs pa can nga sgra tshad gnyis kyi steng bka' bzhi bsnan pa/ spos kyi glang po mche ba drug ldan bya ba yin gsungs pa sogs khengs tshig gsung skabs/ khro lo dgung lo bcu dgu pas tshigs bcad 'di gnas 'dir gtsang nag 'dul 'dzin gyi drung du mkhas pa bsod rgyal la gsungs/ tshogs gnyis las can bka' bzhi sgra tshad kyi/ /mche ba drug ldan glang chen grags myos kyang / kho bo lung rigs mche sder rnon po can/ /seng phrug rtsod pa'i rtsal gyis klad pa 'gengs/ /zhes gsungs pas slob dpon chen po sogs thams cad dgyes so/ /de'i 'og tsam na bsam sdings dgon pa yod do/ /de ni ni gu (spyir ni gu la rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bkur/ ni gu'i khrid bka' bcu gsum/ lugs de la rgyas pa na dbang bka' drug cu re brgyad/ 'bring po dbang bka' nyi shu/ mgon po'i dbang bka' nyer lnga yod/) chos drug gi bka' rgya bdun rgyud du gdams pa'i rin chen sna bdun/ rdo rje 'chang ni gu sta zur chags pa'i ni gu ma mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa'am bal tshad ma'i dbon po/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa sangs rgyas gnyan ston/— 127—

sangs rgyas ston pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i slob ma mkhas grub shangs ston gyis 'jag btab/sangs rgyas ston pa'i slob ma mkhas brtson gzhon nu 'khrungs sa myang smad cung yu ba gdong yin/ bla ma'i lung bstan dang bstun pa'i jo mo lha ri chas pa'i mgul/bsam gtan sgom pa'i gnas dang mthun pa'i dben par bsam sdings dgon pa btab bo/ /pa snam 'dir sngon gyi dus su sprul pa'i rgyal po ge sar bzhugs tshul/bstan pa snga dar lo paṇa gyi bzhugs tshul/ phyi dar mkhas grub rnams bzhugs nas bstan la bya ba mdzad tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni rgyal pos rgya khri shing khri bskor 'byed pa la/ /sma da yul gling dkar stod cig byung / /hor yul yol mar/ (yo dmar)sdings chen du/ /hor ge sar rgyal po 'dul pa la/ /stod yul gling dkar stod cig byung / /'dre klu btsan thos zhes bya ba dang / / 'brong ka ka rwa ring 'dul ba la/ /bar yul gling dkar stod cig byung / /zhes pa gsungs pa'i bar gyi gling dkar stod/ pa snam gyi sa yul yin te/ gling gi gra ma smug gu ni pa snam rdzong gi nub byang gi phyogs thams cad sngog dus zhing med gra ma kho nas sa yul rnams khengs yod pa phyis zhing du bcos kyang / zhing dkyil kyi stongs rnam gra ma khengs yod do/ /gling gi 'jag thang skya mo ni pa snam gyi byang shar nyin lam tsam kyi sa yul thams cad 'jag mas khengs yod kyang / phyis nye ba'i sa yul skye tsher btab pa yin la/ thag ring po'i thang la da lta yang 'jag ma yod do/ /gling gi zam pa dgur mo ni pa snam mdun gyi zam pa de yin/ rgyal —128—

po'i pho lha gyer tshon dkar po ma ṇi dgon pa'i ltags kyi lha gtsug der gnas shing / pa snam rtse zhol gyi lha mchod rgyas pa ston btsas gong rgyun du byed/ mo lha gung sman rgyal mo ni jo mo lha ri de yin/ tshang rog dug sprul nag po lho'i phyogs na gnas pa'i deng sang skabs gza' bdud nga/ zer ba sogs yin/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos pa snam der zhabs kyis bcags shing bzhugs pa'i gnas mdzad pa'i sa yul khyad par can du 'phags so/ /gnyis pa bstan pa snga dar la lo paṇa gyi bzhugs tshul ni pa snam zer ba yin/ bstan pa snga dar gyi pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal po (chos 'khor bskor cing bstan pa rin po cher bya ba mdzad pa'i bya rgyud sga gdong dgon par bzhugs kyang sna snam dang thugs shin tu mdza' zhing gcugs la) dang slob dpon pad ma'i dngos slob (rje 'bangs brgyad kyi sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la re/ tog phog pa'i rje 'bangs grangs kyi khongs su med kyang / 'di 'phrin las phur pa'i rig 'dzin yin zhing 'phrin las phur pa la me tog phog pa yin zhing / lar rje 'bangs nyer lnga po thams cad sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor me tog phog cing smin par mdzad pa las rje 'bangs rer dkyil 'khor re yod pa 'di la gsungs so/ /gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i gsol 'debs sna snam par gsungs pa las/bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du: sgrub chen bka' brgyad gsang sngags dkyil 'khor sa las can rgyal po rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor bco brgyad kyi slob ma'i grangs la gtogs pa'i mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug tshang rog dug sprul nag po'i kha gnon la bzhugs so/) sna (lo rgyus khungs thub cing yongs su grags par slob dpon rin po che pad+ma spyan 'dren pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i mi gsum po kho na yin te/ jo — 129—

mo mtsho rgyal dang spyan 'dren pa mi gsum la/ zab chos phur ba'i chos bskor tshar ba gnang bas/phur pa jo mo lugs/ phur pa sna snam lugs/ phur pa mchims lugs/ phur pa shud bu lugs su bod 'bangs yongs grags so/ )snam (bu ston chos 'byung las/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twas bod kyi rgyal po la bka' bstsal nas/ bod lha srin ma thul bas chos byed du ma ster zhing btsan po sku tshe thung ba des lan pas/ 'dul ba la slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa zhes bya ba mthu rtsal dang ldan pa zhig yod pas/ de spyan drongs shig gsungs pa dang btsan pos rmi lam du byung ba skad bgyis te/ sba gsal snang dang / seng gong lha lung gnyis las/ g.yog sna snam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ lce dz+nyā sirnyi/ mchims shākya pra bhā/ brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ shud phu dpal gyi seng ge dang lnga btang bas slob dpon gyi mngon par shes pas mkhyen te mang yul gung thang du byon pa dang mjal nas rim gyis spyan drangs so gsungs/)rdo rje bdud 'joms gnyis lhan du bzhugs pa/ pa snam rdzong 'di rang yin pas na gang zag gi ming gnas la chags pas pa snam zhes grags so/ /slob dpon pad ma'i dngos slob rbal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chos gnas ༄phokhams g.yer mo thang gi rgyud/ (phur pa'i bka' babs pas phur ba rgyud lugs su grags so/) byang chub gzhon nu byung ba de'i gdung rabs gsum pa byang chub rgya mtsho dang /chos rgyal rgya mtsho gnyis kyi g.yog rdo rje kun thub khrid myang smad pa snam du phebs tshe ar tsho ban de bco brgyad kyis khong dpon g.yog gsum bzung / de skabs sbyor sgrol dar bas mkha' 'gro'i mchod rdzas byed zer rkang lag phur pas brgyangs pas gcen gyis rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags/ gcung pos phur pas khrab shon byas thams cad brgyal rmongs rengs la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa yang pa snam 'di rang du byung ba yin/ pa snam gyi rgyab kyi bya rgyud zer ba'i tsho — 130—
