dgon pa de thog mar sga gdong dang dus bstan pa snga dar la btab pa yin no/ /gsum pa phyi dar la mkhas grub rnams bzhugs nas bstan la bya ba mdzad tshul ni ma ṇi dgon pa'i nye 'gram ltag na rwa los (rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi bla ma bha ro 'am pañja gling pa la bal por gsan pa/ rwa los bal po thugs rje chen po bal bod gnyis kar zhabs la gshugs shing dgra nag 'jigs skor gsum dang he ru ka mngon 'byung gi skor la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ dbon po rwa chos kyi paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī bod la spyan drangs te dus 'khor 'phags mo mngon 'byung mgon po mngon byung sogs bsgyur zhing gsan no/ /rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma gtso bor gsan pa yin zhing rwa pa la'ang ro langs brgyad skor yang yod do/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa la ro langs brgyad skor dang lha zhe gnyis la ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha dgu ma mi rgyud dang shin tu mthun no/ /zhang lo tsā ba grub pa dpal bzang pos rgya gar du la li ta badz+ra la gsan pa 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu ma la ta badz+ra yis mdzad pa'i zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs yod do/ /spyos (skyos ka'od 'byung gi paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha chung ba la gsan pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma dang / skyos bod du zhang la gsan pa'i zhe dgu ma'ang bzhed do/ /zhang shes rab bla mas kyang paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra bod la spyan drangs te dgra nag gi skor rgyas par bsgyur ro/ /gnyos lo tsus dar pun ā tsar+ya la gsan pa'i gnyos lugs lha dgu ma/ shangs pa lugs la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma 'di la rgya gzhung yang yod do/ /'jigs byed kyi khrid la mtshan mo'i rgyu ba'i khrid/ mtshan mo gyen bsgrengs kyi khrid/ rwa khrid rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i khrid sogs so/ /'jigs byed kyi rgyud la rtog pa bdun pa/ rtog pa gsum pa/ rtog pa bcu gcig pa/ las mkhan ti'u lo pa'i rtog pa/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ bod 'grel yod tshul ni rwa lo tsā ba'i 'grel pa gsum/ rgya ston gyi 'grel pa/ gnyan rin po che bstan pa'i 'grel pa/ 'bri khung lo tsā ba ma ṇi shrī ka'i 'grel pa/ jo gdan khro yon pa'i — 131 —

'grel pa/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyi rtog gsum gyi 'grel pa sogs so/)pa snam rdzong gi ske 'og deng sang rta ra'i 'og tsam na khyung po chos brtson zer ba mnga' bdag rtse lde'i mes po 'brug gi chos 'khor la dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa chen po rnams byon/ mkhas par rwa lo/ gnyan lo/ khyung po tshes brtson/btsan kha bo che/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ mar thung dad pa shes rab/ zangs dkar/ (zangs dkar gyis de'i skabs su tshad ma rgyan bsgyur/) lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab sogs lo tswa'i 'grul tshan shin tu che bar byung ba'i zla tshan khyung po chos brtson des mnga' bdag rtse ldes kha che dz+nyā shrī sbyan drangs te khyung po chos brtson gyis lo tsā byas nas rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/ sbyong rgyud/ tshad ma rnam nges/ de'i ṭik+ka khong rang gis mdzad pa sogs bsgyur ro/ /de skabs gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyis lo bdun kha che dz+nyā na shrī la chos zhus/ yo ga rtse mo la mkhas par byas pa sogs kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i khyung po chos brtson gyis sgrub gnas phug pa (grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor phug yin zer ba ma dag go)yin no/ /dus de skabs kyi tshe shin tu mkhas par grags pa she khyung (khyung po grags se/ )gnyis/ dben 'bre ('ban thams cad mkhyen pa dbon ston skyer khang pa'i khu bo )gnyis/ rgya stag (stag pa kha chos) gnyis te drug gi nang tshan khyung po grags se/ lha rje rgya nag (lha rje lha khang pa )gis phar phyin gsan no/ (shes rab 'bar/brtson seng / stag pa kha chos)mtshan gyi rnam grangs khyung po chos brtson/ khyung po grags seng / khyung po grags se rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin no/ /rgya brtson seng ge'i nye gnas/ khyung po grags se yin zhing / de tsa na kha che dz+nyā na —132—

shrī spyan drangs te lo tsā ba gzu dga' rdor gyis mdzad tshe bod pa khyung po grags ses sna drangs pa'i brtsams chos nyan du byon pa'i gseb tu rngog lo sogs mang por yod do/ /po to ba'i slob ma dol pa chen pos khyung po grags se la lo lnga'i bar du dbu tshad gsan no/ /ri lte btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyi pha g.yu 'bum gyis jo mo stag gi rgyal mtshan gyi bu g.yu thog sgra gser bzang bya ba lce btsun la mjal du byung bas lce btsun gyis btsun par bcu gcig nye gnas bcol/ slar zhwa lu'i gdan sa yang g.yu thog sgra gser bzang gis byas pa/ bslab pa 'chal nas dpon brgyud du song / zhwa lu'i gdan sa khyung po grags seng la gtad/ khong rang gis dpon byas mnga' ris bskyangs/ g.yu thog sgras rgyan gong la dmag 'dren pa khyung pos bkag kyang ma khegs par rgyan gong bcom nas mchod cha thams cad zhwa lur drangs pa la khyung po grags seng ma mnyes par lha sar byon nas/ dwags po dbang rgyal dang khyung po gnyis kyis dmar po ri dang lcags po ri bzung nas phar phyin la 'gran bshad mdzad par grags shing / phyis khyung po grags seng zhwa lur byon nas gdan sa sngar bzhin mdzad pa/ mkhas pa khyad par can de'i sgrub phug dang / chos 'chad pa yang pa snam 'dir mdzad/ pa snam rdzong shar ngos kyi phug pa de gtsang spyon gyi gzim phug byin rlabs can yin/ pa snam gyi nye 'khris bya rgyud dgon pa de thog mar bstan pa snga dar la btab pa'i dgon pa yin/ sna snam dang pa tshab lo tsā ba'i phyis rten byin rlabs can du grags pa mchod rten dbus ma gnyis yin zer ro/ /phyi dar la dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu'am bcu —133—

gnyis kyi nang tshan gtsang pa gnyis kyi yang tshong khe (tshong khe thog mar rang chos bskor ba de yin no/)shes rab seng ges myang smad khris dang bya rgyud gnyis bzung ngo / /yang lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi slob ma'am mkhan bu mchog dam pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal a me'i mkhan bu zhang ston tshul 'phags kyis bya rgyud bzung bshad pa bskyangs so/ /yang zhang brtson bsod nams grags kyis bya rgyud bzung gi 'tsho bar pa zer ro/ /phyis su zhwa lu pa che ba ni ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ byang du seng ge ral pa can dang dgu /lcam bdun cu tham pa zhes grags pa'i ka bzhi'i nang tshan ku ri ja skyus kha drag dpung ba'i ka ba zer ro/ /sga gdong nas pa snam rgyab rgyud/(phyis bya rgyud pa 'dir kha che paṇa chen gyis kyang chos bskor ro/)bar la dgon pa yod de kun ra zer ba'i rgyu mtshan las rtogs shing / sngon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rgyud dpung bzang gsang ba spyi rgyad/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ rnam snang mngon byang / phyag rdor dbang bskur sogs bod la bya spyod rgyud kyi bshad gra dang / dkyil chog phyag len bshad pa lag len dgon gnas 'dir rang dga' zer zhing / dgon gnas de nas bya spyod rnal 'byor dang bcas pa'i rgyud man ngag phyogs sgrig phyag len dang bcas dbus gtsang khams gsum la so sor ljon shing gi yal ga sna bur gyes shing / ljon shing gi rtsa ba'am sdong po lta bu'i dgon nas de yin pas sdong zhes rgyu mtshan btags ming du dga' sdong yang zer/ yang na ri rta sga 'dra ba'i gdong gnas yod pas sga gdong yang zer/ pa snam dga' sdong bstan pa snga dar gyi dgon gnas khyad par can byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro ba'i gnas gzhi — /34—

yin te rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan (khri srong gi yab mes ag tshom gyi dus yin pa rgyal rabs khungs na yod/) gyi skabs slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba gangs ti si na bzhugs dus rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa gsan nas spyan 'dren (dang po slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis/) la brdzangs pas/ (spyan 'dren mi gnyis la yang pā tshab lo tsā ba yod do/slob ma byon par chos rnams slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i drung du bsgyur nas rgyal po la skyes su bsnams byon pa yin/ phyi nang gnyis kyi lag len mang po kun/ /gcig kyang ma lus dgos pa thams cad brdzangs/ /gzigs rtogs mdzod la gzhan la sho re re/ /zhes bang chen gnyis la phyi nang gnyis kyi dbang gdams pa rnams gsungs shing / chos rnams bsgyur zer bas bod kyi dpe dang dbang gdams pa chos dang bcas rgyal po dang rab byung dge bshes rnams la skyes su phul ba yin zhing / de lta bu'i dbang chen gnyis kyi gtso bo pā tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims bzang po yin/)slob dpon gyi gsung las/ yas kyi sa gnas bdag 'dra spyan 'dren pa/ /sku gnyer lags te bdag la dbang ma mchis/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal zhal nas bod yul du/ /khyod kyis phyin na srog dang bral bar gsungs/ /bdag la dbang med khri lan skyes lan du/ /man ngag yo ga a ba ta ra brdzangs/ /bang chen mi gnyis po yi brtse lan du/ /mngon par byang chub pa yi kha tra bshad/ /phyi nang gnyis kyi lag len mang po kun/ /gcig kyang ma lus dgos pa thams cad brdzangs/ /gzigs rtogs mdzod la gzhan du sho re re/ /sgrub thabs kyi tshad rnam par bzhugs pa rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa rdor dbyings sgrub thabs dang / rnam snang mngon byang bsdus don/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa dang gsum bskur/ slar — /35—

yang rgyal pos dbas the len dang slob dpon bran ka murti/ dab 'as mnyu shrī go cha dang de rnams kyi lo tsā ba myang smad dga' ba sdong nas pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal pos spyan drangs pa gangs ti ser byon nas gtso bor spyod rgyud mngon par byang chub pa khro bo dam pa rgyan 'phreng lung sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying mang du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'i lo tsā ba mchog tu gyur pa pā tshab des slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lo tsā byas/ chos zab mo dpag tu med pa bsgyur ba'i lo tsā ba pa tshab ('khrungs yul myang stod stag rtse'i nang stag tshal nas yin/ brgyud 'dzin gyi gdung brgyud da lta yod bzhin pa yin no/)tshul khrims rgyal po zhes pa bzhugs pa'i mthil pa snam rdzong rtse dang / chos 'chad pa'i dgon pa dga' sdong de yin/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen so so la gnang ba'i chab shog las bla ma dam pa nyid dga' sdong du bzhugs skabs nya dbon la bka' shog gnang ba'i dbu na rgyal ba'i myu gu bsam bzhin skye zhes pa'i sngon du chos rgyal ring lugs rma med gang / mdzad pa'i snying po bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog /rten dang brten bcas dga' ba'i sdong nyid dang / /phyis dus bstan rtsa 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /gcig 'dus 'khyil ba slar yang dga' sdong zhes/ /dam pa'i gnas nas 'phrin yig ut+pa la/ /legs bsha/da ge sar gtam gyis phyug pa zhig/ /dge bzhas kun dga'i gtsug gi rgyan du spros/ /zhes dang / bstan pa phyi dar la sogs 'dul 'dzin la 'dul ba bslabs/ gzhan yang sne bo grags rgyal la yang gsan pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po des smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyun klu mes gtso che ste klu mes rang la gzus kyi thug cing chos gsan/—136—

khyad par klu mes kyi dngos slob gru mer gyi slob ma rlung skyogs gzus gsum gyi nang tshan gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma gsum dang / khyad par skam gsal ba'i snying bu brten pa'i rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims kyi dgung lo so lnga nas brgyad cu rtsa lnga'i bar la 'chad nyan rgya chen po kho na mdzad pa dga' sdong 'di yin zhing / grwa pa 'dul ba'i bshad nyan 'pher ba stong lhag byung ste bod yul du 'dul ba'i bshad grwa rnams dang 'dul 'dzin gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu byon pa rnams phal cher mched pa'i sa yul yang dga' sdong 'di yin zhing /slob ma de rnams kyi nang nas mchog gyur ka ba bzhi gdung ma bcu las ka ba bzhi ni rma bya byang rdor/ mtha' bzhi 'dul 'dzin/ (mtha' bzhi 'dul 'dzin ni mtha' bzhi brtson 'grus 'bar gyi gnas gzhi 'u phug yin/)mda' 'dul 'dzin/ (gnas gzhi mdog lam yin/)jo gdan nag po dar tshul/ (phyis gnas gzhi yar lung tsha mo rang yin/) sogs gdung ma bcu sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims 'khrungs yul myang stod mang rab pa yin no/ /dge bzhas dol pa chen pos kyang dga' sdong du phebs/ rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims la 'dul ba mthil phyin pa bslabs/ mdo rtsa thugs nas bton/ zur chad pa yang mdzad/ rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar gyis kyang dang por sog 'dul 'dzin tshul khrims bla ma bsten/ bar du dga' sdong du phebs/ rgya 'dul 'dzin bsten/ mtha' mar rma tsho byang rdor bsten no/ /steng lo tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas dgung lo bco lnga la pa snam dga' — 137—

sdong du rgya 'dul 'dzin la rab tu byung / bcu dgu la dga' sdong du rgyas mkhan po mdzad nas bsnyen rdzogs sgrub skabs su dga' sdong gi byams pas khyod rgya gar la song dang bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan che'o zhes gsung byon pa ltar rgya gar du phebs/ spyir chos tshul mtha' dag la byang chub par thugs su chud par mjad cing / khyad par rgya gar shar nub gung gsum la chu bo ltar myul bar mdzad/bstan pa'i 'khur chen phrag par bzhes pa'i dka' ba brgya phrag dang du blangs de rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung rgyun len par mdzad nas bod yul du spel bas/ da lta bka' 'gyur gyi lung bzhugs pa de steng lo'i bka' drin no/ /de nas byams pa'i sku 'di thog snga mo nas dga' sdong na bzhugs par sems so/ /dga' sdong gi byams pa rgya gar shar li rtsod bral gyi byon legs pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro ba 'di'i lo rgyus zur na yod/gangs can yongs la grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po dbyar nyi ma brtson 'grus kyi dga' sdong gi mkhan po mdzad nas 'chad nyan rgya chen po'i chos 'khor bskor ba mdzad pa yang dga' sdong 'di nyid yin no/ /dbyar nyi la snar thang pa rigs ral gyis gsan pa rgya chen po mdzad pa dang / thugs gnyer la shin tu brtson pa'i thos pa mdzad sa yang dga' sdong yin zhing / rigs ral la 'dir bsnyun mdze yang byung ngo / /kha che paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i mkhan bu yin la chos kyang rdzogs par gnang zhing / mkhan brgyud kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa po lho brag pa byang chub dpal yin la mkhan bu bde ba dpal bzang pos dga' sdong du dbyar nyi ma brtson 'grus la phar phyin gsan zhing mdo chog legs par sbyangs/ stan — 38—

gcig pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i mkhan brgyud kyi gdan sa bzung /mkhan po bde ba dpal 'di la bya chad kha ba/ se spyil las rim brgyud slob dpon yon to dpal des mkhan po bde ba dpal la blo spyong don bdun ma'i bka' babs so/ /gtum ston blo gros grags kyi thugs gnyer mdzad sa yang dga' sdong yin/ dga' sdong du rgya 'dul la rwa los 'bum gyis sna drangs 'bul ba dang /rgya sogs kyi chos 'khor btsugs so/ /mkhas grub mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dga' sdong gtsug lag khang du dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i mkhan po mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nya dbon du grags pas slob dpon mdzad/ grub chen kun blo dgung lo brgyad pa la rab tu byung /sa hor yon mchod kyis bod khri stong la sogs bcas pa ni/ khri stong rkang grangs cung zad ni/ zhes dbus gtsang mnga' ris gsum lus kyi rnam pa byas/yan lag khri skor bcu gsum las gtsang la drug /dbus la drug gtsang min dbus min la khri skor/ khri skor re re la lha sde stong skor bzhi yod/ khro phu ba/snar thang pa/ bar sdings/ dpal sding dang grang phu lung pa gnyis gcig tu bsdoms pas stong gcig /stong bzhi ste chu phyogs stong skor zer/ zhal phyogs stong skor bzhi ni thar pa/ gnas rnying / dga' sdong / bar phyar stong skor re re'o/zhes dga' sdong pa la stong skor gcig bcas so/ /zhwa lu ba'i ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ byang du seng ge ral pa can dang dgu/ lcam bdun cu tham pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i dga' sdong dam pa chos kyi ka ba/ ku ri bya skyus kha drag — 139—

dpung pa'i ka ba/ g.yus sgyu ma nor gyi ka ba/ ne ser mthu'i ka ba/ gdung ma brgyad ni shar du kyi gru sha byar tshangs/ lhor 'or mug pa/ 'bri mtshams/ nub tu sdog /byang du gnyan rje 'bangs cog ro span no/ /byang gi seng ge ral pa can 'u yug gos sngon can gyi lung pa yin no/ /mi tra dzo kis shā ri pu tra la gsungs pa'i chos drug khyad par bka' babs pa'i shā ri pu trore slob ma mi nyag grags pa rin chen gyis dga' sdong gi mkhan po mdzad nas bshad grwa rgyun ring bskyangs pas bka' drin 'di mchog tu che'o/ /stag gzig gi brag la slob dpon pad ma'i sgrub phug byin rlabs can yod/ pa snam gyi lho brgyud nas karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gzim phug thar pa'i gong tsam na spo tho le yod do/ /spyir pa snam lung pa'i sa khongs na ri bkra shis pa brgya rtsa/ chu mig rtags mtshan can brgya rtsa/ shing sna brgya rtsa/ rtswa sna brgya rtsa/ dgon pa brgya rtsa yod/ dpa' bo brgya rtsa yod/ dpa' mo brgya rtsa yod pas yul ljongs khyad par du 'phags zer ro/ /dgon pa phal cher 'brug pa rgyal dbang rje'i slob ma rtog ldan lha btsun pas dgon pa brgya rtsa bteb zer bas dgon pa'i nang tshan shas cher mang ba tsam yod do/ /dgon gnas khyad par can pa'i lo rgyus zhib tsam bshad na/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpyal rat+na shrī la sras lnga'i gcung chung shos mkhan po 'phags pa dbang phyug gi sras/ dpyal pe tsa dmar ba ru dang 'od gsal po/ pe tsa dmar rus sman lung na zhang cog tu byang chub 'byung gnas bzhugs pa der slob gnyer la byon/—140—

zhang gis dpyal 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan du btags/ lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang lhan du chos gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs las byang dang bcas khyad par yang dag thugs (rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon hūṃ ka ra rgya gar nas bod du spyan drangs kyang ma 'drongs par rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis snubs nam mkha' snying po/ 'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros/ bsgyur ba'i lo tsā ba yang 'bre dkon mchog 'byung gnas sogs dge slong mi lnga brdzangs/ rgya gar slob dpon hūṃX ka ra dang mjal/ yang dag pa'i chos skor rnams gsan bsgyur mdzad pa'i lo tsā ba/) kyi sgrub pa gtso bor byed pa mchims phu'i phyag bzhes dang bcas dgu sogs mthar phyin par bslabs so//sman lung de zhung na rim gyis bzung / zhung cog tu byang chub 'byung gnas kyi zhal bkod mdzad par/ dpyal 'ban 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan 'di/ /nga dang dgongs pa gnyis pa la/ /grub thob brgyud pa mang byung bas/ /nga yi gdan sa 'di yis bzung / zhes so/ /slar pe tsa dmar dra'i zhang gi slob ma mchog za ri ye shes 'phags pa brgyud drug le lag bcu gnyis phra mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi mchims phu'i phyag bzhes dgu sogs mthil phyin bslabs so/ /de sman lung na sras sum/(yum)bcu bdun gser chos kyi pu ti sum cu bzhengs yod/ pe tsa dmar dzus ra dza gad thog gi mchod rten dkar po bzhengs/ yang pe tsas smri ti sman lung du spyan drangs/ sgra tshad/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug stong pa dang / de'i snying po mtshan brjod/ de'i 'grel pa bar ma la sogs gsan zhing bsgyur ro/ / lo stor grags so/ /pe tsas dgung lo bdun cu pa la sman lung 'phrul gyi lha khang bzhengs pa rgya'i gtsug lag khang gnam gyi the'u la dpe byas bya skyibs nyis rim/ rgya —141 —

phibs rtse mo lnga la gser tog /rten gtso rnam par snang mdzad/ dus mchod pra ti ha ra btsugs so/ /pe tsa'i sras gsal rab dang mchog rab gnyis/ sras rab kyi sras gsum gyi mtha' chung chos kyi grags pas sman lung lha khang gi khyams dang sgo khang brtsigs/ des bse phug gi kun dga' rwa ba bzhengs shing byams mchod bcugs/ pe tsa'i sras gsal rab kyi sras gsum gyi/ gcen rgyal ba'i blo gros kyi sras mched gnyis las che ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bal por pham mthing ba 'jigs med grags pas/ (dpal na ro pa chen pos bde mchog dang dgyes rdor bka' babs pa'i slob ma pham mthing pa sku mched bzhi'i che ba yin ste lo bcu gnyis 'bral med du na ro pa sten pa yin/ de'i 'og pham mthing pas na ro pa lo drug bsten/ de'i 'og pham mthing pas na ro par lo gsum bsten/) dgyes rdor yab yum bka' brgyud gsum 'grel pa bco lnga/ gzhan yang bde mchog sogs gdams pa khyad par can mang du bka' babs pas lhug par gnang zhing bsgyur bas bde mchog dpyal 'gyur du grags/ sman lung du dngul gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gar bu mi tshad tsam bzhengs— go /— tre bla ma chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sras bla ma kun dga' rdo rje ni rgya gar paṇa chen gnas lnga rig pa paṇ+ḍi ta a ma ra tsan+t+ra/ su ka shrī bha dra la sgra tshad/ dgyes rdor bde mchog dang dus 'khor sogs rgyud 'grel mang pho gsan/khyad par bla ma ha ngu dkar po la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs gzhung drug spyin bsreg dang bcas gdams pa zhus grub pas yi dam zhal gzigs/ dngos grub gnang / gnas sman lung gi sa yul lung bstan/ bla ma ha ngu mnyes/ gsung — 142—

gi rten du phag mo'i skor gyi rgya dpe gnang / sku'i rten du phag mo'i sku thang gnang /dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i rten du thod sku/ rus rgyan/ ting shag sogs byin rlabs kyi dam tshig gnang / slar yang lung yang bstan/ dpyal pa kun dga' rdo rje paṇ+ḍi ta stong nyid ting 'dzin bod la gdan drangs/ khyad par sman lung du gzhi phab ste gsang sngags kyi chos skor mang po dang man ngag mang po zhus shing bsgyur ba shin tu mang bar yod rnams la dpyal ba kun dga' rdo rje'i 'gyur dang dpyal ba'i chos skor zhes yongs su grags so/ /bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'i sras bla ma kun dga' grags rgya gar yul dbus la byon/ paṇa chen mkhas dgu'i zhabs pad la gshugs/ lo bcu gsum bzhugs/ bod la byon khar ri bya rkang (dgra bcom pa 'od srung chen po'i sku gsung bzhugs pa'i ri bya rkang dang thogs med kyi lo bcu gnyis pa byams pa sgrub pa'i ri bya rkang dang gcig go) du bla ma dang mkha' 'gro la tshogs mchod phul gsol ba btab/bzhin bzang dam pa yid 'ong ma/ /sngo bsangs rus sogs rgyan gyis spras/ /skra bzang gzugs dang lang tshor ldan/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos dang mjal/ /sgrub pa byas na phun sum tshogs/ /sgrub pa'i gnas su sman lung mchog /sa yul mchog nyid de yin no/ /zhes gnas lung bstan no/ /bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'i drag po rtsal gyis rgya gar du paṇ+ḍi ta bram ze dpal 'dzin (paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang chos skabs gcig tu gsan/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi gsang 'dus gsan pa'i bla ma nag chung de yin/) la nag po zhabs chung ba sogs mang bar bsten nas lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud 'grel bsgyur bas na dpyal 'gyur du grags — 143—

so/ /bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'i sras gsum gyi gcen bla ma dam pa lo tsā kun dga' grags kyi sras lnga'i bar pa dpyal lo chos bzang gis rgya gar du paṇa grub mang po bsten/ chos mang po gsan/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po chen po dang mkhas pa rnams kyi bka' nan lji bas rgya gar du bzhugs par thag bcad skabs/'phags pa rin chen dbang phyug gi zhal dngos su gzigs shing / gnas mchog thar pa 'debs par bstan pa ni/ rgya gar yul du de tsam gyi/ /chos tshig don cha la nges thob pas/ /da 'di ru ma sdod byang phyogs song / /dbyings thar pa chen po grong khyer du/ /thar pa chen po'i them skas tshul/ /kye 'gro ba dpag med thar par 'gro/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du de che'o/ /sa gang yin gnas bzhi'i cod paṇa mdzes/ /zhes dgon gnas bar pa'i ming / rgya nag yul bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan pa rgya chen por 'gyur ba'i lung bstan thob cing / rgya gar gi paṇa grub rnams la dbang dang gdams ngag zab mo thob/ rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/7bod du thar pa 'di ri khrod kyi tshul du lung bstan ltar btab bo/ /kha che paṇa chen spyan drangs nas paṇa chen shākya shis (kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra la bod du slob ma mchog tu gyur pa'i bka' zab mo babs pa ni/ sa paṇa la tshad ma'i bka' babs/ byang rdor rnam gnyis la 'dul ba'i bka' babs/ khro lo byams pa dpal la man ngag gi bka' babs/dpyal lo chos bzang la rgyud kyi bka' babs so/ /dpyal los na ro 'grel chen bsgyur ba sogs rgyu 'grel mang du bsgyur ro/ )dgon pa'i mtshan yang dpal byang chub thar pa gling du mtshan gsol/ rdo rje gdan sa chen po nyid la sgang badz+ra spyan drangs yun du thar — 144—

pa'i sa yul du bzhugs skabs/ bde mchog dbang rgyud man ngag dang gzhin rje gshed dmar po'i skor rnams zhus te bsgyur ro/ /thar pa'i sa yul 'dir byin gyis brlabs so/ /lo tsā dpyal chos bzang gi gcen po ba stag gi sras gsum las gcen po pad ma can gyi bla ma lo tsā ba'i thugs sras su gyur/ gsang (dpal na ro pa'i thugs dam gyi rten gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil thang dang rdo rje phag mo'i sku thang byin rlabs can gnyis kyang dpyal chos bzang gis rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'o/ ) 'dus rgyud bdun dgyes rdor rgyud gsum po rgyud mtha' dag gi bka' gnang zhing / thugs su chud nas thar pa'i gtsang khang khyams dang bcas bzhengs/ rten byang chub chen po bzhengs/bal por de'i rgyab yol bzhengs pa sogs de gsum dus gcig la grub pa'i ngo mtshar ba/ gtsug lag khang rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs/ gser sku ma hā bo dhi dang mtshungs zhes rgya bod gnyis kar grags so/ /chos sku'i rten gdung khang bkra shis 'od 'bar dang / 'bum khang chen mo yang bzhengs/ de'i dbon brgyud slob dpon rgyal mtshan mthu gtad gzer gsum thogs med grub pa des sman chikhung nag tshang byang bzungs so/ /slob dpon urla rin chen gyis sman lung nag tshang rnye bzungs so/ /de'i dbon brgyud bla ma dam pa rin chen bzang pos kye rdor gyi blos bslangs gzhal yas khang bzhengs shing / byang chub chen po'i gdan khri brkos legs gser gyis byugs pa mdzad do/ /de rjes thar pa lo tsā ba a mo gha sidha dang / de rjes thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po lo — 145—

drug mjad/ rgya gar shar nub dbus 'gyur 'chang rnams na bod kyi bcun gcig mor grags pa thugs dam zab mo'i don la mnga' brnyes pa/ 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa des bal po'i nags gseb tu sgra dbyangs kyi chos gsan/bod du slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab cing / mchog gyur pa rong pa shes rab seng ge dang / rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub sogs so/ /bu ston gyis lo cwa de'i zhabs drung du zla ba bcu bzhi'i ring bar ma chad bsten/ zla ba gnyis re tsam dang / gsum bzhi re tsam dang bcas pa yongs su dril ba lo bzhi lhag gi bar du thar pa ru bzhugs nas gtso bor sgra tsan+t+ra pa'i mdo 'grel dang bcas pa dang / phal pa'i tshul du sgra ka lā pa'i mdo 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i thugs sbyor mthar phyin par mdzad/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug la sogs pa sbyor drug gi skor/ rgyud phyi ma sogs dus wor gyi skor/ rdo rje snying 'brel dang / na ro 'grel chen dang / bzang po yongs gzugs la sogs kyai rdor gyi skor/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / phyag rdor stod 'grel sogs bde rma/skrog gi skor/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud la sogs gdan bzhi'i skor dang / gshed dmar bcu gsum la sogs gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ gzhan yang mi g.yo bla med la sogs pa'i rgyud/dbyangs can dkar dmar la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa sngags skor tshan chen po gsan/ gnad kyi zla zer la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid phyogs snyan ngag sdeb sbyor la sogs mang po gsan no/ /— /46—

thar pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso byang chub chen po'i sku'i gzhogs g.yas la gong du smos pa'i lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i dngul sku rdo rje sems dpa' sman lung nas spyan drangs pa/ de'i gzhogs na dpyal chos bzang gi nang rten thub dbang zangs sku che ba de'i g.yas phyogs rim bzhin 'jim sku kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra'i sku paṇa chen rang gi phyag nas ma dbu zhwa paṇa chen rang gis ngo ma bsnams pa/ dpyal lo chos bzang gi sku/dpyal nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi sku/ dpyal 'gro mgon kun dga' nyi ma'i sku/ spyir thar pa la chos kyi bka' babs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / rag pa cam las snga 'gyur la rgyud drug le lag bcu gnyis/ phra mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi gtso bo yang dag thugs kyi sgrub pa byed pa sogs mchims phu'i phyag bzhes dang bcas pa dgu khyad par phur pa bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len/ (dpyal lugs phur par grags ) gsar ma la thar pa ba'i thugs dam lha bzhi/ (dgyes rdor dang / bde mchog /rdo rje phag mo/ skyon rje lted bos bsto/) dang / khyad par lha bzhi'i chos skor gyi dbang skur byin rlabs dang / rjes gnang bcas pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs gzhung bdun zhal gdams (bde mchog dkar po/ phag mo ser mo/ mkha' spyod dmar mo/ rje btsun seng ge sgra/) dang bcas pa'o/ /gnas bzhi sman lung / (gnas phyogs sman lung der )dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bka' srol chen po mi 'dra ba bzhi babs te/ dpyal lo bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bal por pham mthing pa chen po 'jigs med grags pa la dgyes rdor yab bka' yum bka' rgyud gsum gyi 'grel ba bco lnga dang gdams pa — 147—

khyad par can gsan pas na ro chen po'i bka' srol lo/ /dpyal pa kun dga' rdo rje rgya gar paṇa chen gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta a ma ra tsan+d+ra la dgyes rdor rgyud 'grel skor tshang rgyas gsan pas a ma ra tsan+d+ra mi tra pa'i bka' srol lo/ /skyeg tsha rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis rgya gar paṇa chen bram ze dpal 'dzin la dgyes rdor cha tshang gsan bas pad ma badz+ra yi bka' srol lo/ /yang skyeg tsha rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis nag po zhabs chung ba las dgyes rdor gsan pas dam tshig rdo rje'i bka' srol lo/ /slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rje pad ma badz+ra in dra bhi lak+ṣa ma ki (bram ze dpal 'dzin ga ya dha ra 'brog mi sogs sa skya bar babs so/ /rdo rje'i bka' srol lo/) thar pa dang bcas pa 'dir bstan pa snga dar phyi dar sogs la mkhas grub dpag tu med pa byon nas bstan pa rin po che sgo du ma nas dar zhing rgyas la/ bstan rtsa dge 'dun dang de bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang sogs 'phel rgyas su byung ba yin kyang phyis dus zhig na nyams grib tsam byung / dpyal brgyud ma nyams par bzhugs kyang gnas gzhi ser khyim pa lta bu'i gnas gog por song ba sogs nyag phra ma'i skabs su dpyal ston chen po bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes sam yang zer/ gang ltar mkhyen rab blo gros kyi rgya mtsho'i rdzings chen po la gnas shing / rnam dkar gyi lha ba mu tig chun por mdzes pa/ khrims gnyis snyan grags gdugs dkar srid pa gsum du g.yo ba/ /gangs can bsod nams kyi dpal du 'khrungs pa/ /mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang pos spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel thabs kyis khur chen po phrag pa'i rgyan du mdzes la/ khyad par dgon gnas thar pa 'dir rab tu byung ba'i tshogs dang /— 148—

dri'i gtsang khang / dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rwa ba sogs bstan pa'i kha gso yar ldan du mdzad tshul sogs dkar chags sogs su blta'o/ /tshong 'dus mgur mo'i gtsug lag khang ni sngon rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs kyi blon po rnams kyis gcug lag khang bzhengs pa lce lha bzang grags pas tshong 'dus mgur mo'i lha khang bzhengs/ lce khri bzang byin gyis rtsibs kyi lha khang bzhengs/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi drug gam bcu 'am bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug 'khrungs sa tshong 'dus mgur mo'i rab kha yin zhing / tshong 'dus mgur mo'i gtsug lag khang 'dir 'chad nyan bskyangs so/ /rje mi tra chen po tshong 'dus bzhugs/ dbus gtsang gi dge bzhas grags pa can mang du 'dus/ de nas tshong 'dus mgur mor byon nas zla ba gsum bzhugs te/ 'gro ba mtho dman bar gsum gyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ dge bshes chen po gtso mdzad dbang byin rlabs/ sdom 'dzin/sems bskyed/ rgyas gdab zhus pa la grangs med cing / khyad par dbus gtsang du grags pa'i dge ba'i bzhas gnyen chen po drug ste rgya 'grel lam lo gro gshen dang drug go /de drug pos zab don gyi bstan bcos zhus pas rnal 'byor bdun/ sems mdud grol ba sogs mang bar gsungs/ jo bo kha sa chu rjis sems nyid ngal gso'i gdams pa jo bo spyan ras gzigs nyid kyis gnang ba'i yi dam du bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i e ka dza ti bya ba yod/ des gnang ba'i rdo rje sbas pa'i gsang lam/ chos spyod yan lag bzhi pa/ lam 'a cur rnam gsum/— 149—

mi tra'i chos drug /mi tra dzo ki lugs kyi bsam pa gsum ldan gyi bsnyen gnas zung 'jug bzhi/ skyes bu bzhi'i lam rim/ rdo rje lam rim/ rin chen 'bru dgu dang / mthar thug dgu /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom don sogs gnas 'dir chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ro/ /rje mi tras tshong 'dus man la ma byon no/ /gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo ru g.yu thog pa'i rgyud bzhi 'chad pa'i mgo bting tshe/ a ru ra'i char pa babs/ g.yu thog pa'i sku dpang du lha tshangs pas phul ba'i a ru ra snyim pa kha sbyar tsam zhig babs so/ /tshong 'dus mgur mor kha che paṇa chen gyis kyang zla phyed skor bzhugs nas mdo rgyud kyi chos gsungs/ sngon 'gro'i chos spyod med thabs med gsungs nas chos spyod bsdus pa gcig brtsams/ phyis rgyas shos de snar slad mo cher brtsams par mdzad do/ /paṇa chen budha shrī tshong 'dus mgur mor spyan drangs gzhung mang po gsungs/ rgyan gong lha khang du byon nas ltas brtag pa dang bcas mjad/chu pho byi ba'i lo chos rje bu ston nyid kyis dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum bzhes pa'i dus su don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan chen grags pa gzhon nu dpal bzang po zhes grags pa paṇa chen gyi mkhan brgyud bzhi pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi gya gcig tu grags pa de dang / slob dpon las byed pa bsod nams zhes grags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dang / slob dpon gsang ste ston pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bsod nams bzang po/ dad pa'i dge 'dun sde snod 'dzin pa chen po dkon mchog bzang pos thog drangs pa —/5(—

nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi dbus su yul sna tshogs kyi mi dang / zong tshong du ma 'du ba'i gtsang tshong 'dus mgur mo'i bla brang shar du bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas dgra bcom pa chen po'i rnam par gyur/ mkhan po de la gtso bor so sor thar pa'i mdo la sogs pa gsan gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang / sher snying mdo sgrub sogs zhor nyan du mdzad/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' chen po bsod nams grags la gtso bor 'dul ba mdo rtsa la bya tig btab pas bshad bka'/sdom tshig gi bshad pa/ so thar gyi mdo'i bshad pa las brgya rtsa gcig pa'i bshad pa la sogs pa rnams gnas 'dir gsan no/ /gzhan yang smon pa sems bskyed/ 'jug pa sems bskyed/ don zhags blo sbyong sogs zhor nyan du mdzad/ khyad par du'ang blo sbyong gsan pas nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i gsol thebs pa yang gnas 'di yin no/ /tshong 'dus mgur mo'i grong khyer dang nye bar chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan po bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu dpal bzang gi sku gdung ril po myang smad 'be lung nas bu ston rin po ches thog drangs rnam sbyar gyon pa'i dge slong nyis brgyas spyan drangs nas tshong 'dus kyi grong nye 'gram du gdung bzhus/ der mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa de'i nang du gdung thal bzhugs pa'i ring bsrel mang du 'dzags pa'i byin rlabs can de yod/ tshong 'dus khri khang gi nye logs kyi lho nub phyogs kyi ri la rgyal ba lo ras kyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phug pa yod/rgyal ba lo ras pa 'di gtsang pa rgya ras kyi slob ma mchog lo rgod gnyis kyi lo ras de yin/ 'khrungs yul dbus kyi gzhung yin/ lo du mar se mo do la — 15 —

bzhugs/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs/ mi la ras pa'i skye bar yang grags/'di nas mched pa la smad 'brug zer ro/ /smad 'brug gi chos zab mo thugs la mnga'o/ /tshong 'dus kyi 'go tsam gyi nye 'gram na dbon gnas bon grong du zhang lo tsā ba grub pa dpal bzang po rgyang tsam bzhugs dus dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal gzigs shing / mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'khrungs pa yang de yin zhing / des mgur 'di gsungs pa/ chos bden pa gnyis kyi dbyings rtogs pas/ /dbyings 'gag med yi dam mngon sum mthong / /chos mi rtog ting 'dzin zab mo'i don/ /brjod med du rtogs pas gnas 'di'ang mtshar zhwa lu'i phu rā dza shar phyogs na ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi bzhugs yul ko brag rang du yod/ de skabs su bod na ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan yongs la 'gro phan che zhing grags pa che bas chos gnyer lho'i dir rir bos nas sha wa ri'i (sha wa ri'i chos drug skor snga tsor ni paṇ+ḍi ta bi kyā tsa spros bod 'khor nas bal por phebs skabs rnal 'byor dbang phyug sha wa ri dngos dang mjal nas sha wa ri'i chos drug skor cha lag kha tshang gsan nas bod du 'gro phan nus pa zhig gnang dgongs te/) chos skor mtha' dag tshang ba'i bka' babs pa dang / lam 'bras se ston rig nas rgyud lugs la yang rab tu thob pa/ zhang ston sku mched/ 'bring du thob pa zha ma lcam sring / mtha' mar thob pa se mdog byang ye'o/ /zhwa lugs la'ang pho lugs mo lugs/ 'dres pa'i lugs la ko brag bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ las stod pa dbang rgyal/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ phyag na dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ ko — 152—

brag pa la lam 'bras kyi yang bka' babs shing gegs sel gyi yang bka' babs so/ /ras chung pa dang dbus ston gyi bla ma khyad par can bzhugs pa smon lam mkhar zhes bya ba yang yod do/ /yang dbus gtsang mkhas pa mi bcu'i nang tshan lo rdo rje dbang phyug gis bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo me (sa ka mo bya lo la rgyan gong de btab pa yin la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi chos kyi khungs rgyud 'byung tshul thung tsam bshad na nel pa paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus de yi ge rnying ma mang po dang bstun nas bsgrigs shing / mkhas mang la bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyis gser ltar gshugs shing dpyad nas dag par bsgrigs gsungs pa'i lo rgyus ltar bkod pa ni bo dong pa g.yo dge 'gyung / mjed la bya la ba gtsang rab gsal/ stod lung pa dmar ston shākya mu ni dang gsum/ dpal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa /sngon gyi sgom grwa/bcu gnyis rgyal pos btab pa'i nang tshan der sgom la bzhugs pa'i tshe btsun pa khyi 'khrid cing rnga bshang rdung pa/ mgo la bya rgod kyi sgro btsug pa/ ri dwags la mda' 'phen pa mthong nas/ ban rgan 'phrul lam btsun pa smyo zer/ de las glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa go bas 'dul mngon gyi dpe cha dre'u rgyab gnyis bkal te hor yul du byon/ der chos la 'god ma nus/ rgyal po glang dar bsad pa'i gtam thos/ hor yul nas hor gyi dge gnyen shākya shes rab bya ba gcig dang sdebs/ khams su phebs nas an chung gnam rdzong gi brag phug bzung nas bzhugs/ gtsang rab gsal gyis khang pa gsar ma ri'i phug gi dgon pa bzung / ka 'od mchog grags pas bal yul nas tshur 'ong ba'i lam — 153—

du gtam thos te mngon pa dre'u rgyab gcig bkal nas bros te dpal bzang mkhar chags/ dril bu'i dgon pa bzung / lha lung dbyangs rab 'byor dang rong ston seng ge grags gnyis kyis yer pa'i brag nas 'dul mngon gnyis kyi dpe mang du 'khyer nas nags shod la bros/ lha lung dbyangs rab 'byor gyis zla shod cha rong gi dgon pa bzung / rong ston seng ge brag gis byang tsha bye rong gi dgon nga/ bzung ste bzhugs so/ /mi drug car mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i mkhan bu dngos rang yin nga/sa/ sba rat+na 'am sba gsal snang ngam/ dab 'as ye shes dbang po bsrung gi mkhan bu dngos yin pas na/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho nas brgyud do/ /lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shrī la/ dzi nā mi 'dzispru mkhan po dngos yin zhing / bod du 'gyur ba'i chos thams cad kyi lung yang yod pas/brgyud chul so so ba yin no/ /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal yang khams su 'khrungs zer zhing / bon po'i bu dmu zu gsal 'bar zhes bya ba ra lug 'tsho bas slob dpon de gsum mthong nas dad pa skyes nas chos zhus pas/ 'dus pa 'od ldan btad nas 'di la ltos/ dad na rab tu sbyin gsungs nas bltas pas dad pa thob nas rab tu byung ba'i lo rgyus dang bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i mkhan po gcang / slob dpon g.yo/gsang ston dmar/ kha skong ha shang gnyis sogs yin pa'i ngag brgyud g.yam rgyugs su 'chad pa mang ste shin tu ma dag pa ste bla chen 'phan yul gzhong nga/ ru dmu zu gsal 'bar zhes bya ba'i bon po gcig gi sras dmu zu dge 'bar zhes su 'khrungs/ lo bcu drug lon nas snang gsal lha khang du phyin nas/ rab byung — 154—

chos 'chad pa dang nyan pa'i gzugs gyang ris la 'dug pa mthong nas 'di ci yin dris pas/ rgas mo gcig na re/ rab tu byung ba'i gzugs yin zer/ las 'phro'i stobs kyis dad gus skyes te/ 'di 'dra ba gang na yod dris pas/ rgas mo de na re/ gzhan ni khungs ma thob/ chu bo ri nas bros pa'i dmar g.yo gtsang gsum ni nges par 'dug zer ro/ /de'i tshe las 'phro sad de chos min pa yid la mi dran pa'i dad pa skyes/ mdo smad du 'tshol du byon te/ lam du bon po gcig gi sar bsdad nas gtam dris pas/ de kun an chung gi gnam rdzong brag phug na yod/ 'di yang chos su 'dug gi 'byer ram zer nas/ 'dul ba 'od ldan gyis pu ti gcig spyin/ lam bar la blta yi byon pas dad pa'i shugs drag po rang 'khrungs su skyes/ an chung du byon te dbus pa mi drug dang ha shang gnyis te brgyad po 'tshogs nas/ lha lung dbyangs rab 'byor gyis mkhan po byas/ rong ston seng ge grags kyis slob dpon dang gtsang rab gsal gyis las slob byas/gzhan ma rnams kyi dad pa'i dge 'dun mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas thos pa mdzad tshul ni mkhan po la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi/ kwa la rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sde lnga/ dmar g.yo gnyis la 'dul ba mdo man chod kyis phran tshegs/ rong ston la sdom rnam gnyis/ mdzod dbu ma/ gtsang la pra ka ra ṇa brgyad sde brgyad sogs thos pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgya dang bod kyi mtshams ri bo dan tig dgon par sgom sgrub mdzad/ yul phyogs de'i mi skrun bdun thog rdibs nas shi ba btsan du skyes/ longs spyod chen po yod pa'i grib btsan skrun — /55—

bdun gyis yon bdag byas nas yo byad sbyar/ dbus nas sring mos g.yog byas/ sgom pas mngon shes la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi yon tan mang du thob ste/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal zhes grags/de nas byon te zog po mi drug gis sna blangs nas zhabs tog byas nas chos btsugs te yig cha phal cher las sog pa mi drug zer ba yod kyang / zog po mi drug zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni dmar g.yo gtsang la rab tu spyin par zhus pas/dge 'dun ma 'tshogs pa de'i bar du gzugs btsun du byas pas zog po mi drug par grags la/ bla chen po der byon skabs dge 'dun 'tshogs te rab tu 'byin par zhus pas/ mkhan slob kun na re/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/glang po smyon pa'i sna la ral gri btags nas sems can gsod du bcug pa ni bla'i / rab tu byung nas ma bskyangs pa ni de ltar ma yin no/ /zhes bka' bstsal to/ /nged rgas pas mkhan bu mi skyong / khyed kyis gyis shig gsungs/ ngas bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mi 'ong zhus pas/ de la nyes byas shig 'ong ste/ sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba'i dgos pa che ba la gnang gis ci yang gyis gsungs nas khas blangs te bla chen pos mkhan po mdzad/ gtsang gis slob dpon mdzad/ gzhan rnams kyis dad pa'i dge 'dun byas nas rab tu byung nas/ sngar zog po mi drug po de phyis mkhas btsun mi drug tu grags so/ /drug po ni 'al snubs gnyis/ spang cog gnyis/ shong 'bar gnyis te drug go /de yang 'al rdo dbang phyug dang / snubs dpal gyi dbang phyug gnyis mkhas pa'o/ /spang gong ye shes g.yung drung dang / cog ro shes rab byang chub —156—

gnyis mkhas btsun 'dzoms pa'o/ /shong chung ba shes rab grags dang / an 'bar ba byang chub gnyis btsun pa'o/ /gzhan yang sgro mañju shrī la sogs pa shin tu mang ba la bka' drin nos so/ /mdo smad du bstan pa'i me ro bslangs nas shin tu rgyas par gyur te/de'i tshe spang gong ye shes g.yung drung gis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan rab tu phyung ste mkhas slob kyi grwa btsugs nas btsun pa'i phul du phyin te/ grub ā tsar+ya ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes grags la/ mkhan bu rnams la'ang btsun brgyud du grags so/ /snubs dpal gyi dbang phyug dang an 'bar ba byang chub kyis mkhan slob kyi grwa logs su bzung ste bskyangs pas phan chung bar grags kyang / slob ma rnams la mkhas brgyud du grags so/ /de yan du lcags mo bya'i lo la chos bsnubs/ sa mo bya'i lo la bstan pa'i me ro bslangs pa yan chad la lo brgya dang dgu dbus gtsang ru bzhi na dge slong gi ming med do/ /rgyal rabs kha shas dang lo rgyus phal che ba las dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu'am drug gis khams la byon/ bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal la mkhan po zhus nas sdom pa blangs so zhes pa sogs dang / 'dul ba'i mkhan brgyud la'ang de bzhin gsungs pa mang zhing grags che ba yang / khungs su mi btub pa'i ngag brgyud g.yam rgyugs su 'chad pa dar ba ni shin tu nor zhing 'khrul pa ma dag pa ste/ shin tu dag pa klu mes chen pos brtsams chos las byung ba ltar dris pa ni/dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu gnyis yin ste/ ji ltar yin zhes na snga — 157—

ma bdun dang phyi ma lnga ste bcu gnyis so/ /snga ma bdun ni klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ 'bring ye shes yon to/ tshong khe shes rab seng ge /lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug /sum pa ye shes blo gros/ rgya blo gros shes rab/ gzhon ban chos mchog bcas dang bdun gyis grum ā tsu rla ye shes rgyal mtshan la mkhan po zhus/cog ro shes rab byang chub la slob dpon zhus nas bka' drin nos te/ snga ma lnga dge slong du byas/ phyi ma gnyis dge bsnyen du byas so/ /de'i 'og tu dpyis phyin nga/ lnga ni mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags/ rag shi chul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba bcun blo gros dbang phyug skye bo myang 'ban chos skyabs/grub shes rab smon lam mo/ /de yang sngon ma rnams kyis dbus gtsang la yar byon pa dang / phyis ma rnams mar bzhud pa lam du 'phrad de gar 'gro dris pas//mdo smad du sdom pa len du 'gro zer/ thag shin tu ring bar 'dug pas rtol ba dka'/ nged kyis bslab pa de legs par blangs nas yod/ nged kyis phog nga/sa chog yar la log dengs byas pas ma nyan/ 'o na nged kyi mkhan po longs thagamakhas btsun 'dzoms pa yin no zhes smras pa/sa/ khong rnam/sa kyis kyang de ba 'an byas te grum ye shes rgyal mchan la bka' drin nos te/ de yang sba rag mtha' bzhi gsum gyis dge slong byas/ myang grum gnyis kyis dge bsnyen byas so/ /grum gyis phyis bsnyen par rdzogs kyang sgom sgrub la brtson par byas te sde ma/ 'phel lo/ /de bas cung snga ba na gzhung pa chos skyabs/ rgya ston seng ge skal smon 'bar gyis kyang phyin te sdom pa bslangs shing thos bsam byas kyang sgom sgrub la brtson pas sde ma 'phel lo/ /thams cad kyi 'og rol du rma chos kyi byang — /58—

chub ces bya bas khams su thug ste/ yar byon pa la skyid shod kyi rma mtsho'i sde rnams byung ba yin no/ /snga tshar rnams yar byon pa'i tshe mkhan slob gnyis kyi zhal nas/ khyed lngas dbus su sde tshugs/ klu mes rgyud bzang khyod kyis mkhan po gyis gsungs nas rnam sbyar yang gnang / tshong khe blo rno khyod kyis sde snod shod /lo ston chos skyong chags pas bstan pa srungs / 'bring pho sgo zab cing bzang pa khyod kyis gnas brtan gyis/ sum pa sgo zhan pas klu mes kyi nye gnas gyis gsungs nas yar byon te/ mor dger lo gcig stabs su bzhugs/ de nas mkhan slob kyi gsung bzhin so sor gyes pas/ gtsang du lo tshong gnyis/ dbus su klu 'bring gnyis byung ba yin no/ /spa rag gnyis kyang yar byon te sdebs nas sde btsugs pa yin no/ /de ltar skyes bu stobs (can)dbus gtsang gi mi drug ces yongs su grags pa yin no/ /de yang gtsang pa gnyis gtsang du song / tshong khes myang smad du khrid dang bya rgyud gnyis bzung / de nas myang stod khu le dang /nying ro dang / rgyang ro/ 'gos yul stod gsum la sogs par rgya po dang grang chung la sde pa mang du byas/ de'i slob ma rnam gnyis dang bcas rong gi ngur smig dang /tshe dmar dang sku thang la yag tshun chad du dge 'dun gyi sde dang gnas gzhi bzhi bcu'i rmang nyi ma gcig la bting / de sogs mang bar rgyas shing gyes te tshong tsho'i sde zhes grags so/ /lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis myang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang gi gzhi bting pas/ dkar mo mched bzhis spyan phor chung cam re byas te dngos su byon nas/ mthu stobs kyi rgya ma chung zhig nged kyis grogs byas la sangs rgyas kyi — /59—

bstan pa shing skam la me mched pa bzhin du btang ngo zhes gsungs/ de nas lo ston gyis gnas gzhi'i rgya bskyed pas nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/ mi chen po'i rgyal ba 'di ni/ shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa spyan chen po zhes bya ba'i sprul pa yin pas khyod kyi ma bkol yang grogs bya'o/ /zhes grags so/ /de la mkhan bu mi brgyad byung ste/ sum ston 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ lce ston shes rab byung gnas/ glang ston byams pa/ gzhu ston gzhon nu brtson 'grus/ rgya shākya ban khyu/ rdar ston shākya blo gros/ skyo ston shes rab rdo rje/ kyi ā sto rla ye shes dbang po/ de la sum ston rgyan gong gi dpon du bskos/ lce ston gyis zhwa lu'i dpon byas/ rgyan gong 'di lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis gtso bor mdzad/ nye gnas lce btsun shes rab 'gyung gnas kyis bzhengs pa'i zhabs tog mdzad nas/ bstan pa phyi dar gyis 'go me (sa ka mo bya lo la 'gram bting rjes rgyan gong gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs pa'i mthil lan lce btsun gyis mdzad pa sogs slob dpon gnyis kyis rgyan gong gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par bzhengs so/ /glang ston byams pas khro phug dang 'om phug mo btab/ gzhu ston gzhon nu brtson 'grus kyis chu mig ring mo bzung nas 'phrang brag dmar po sogs btab/ gzhu tsho zhes su grags so/ /rgya ston shākya ban rnyes grom pa rgyang gi mkhan po byas pas/ stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ leng la sogs pa mkhan bu mang du byung ngo / /stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus kyis la stod sems tsher bzung ste gnas gzhi mang du btab pa las la stod stag tsho'i sde —160—

pa rnams byung ngo / /kyi ā tsār+ya ye shes dbang pos myang smad khris su gnas gzhi bzung ste/ de las gyes pas myang ro dang lhan la sogs pa'i tsho rnams byung /lo rgyus 'ga' zhig las lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong brtsigs/ de la mkhan po nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ste/ rgya shākya gzhon nus la stod dmar la thang brtsigs/ de la 'bri mtshams kyi bul tog lha khang sogs mched pa la rgya tsho zer/ skyos shes rab rdo rjes don mo ri brtsigs/ stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus kyis stag lo khang brtsigs/ de nas mched par stag tsho zer/ a mes zhu gcig mas 'phrang dang brag dmar bzung / de nas mched pa la zhu tsho zer/ 'dar shākya yon to gyis gzus po bzung / de nas mched pa la 'da' tsho zer/ li blo gros gzhon nus jo mo brtsigs/ de nas mched pa la mi tsho zer/glag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chu mig brtsigs/ de nas mched pa la glag tsho zer/ chag pa'i dga' shes rab bla mas bsnyems brtsigs/ rngeg ye shes 'byung gnas kyis spang dkar lha lung brtsigs/ glag btsun byams pas 'om phug brtsigs/ de nas gtsang 'gram bzung / de nas bum thang / chag pa/ tri gong /'gos ston khrom ma la sogs pa la glang tsho stod smad zer ro/ /mgo pa g.yung drung gis 'dre lha khang bzung / des zhwa lu yang bzung / de nas ka bzhi gdung drug/de nas mched pa la zhwa lu brgya skor zer/ kyi ye shes dbang pos shangs kyi mkhar lung brtsigs/ de nas gyo re glang ra brtsigs/ glang ra nas mched pa la glang ra skor zer/ nyug gi u lung nas gyes pa la u tsho zer/ de gnyis la kyi tsho smad pa zer ro/ /de nas a me'i mkhan bu zhang ston tshul 'bar gyis bya rgyud —161—

bzung sogs/ lo ston gyi slob brgyud dngos nas so sor gyes pa'i 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i snying khu'i sde tsho shin tu mang ba gyes tshul yo da kyang yi ge ma/nga bas 'jigs nas ma bkod do/ /rgyan gong du rje btsun sa paṇa (sa paṇa rnam thar bskal nga/ bzang po'i legs lam las/ mu tig 'og chags gangs kyi ri/ /'phreng ldan nor 'jin yangs nga/'i rgyan/ /gong dang bla na med pa yin/ /bkra shis gcug lag khang chen por/ /rnam/ 'dren ston nga/ nyid dang de'i / /bstan pa gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can/ /bco brgyad grangs kyi zol de las/ /snying po'i char yang yod smra'i sde//bstan mkhas gnyis ldan ma/khan chos kyi rje/) yi mkhan po kha che paṇa chen/ slob dpon spyi po lhas pa byang chub 'od sogs kyis mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ dbus bsil ba'i rdo gzhong dang bcas khro yod/ byang (byang chub dpal/) rdor (rdo rje dpal)rnam gnyis gcag gas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / gcig gis thog mar mjal ba yang rgyan gong 'dir yin no/ /zhwa lu'i sa phyogs 'di nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sku'i rnam pa lhun gyis grub pa ste/ byang phyogs ri pad ma'i 'dab ma ltar snang ba/ myang chu sngon mo zla ba chu shel gdan dang grub pa/ tshong 'dus rin po che'i gling / gsang gnas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rten 'brel dang ldan pa/ byang chub dge gnas kyi lte ba rtsa 'dab 'khor lo'i dbyibs su gnas pa/ paṇa chen lo paṇa grub thob du mas theg pa che chung gi chos kyi 'a/bor lo bskor ba'i ltas dang ldan pa dpal zhwa lu gser khang 'di thugs ka chos kyi pho brang rang byon du gnas phyir/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku rang byon dngos su bzhugs shing / 'gro ba rnams kyi srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' — 162—

dag sbyongs shing / mngon mtho nges legs bden 'bras mtha' dag 'bad med du bskrun pa/ shar nub kyis 'dzin phyag zhabs kyi dbyings su gnas pa/ lho phyogs ri bo dbu'i gtsug gi rnam par grub pas/ grub thob pho mo dpag tu med pa'i sems can gyi don ma lus pa 'grub pa'i rgyal mtshan khor yug tu 'jug pa/sa phyogs rnams kyang grog sbur la sogs pa'i srog chags phra mo nyung zhing skye bo thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyi rgyud dul ba/ phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /de'ang mkhan brgyud dang dbon brgyud grags pa can byon pa'i rtags su/byang phyogs kyi chu klung 'di g.yu 'brug sngon mo mkha' la 'phyo ba 'dra zhing rgyun mi 'chad par babs pa/ mkhas grub dge ba'i bzhas gnyen bstan pa 'dzin pa'i srog shing du gyur pa 'byung ba'i mtshan mar lho phyogs kyi ri gser gyi gdugs phub pa 'dra ba/ srid zhi'i rgud pa sel zhing mngon mtho nges legs dang / 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub pa'i ltas la/ shar phyogs kyi ri lhun po rin po che 'bar ba'i dbyibs su gnas pa las nyams dang rtogs pa rgyun mi chad pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ nub phyogs kyi sa 'dzin pad ma rā ga'i gzhong pa lta bu/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang /'dod dgu lhun gyis grub pa'i ltas la lo paṇa grub thob du ma'i sku gdung ring bsrel bsdu ba'i sa la legs par bltams pa'i chos sku'i rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan yang sgom pa ngan par mi byung zhing / zhi ba'i las grub pa'i rtags —163—

su shar phyogs kyi ri glang po che nyal ba 'dra ba lta ba ngan pa mi 'byung zhing / rgyas pa'i las grub pa'i mtshan par lho phyogs kyi sa 'dzin gdugs kyi dbang po 'phyo ba 'dra zhing / sa phyogs gser gyi mdog tu snang ba/ bshad sgrub las mi g.yel zhing / dbang gis las 'grub pa'i ltas la/ nub phyogs kyi ri nam mkha' la bsnyegs pa 'dra zhing / byu dra'i phung po sbungs pa dang 'dra ba/ gsang sngags kyi snod dang ldan zhing / drag po'i las 'grub pa'i rtags su/ byang gi grog po rdo rje btsun mo'i chos 'byung gi dbyibs su gnas pa/ nang gso zhing bcud len grub pa'i phyir/ sman chung dang cung zhi rtswa rtag tu ngu dang sman dang / rdzas kyi bye brag du ma skye ba/ gzhan yang sa phyogs dar dang rin po che/ gser dngul/ zangs mtshal spang mthing la sogs pa'i gser kha du ma lhun grub tu gnas pa/ phongs pa rnams kyis dbul ba sel zhing 'byor pa'i dpal la spyod pa/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sa gzhi dang ri bo rnams kyang rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi dbyibs su gnas pa/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma lus pas gang zhing / mkhas grub du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal zhwa lu gser khang 'di ni/ lo ston gyi nye gnas lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis lo ston la bdag gis mda' rnyobs par gnas gzhi zhwa lu tsam gcig brtsigs par zhu zhus pas/ de bzhin gyis gsungs nas/ phyag mda' gser gyis bkang nas phul bas/ lo ston gyi phyag mda' bsir bsir lan gsum mdzad nas/ lce btsun shes rab che gsungs nas 'phangs pas da lta btsan khang rnying ma'i mda' 'bum zhes grags pa 'di yin/ de nas lce btsun rang gis zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtse nub —1yo—

ma gnyis kyi lho byang gnyis/ shar ma'i yum chen mo'i steng man dang 'og da lta mgon khang byas pa 'di de dus bzhengs so/ /rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i spyi ste gu ru bzhengs/ da lta rang byon bzhugs pa'i lho phyogs na zhal byang gzigs na bzhugs pa de bzhengs nas gsol ba btab pas/ de'i zhal nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan na jo bo kha sar pā ṇi de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad khyad par 'phags pa zhig 'byon par 'dug pa'i gdan drongs cigasungs pas der lce btsun gyis gdan 'dren pa'i 'dun pa mdzad/ don gnyis pa bod kyi sdom pa 'di ma dag par shes nas/ zhwa lu dge 'dun chos sde dang bcas 'go ba ye shes g.yung drung la gtad/ de dus zhwa lu pa la ka bzhi gdung brgyad byung zer/ de nas lce btsun gyis rgya gar rdo rje gdan la byon/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po slob dpon a bha ya ka ra la sdom pa blangs/ chos mang po zhus/ spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi sbyan drangs pas/ rgya gar gyi lha bsrung rnams ma dga' nas/ chu bo gang gā la spyan ma 'drongs/ der lce btsun gyis dkon mchog la zhag gsum gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab pas/ mon pa'i mi tha mal pas nyis 'gyur bas che ba gcig byung nas rnal 'byor pa khyod sku 'di gar spyan drangs pa yin zer/ bod na zhwa lu zer ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig yod de ru spyan 'dren pa yin byas pas/ 'o na ngas 'bur gyis gla bya'am zer/ bod kyi zhwa lu tshun bskyal gla ji tsam dgos pa ster gsungs nas spyan drangs te/ zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gyi gtso bo la bzhugs te da lta rang byon gyi sku rgyab na bzhugs pa yin no/ /spyan 'dren mkhan gyi mi rang bzhin min par yal (mgon —165—

po beng gi sprul pa'o/) song / rten ngo mtshar che bar grags so/ /de nas jo bo chen po rje dpal ldan a ti sha zhor la spyan drangs nas zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang la rab gnas zhus pas rab gnas legs/ khyad par yum chen mo'i spyan la rab gnas chags te bkra shis so/ /de dus jo bo'i zhal nas jo bo thugs rje chen po la yi dam byed pa su yod gsungs pas/ lce bcun gyi bdag bdog lags zhus pas/ 'o na chu bo sin ju' 'gram nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rang byon gcig byon par gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de dus zhwa lu pa che ba rnam pa bzhi zer ba yod de/ las ka bzhi yin pas che/ yon bdag btsad po yod pas che/ sdom pa rgyal ba ra ma yin pas che/ rus pa lce yin pas che/ khrom gzher 'dong khri nas lce dkar nag gnyis su gyes so/ /'od gsal gyi lha nas (gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi sdeng nas 'brug lta bu'i lce dang sa mer gyi zhu ba lta bu'i btsun mo bshos pa'i sras la lha gan rtse rgyal po byung / des gdung rgyud 'a lce'i ming thob/lha gan rtse rgyal po dang klu gza' btsun mo bshos pa'i sras la lte nyi zer 'phrul gyi rgyal jo/ byung / de las sras bdun gyis thang chu shel gyi skas las babs te/ stag gzig gi yul dang / de nas hor/de nas rgya yul/ de nas yar rim 'khyud kyis yar lung du phebs so/) babs shing / bod yul du'ang rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon (lce dbang chen mos mdzad/ ) bgyis nas bstan 'gro la phan pa rgya chen po byas/ de'i rjes su (sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba lce khyi 'brug dang lce lo cwa ba dz+nyā na sa dha sogs kyis sher phyin sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyur cing sgra'i gnas brgyad la sogs pa brtsams/ lo cwa ba lce khyi 'brug gis sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dang rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang sad na legs gnyis kyi nang blon mdzad do/ /gzhan — /66—

yang lte blo ldan seng ge dang / lce mdo sde pa seng ge la sogs rnal 'byor gyi bka' srol 'dzin pa mang du byon/ lce lo tsā ba dga' ba'i dpal dang / lce lo tsā ba klu mes dang / lce lo tsā ba bkra shis brtsegs dpal sogs/) lo tsā ba mchog tu gyur pa dang / blon po'i tshul bzung nas phan pa rgya chen po mdzad pa de'i rigs rgyud la byon pa/ lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i rjes su lce btsun gyi pha yul 'bum gyi jo jo stag gi rgyal mtshan gyi bu g.yu thog sgra gser bzang bya ba/ lce btsun la mjal du byung bas/ btsun par bcug /nye gnas bcol/ gcung po shes rab ye shes kyi rjes su zhwa lu'i gdan sa yang g.yu thog sgra gser bzang gis byas/ g.yu thog sgra gser bzang bslab pa 'chal nas dpon rgyud du song /gdan sa khyung po grags seng la gtad/ khong rang gis dpon byas te mnga' ris bskyangs/ khyung la g.yu thog sgras gnas 'di la lcags ri gcig gtong byas pas 'thad pa'i gyis gsungs/ nang du khron pa gcig 'dru byas pas 'thad gsungs/ de gnyis tshar ba dang / g.yu thog sgra gser bzang gi dus su g.yas su bye ma g.yu zur/ sa zhing sngo zhing yid du 'ong ba/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon 'byon pa'i gnas byang skyob pa/ lho gzhol pa/ mdun na ne'u gsing la me tog dpag tu med pa 'khrungs pa/ bya sna tshogs snyan pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ ri dwags sna tshogs dga' ba'i gar byed pa der rang byon gyi jo bo 'di nyid dbu myug ge bzhugs 'dug pa la/ dge bsnyen rdo rje 'bum zhes pa des ra lug 'tshor phyin pa da nga /sprul pa'i ra ma g.yu'i og 'dzar nyil le byas pa gcig yod pa des g.yas phyogs su skor ba byed kyin 'o ma'i khrus gsol ba de mthong nas dge gnyen dad — 167—

pa mtshungs med skyes te/ g.yas su gtsang 'gram du spyan drangs pas byon nas gtsang 'gram du bzhugs/ de dus zhwa lu pa'i slob dpon brtson 'grus zhes pa des mtshams sbyar nas zhwa lu bas chos bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gtsang 'gram pa la sprad/ jo bo rang byon zhwa lu ri phug tu spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol ba la/ de dus chu zhal 'khrug pa'i 'ur shod yod pas chu mig pa rnams kyis jo bo nyid brkus te phyin pas/ jo mo ri phug mas jag 'ching brgyab nas gar yang bgrod ma thub/ rkun ma rnams kyis bcag pas kyang ma chag pa/ mi 'jigs pa rdo rje'i skur byin gyis brlabs nas khur kyang ma theg /bcag kyang ma chag pa 'dug /de dus rgya gar ba dang bal po dbus gtsang ba rnams yon bdag tu dga'/ khyad par bal po rnams yon bdag bzang / bal po rnams kyis rgyan ri dang zhal ri nor gyi dgos nas zhal ri'i mda' ru mchod rten bzhengs pa deng sang yang bal po mchod rten du grags pa rgyan gong gi nub stod na bzhugs so/ /de nas zhwa lu pa dang ri phug pa bka' bgros te/ jo bo 'di zhwa lur 'gro don che ba yod snyam nas jo bo zhwa lur spyan drangs te/ yang jo bo nyid gtsang khang du bzhugs su gsol snyam pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas nga mas 'phang na bu sdod pa bzhin yin zhes gsung byon nas/ snga sor rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi de'i sku pang na bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /'dir 'e ti'i thugs dam rten gyi thugs rje chen po yang bzhugs/ zhwa lu'i gtsang khang nub ma gnyis kyi lho'i rten gyi gtso bo la bzhugs so/ /de nas g.yu thog sgra gser bzang gi sras lce 'bum/ de'i sras lce 'bum me dang / 'bum dar gnyis —168—

'angs so/ /de na zhwa lu khri skor gyi ming ni med/ mnga' ris ni khri skor tsam yod/zhwa lu pa'i ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ byang du seng ge ral pa can dang dgu / lcam bdun cu tham pa zhes grags/ ka ba bzhi ni sga gdong dam pa chos kyi ka ba/ sku ri ja skyus kha drag dpung pa'i ka ba/ g.yus sgyu ma nor gyis ka ba/ ne ser thu'i ka ba ste ka ba bzhi'o/ /gdung ma brgyad ni shar du kyi gru sha byar tshal/ lhor 'ar mug pa/ 'bri mtshams nub tu ldog /za rkang sbo byang du mnyal rje 'bangs/ cog ro paṇa no/ /byang gi seng ge ral pa can ni 'u yug gos sngon can gyi lung pa yin/ a mes 'bum dar la sras a mes 'bum bstan sku mched gnyis/ a mes 'bum bstan gyi jo mo mnyal ma brel chung khab tu bzhes pa la sras a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes dang shākya blo gros 'khrungs/ lce a mes 'bum mes la sras a mes dge 'dun bzang po 'khrungs pa yin/ a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dus su chu zhal 'khrugs skabs gtsang khang gi rta mgrin 'dis thengs gsum bton nas chu mig pa pham ste a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi jo mo tsha tsha btsun ne khab tu bzhes pa la sras sku zhang rnga sgra/ sku zhang mgon po dpal/sku zhang kun dga' 'bum sde sku mched gsum/ sras mo ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ jo jo stag 'bum/ jo jo ye shes 'bum sde sras mo gsum/ kun dril lcam sring drug 'khrungs so/ /lce a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sras mo ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ 'gro mgon phyag na'i jo mor phebs/ sras dharma pha la —169—

rak+ṣa ta/ de'i btsun mo ma gcig 'bum gyi sring mo jo bo stag 'bum sbyan drangs/de'i sras ran+ta pha la 'arak+ṣa ta'o/ /sa skya pa dang sku gnyen du 'brel chun/ lce'i gdung rnams la chen po dang sku zhang gi ming thob bo/ /a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sku che'i smad la se chen rgyal po'i smon gro stong skor snar/ gdung brgyud thams cad kyi rtsa ba sku zhang yin pas sku zhang rnga sgra ru snang / sku zhang mgon ngo/ dpal la zhwa lu khri skor lha sde mi sde gnang ngo / /a mes chen po sangs rgyas kyi dus mkhas pa chen po dbus ston seng ge 'od zhwa lu'i mkhan por bskos/ ran+ta pha la sku na phra mo la grongs/ de'i spur sbyangs nas ring bsrel phung po ('ba' zhig tu song 'dug nas bla ma bgres po rnams la ring bsrel 'byon dka' nas bu chung 'di la ring bsrel phung po/) 'byon pa ya mchan che/ sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud yin pa tsam gyis bzang 'dug pas brgyud pa nas brgyud par bcas pa gong ma'i bla ma 'chol pa yin pas bdag nyid chen po smon ce yul hor nam zhing du sprugs pa gdan drangs/ bod du byon nas jo mo bdun longs la rgyud pa spel gsungs pas lung dang 'jags sa mjad/ rgyud pa spel bas deng sang gi bar du rgyal po'i bla ma pa'i bdag por yod pa/ zhwa lu pa yum sras kyi drin yin no/ /sku zhang rnga sgra'i rjes la zha lu'i dpon sku zhang mgon po dpal gyis byas/blo 'bur byang ma sgo gsum ma bzhengs/ sgo gsum ma'i nang du khong rang gi yab a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi nang rten la thub pa chen po'i gser sku khri rgyab dang bcas pa na bza' gos chen dmar smug gi chos gos gru 'dzar rnams — /70—

mu tig gis byas pa dang / gsung rab rgyas 'bring bsdus rnams bzhengs so/ /zhwa lu'i mkhan rgyud ni lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas gcung po shes rab ye shes khu bo g.yu thog sgra gser bzang / khyung po grags seng gis mkhan po mngon pa ba la gdan sa gtad mngon pa bas zhwa lu da rdzog thon brtson pa la gdan sa gtad/ de rjes wa chos byang pa yod/ a mes chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dus su mkhas pa chen po bu ston seng ge 'od yod/ chu mig chu skor gyi dus su mkhas pa chen po gcig la gral byin pa la bu ston seng ge 'od/ chos rje 'jam gsar/ shangs pa kun mkhyen/ mkhas pa bsod rgyal rnams yin/ bu ston seng ge 'od kyis rjes su mkhan po 'dul 'dzin pa/ mkhan po grags gzhon pa/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen/ (dgung lo so gcig la zhwa lu'i gdan sar phebs nas mkhan po lo so bdun mjad/)thugs sras lo tsā rin chen rnam rgyal/ (mkhan po lo gsum mdzad/) 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ (mkhan po lo nga gnyis mdzad/)mkhas grub sangs rgyas dpal rin pa/ (lo brgyad/)'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal ba/ (lo nyi shu rtsa bdun/)kun mkhyen chos kun dpal bzang / (lo bcu bdun) chos rje bshes gnyen bzang po rgyal mtshan (lo bcu gcig)chos rje rin po che rig 'dzin/ chos kyi rgyal po sku zhang rnga sgra la/ sras sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan sku 'khru/ngas/ sku zhang mgon po dpal la sras sku zhang rdo rje dbang phyug ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum/ ma gcig nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ jo bo rdo rje 'bum/ jo jo btsun ma sde lcam sring lnga 'khrungs/ ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum gyi bla ma bdag nyid che mo'i jo mo mdzad/de la sras tā dben gu shrī kun dga' nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal —171 —

mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa chos kyi mnga' bdag chen po rnam pa gsum sku 'khrungs so/ /ma gcig nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan gyis shar pa'i jo mo mdzad de sras bla ma rin chen rgyal mtshan lcam sring gsum 'khrungs so/ /jo mo rdo rje 'bum gyis tshal ba smon lam dang / du dben sha bde rgyal 'od jo mo mdzad/ sras si tu kun dga' rdo rje/ (tshal pa'i deb dmar du grags pa de mdzad mkhan/)dang / dus dben sha mgon po 'phel byung / sku zhang mgon po dpal gyi rjes su sku zhang rdo rje dbang phyug ni lo gsum na zhwa lu'i dbon mdzad gong nas kyang zhwa lu khri skor yab bzhi 'jag pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / rdo rje dbang phyug gi rjes su/ /sngon bsags bsod nams chu gter las byung zhing / /dpal 'byor snyan par grags pa'i 'od stong ldan/ /rgyal srid rgyal mtshan gling bzhir gsal mdzad pa/ /bstan la rab dad spyin bdag ces bu ston rin po ches gsungs pa ltar rnam sras kyi sprul pa sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis zhwa lu'i dpon mdzad/ tshal pa'i sras mo dpon mo 'dzoms/ 'bum dpal shi jo mor bzhes/ mtshan brgyud la mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / grags gzhe ne pa yod/ sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rgya yul la byon/ ol ja du rgyal po'i phyag nas shel gyi 'on rtse rma bya ma gsol chang gis bkang nas gnang / khyod gdud rgyud kyi zhang por 'dug pas nged kyis kyang zhang po yin du chugs gsungs nas gnang / dbus gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum gyi bdag po hu shrī du dben shas mdzad/ stag mgo nor bu gnyis pa bzung pa'i khrims kyi bdag po mdzad —172—

cing kun yar chad/ gong mas zhwa lu khri skor gyi lha sde mi sde thams cad bdag par byas pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i glo 'bur lho'i bse sgo ma dang / shar gyi sgo khang la mgon khang byas/ da lta byang ngos kyi sgo rgyud lam chen mo 'di bton/ lho dmag sde dang bcas pa'i shing 'dren byas/ shing tshan chen po drangs/ shar rgya hor gyi yul nas bzo bo mkhas pa bos/ rgya phibs g.yu chu can gser gyi gan dzi ra btsugs pa che ba bzhi/ zur gyi glo 'bur bzhi la g.yu chu'i ba gam dang / rgyan la gser gyi gan dzi ras brgyan pa/ gser khang rgya phibs gsum brtsegs su yod pa/ gzhan rnams rgya phigs gnyis brtsegs pa med la/ nang na tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis spras pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ khyad par bse sgo ma na dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / gser las bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur brgyad stong brgya rtsa brgyad/ gtsug lag khang nub ma gnyis na/ gcig gi gtso bo la rang byon 'phags pa/ gcig gi gtso bo la rnam snang / lho'i gtso bo la dus gsum sangs rgyas/ byang gi gtso bo la thub pa chen po/ shar gyi gtso bo yum chen mo/ de'i 'og na rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi mgon khang dang bcas pa la 'khor grangs kyis mi chod pas bskor ba rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa dang / rwa ba bzhi la mchod pa chen po bzhi btsugs/ sngon gyi chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi rnam thar kyang da dung yang nga'i gtsug lag khang 'di dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu zhig snying la 'dod/ dge bshes du ma tshogs pa zhig snying la 'dod/ de la las spyan gyi tshogs dpon shin tu bzang ba gcig grags sam bsam par sbyin bdag chen po'i lhag bsam rnam tsā—173—

dag gi nus pa la brten te lha lung bstan pa la/bu ston chos rje lo tsā nyid de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /dge legs yon tan kun gyi rin chen gter/ /'gro tshogs sdug bsngal skyob pa'i gnyen gcig po/ /mkhas grub bu ston chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ma byon bskal bzang bdun pa chos kyi rje/ kun mkhyen skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje can/ /'gro kun bu bzhin skyong ba'i rtsa lag mchog /ston pa'i rgyal tshab bla ma bu ston mchog /gang gis mkhyen pa'i me dpung gis/ /ltas ngan tshang tshing kun bsreg cing / /'gro kun snying gi mun 'joms pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig tshogs gnyis shing rtas legs drangs shing / /mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas phrin las bzang / /'od zer dpa/ga med 'phrog pas 'gro blo yi/ /mun pa rab 'joms bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dpag med bskal par tshogs gnyis rab sbyangs pas/ /sku gsum 'bras bu rin chen mngon du mdzad/ /phrin las rnam bzhi rtag par legs grub pa'i/ /chos rje bu ston 'o/ tswa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rig gnas ma lus mngon du mthar phyin yang / /slob pa'i tshul bzung sgra tshad bzo dang gso/ /khyad par nang rig don la sbyangs pa mdzad/ /mnga' ris paṇa chen kun mkhyen de la 'dud/ /spang bya gzhi bcas spangs nas ring du lon/ /bslab bya ma lus bslab pa mthar phyin yang / /bstan pa bzung phyir so thar snga phyi'i tshig /bzung nas rjes su skyong mdzad de la 'dud/ /sngon nas sgo gsum dri ma kun spangs shing / /sa lam 'bras bu ma lus mthar phyin yang / /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams legs bsten nas/ /rgyud lung dbang rnams rdzogs mdzad — 174—

de la 'dud/ /bu ston rin po che de sngags mtshan nyid la sbyangs stobs/ slob ma la sdom pa phog tshul/ slob ma mkhas btsun nyan bshad 'pher ba thon lugs/nyams rtogs kyi rnal 'byor pa thon lugs/ mngon shes ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams rtogs thugs rgyud la mnga' tshul/ yi dam zhal gzigs tshul/ gsung rab bzhengs tshul/ lha rten bzhengs tshul/ chos bsgyur tshul sogs sgo re re'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ ji ltar phyogs bcu'i chu klung ji snyed pa/ /chu thigs tshun chad rgya mtshor 'du ba ltar/ /de bzhin chos sgo ma lus ji snyed pa/ /gcig tu 'dus pa bu ston lo tsā yin/ /khyed kyi 'phrin las ji tsam mkha' khyab pa/ /de tsam khyab ste chad med rtag gnas pa/ /nam mkha' la ni kun tu 'gran pa 'dra/ / nam mkha' ma bzod go skabs phye ba snyam/ /bu ston gyi skye ba gong ma ni kha che paṇa chen yin/ de sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal du gyur pa ni rnga bo che'i mdo las/shākya shrī zhes bya'i dge slong dag /bstan dang sems can don la brtson/ /zag pa thams cad zad gyur te/ /rab gsal zhes byar sangs yang rgyas/ zhes dang /rgya gar kha che rje btsun sgrol mas khyed la ma 'ongs pa na mi mjed der skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal zhes par sangs rgya'o zhes yang gsungs/ sing gha gling gi dgra bcom pas kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i bi shu ta tsan+d+ra la khyod kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog 'di dang /ze'u 'bru yod pa'i me tog 'di thog ma kho nar dge slong shākya shrī bha dra la phul/me tog lhag ma bzhi po 'di khyod kyi lhung bzed du 'khyer la khyed rang gi mched zla ka smir paṇ+ḍi ta de'i phyag tu re zhig gtod/ de ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun pa — /75—

yin pas bsod snyoms bsams/ yon cung zad phul nas 'bras bu dpag tu med par gyur ro/ /ri bya rkang can gyi drang srong grub thob kyis kyang de dang 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal yin par lung bstan no/ /mdo sde bskal bzang las de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal skye ba'i yul ni rgyu skar can/ rigs rgyal rigs 'od dpag tshad lnga/ yab legs pa'i blo gros/ yum me tog /sras dus rigs/ rim gro pa dga' ba'i dbang phyug shes rab can gyi mchog bkra shis/ rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog 'brug sgra/ 'dus pa dang po la nyan thos bye ba phrag 'bum/ gnyis pa la dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag dgu'o/ /gsum pa la dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag brgyad do/ /sku tshe lo bye ba phrag dgu'o/ /dam pa'i chos ni lo brgyad khri lnga stong bar du gnas so /sangs rgyas de'i rnam par sprul pa zhwa lu bu ston lo tsā ba spyan 'dren ched gnyer zhus pa zhal gyis bzhes nas lcags pho spre'u lo la nyid kyi dgung lo sum cu so gcig la zhwa lur phyag phebs/ sngon khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la zhabs tog ji ltar byas pa ltar du spyin bdag chen po des kyang chos rje nyid la gus pa chen pos zhabs tog tshul bzhin du byas/ lus longs spyod gnyen 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad phul nas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba gcig zhu/ sgos zhwa lu ba yon mchod dar zhing rgyas pa gcig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pa ltar mdor na yon tan gyi bdag nyid chen po 'di ni mkhyen rab dang thugs rjes phun sum tshogs pa'i gru dang rdzing la —176—

sogs par bzhus/sa te mdo rgyud rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu byon nas don gnyis kyi nor bu blangs te/ lus can grangs med pa'i blo'i dbul ba sel bar mdzad pa'i tshul smos ci 'tshal gzigs pas gsal ba 'di lags mod/ skyes bu dam pa 'dis dbyar dgun gyi dus chos la phyir mngon pa kun las bshus/tshad ma rnam nges/ spyod 'jug rnams la nyid kyi ṭik+ka btab pa dang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba la bya 'dul 'dzin gyis ṭik+ka btab pa/ gtso bor rgyun du gsungs pa/gzhan mdo rgyud kyi bshad pa lung bka' dbang bka' gdams ngag che chung la sogs pa thogs pa med pa mang po zhar chos su gsungs/ ston dpyid dus 'khor rgyud dang 'grel chen la nyid kyi mchan bu btab pa/ gsang 'dus 'grel pa don gsal la nyid kyis ṭik+ka btab pa/ yo ga rdo rje 'byung ba la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ṭik+ka/ dpal sam bu rti la nyid kyis ṭik+ka btab pa rnams rgyun du gtso bor gsungs/ phal pa zhar chos kyi tshul du mdo rgyud la bsten pa'i bshad bka' dbang bka' man ngag bka' byin rlabs kyi bka' lung mang ste/ mdor na mi re dang ngo re la 'dod chos re/ de re re la'ang blo rtse gtad du bco pa/ de yin nges mnyam du thag chod pa'i lung rig pa man ngag bcas pa gsungs/ gzhan yang 'grel pa dang 'grel bshad la sogs pa mang du mdzad nas gsungs so/ /de'i dus chos rje nyid kyis sngon jo bo rje lha gcig bzhugs shing / de'i thugs dam tsha tsha bzhugs pa'i mchod rten byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ zhwa lu ri phug na spe'u chung gcig yod pa la gzhi byas nas/ gtsug lag khang dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa bzhengs/ gzhan yang chos rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag —177—

khang du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gser sku khri rgyab dang bcas pa dang / rnam snang gi gser sku/ thub dbang gi gser sku/ byams pa'i gser sku/ dpa' gsang ba 'dus pa'i gser sku la sogs pa bka' drin che ba'i bla ma bzhi'i nang rten rnams bzhengs/ de nas dgung lo drug cu re gsum bzhes pa chu pho 'brug la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi ma tshad bsgyur/ byang chub chen po'i phyag chad dri med 'grel pa'i lugs kyi rtsom pa mdzad/ bstan pa dang sems can mang po'i don la dgongs shing / khyad par du 'ang yum gyi phyi rten so phag las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs/ gsung rab bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs so/ /sku zhang grags pa rgyal rma/tshan la sras sku zhang kun dga' don grub/ sku zhang rin chen rgyal mchan/ sku zhang ye shes kun dga'/ cha bo sku zhang dkon mchog rgyal mchan/ tsha bo sku zhang dngos grub rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang yab mes kyis srol kha bzang po bskyangs/ khyad par du chos rje rin po 'di spyi bo'i thod bzhin khur/ sngar yab mes kyis bzhengs nga 'i gcug lag khang chen po'i zhabs tog byas/ dge 'dun gyi chos sde chen po bskyangs/ khyad par du sku zhang kun dga' don grub kyis bstan 'gyur lha khang du bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro cog rnams bzhengs/ sku zhang kun dga' don grub kyis spyin bdag mdzad nas zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang nang steng gi phyogs bzhi'i ri mo la nub mar rdo rje dbyings rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor/ lho mar dpal mchog rigs — 78—

bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor/ byang mar kun rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor/ shar mar 'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bzhengs/ khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzhal yas khang chen po bzhengs pa'i dus su chos rje pa nyid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa mdzad pa la rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor nyis brgya bcu gsum bshad/bshad rgyud rtse mo'i 'dab brgya dkyil 'khor nyer dgu dpal mchog gi dkyil 'khor brgyad cu rtsa ba/'i/ sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ gzhan yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor sum cu so bdun/ chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor nyer bzhi/ gtsug dgu la sogs pa'i lha 'bum mdzad/bstan bcos chen po 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa na sngar ma tshang ba bcugalhag pa bton/ go rim bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag mdzad/ sku zhang chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi nang rten thub pa jo bo'i sku tshad ma dang gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi sku gzugs sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyis byur bur bkang pa'i lha khang chen po'i zhal lta mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rab/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa/ ma ga ta bzang mo'i rtogs brjod yab sras mjal ba/ u ḍa ya na'i ras bris la sogs pa bris sku sna tshogs dang / gzhan yang rgyud sde lha tshogs kyi bkod pa mdzad/ de'i skabs mtshams shig tu dpon chen rgyal bzang gis shangs su gdan drangs pa'i dus su bu ston gyis dri med mchod rten la sogs pa chos sku'i rten/ thub pa chen po la sogs pa sprul sku'i rten/ byams 'jam dpal sogs longs sku'i rten mang po'i —179—

bkod pa mdzad/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ rnam snang mngon byang gi dkyil 'khor gsum/ gzhin rje gshed khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor lnga/ mi g.yo ba brtul phod pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi dkyil 'khor gcig bsrung pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ gcig 'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi/ gdugs dkar gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi/ dri med kyi dkyil 'khor dgu/ mi g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig /gza' yum gyi dkyil 'khor gcig tshogs bdag gi dkyil 'khor gcig la sogs pa spyod rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor mang po'i bkod pa dang / de rnams kyi lha 'bum mdzad/ don zhags cho ga zhib mo'i dkyil 'khor dgu mig stong pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i dkyil 'khor gcig sgrol ma las sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gcig phyag rdor sa 'og gi dkyil 'khor gnyis/ rig pa mchog dkyil 'khor lnga/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor gcig gar mkhan mchog gi bzhi/ gnod nas kyi dkyil 'khor gcig pad+ma 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig pad+ma cod pan sogs bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'bum rnams mdzad/ sras sku zhung kun dga' don grub gyis zha lu'i dpon byas/ mthong jing du dben sha'i 'ja' sa gnang / bod chol kha gsum gyi khrims bdag mdzad/ zhwa lu khri skor bdag pa'i 'ja' sa dang stag mgo bzung / yab la ji ltar yod pa'i bya ba/ las ka mnga' ris rnams gong nas rim bzhin gnang / yab kyi dus las kyang dbang btsan por byung / steng gi phyogs bzhi'i gzhal yas khang gi ri mo/ tshe dpag med kyi lha khang / bstan 'gyur lha khang / gnas brtan lha khang gi —180—

skyabs bzo/ nag po'i bde ldan lha khang dang bcas pa rnams bzhengs so/ /chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa la bla brang deb gter dang bcas pa rtsis phul/ dge 'dun rnam/sa la dad gus phun sum tshogs pa yab ltar mdzad/ de la sras po dkon cog rgyal mtshan dang / slob dpon chen po dngos grub rgyal mtshan gnyis 'khru / ngas so/ /sbyin bdag sku zhang kun dga' don grub gyis mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston lo tsā bas sngar ma bsgyur ba'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang du bsgyur zhing / chad pa rnams kyang hor khong bsabs/ rgyud rdzus ma rnams sun phyung / bka' bstan bcos khag cig gzhi 'gyur/ khag cig zhu chen khag cig hor khong bsabs te bstan pa'i srog shing chen po mdzad/ lhag par kun spang chos grags dpal bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor dpal gnyis su med pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud chen la gzhi 'gyur/ mdor na yi ge pa rnams kyis mtha' skor nas 'gyur dang / rtsom pa rigs mi gcig pa mang po dus gcig la mdzad kyang rang rang gi lag pa ma stongs par zhal thon du lhod med par spobs/ ji lta ji snyed pa'i don la dbang 'byor/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi rtsa kha bye bas 'grel tig mgur ma/ chos kyi springs yig la sogs 'phral la dran/ gzhan gyi mtha' drug ma dran pa mang po dran zhing / thengs gcig zin nas brjed pa mi mnga'/g.yas g.yon byon dus su dbang dang bshad pa dang / gdams pa 'di lta bu zhu zer ba ci byung yang dpe la lta mi dgos par thugs la shar byon/ pod chung lag ngar cam zhig shes pa'i jo bo mtshan nyid pa'i jo sras sngags pa kun gyi dregs pa —181—

dang mi 'dra/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la thugs rgyal gcig kyang mi bdog slob bu'i rigs kyang rgya gar rgya nag bal po/ hor/ yu gur/ sog po/ sga/ bod kyi gtsang / dbus/ mnga' ris/ mdo stod/ mdo smad la sogs pa'i mi rigs mi gcig pa grangs med pa mang po smin zhing grol bar mdzad/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul/ chos rje sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / slob dpon chen po bsod nams blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku mched la sogs dang / lo tsā ba chen po byang chub rtse mo/ sems dpa' chen po rgyal sras thogs med pa/ lo chen skyabs mchog pa dharmā shrī/ gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams grags dang / bla ma chos grags dpal bzang po gu shrī dang / lo tsā blo gros dpal la sogs pa rigs dang rus dang yon tan che ba'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pas/ slob ma mang po yang 'dus/ bka' pod mchan chung mtshan nyid kyi pod rkyang re tsam dang sngags kyi rgyud pod rkyang re shes pa'i slob ma ni bgrangs kyis mi langs ste slob ma gcig gi phar spyod 'dul gsum/ dbu tshad mngon sum/ rgyab chos dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshig don la mkhas pa'i tshad der phyin pa dang / gcig gis kyang 'phags yog dus gsum/ gur rtags sam gsum/ lo nag dril gsum/ nag 'jigs skor gsum sogs kyi tshig don la mkhas pa'i tshad der phyin pa dang /bskyed rdzogs kyi don la brtan pa thob pas rnal 'byor po yang chen por grags/— 182—
