ku sa li la sogs pa'i slob ma grangs kyis mi chod de rnam thar la gzigs pas gsal ba 'di lags mod/ chos sde chen por yang dge 'dun tshogs pa sum stong brgyad brgya re tsam gyi tshogs dpon mdzad/ ri phug tu yang sngags mtshan nyid kyi sde snod 'dzin pa sha stag dang / 'dag sbyar chu sbug sgo la bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun tshogs pa lnga brgya tsam re 'dus/ gzhan yang stag tshal 'ol mo/ /snye mo tshal/ mig gro 'bras yul/ shangs dbye mar la sogs par skye bo khri phrag mang po la sems bskyed phog thar pa'i sa bon bzhag nas 'khor ba mtha' can du bzhag go /sku zhang kun dga' don grub kyis tshe dpag med lha khang / bstan 'gyur lha khang / gnas brtan lha khang gi skyabs bzo nang po'i bde ldan lha khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ de rjes sku zhang ye shes kun dgas mi 'khrugs pa blos bslangs/ steng gi bskor khang gi logs ris gnas brtan tshon rtsi/ shar gyi chos rje bu ston yab sras kyi sku 'dra/ phyi'i logs ris nang po'i bde yangs/ spe dkar gnas kyi 'bum ra'i phyi'i byang gi lcags ri/ mo dben gyi 'obs/ lcags ri phyi nang rnams bzhengs so/ /ye shes kun dga'i mched sring mo jo mo khye 'dren dpal gyis sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i jo mo mdzad/ sras bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'khrungs so/ /bu ston rin po che'i phyi rten dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ zhwa lur sgo gsum ma'i nang du gser 'bum/ nang rten la thub dbang gser sku khri rgyab la shwa ri'i bu/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis kyi ldem du byas pa/ gzim mal sku 'dra'i thugs kar dbu bya ril du bzhugs/ chos rje — 183—

thugs sras pa'i phyir rten zhal bzhugs dus bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs/ nang rten zhwa lugs thub pa'i gser sku khri rgyab dang bcas pa gzim mal sku 'dra rnams bzhengs/ chos rje rin po che sangs rgyas dpal rin pas ri phug na phyi rten mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs/ nang rten thub pa'i gser sku gzim mal du 'dra zhing / 'jam dpal dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi pa'i zhal bzhugs dus bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten dang / zhal bzhugs dus bzhengs pa'i thub pa chen po'i gser sku khri rgyab dang bcas pa sne gdong gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs so/ /zhes zha lu 'dir bstan skyong sbyin bdag dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bus bya ba mdzad tshul sogs thung tsam smos pa ltar gyi mthu khyad par can la brten/dus deng sang yang rgyud sde zab mo'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas phyag len nyams med kyi sgrub mchod yod tshul tsam bshad pa la dpyal g.yu skra/ dpal legs kyi sras gsum gyi dkar po cung bzang dpal gyi brgyud thar par byung pa rnams yin la/ bar pa nag po dpal legs phan gyi brgyud kom drug pa sogs yin no/ /mtha' chung phra bo 'phen legs brtsegs kyi brgyud skyer na sdong gis lcang ra ba dang / rā rdza g.yu lung ba sogs yin/ (gzhi ka bsam grub rtse'i skor bzhugs/)lha gnas dang 'dra ba'i/ (myang zhabs smad kyis yul bsam rtser grags pa de la/)ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par gyi mtho pa bco lnga yod de phyi gnas la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ nang bstan pa bstan 'dzin sogs la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ gsang ba rten gsum la brten —184—

pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa bzhi/ de kho na nyid phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su 'gyur pas na ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa gcig ste bco lnga'o/ /dang po phyi gnas la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ phyi yul sa'i dpyad ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ming khyad par can 'dogs pa'i gzhi yi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ zag med kyi thugs rgyud bltams pa'i dam pa mchog gi ched du mngags pa ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ 'chi med yul ljongs dga' tshal la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i skyed tshal gyi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba kho na byung ba'i bsti gnas su nges par bstan pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o/ /dang po phyi yul sa'i dpyad ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni/ legs byas zla ba 'bum gyi 'od dkar las/ /rnam dkar mu tig 'dzag pa'i dpal yon can/ /snang ba bkra shis rtags kyi dge mtshan gyi/ /'khor lo rab 'bums gnam sa la khyab pa/ /zhes bsam rtse 'di sa gzhi pad ma 'dab brgyad lta bu'i mdzes pa shar du slob dpon pad mas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis brlan pa'i myang chu dar dkar kyi yol pa brgyangs pa lta bu/ lho na dpe sngon dang dong rtse'i ne'u gsing g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal lta na sdug pa'i dbus na gnam thos ris brjod pa/ nub ri thal dkar mche ba drug ldan glang chen sa srung nyal ba lta bu'i mgo pho brang la bshud nas myos bum ngom pa 'dra ba/ byang du gtsang chab g.yu 'brug sngon mo rgyu ba'i dbyibs bkra shis pa'i tshig mgrin gsang mthon por sgrog pa lta bu/ gzhan yang bsam grub rtse'i phyogs dang mtshams thams cad bkra shis shing ngo mtshar ba'i — 185—

dge mchan bzang po'i ri bkra phun sum tshogs pa yod de/ rgyab ri glang chen ‘nal ba 'dra yod cing / shar na zangs dkar gyi ri yul 'khor srung pi waX rdung ba 'dra ba/ byang na rgyab ri rnam thos sras g.yon ne'u le bsnams shing / ne'u le'i kha bsam rtser bstan nas phyogs der nor bu skyug pa 'dra ba/ nub na khyung ri spyan mi bzang / de bzhin du lho na 'phags skyes po/ lho nub mtshams na ri dung kha gyen du bslang ba yod de grags pa che ba 'ong ngo zhes/ ngo mtshar (bskal bzang dang lung bstan bdud rtsi'i bzhud dang / kun tu dga' ba'i dpal rnams 'phel ba lhan cig tu bstan nga/sa bya ba lha na cig brjod pa'i rgyan ngo mtshar ba/)bkra shis rtags kyis bkra shis pa'i bskal pa bzang po dang / /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa dam pas lung bstan bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rmad byung 'gro ba'i bskal bar ldan pa kun yid dga' ba'i dpal/ /lhan cig phyogs su 'phel ba bsam grub rtse'i gnas su spru/ba/rnga5/gnyis pa ming khyad par can 'dogs pa'i gzhi yi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni/ sa yangs po khams gsum gyi khongs nang du/ /mdzes snyan grags gdugs dkar du g.yo ba/ /de yongs kun la khyab par phubs byas kyang / /bod bsod nams su mtho'i bsam grub rtse (grags pa phul byung gi rgyun/) zhes myang smad sa'i thig le 'di jo bo a ti sha'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i mgur gyi lung bstan las/ chos dge ba bcu yis khyad 'phags pa'i/ /gling phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling / /de yi nang nas bod yul kha ba'i ljongs/ /sgos myang smad sa yi lte ba yin/ /zhes dang / dbus nas dpal 'bar zhing mtha' nas g.yang lud — 186—

pa'i pho brang gi lte ba/ brag seng ge 'dra ba drug gi steng du pho brang btang pas ming seng ge drug rtser thogs so/ /slob dpon rin po che'i pad ma thang yig las/myang smad nyi ma ri la rdzong gcig byung / zhes slob dpon rin po che pad ma'i gsung dngos las zin par nyi ma'i rdzong du grags so/ (sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar bskal pa bzang po'i legs lam las/ de las (snar thang las ha cang )ring min (sa na myang smad )nyi ma'i phung po'i rir/ /gnas skabs gsum pa'i lhas brtson srid pa'i rdzong / lung bstan/ (slob dpon pad mas/ )ji bzhin babs par dgongs las deng / /sa la bsam don grub pa'i rtse mor grags/ zhes pa sa 'di yin no/) ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis rdzong chen bcu gsum brgyab pa'i rting ma yang 'di yin zhing / bsam pa'i don thams cad grub pas na ming de bsam grub rtser thogs pa yin no/ /gsum pa zag med kyi thugs rgyud gtams pa'i dam pa mchog gi ched du bsngags pa ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni pho brang bsam grub rtse la bsngags pa/ rgyal ba'i dbang po mi bskyod rdo rjes chab shob rgyas pa'i nang na/ skye bo (dngos thob kyi dga' ba'i rgyan/) rnams kyis rab dga'i mig gi bdud rtsis sbungs pa dang / /legs byas dge ba'i bsod nams bye bar bskrun pa'i tshad gyur ba/ /ngo mtshar snang ba mchog gi gter de mthong nas skyes bu rnams/ khren tu dga' ba'i rba rlabs dbu ma'i 'dzum dkar rmad byung ston/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i dbang po dbang phyug rdo rjes/ /bsod nams bsam pa grub pa'i pho brang gi /rtse mor ltar mi bzod pa'i bya 'dab 'od/ /sprin dkar tshogs dang 'dres pa'i nor bu yis/ /the tshom phul la byung gi sgo nas bsngags pa// / kra ma shrī ru' re kha yang na — 187—

mngon/ /sbyangs pa'i tshon dang gser dngul byugs tshal gyis/ /bye ma med par bris pa'i gzhal med khang / /rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan ma bsgreng ba'i zur/ /de la nyi zla zur zhing skor ba snyam/ 3/sems med rab rtog gi sgo nas bsngags pa// zhes lha dang mi rnams kyis mgrin pa'i rnga gsangs mthon pos bstod bkur gyi gnas mchog dam pa/ skye 'gro kun gyi cod pan du mdzes pa bsam grub rtse 'di'o zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'chi med yul ljongs dga' tshal la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i skyed mos tshal gyi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bsod nams las su rung ba'i mthu dpal stobs su mtho ba yis skyed mos tshal byung ste/ ser skyar zas gtsang sras 'khrungs dus grags 'dzin ma la sogs bu mo mdzes ma lnga brgya/'dun pa sogs bran bdun brgya/ rte'u pho khri mo khri/ gling gi dbus su byang chub kyi shing / phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi la sras bzhi/ gter lnga brgya/ skyed mos tshal lnga brgya rnams 'byung bas mtshan rgyal po don thams cad grub par thogs so/ /sham bha la'i pho brang gi rgyal po'i legs byas kyi dpal las ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal rdzing bu'i mtsho bcas byung ba dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po'i mthu dpal las phyogs bzhir skyed mos tshal bzhi ste dga' ba'i tshal/ 'dod pa'i tshal/ shing rta sna tshogs pa'i tshal/ rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal rnams byung ngo / /de bzhin du mi'i dbang phyug pa'i 'jer (9 ka'ajigs rtse rgyal po'i bsod nams kyi sgo skal dus su smin pa'i mthu rmad du byung ba la rten nas pho brang bsam rtse'i —188—

myang yul stod smad bar gsum gyi ngos tshar gtam gyiXgs bshad mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs/ phyogs bzhir skyed mos tshal bzhi byung rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin te me long gi le'u gsum par/ rgyal po de yi mthu yis ni/ /de yi skyed tshal lha rnams kyis/ljon pa yal 'dab gos dmar dang / ldan pa dag gi gnas su gyur/ zhes pho brang bsam grub rtse'i lho phyogs su bkra shis dge mtshan zhes pa'i skyed mos tshal dang / sa ha ka ra ste a smra khyad par can gyi me tog bye brag tsu ta ku mu dang / puṇ+ḍari ka ut+pal/ brgyu rdzan/ keng shu la sogs cha 'dra ba'i me tog mdangs bkra la dri bzang por 'thul ba/ rtsed dga'i bya ba la 'jug pa'i khrus kyi rdzing bu lteng ka khang bzang dang bcas rnams cung zad ma yin par 'gro ba rnams kyi yid mchog tu dga' ba skyed par byed pa bya sna tshogs kun tu dga' bas myos pa'i sgra snyan zhing yid du 'ong ba sgrog pa sta me long gi gzhung le'u gsum par/ yal 'dab gsar pas mdzes pa yis/ /ljon pas drangs pa'i gzhon nu rnams/ /pad ma mngon phyogs bung ba yis/ /mig nas bzung ste 'gug par byed/ ces pa dang /mthun par yid la dga' ster gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa yin ste/ bkra shis ljon pas brgyan pa'i skyed tshal 'di/ /'gro ba yid rab 'phrog pa tsam gyis kyang / /yongs 'dus tshal gyis rjes su 'gro min ste/ 1 dpe can gyi bsdus brjod mtshar du dngar ba// /dge bzhin 'bras bu 'phel ba byed pas kyang / / legs byas 'bras bu'i 'khur gyis mdangs bkra zhing / /gzhan gsos bu yis shis pa brjong/ pa'i gnas/ /yul gyi dge bcu 'dzin pa mi bdag gi 1 /sems ldan rab rtags kyi rgyan//'dren byed 'phel bar byed pa lho yi tshal/ /pho brang gi shar dbang po'i phyogs na/ /ljon pa sna tshogs kyi nags tshal stug por 'dres shing / /dga' —189—

ston la rol pa'i chu skyes gsar ba'i kun dga' 'dzum zhing mdangs su bkra ba du mas sbud pa'i me tog gi 'phreng ba can mig la mdzes pa'i dpal/ rna bar snyan pa'i bdud rtsi 'bab cing / rnam 'gyur yid 'ong ba'i gar/ yal 'dab 'phang phung lo 'bras mngon par rgyas pa'i steng du bya rnam pa/ 3/rkang drug rnams /sna tshogs 'dus shing rtsed dga'i dga' ston la rol pa'i bya tsho'i skyed tshal zhes grags te/ sman ljongs 'bab chus brgyan pa yongs 'du'i dga' chal dang / /lha shing mya ngan med pa'i 'phreng tshogs g.yo ba'i dbus/ /snyan tshig lhong lhong sgrog bya mgrin snyan gzhon nu rnams/ 1 /dpe rgyan mtshar du dngar ba/ / pad mtshor rol 'dis sum rtsen tshal gyis bskal bzang bzhin/ /rab mjes me tog tshom bu'i mdangs bkra zhing / /sngo ljang lo 'dab 'khrigs pa'i grib bsil can/ /dri zhim 'bras bus brjid pa'i ljon tshogs rnams/ /rgyal po gang de'i bsod nams dpal du bskrun/ /pho brang gi byang stod phyogs na ljon shing sna tshogs las yal ga rgyas shing / me tog dang 'bras bu'i ba gam can gyi lding khang dang 'dra ba/ yid la 'dod 'jo'i 'bras bu ro brgya'i bcud du gang bas kun dga'i dpal du 'dzag pa'i 'bras ldan gyi nags tshal rmad du byung bas na dga' tshal gyi skyed mos tshal te/ sna tshogs ljon shing lo 'dab 'phang phung 'khrigs pa'i lding khang nas/ /legs byas 'dod dgu'i rwa ba yongs su 'gengs pa'i 'bras bu'i mchog /g.yur zar 'dems pa'i bsod nams dpal gyi dga' char cher 'bebs pa/ /rdzogs ldan sprin dang dpag bsam shing gi tshal bzhin mngon par mtho/ 2 /gzugs can rmad du byung rgyan/ dpe rgyan gsum bsres pa'i spel rgyan — 9( —

no/ //pho brang gi lho nub chu lha mo dang nye bar tshal sna tshogs pa'i 'phreng ba las nags klung dri bzang por 'thul ba/ 'dabs ci chags skad snyan par sgrog pa'i bskal ba bzang por ldan zhing / chu rgyun mu tig gi 'phreng ba ltar lhung lhung du snyan par babs pa sogs klu lding zhes bya ba yang yod de me long gi gzhung las/gar byed ni tsu la phang du/ /glu yang len no mjug sgro can/ /dga' ba rgyas pa'i mig drag ni/ /chu 'dzin la ni bstod par byed/ ces so/ /lnga pa stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba kho na 'byung ba'i bsti gnas su nges par bstan pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni rten 'brel yig chung las/pad ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du/ /dri ldan me tog bung ba sdud/ /sha yi dri la sha sbrang 'khor/ /'brog bzang du ni ri dwags 'du/ zhes phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel gyi mthu zab mo las byung ba ltar brag seng ge 'dra ba gcig gi gam pho brang btab na 'gro ba mi yi kha lo sgyur zhes pa 'bum las gsungs na/ seng ge drug gi steng du pho brang bsam 'grub rtse btab pas kun la kha lo bsgyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'dzam gling gi lte ba byang chub kyi shing drung du sangs rgyas par zhes skabs lha rnams kyis gsol pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling de ni deng sang 'od srung rdzogs byed sogs rtog ge pa drug bram ze rgyu rgyal sogs rjes su sgrog pa drug /rengs byed kyi bu ltag spyod sogs snyoms par 'jug pa drug ste/ bco brgyad kyis ma rungs par bgyis pas 'dzam gling du gshegs pa'i skabs ma lags so zhus pas de dag nga nyid kyi zil gyis mnan nas so/ /seng ge /tsan+t+ra chu dang zla ba'i zer zhes dpe mang po zhig gi don bud med kyi — 91 —

reg bya sel bar bstan pa'i mang ba'i dpe 'di yang yin/ gcig gis gcan gzan tshogs rnams du ma rnam par skrag /rdo rje gcig gis brag gi rtse mo du ma rnam par 'jigs/ /brgya byin gcig gis lha ma yin dbang du ma rnam par 'joms nyi ma gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams du ma rnam par sel/ /zhes gzi gnon gyi dpe'i gtso bo seng ge la mdzad pa nyid kyis blos dpag par nus shing / drang don gyi rtsa rgyud dang / nges don gyi rtsa rgyud de/ dang po ni/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa yin zhing / gnyis pa/ nges don gyi rtsa rgyud ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri phrag drug stong pa'i rdo rje glu blangs kyi le'u zur du 'byung ba mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed/ ces gsungs pa dang / rgyud bla mar mi 'jigs 'khor gyi nang na seng ge bzhin zhes dang / sdom gsum las/ bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab seng ge sgra/ /ltas ngan ri dwags mtha' dag skrag par mdzad/ /ces dang / legs par bshad par/ khong mdzangs bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /gcig pu yin yang kun las rgyal/ /ri dwags rgyal po seng ge dang / /'khor los bsgyur la grogs mi dgos/ /zhes dang / ri dwags rgyal po gdong lnga las byung ba'i rgyud gcig bsgrengs 'dren gyur na/ /mtha' dag rgyud tshogs ma lus pa/ /skad cig la 'jig rten 'brel 'byung /zhes seng ge lta stangs kyis ma lus shing lus pa med par mtha' dag zil gyis gnon pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'i thugs/ pho brang 'di la brten nas stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung ba mngon sum gyi yul du gyur ba 'di yin la spyir —192—

btang 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung tshul chos mngon las bskal pa rdzogs ldan tshe lo brgyad khri yan la 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung gi de man la stobs mnga' thang dpal 'byor mi shong bas 'khor los bsgyur ba mi 'byung ngo / /'khor bcas bsgyur ba la yang gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa dngul gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gsum/ zangs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gnyis/ lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gcig la dbang bsgyur te/ mdzod las/ gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo can/ /de dag gling gcig gling gnyis dang / /gsum dang bzhi la mas rims bzhin/ pheb bsu rang 'gro g.yul bshams dang / /mtshon brtsams pas kyang gnod pa med/ /ces gsungs/ bskal pa gzhan la 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung tshul ni mdo sde dang 'dul lung las gsungs pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab cing / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi dbang gis 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung ba ni bskal pa'i dus bzhi'i nang nas rtsod ldan/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dus bzhi'i nang nas rtsod dus kyi skabs su drag po 'khor lo can gyi nas dum bu bcu gnyis kyi kla klo bcom nas rdzogs ldan lo lnga stong bzhi brgya/ sum ldan lo lnga stong bzhi brgya/ gnyis ldan lo lnga stong bzhi brgya/ rtsod dus lo lnga stong bzhi brgya/ yongs bsdoms sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che mi lo nyis khri chig stong drug brgya'i bar du gnas pa 'khor los bsgyur ba de yin no/ /de skabs su babs pa'i dngos don/ sa 'dzin gdong lnga'i dbyibs su mdzes pa'i steng gi pho brang du 'khod pa'i stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba — 193—

'di'i rigs mchog dam pa ni/ sum rtsen yul gyi lhag bsam bdud rtsi yi/ /rab myos gzhan phan dkar ba'i gos gyon nas/ /'chi med lam ring las 'ongs gangs can par/ /bsod nams nyi ma 'bum gyi snang bar shar/ zhes lha rigs rnyog pa med pa'i spun gsum/ bod yul gyi lhe ba yar lung gi ri/'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus chen bzhugs pa/ yar lung shel brag gi ltag gi ri gsum la babs te gangs can pa'i dpal du byon zhes gleng / lha sprun gsum gyis che ba des ri gsum gyis gnya' ba ste mtho sa nas babs pas deng yang lha ri zhes ming du thogs shing / gnya' ba zer rgyu la zur chags pa'i gnyags zhes zer ro/ /de'i rgyud pas deng sang gi brngo du yang shel brag gi gnas dgon cha lag dang bcas 'dzin no/ /lha'i bu gzhon pa gnyis kyi rgyud pa yang yar lung na yod pa grags so/ /dpyad pa/ ma dag la mthong rgya dkar khung las dog pa/ mi shes pa'i yul ngo so sor ngom pa mkhas pa bsti stangs kyi yul min ras/ (ris) su nor bas rmongs pa rnams bod rgan po'i ngag sgros yi ger gsal bar bkod pa ltar phyi'i rus/ nang gi rus/ gsang ba'i rus dang gsum/ dang po/ phyi'i rus la rus chen bco brgyad dang / rus chen drug dang / rus chen bzhi yod pas rus chen drug ni/ dbra 'bru sga dang gnyags dang bzhi/ (rgyal rabs mang che bar se dang dmu dang ldong dang stong zhes grags/ zhus dag pa'i mchan/) nu bo dbas ta (zla kaganyis dang drug /zer ba'i rus chen po gnyags yin zer ro/ /gang ltar rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa de'i rgyud la gnyags dz+nyā na (dz+nyā na khong du chud pa la'o — 194—

zhes byings kṛ ta rkyen yu ka byin/ yu bu rnams kyi a ༷da akra dag rnams zhes so/ /a na ru bsgyur ma is sbyar ba'o/)ku mā ri zhes pa'i 'di slob dpon rin po che pad ma dang thog cung zad mi mtshungs zer ba mang yang slob dpon pad ma'i zhabs la thugs nas zab kyis gdams pa lon te/ (ku mur rtse ba la'o byings/ smo sogs las nyin krita byin/a'i nad dbyi'o a rkyen/ slob phan gyis ming le'u bdun pa mug da par/ na tshod la dang po la'o na tshod la 'jug chos skyed pa yin kyang yī rkyen ster/)slob dpon rin po che'i dngos slob so so'i rdzu 'phrul bstan par/ nam mkha'i snying po mkha' la bya ltar 'phur// zhes sogs nas dz+nyā na ku mā ra rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan zhes dang / slob dpon rin po che pad mas mkhas pa mi bzhi'i gdams pa dbang gdams ngag dang bcas pa rgyal po khri srong nyid dang gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra la gnang ba yin no/ /bka' bstan mang po bsgyur bas sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā chen po dang / rgya gar gyi mkhas grub dam pa bi ma la mi trore zhabs rdul spyi bos brten/ bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnas thob cing / bi ma la'i chos 'khor zab mo mtha' dag bsgyur ba'i lo tsā sgyu 'phrul dang / phur pa snying thig /gshin rje sogs ring ma skor gyi zab khu mtha' dag gi bka' babs pas de nyid rgyud pa so so'i gral la bzhugs pa/ snubs nam mkha'i snying po dang myang ting 'dzin bzang po la chos zab mo thos pa sogs sgrub pa la mkhas pas brgyan pa 'di la mi mthun phyogs kyi gnod pa mang po zhig gis gtsos kyang mthu stobs kyis tshar gcod pa dang mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i gnyags dz+nyā na ku nā/ ras nam mkha' la phur ba la sngags btab pas sa la lhung nus pa sogs skyes bu khyu mchog 'di gnyags kyi rigs su 'khrungs so/ /yang — 195—

bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu'i skabs su gru mor tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis chu mo glang gi lo la klu mes chen po mo mkhar 'bras mor gdan drangs pa de'i spyan 'dren pa bzhi la khu gzhon nu rin chen/ gnyags yon tan snying po/ mchims lhun gyi grags pa/ mchims mchog sku dang bzhi'o/ /bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur ba 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i snying khus thugs rgyud 'dzin shing / thos don nor gyis phyug pa dang / don mthun ming du btags pa/ yon tan snying po yang mchog tu gyur pa gnyags kyi rigs su 'khrungs pa'o/ /yang kha che paṇa chen shākya (shākya phod pa'i byings la kṛ ta yi/ kya snya rkyen ster ba'i yang na ming le drug pa'i grags pa'i don la ya rkyen byin pa'o/) shrī (shrī bstan pa'i byings la/ki pra ste phyis nas byings rtags thun mong byas shing / ki pra sogs ring por byas pa'o/ /)'khor paṇa chung dgu dang bcas bod du phebs nas gtsang stod du bzhugs skabs paṇa chung dgu'i nang tshan su ga ra shrī yar klung du spyan 'dren zhu mi gnyags lo tsā ba chen po yin zhing / paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag g.yog mnga' ris pa dge mdzes byang chub yod pa des paṇ+ḍi ta las kyang gnyags lo tsā ba mkhas par rtogs nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhus pa sdogs khyad par can gyi lo tsā ba de yang mchog tu gyur pa gnyags kyi rigs su 'khrungs pa'o/ /pha dam pa sangs rgyas gnyal lo ro sogs nas brgyud nas yar stod la phebs dus khu lo tsā ba bla ma la dam tshig nyams pa yin gsungs nas ma mjal zhing chos gnang ma 'dod/ gnyags lo tsā ba la chos mang du gsungs shing / shin tu mnyes par mdzad pa de yang rigs mchog tu gyur pa gnyags rigs su — 196—

'khrungs pa'o/ /yang jo bo rje a ti sha nyid kyis bar du lo tsā bas kyang ma chod par lam gyi rim pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub yig rgyas pa dmigs pa skor gsum dang bcas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dgon pa ba 'jing dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang / des sne'u zur pa dang zhang ka ma pa la gsungs sne'u zur pas mnga' ris dge mdzes byang chub la gsungs/ des skor chen po la gsungs shing / skor chen po sa khyad par du 'phags pa/skor chen po'i lam rim zhes kun la grags so//dge ba'i bzhas gnyen skor chen po'i rab byung mkhan po gnyags chung lo tsā ba yin zhing / dgon gnas ltag can gyi bdag gnyags los mdzad pa la/dge bzhes skor gyis phyi'i lcags ri brtsigs pa sogs zhabs tog sgrub par mdzad pa'i yul de yang rigs mchog gnyags rigs su 'khrungs pa sogs gnyags rigs 'di la mkhas pa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug (lo tsā ba'i mtshan thogs pa'i zag med kyi blo mnga' ba'i chos kyi spyan ldan/) bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa sogs rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang gi mdzes pa'i dpal de nyid las byung ba ni zhing shag rdo rje nas bzung da lta mi 'jigs pa'i khri steng du mngon par mtho zhing spa ba karmā/ (zhu kri nya byed pa la'o byings a rdi hu su khri ni sa da zhes/ ma rkyen ston byas tsan+d+ra pa las a tsā las ha ra las sogs gnyis brtsegs/)bstan skyong dbang po zhes pa 'di yin la 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i sa yul ni byang phyogs sa'i thig le ri kun tu gzigs dang mi ring ba'i nye 'dabs seng ge lung zhes grags pa/ phyogs bzhir ri seng ge 'dra ba/ dbus gad pa khri gdan 'dra ba'i khar ri seng ge 'dra ba/ da dung g.yas 'khyil 'dra ba'i ngogs dgon pa grong khyim dang bcas pa yod pa la rgyu — 197—

mtshan des seng ge lung du thogs shing / sa dpyad seng ge 'dra ba yod pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags tshul gong du brag seng ge 'dra ba'i khar pho brang bsam rtser btab yod tshul skabs su bshad zine pa ltar byang phyogs mi nyag gi rgyal rgyud rim par stod phyogs la 'chugs/ dus skabs shig gi tshe dge zhing bkra shis pa'i sa yul seng ge lung du bzhugs pa'i mtshams sbyar ba'i mthus/ byang ngam ring gi bdag por gyur pa dang / spyir sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod yul gangs can 'dir mngon mtho nges legs kyi dpal mi dub cing /mtha' btsan pa'i phyir mchod rten stong rtsa brgyad btab pa'i ming la rgyal po mchod rten du thogs shing / seng ge lung gi mchod rten stong rtsa brgyad kyi gtso bor 'di la dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bsam bzhin du ma 'ongs lung bstan gyis mchod rten rgyal po skyes su mtshan btags pa/ gangs can skye dgu'i dpal du rgyal po 'di srong btsan sgam po'i sprul par gdon mi za bas 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos yul mig gi bdud rtsir bstan pa rang re tsho bskal par bzang la gzhan yang gter ston kasmi las 'bre'/ rtsal gyis mchod rten rgyal po skyes nas slob dpon rin po che'i pad ma'i kun da byang sems dkar po ril bu gwa'u kha sbyor gter du bzhugs pa ste bton kyang ma 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel gyis slar yang gter de gar bzhugs pa de'i mthu las rgyal po 'di nyid kyi slob dpon rin po che pad ma'i rnam par rol ba'i gar du'ang gtogs par gor ma chags/ ngo bor rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa/ skyon yon rnam par mkhyen pa'i rig pa/ blang dor gyi gnas phra zhib 198—

ston pa sogs blo gros kyi dpal dang ldan pas 'jam dbyangs mi'i zol 'dzin snyan tshig smra mkhas bdud rtsi'i ro dang ldan pas zla ba'i sring mo mgrin par chags pa'i skal can lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis bstod bkur mchod pa'i zhing / sbur rgyal bod kyi dge bcu'i las lam dkar por spyod pa'i byed po mngon mtho nges legs kyi 'bras bzang 'byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi rkang 'thung khrims gnyis lha'i gdugs dkar dri ma med par phub nas/ skye 'gro'i gdung ba skyob pa'i dpal gyi dum bu 'di nyid de (bya ba brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ )dpal 'byor lang tsho'i 'dzum dkar snying pu bzhad byed ka mye'i (las bsam bya ba/)khur g.yo zhing / /khrims gnyis phan bde'i chu gter gang zhing thub bstan rgyas byed dpal gyi dpyid/ /lha 'dis skye bo tsha gdung gyur par bsil byed spyin pa'i phyag skyongs shing / /phas rgol mun tshogs smag rus drung 'byin zla shel dbang po rgyal gyur cig/mkhyen rab bdud rtsi'i chu gter che/ /rba rlabs g.yo ba'i kun gsal mtha'/ /yangs par sgrog pa'i sgra snyan po/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rna bar mdzes/ /kwa ye 'dzam gling skye 'gro'i bsod nams nor bu'i sgron/ /thub bstan phun tshogs lang tsho gsar du spro mkhas pa'i/ /sa las rnam rgyal srid pa kun gyi thig le mchog /bsngags pa'i ut+pal gzhon nu dar ba rna ba'i rgyan/ /gtam snyan 'od stong rna cha nyin rer yang / 1 /snyan grags yon to gyi khyad par gyi chos brjes pas yongs rjes kyi rgyan//phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i 'gram par rtsol bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun gyi dge legs mthu bo che/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdus nas rang gis mdzad/ /ces de lta bu'i khyad par gyi chos kyi yon tan dang —199—

ldan pa'i rgyal po de bzhugs pa'i pho brang gi ngo bo de yang ci lta bu zhe na/ legs byas dpal 'byor bsam kun 'grub pa'i pho brang dam pa'i dpal/ /rtsa ba rab brjid klu yi 'jig rten mnan la ngo mtshar ci/ /rtse mo ches mtho mchog tu mdzes pa gzi brjid 'ong tshogs kyi/ tshangs pa r+ṣa po'i 'jig rten gang de phug pa de ngo mtshar/ /dpal 'byor dpung gi grags pa'i ba dan g.yo ba'i khab/ /sum rtsen grong gar khengs pa za la ngo mtshar ci/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po'i gzi brjid kyis/ / khur 'di bzod pa 'byung po 'dzin ma 'di nyid mtshar/ /ma lus dgra bcom phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang ni/ /'degs pa'i rta bab ka ba ste/ /dpung pas sa kun yongs bzung mdzod/ /ces pa la sogs rgya cher rtogs par bya'o/ /bsam rtse'i yul phyogs der hor zla lnga pa la dus bzhi cig car du 'char ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam yang yod/gnyis pa/ nang rten pa bstan 'dzin sogs la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa la lnga ste sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs te 'bras bu sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ yang snying rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'khrungs shing bstan pa spel bas ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ lta ba'i mthar thug thal 'gyur la 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel bas ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ lta sgom gyi mthar thug bka' rgyud grub thob skyes chen gyi sgrub pa bsam gtan gyis 'khor lo bskor ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ skyes bu dam pa mchog rnams 'khru/ngas nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad —200—

nga/'i ngo mtshar phum sum tshogs pa dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ sa gzhi byin gyis rlabs te 'bras bu sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i ngo ma/tshar phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rnam dkar 'o ma'i chu gter dbu (lbu kaba'i shadzum dkar klong yangs ngo/ra/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ngo bo dmigs (med) mtshar sdug snying por 'khrungs/ /skye 'gro rnam par khyab pas spyi bos brten nga/ khor yug rgya/ /'od stong ldan pa nyi ma'i mgon po nga/da ma (pa da 'gro ba la'o zhes byings a rta hu su dh+ra kla ṇi nga/ da zhes pa pa ma/'o/ ma rkyen byin pas pad ma 'grub tu yod pa la'o zhes byings nyer bsgyur ri sngon du bzhag /a tsa si rkyen yon tan byas/ sam bha wa 'grub bo tshig sdud byas/ dngos 'gyur du bsgyur ba/ me tog pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i byung ba/ nges par kun sbyin pa sde lnga nga/ ni nga'i ā ta nga/blar/) pho brang bsam rtse'i rgyab ri glang chen nyal 'dra'i mkhal ma/'i sdeng gi thad 'og tsam gyis phug pa gnyis su slob dpon rin po che pad ma dang mtsho rgyal gyis sa yul 'dir mi mthun phyogs kyi 'dre srin gdug pa'i tshogs char bcad/ sa gzhi gzhom med rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas rgyun ring bar bzhugs shing / theg pa thams cad kyi mthar thug /grub mtha' thams cad kyi zhe phug /rdo rje theg pa las kyang snying po gsang sngags zab mo sgrub pa sam bha wa/ bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par bzhengs nas dbang bskur/ man ngag zab don snying por bsgril nas mtsho rgyal dang gdul bya snod ldan gyi tshogs la gsungs/ slar mtsho rgyal gyis nyams len du dril nas bsgrub pas 'bras bu grub pa'i/ rtags su sgrub chu rang rdol du babs pa dang /bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i stegs dang bcas dus deng sang yang mngon —201 —

gsal du yod pa 'di yin zhing / ming bka' brgyad phug pa zhes yongs la grags the du/ /gsang sngags zab mo sgrub pa bka' brgyad ci lta bu'i yin zer na/dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bor bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po he ru kas 'og min gnas su zhi bas 'dul ba'i don du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs/ drag pos 'dul dgos par he ru ka chen po'i skus khro bo sngon 'byung gi dkyil 'khor chen po rab rgyas 'bring bsdus kyis phrin las kyi tshogs rab tu grub pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa/ de la zhi khro spyi'i rgyud dang bye brag gi rgyud du dang po spyi rgyud las/ rgyud sde lnga gsungs pa la bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phyi ma nges par 'gyung ba'i rgyud/ phyi ma'i phyi ma sngags kyi rgyud/ ma tshang ba kha skong ba rgyud/ 'byed byed lde mig gi rgyud dang lnga'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag rgyud la yang rtsa rgyud dang / yan lag gi rgyud gnyis su gsungs/ dang po rtsa rgyud la sgos rgyud bcu tham pa gsungs te/ zhi ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/gshin rje 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dbang chen 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phrin las 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ ma mo 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dregs can 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ drag sngags 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ zhi khro gnyis ka sgrub pa'i rigs na/'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams gsungs so/ /yan lag gi rgyud ni dgos rgyud bcu po so so la yan lag gi rgyud shin tu mang bar bzhugs pa rnams rgyal ba dgongs pas gsung tshul lo/ /rig 'dzin —202—

byang chub sems dpa' rgyud sde rnams glegs bam la bris tshul ni rig 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dus/ byang chub sems da/pa' rdo rje chos zhes kyang bya/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'am lag na rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes kyang bya ba des thog mar ngag tu bsdus/ de nas gser gyi glegs bam la be+e ḍūr+ya zhun mas bris pas rig 'dzin rig pa'i rgyud glegs bam du bris pa'o/ /gter du sbas tshul ni mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo ches spyi rgyud dang /bye brag rgyud so sor phye la rin po che'i sgrom so so'i nang du bzhugs tshul ni spyi rgyud lnga dang sgos rgyud bcu ste bco lnga'o/ /rin po che sna brgyad kyi sgrom du btsud/'jam dpal sku lcags sgrom/ pad ma gsung zangs sgrom/ yang dag thugs dngul sgrom/ che mchog gser sgrom/ phur pa phrin las g.yu sgrom/ ma mo rbod gtong bse sgrom/ 'jig rten mchod bstod mchong sgrom/ dmod pa drag sngags gzi sgrom sogs su btsud pa de rnams lha srin sde brgyad rnams gter gang du 'jug ma 'cham pa la mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo ches dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas so/ /de grub thob kyis bton tshul ni dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi gnas der nyin mtshan du thog ser dang me 'od sna tshogs 'khrugs pa gzigs pas slob dpon brgyad dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus nas mthun rdzas bshams nas bden brdar gyi chos gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mos gter nas bton te gser sgrom bi ma la mi tra dang / dngul sgrom slob dpon hūṃX (khyu spo nya ri/ha na 'tshe ba la'i byings/ skru rkyen rjes su 'brel ba la mtha'i dbyangs la sogs dbyi sogs kyi —203—

me po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'grub/) ka ra la/ lcags sgrom slob dpon 'jam dpal bzhes gnyen la/zangs sgrom slob dpon klu sgrub la/ g.yu sgrom slob dpon pad+ma la/ bse sgrom dha na sam sla ta la/ mchod sgrom slob dpon rom bu gu phya de wa tsan+t+ra la/ gzi sgrom slob dpon sharnyi gar+bha la gtad/ so so'i bka' lung rgyas par bstsal ba ste gnang ngo / /rin po che sna brgyad las byas pa'i sgrom dbus su bzhag pa de slar gter du sbas so/ /slob dpon rin po che pad+mas slar gnas der byon nas gter du sbas pa/ de'ang bka' las grol zhing / gzhan bka' brgyad po yang ma lus shing / lus pa med par tshang la rgyas par dbang lung man ngag gis rgyas btab ste yongs su rdzogs par slob dpon rin po che pad+ma nyid la babs so/ /gang zag snyan khungs su brgyud de bod yul du babs tshul ni slob dpon pad+ma bod du phebs grub rjes 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon chen po lags/ bdag rgyal po'i rigs can 'dra ba 'jig rten gyi phyogs su bya byed mang ba dang g.yengs pa che bas thos bsam dang dka' thub la ma bltos pa'i myur du sangs rgyas nges pa'i chos rgyud ma bu bshad 'grel dang bcas pa/ 'phrin las lag len dang bcas pa/ sgom rim gdams pa dang bcas pa/ las kha tshar dgos ṭa don) dang bcas pa/ gsang sngags kyi spyi'i gnad chings dang bcas pa rang gzhan gyi don ma lus par tshang ba'i chos gcig zhu zhes pas/ rgyal po nyid kyis gtso byas pa'i bdag cag rje 'bangs brgyad kyis bsam yas mchims phur dbang rim rdzogs par zhus te de yang slob dpon gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa zhi khro gnyis kyi dkyil —2()4—

thu pa yur ri sdang smad bar gsum gung mchar gtar/ gyi re/gas bshad ma/bas pa'i 'jug ngogs/'khor (zhal phye nas bsgrubs te dbang phyi nang gsang ba gsum rdzogs par bskur ba la/ dang jo/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du thun mong spyi/ khyab rdzogs nga/ra bskur/ de nas /bro bo'i dkyil 'khor 'jug nga/'i tshe/ (dad brto na brtul zhugs ldan nga/'i skal ldan gang / /ja/na nus zab gsum dbang gi smin byas nas/ /zhes dad pa/ khyan la phyi phan pa'i dbang bcu bskur/ brtso na 'grus rbon pa nang nus nga/'i bum/ dbang lnga bskur/ brtul zhugs dang snye rje na nga/'i gang zag la gsang ba zab rmo 'i dbang gong ma/ gsum/ bskur/) bdag rje 'bangs brgyad kyis dkyil/ 'khor la me/ tog gser srang bcu bcu gtor bas rgyal po nyid kyi me tog dbus che mchog gi dkyil 'khor la babs/ snubs nam mkha'i snying po yang dag gi dkyil 'khor la/ snubs sangs rgyas ye shes gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ngan lam rgyal ba ma/chog dbyangs dbang chen rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor la/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi rdo rje gzhon tshu'i dkyil 'khor la 'brog dpal gyi ye shes bla med te ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la/ rlangs dpal gyi seng ge dregs pa kun 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor la/ lo cwa ba be+e ro ca na stobs ldan nag po'i dkyil 'khor la ngabs te/ de nas slob dpon gyis khro bo'i lha tshogs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i zhal ni me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du bstan nas/ dbang phyi nang gsang ba gsum lta ba spyi 'byams dang yongs su rdzogs par bskur zhing / ngo sprad de lus ngag yid gsung lha'i sku gsung thugs su sgyur zhing smin par mjad do/ /rgyal po nyid la gnang ba'i gsang sngags bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa ste ldan ma rtse mangs kyis bsgyur zhing bkod pa la rgyud kyi skor/ lung gi skor/ man ngag gi skor rnams su phye nas rgyud kyi skor la spyi rgyud lnga/ bye brag gi —205 —

rgyud bcu ste bco lnga yod/ lung gi skor la lung chen po lnga gsungs pa ste/ gsang sngags nges pa bdun gyi lung / mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha'i lung / phrin las mthar phyin sgrub pa'i lung / thugs rje dpyad thag gnas kyi lung / gsal bar byed pa sgrol ma'i lung ngo / /de ltar rgyud lung nyi shu'o/ /man ngag gi skor la gsum las phye ba'i nyi shu'o/ /sgrub pa bka' brgyad nyams len snying por dril ba lnga ste phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskyed pa ma hā yo ga ltar bsgrubs pa/nang phung po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rdzogs pa a nu yo ga ltar bsgrubs pa/gsang pa rig pa sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ltar bsgrubs pa/ de kho na nyid lam rim la brten nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel du bsgrubs pa/ phrin las yongs rdzogs la brten nas sgyu lus lha ru ngo sprad dang lnga'o/ /de lta bu'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad nyams su blangs pa la brten nas rgyal po sku tshe bsrings pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob bo/ /snubs nam mkha'i snying pos nyi zer la 'gro/ snubs sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur pa 'debs/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis rta skad 'byin nus/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis bsad gso nus/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes kyis ma mo mngon sum du rbod nus/ rlangs dpal gyi seng ge lha ma yin sde brgyad bran du 'khol nus/lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa nas 'jig rten dregs pa can thams cad dbang du 'dus shing las la 'gyed nus/ lo tsā ba gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ras rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston nus so/ /zhes sngon du bshad pa ltar gyis zab chos phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa —206—

chen po bka' brgyad de nyid kyi dbang bskur sogs zab chos cha tshang ba rgyas par slob dpon rin po che pad+mas bskyar bzlas te bsam 'grub rtse'i bka' brgyad brag phug tu gsungs pa yang gong bzhin no/ (slob dpon rin po che pad+ma rgyal po la gsungs pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs/ bka'3dus pa chos rgyal po nyid rang thugs rgyud la bzhugs pas bla yi/ ma 'ongs pa la dgongs nas brag mgrin bzang la sbos gsungs pa bzhin sbas/slar rgyal khrims 'jig la nye ba nas dbon sras dang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi lho phyogs mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang gi rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku rgyab tu gter snod pod ti sbas so/ /gter 'don pa'i dus la bab dus rgyal po dngos nyid byon pa lung bstan no/ /gter kha gong ma mnga' bdag myang rin po che gter kha nas bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa cha lag tshang ba/ gter kha 'og ma gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phrus bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar/)gnyis pa yang snying rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'khrungs shing bstan pa spel ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni cag po yu ba gdong gi grong der lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na (phal che ba'i 'jig rten grags gto blun chig la be+e ro tsa na snye mo bye mkhar du 'khrungs kyang zer ro/)'khrungs pa be+e ze'i 'dra 'bag 'khrul med las bshad do/ /rgya gar grub thob rnams kyi zab don man ngag thugs kyi nying khu rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len gnad du bsnun nas sgrub pa la bsgril nas bzhugs pa'i bsti gnas kyi phug pa byin rlabs can pho brang bsam rtse'i shar phyogs kyi skyid bde sbug gi phug na yod pa'i be+e ro phug par grags pa de yin no/ /zangs khar —207—

ri'i 'og tsam na be+e ro'i rdo la zhabs rjes dang / gzhan yang grub rtags kyis khyad par bstan pa sogs yod do/ /be+e ro tsa na zhes pa de slob dpon rin po che pad ma sam bha was las can dag pa'i 'khor rje 'bangs brgyad kyi nang nas be+e ro tsa na la stobs ldan nag po'i bka' babs pa'i skyes mchog dam pa rdzu 'phrul gyi 'jig rten dregs pa can thams cad dbang du 'dus shing / las la 'gyed nus pa'i mthu ldan no/ /bod du rab tu byung ba la snga ba la sad mi bdun gyi mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/ las slob dang / gsang ston sogs dang / dā na shrī la/ dzi na mi tra sogs rgya gar gyi dge slong khyad par can gyi tshogs 'dus par bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ rba ye shes dbang po/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma ā tshwa rla rin chen mchog /'khon klu'i dbang po srung / rlangs khams pa go cha/ gtsang legs grub te/ sad mi bdun gyi nang gi mchog gyur be+e ro tsa na 'am rnam par snang mdzad srung bar grags pa yin no/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs bla na med/ /zhu chen sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa/ /skad gnyis smra mkhas lo tsā chen po rnams/ de dag bdag cag rnams kyi mig tu gyur/ ces gsungs pa ltar lo tsā ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu nyi ma ltar mngon par mtho bar gyur pa be+e ro tsa na des gnas mchog mchims phur bla 'bum mar grags pa'i 'gyur byang du ban chung bod du skyes kyang dam pa'i chos kyi mtho ba/ shes bya'i chos la mi shes pa'i mun pa dang bral nas rab 'byams gnas lugs zab mo khong du chud pa/ blo gros chu gter gyi gting mtha' mi dpog pa/ rgya gar paṇa grub rnams kyang thugs zhum —208—

nas 'dud pa la mngon du phyogs pa/ lta ba klong du brdol/ rgyal po'i bla'i mchod gnas kyi tog tu bkur zhing / dka' ba brgya phrag tu spyad kyang sems zhum pa dang bral ba'i shwakya 'a dge slong rnam/ nga/ra snang mjad srung ba zhes nga/sa rgya gar dbus 'gyur gyi dnge/ snyel btsos te 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes dang / be+e ro tsa na bdag rni skye ba grangs med nas sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i yon tan gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon nga/ra gshegs pa dang / pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang skyes pa shes pa la sogs pa'i mngon shes yod pa dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa sems la ston/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyi thugs kyi bang mdzod ma lus par bkrus pa/ mchog gi dngos grub lhun gyis grub pa sangs rgyas la nye ba/ srid pa mtha' ma ba yin zhes snang ba mchog thob pa yin no/ /rgyu'i theg pa'i chos rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la zhus shing / 'bras bu'i chos zab mo rdzogs pa chen po rgya gar mkhas grub bdun dang / khyad par shrī sa dha las yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i skyes mchog dam pa slob dpon bi ma la dang paṇa grub lo cwa ba/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis be+e ro tsā na la yang dag bcu gcig gi sgo nas bstod cing bsngags pa'i skyes chen de bsam rtser 'khrungs/gzhan yang be+e ros 'dul ba lung sde bzhi bsgyur/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa bam po dgus ma long pa bsgyur/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa bam po sum cu rtsa lngas ma longs pa bsgyur/ sangs rgyas phal po che bam po brgya dang brgyad bsgyur/myang 'das bam po nyis brgya brgyad cu las bam po nyis brgya ma bsgyur/ lang —209—

kar gshegs pa bam po bco lnga bsgyur ba sogs rgyu'i theg pa bka' dang bstan bcos shin tu mang bar bsgyur/ 'bras bu sngags kyi chos la tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad yod pa la bcu drug bsgyur/ nam gung la rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i snga 'gyur lnga la sogs pa 'gyur ro/ /gso ba rig pa'i rgyud sogs kyang bsgyur ro/ /spyir (man ngag rdzogs pa wo po'i skor la phyi sems sde'i skor dang / nang klong sde'i skor dang / bam po'i skor dang / mdo lung rdzogs r+ṣa ma bu'i skor dang / man ngag rdzong weng gi skor/man ngag bsam gto gyi skor/) rdzogs pa chen po'i phyi skor la rnam grangs dang /'gyur lugs gnyis/ rnam grangs ni rgyud sde/ sems sde/ klong sde/ bam po'i skor/ mdo lung rdzogs pa chen po ma bu'i skor/ man ngag rdzong 'phreng gi skor/man ngag snyan rgyud skor/ man ngag bsam gtan skor sogs rgya gar gyi yul na rnam grangs dgu bzhugs/ 'gyur lugs ni rgya gar gyi yul na rgyud mang yang rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga dang / yan lag gi rgyud bdun/ bshad pa'i rgyud bzhi ste rgya mtsho'i gling du 4gad pa'i rgyud sde chen po bcu drug bod du bsgyur ro/ /kun byed rgyal po ma bu dgu skor du gsungs pa dang / kun byed rtsa ba'i rgyud thob pa'i shes rab la gdams pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa/ rgyud phyi ma bsam byung gi shes rab la gdams pa le'u gnyis pa/ phyi ma'i phyi ma sgom chung gi shes rab la gdams pa le'u bco lnga/ kun byed bshad pa'i rgyud mdo bcu/ spyi'i bshad rgyud 'khor ba rtsad gcod dang lnga/ lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum/ sgom pa rgya mtsho dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u bdun/ spyod pa nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig /'bras bu rin po che dang mnyam pa'i rgyud —210—

le'u bcu gcig pa zhes so/ /sems sde'i skor la rgya gar yul na sems sde bdun cu rtsa bdun bzhugs pa la bod du 'gyur pa la nam mkha' che khyung chen rtsal che/ rig pa'i khu byug sgom pa don drug ma/ rmad du byung ba nam mkha'i rgyal po/ rdo la gser zhun bde ba phra bkod/ byang chub sems tig kun 'dus/ bde 'jam snying po/ rdzogs pa spyi spyod/ yid bzhin nor bu/ rje rtsal dam pa/ spyi rgyud sbungs pa/ rtse mo byung rgyal/ de ltar sems sde'i rgyud bco brgyad/ man ngag bco brgyad ngo sprod dang bcas pa'o/ /klong sde'i skor la rgya gar yul na klong skor bco brgyad bzhugs pa la thugs rje klong nag ma gnyis/ klong dkar po rgya mtsho'i klong ma bu gnyis/ klong chen rab 'byams ma bu bzhi ste klong skor gsum bod du 'gyur ro/ /rlung sems kha sbyor zhes bya ba ste sems sde rtsa ba bco brgyad/ bskal pa dum bu'i rgyud bco brgyad bod du 'gyur ro/ /bam po'i skor la rgya gar na bam po nyis khri bzhugs pa la nang pa'i bam po/ stong pa'i bam po/ ye shes kyi bam po/ lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i bam po sogs bam po brgyad/ (brgya)skor zhig bod du 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs chen mdo lung gi skor la/ mdo lung mdo rtsa gnyis/ mdo 'grel dang gsum bod du 'gyur ro/ /yul rdzogs chen ma bu'i skor la/ ma stong pa'i ye shes/ bu rig pa'i ye shes ma bu gnyis bod du 'gyur ro/ /man ngag rdzong 'phreng gi skor la/ bka' rdzong / gnyan rdzong gnyis bod du 'gyur ro/ /man ngag snyan rgyud che chung gnyis bod du 'gyur/ man ngag bsam gtan gyi skor la/ bsam gtan brgyad cu pa bod du 'gyur ro/ /de rnams ni a ti phyi skor sems phyogs kyi —211 —

'gyur lugs so/ /rdzogs chen nang skor 'di la rnam grangs dang / 'gyur lugs gnyis las rnam grangs ni rgya gar yul na rig pa bla ma'i rgyud bya ba ma bu gsum bzhugs/ 'gyur lugs ni bram ze'i skor dang / rig pa'i skor dang / gab pa'i skor dang / rmad du byung ba'i skor dang / snying po'i skor/ rdzogs wo lde mig gi skor drug bod du 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs wo bram ze'i skor 'di la rgyud drug /lo rgyus bdun/ 'phrul gyi lde mig dang brgyad/ 'khordo ra lo gsum ste bcu gcig /rin po che rgyan gyi man ngag dang bcu gnyis bzhugs so/ /de rnams nang skor gyis 'gyur ro/ /a tig gsang ba'i skor 'di la rnam grangs dang / 'gyur lugs gnyis/rnam grangs ni rgya gar yul na gsang rgyud chen po gcig yang tig spyi tig dang gsum du bzhugs skad/ 'gyur lugs ni a ti gsang skor la zab mo skor dgu bod du 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs pa chen po skye tshad skor/ 'phrul bzhi zab mo skor gcig rin po che rgyas pa'i skor zab mo gcig yin/ nyi ma'i 'khor lo zab mo skor gcig yin/ rgyal po'i gter zab mo skor gcig yin/ za 'og bar khyim zab mo skor gcig yin/ rgyud pa tha ma zab mo skor gcig yin/ gzhan yang bshad thob gnyis las mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i lugs la thig le sde bzhi/ 'jam dpal sde bzhi bi ga bar ta sde bzhi la sogs so/ /ku su lu rnal 'byor pa'i lugs la sngags kyi rtsa ba gsum ste/ rgyud thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'jam dpal dgongs pa 'dus pa/ lung thams cad kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i 'khor —2/2—

lo/ ma/na ngag thams cad kyi gsang ba/ 'bar le snye lngas skor ba'o/ /chos dpag tu med nga/'i kun rdzogs nga/'i ma/tha' ma 'a/ rang gro'/ ma/ngon sum/ du ston pa'i man ngag gnang ste gsal byed rin ngo/ che 'bar ba ba nangs nas// rgya'/ thabs snri/ ྅ gas rnal ma'i dbang la sogs nga/ dbang gi chu bo bdun rdzogs nga/ bskur/ de rjes rig nga/ rtsal dbang bco brgyad bskur nas gnas lugs gco bor bton pa ye shes rdzo gas pa'i ngang / 'khrul chul gtso bor ston nga/ ye shes gsang ba dang /rtogs thabs gtso bor ston nga/ rig pa ra2 gsal mchog gi rgyud dang / sgom thabs gtso bo snye/na pa nam mkha' sa mun ta nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud dang / 'bras bu gco bor ston nga/ snying po don gyi rgyang dang lnga'o/ /gzhan yang klong dgu la sogs pa sde yan lag gi rgyud rtsa lnga dang / sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje'i bka'i man ngag sro na bu bco brgyad/ rig 'jin gyi chos bzhi sogs slob dpon chen ngo/ so sos ma/jad nga/ shin tu mang / rang bzhin rdzo gas nga/ chen po sde gsum las de dag las khyad par du bsdus pa'i thig le rang gnad la dbab pa 'di la rnam grangs dang / 'gyur lugs gnyis las rnam grangs la gnyis te/snyan rgyung/ dang bshad sngud gnyis so/ /bshad rgyud la thig le rang gnad la dbab pa 'di la phyi skor nang skor gsang skor dang gsum/ gsang skor bla na med pa'i skor dang bzhi/ rgya gar yul na rnam grangs bzhi bzhugs so/ /phyi skor nang skor gsang skor gyi 'gyu/ra lugs ni/ phyi shing sgrom skya mo'i skor dang gcig /nang bse sgrom smug po'i skor dang gnyis/ gsang ba dngul gyi gwa'u spar khab can gyi skor dang gsum bod du 'gyur —2/3 —

ro/ /phyi shing sgrom skya mo skor sogs (zug pa rtsa ba/ gyes pa yal ga rgyas pa lo 'dab/gsal ba me tog smin pa 'bras bu/ ) las phyi pa shin tu mang ngo / /rdzogs pa chen po yang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mngon sum snying tig gi skor la rgyud bcu bdun/khros ma nag mo'i rgyud dang bco brgyad/ zab pa'i po ti bzhi/ thun mong gi po ti bzhi/ man ngag gi yi ge mi 'dra ba brgya dang bcu dgu bzhugs so/ /sems sde ma bu bco brgyad kyi nam mkha' che la sogs be+e ros sngar khri srong la lkog gyur du gsungs pas snga 'gyur lnga dang ma myo ngag rgya mtsho'i klong du grags pa rnams la brgyud pa dang po zhes bya'o/ /bi ma las rtse mo byung rgyal la sogs bcu gsum gsungs pas phyi 'gyu/ra zhes grags so/ /yang na brgyud pa bar ma la g.yu sgra snying pos gnyags dz+nyā na dang / rma rin chen mchog la gsungs pa rnams so/ /brgyud pa mtha' ma ni rgyal po g.yu sgra snying pos spang sangs rgyas mgon po dang /rgya blo gros gzhon nu dang / sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gsungs pa rnams yin no/ /be+e ro nas khams su rim brgyud du byon pa la rdzogs chen a ro dang / rdo rje zam pa sogs so/ /rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na/(ru tsu 'bar ba la'o zhes byings bzhag /bi sngon du yu ṭa'i rkyen byin/ de de yi bsdu zhes bsdu ba byas/ yon tan yu bu rnams kyi a na a ka an tu zhes pa yu a na ru bsgyur/ de rig de rjod de'i 'di ltar sogs kyi a sngar 'dod ces/ aṇa rkyen ḍā yig dang bcas pa la dang por 'phel ba'o zhes pa be+e ru 'gyur/)bsam 'grub rtse'i sa yul du 'khrungs shing / thos don sgrub pa snying por dril ba yin no/ /—214—

gsum pa lta ba'i mthar thug thal 'gyur la 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bod du thal 'gyur srol 'byed pa tsam gyi slob ma rma bya'i 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i dgon pa phun sum tshogs shing /spyi mdo dang sgos thal 'gyur gyi bshad srol bla na med pa'i dgon gnas chen po da lta gnas rnying rgyal khang yod pa 'di yin zhing / rma bya'i skrur ril po dang phyag dpe/ na bza' cha tshang / gsol lhung rnams mchod rten nang du bzhugs pas na mchod rten gyi ming rma bya mchod rten du grags so/ /'di la skor ba brgyab pas don thams cad 'grub pa dang / rtsod pa las rgyal ba sogs rtags mtshan mngon gyur du gsal bar gyur pas stod smad la byon pa'i grwa skor ba so so rnams 'di la skor ba ched gnyer rgyag go /rma bya'i thugs dam rten byin rlabs can du grags pa thub dbang gser sku pad gdan dang bcas pa la mda' tshad gang tsam yod pa de bzhi sde'i lha khang na bzhugs/ rma bya la klu dang dri zas phul ba'i chos dung gnyis yod pa rnam thar nang du gsal ba/ de nyid gang rung zhig yin zer ba'i lo rgyus kyi nges pa ma rnyed kyang bzhi sder rma bya'i chos dung dngul shog ma yod do/ /spyir btang pa tshab la yang bstan pa snga dar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs su yo ga la mkhas pa'i mi gsum ste/ tshig la mkhas pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis kar mkhas pa slob dpon kun dga' snying po de gsum las sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti ser sgrub pa la phebs dus bod rgyal —215—

pos dgongs nas spyan 'dren la brdzangs pas 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lung bstan la bod dbus gtsang la phyin na don du mi 'gyur zhing / tshe la bar chad 'ong zhes bka' las ma grol bas bod rgyal po/ btsun mo/ blon po/ bshad grwa/sgom grwa so so la zhal gdams tshigs bcad gnang nas slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas ma byon/ chos zab mo gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes par mdzad pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lo tsā la phebs pa/ pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal po zer ba'i pa tshab gcig dang 'di 'khrungs sa myang stod stag rtse'i phu yin/ gdung rgyud da lta yod bzhin pa dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi rgyud pa dang po/ kha che dz+nyā na gu rla nas ong lo tsā sogs rgyud pa bar pa/ rma so skam gsum nas rim brgyud do/ /rgyud phran la grwa pa mngon shes dang / lce dang gnyags gsum nas brgyud do/ /rgyud pa mtha' ma byang chub sems pa kun dga' des pā tshab dgon pa pa zhes pa'i pa tshab gcig /'dir bshad par skabs su babs pa'i pa tshab ni pa tshab nyi ma grags zhes pa/ mnga' bdag rtse lde'i chos 'khor btsugs/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa phal che bas mnga' ris la byon skabs dang byon pa dus mtshungs pa/gzhan 'di dang sku bgres gzhon gyi rim pa cung zad ma gtogs 'di dang thog mtshungs su byon pa la/ rngog lo tsā ba (mdo sngags kyi chos mang du bka' babs shing bsgyur ba/) pu hrang lo chung grags mchoge shes rab (bde mchog gyi rgyud spund pa mnang ga zab chos pu yo lugs dar ro/ ) de'i slob ma dmar chos rgyal mtshan/ mar do chos kyi dbang phyug (bde mchog gi rgyud bshad man ngag do pa lugs dar ro/ )mal gyo —2/6—

blo gros grags ('di sa rdzo nga/ chen jo/ la gnang ba so/gas bde ma/chog rgyud bsad dang / man ngag sogs dang ma/gon kro/'i skor rma/'a skugs/ ngar ro/) rwa lo rdo rje grags// (gshin rje gshed nag ngo/ dgra gdong 'jags/ sa su ra gye rgyud ngang ma ma ngag dar ro/ ) sa‘ben jo dar slo/ grags/(gsang nga/ ye shes/ /nabs zugs/ kyi rgyud ma/na ngag dang na rngi ba ( 'a pa/'i ches sbo ra ngar ro/ )nge/'i slob ma/ gnam/ /ba/'u nga// snyel t+yā ba /ba'o che sogs so// /dra chab kyis rgya gar snyel byon/ rig nga/'i khu byug slob ma sa ra dha sa/ ha su ma ri/ ka na ka wa rma gsum/ bsten nas chos chul zhib par zhus nas bod du byon/ thal 'gyur ba'i srol lam gyi rgyun bzang ngo/ bcugs so/ /slar ja ya ā nan bod la spyan drangs/ lha sar rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs yul 'gyur gyi dnge/ la gtugs nas bsgyur ba'i 'a cwa ba bka' drin can pa tshab nyi ma grags zhes 'ang na yul smon ma/spar rdzo nga gi stong cam na sku gdung ril por /bang bu brtse gas pa/'i nang na ma 'ums par da lta'ang bzhugs shing / gdung rgyud 'phan yul phu na da snye / /'ang yod do/ /rma bya zhes bya ba la yang phyu ba chos kyi seng ge'i slob ma'i mchog seng ge brgyad/ jo sras mi bzhi/ grub thob mi gsum/ seng 'dra brgyad ces sogs yod pa las seng chen brgyad kyi zla mchan rig pa'am/ rtso da pa'i khyu mchog rma bya byang bces na zer ba'i rma bya gcig rgya 'dul ba 'jin pa dbang phyug chul khrims la sle1ba ma'i mchog tu sdo/ra ba ka bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ lcam dral ma sogs ste/ba ma ches mang yang ka ba bzhi ni 'dar 'dul 'jin/ mtha' bzhi brtson 'a sdi/sa 'bar/ jo gdan nag po dar tshul/ rma tsho 'am rma bya byang rdor ram byang chub rdo rje/rma bya 'di'i dngos slob bya 'dul ba 'jin pa brtson 'khru1sa 'bar yin zhing /—217 —

yang bya 'dul 'dzin gyi slob ma sogs 'dul 'dzin yang yin no/ /bya 'dul 'dzin 'di rong pa phyag sor ba'i slob ma bu bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan zhig yin zhing / rong pa phyag sor ba'i lam rim dang / nag tshos mdzad pa'i lam yig rnams bya 'dul 'dzin nas ches dar ro/ /rgya'i slob ma rma bya byang rdor zer ba'i rma bya gcig dang 'dir bshad par 'os pa'i rma bya ni pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags pa'i bu bzhi ni/ tshig la mkhas pa gangs pa shes don la mkhas pa gtsang pa 'dre sgur/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya byang brtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thag pag ba (thag ma pa ka dang bzhi yod pa las/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya byang chub ye shes sam rma bya byang brtson zhes pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i dgon gnas gong du smos pa ltar yin zhing / rma bya byang brtson gyis byang chub sems pa zla ba rgyal mtshan la chos zhu bar bzhengs nas dge 'dun la mang bkol byas/ chos skyong la gtor ma btang bas mnal lam du khyod thugs rje chen po can du 'gro'am zer/ mi 'gro/ byang chub sems pa'i zla ba rgyal mtshan can du 'gro byas pas/ de kha thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin/ khyod lam du 'jigs pa mi yong par 'dug gi myur bar log shog ces chos skyong gis lung bstan pa yang bsam rtse'i nye 'gram gnas rnying rgyal khang yod pa 'di ga yin/ chos skyong bsrung ba de chos sde chen po de'i gnyer gtad srung bar rgyal po chen po 'di nyid yin pas gnas rnying rgyal po kho na nyid de zhes gdams so/ /bzhi pa lta sgom gyi mthar thug bka' brgyud grub thob rkyen (skyes )chen —218—

gyis sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni sgrub brgyud bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs rdo rje 'chang dbang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du rgyud pa'i zam ma chad pa/ gzhan la ltos mi dgos pas pha rjes bus zin pa sha stag rtogs pa don gyi dbang chog sems la bskur bas snang srid sku gsum gyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i brgyud ldan dngos grub rgya mtsho kha ma bri ba/ sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu la byi dor byas pas dgos 'dod mtha' dag sems las grub pa/ rtogs pa'i nor bu 'od ma yal ba/ man ngag zab mo nyams su bstar ba grub thob 'am bug pa zhes bsam 'grub rtse'i chu spe'i phyogs kyi brag logs kyi phug pa 'dir dman pa'i sa bzung / gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur/ ri'i bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pas nyon mongs pa rang bzhin shes pa'i lam gyis sbyangs/ spang blang gi mtshan mar rang grol tsan dan dang lde'u 'am mkha' dang lag mthil ltar mnyam pa nyid khong du chud cing / de kho na nyid rtogs pa mthar thug nas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod chen po la phebs pa yang brag phug 'di nyid yin no/ /gzhan la 'am bu 'di na bde mchog gsungs pas mtshan dang yul gyi ming 'a yang de ltar du thogs so/ /bsam 'grub rtse'i shar gyi tshal gseb tu dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub kyis sa gnas kyi rten 'brel khyad par can du gzigs nas yun ring sgrub pa la bzhugs pas rtogs grol phun sum tshogs pa rnyed pa yang yin no/ /gser gling pa bkra shis dpal gyi slob ma'i mchog tu gyur pa/ rdo rje dpal gyis nga mkhas —219—

btsun gzhon nu 'khrungs sar sgom la 'gro gsungs nas pho brang bsam rtse'i rdzong gi ltag ri khrod brag po cher sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu rgyun ring bzhugs pas gnas kyi ming gang zag la thogs te brag po che ba rdo rje dpal zhes grags so/ /pho brang bsam rtse'i shar myang chu'i nye 'gram na rgyal ba'i dbang po rang byung rdo rje'i skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang shas shig la zab khrid sku gsum ngo sprod rnam bzhi rgyud grol/ bskyed rim dang 'brel ba thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rdzogs rim rlung sems dbyer med kyi khrid/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ pad+mas dngos su rang byung rdo rje la gnang ba'i snying thig zab rtags brgyud gsum sogs chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba'i bzhugs khri da lta yang mjal rgyu yod do/ /lnga pa la skyes bu dam pa mchog rnams 'khrungs pa dang zhabs kyis bcags nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni sngon du smos pa ltar lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na yu ba gdong du 'khrungs/ dpal na ro pa'i lcam sring mo/ rdo rje 'chang la gdams pa dngos su thob pa/ ni sgu sta/ zur chags pa'i ni gu ma zhes pas/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ don khrid man ngag gi skor/ rgyab rten lung gi skor/ bka' srung mgon po'i skor sogs rgya che bar bzhugs shing / smin byed la gzhung bka' dbang nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs te/ rtsa ba ni gu chos drug /sdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med sogs gdams pa zab la rgya che ba dang bcas khyung por gnang nas/ mi rabs bdun du chig rgyud rgya yis btab ces pa'i chig rgyud bdun ni rdo rje 'chang / ni gu ma/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin r+ṣa —220—

brtso na 'grus/ dbon ston skyer /spang / sangs rgyas ga sgyu nyen ston/ sangs/ rgyas/ skon pa/ 'di yan la chig brgyud rgyas/ btab nga/ yin la ni gu'i rin chen sna bdun nam chig brgyud bdun gyi ma/tha' ra/ sa/ngas rgyas bsta na nga/'i slob ra/ 'jag bsam gnyis 'a/sa bsam sdi ngas nga/ ma//spas nga/ gzhon nu grub kyi 'khrungs/ sa// myang smad gcung nga/ yu ba gdong du 'khrungs/ des bsam sdi/ngas btab nas// (dwags/ shangs chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi ) shangs nga bka' brgyud kyi bstan nga/ rin jo/ che rgya chen spel lo/ /sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyi rnam 'phrul zhwa lu bu sdon gyi bla ma mchog tu gyur pa rgyu ri nga// zhes pa de'ang 'khrungs/ de bsam rtse'i rjo nga rgyab kyi rgyu ri na deng sang dngo/na brgyud dang bcas nga/ yod nga/ de yin/ nga/r+ṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyi zhal slob khyad par can kun dga' tshe 'phel 'khrungs sa ni zangs dkar mdun gyi dga' grong du 'khrungs/ thos bsam mthar phyin nas brag dmar mchod sde'i slob dpon mdzad nas rgyud sde chen ngo/'i sgrub mchod mang shas yod pa rnams la gad brdar gyi lag len gzung ba sogs kyi srol rgyun bzang pa bcugs/ slob dpon rgyun ring mjad pas gnas kyi ming bla ma la thogs te brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel gyis sdom gsum skor gyi yig cha mang bshad mjad/ phyis sgrub pa snying por dril sa zangs dkar rdzong gi rgyab na ri gser sdings/ sku tshe hril po sgrub pa kho na bzhugs so/ /rgya gar shar phyogs sa ñja na dar 'khru/ngas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen la yi dam sgrol ma'i lung bstan gyis gangs ri'i ljongs su phebs/bod dbus gtsang du rgyud gdams pa zab mos nyin mor byed pa ltar gsal

zhing / skal bzang rnam thar lam la bkod nas rgya gar la log phebs skabs paṇ+ḍi ta nags rin dang / khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtshos zhabs 'bring ba mdzad nas pho brang bsam rtser byon/ bde mchog lha bcu gsum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dus maṇ+ḍal me long las kyang chung ba'i lag mthil tsam chung chung zhig la khrus khang pas bde mchog rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa bris pa des slob mas grub pa'i rtags khyad par ba bstan/ paṇa chen gyi phyag nas lhung ba ltar mdzad kyang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la nyes skyon ma byung bar bkrag mdangs gsal ler byung bas bla mas grub rtags bstan zhes bod yongs la grags so/ /bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma de la bka' srol bzhi'i nang gi bde mchog gsang 'dus 'phags lugs ltar bkral ba'i bde mchog sdom 'byung lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig dang / sher phyin dgu brgya pa gsung ba po'i la wa ba/ tsa ri byar gyi la wa phug gnyal smad lo ro sogs su byon pa'i la wa pa/shar 'bum par gdung bzhugs pa'i la wa pa/ dge slong pad mo'i ming po rgyal po mdzad dus ming in+t+ra bo dhi/ (in+d+ra bo dhi che 'bring chung gsum gyi chung ba yin no/) rnal 'byor pa mdzad dus ming la wa pa/ lo bcu gnyis gnyis mdzad rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i o rgyan yul gyi grub thob de nas brgyud pa/ bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan ste/ bde mchog la wa pa'i lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig dang / 'brug pa'i phyogs la gtso bor bzhugs pa'i mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig dang / dpal sha wa ris dngos su bal po shan+ta pu rir —222—

nags rin la gsungs pa'i bskyed rim dang 'brel ba bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rdzogs rim khyad par can zab chos ches mang ba bzhugs so/ /pho brang bsam 'grub rtse'i nye 'gram sgrol ma ri zhes pa'i mdun na gtsug lag khang sogs dang / sangs rgyas stong gi rdo sku sogs dang / rje btsun byams pa'i sku gser zangs las grub pa sku tshad sum thog tsam bzhugs pa sogs 'chad nyan gyi dgon phun sum tshogs pa bkra shis lhun po 'di paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi dgung lo nga bdun par btab dus deng sang gi skabs mkhan por mnga' gsol ba paṇa chen rin po che 'di nyid dge ba'i bzhas gnyen bka' gdams pa'i skyes chen rnams kyi mtshan nyid (bslab gsum rin chen thod bzhin spyi bos bkur/ /byang chub sems mchog rab sbyangs gzhan don mdzad/ /dad ldan skye bo nges legs gnyis la bkod/ ces dang / jo bo rje a ti sha'i gsung las/ nga mkhas pas btsun tshugs ma bcom pa/ /las rgyu 'bras zab mo sgom pa'i drin/ /nga sgom pas kha 'don mi 'joms pa/ /bka' mdo sde zab mo bltas pa'i drin/ /nga klog pas bsam gtan mi 'joms pa/ /rje bla ma'i man ngag chun pa'i drin/ /chos thams cad gcig tu rab bsdus nas/ /gnas stan thog gcig tu sgom shes pa/ /kye bka' gdams chos la spyad pa'i drin/)dang ldan pa 'dis byams pa'i sku zangs sku rgya lha dang nor 'gro ba mi tshad tsam/ 'du khang gi mchod rten du rje btsun gyi sku dngul gar blugs li ma lha khang / sngags khang lha dbang / der gsang ba 'dus pa/ mar khug nas brgyud pa'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bshad sgom grwa bzang po 'dzugs par mdzad/ gtsug lag khang gi bsti stang la rgya phibs/ gan ji ra/dge 'dun gyi dbyen 'dum pa'i gnas zab mo la dgongs nas nub chu lha mo lce —223—

stong gi phrag gnon pa lta bu/ dbyen 'dum mchod rten chos 'khor yan gser zangs las grub pa'i sogs so/ /gsum pa/ gsang ba rten gsum la brten pa'i ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa la bzhi ste/ li ma lha khang gi rten ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/ rgya nag bla ma lha khang gsum gyi rten ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa/gsung rten bzhugs tshul gyi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ li ma lha khang gi rten ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni rgya gar ma ga dha ste dbus 'gyur 'chang dang / go ṭa pa ste rgya gar shar phyogs/ be+e da rta ste rgya gar lho phyogs/ kasmi ra ste rgya gar nub phyogs sogs yul gyi spyi dang bye brag so sor phye bas sprul pa'i bzo bos bzhengs pa/ rgyu rang byung dang bcos mas dzhai khriX bde gshegs thub pa bzhis rgyu byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba/ li dkar/ li dmar/ li ser/ li khra sogs dang / khyad par mo rag gar bur dang li khra dkar dang / nag dang / smug dang / khyad par rag skya sogs kyis rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'i khar sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel gyis thugs kar gtams pa kho na li ma lha khang der bzhugs pa thams cad kyi lo rgyus sogs brjod par ci la spobs/ rten gtso rag tsam zhig smos na/ jo bo rin po che shākya mu ne'i bzo phud sangs rgyas dngos kyi phyag gnas bzhugs shing / lha yul du bzhengs pas mtshan thub pa lha yul mar thogs pa 'di rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta sha dha ka ra was thugs dam rten la mnga' ris su bsnams phebs/ des lo tsā ba rin chen bzang por gnang bas/ des thugs dam spel mdzad pa sogs de nas rim brgyud mnga' ris rdzong dgar phebs pa/ byang pa tā dben pa'i gnas tshul la brten/ thugs —224—

rten gangs la nyi shar/ gsung rten mdo sde gser gyi gad pa/ sku rten thub sku lha yul ma rnams byang nga sa mig gcug shor ba rnams rta zur rdzo nga du phebs/bzhugs pa'i dzil gyi ming thob pa/'i thub nga/ rnga zur ma gar phebs nga/'i sar brog lam rgyun bcad pa/sa thub nga/ thog thub mar grags pa dang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po nga/ṇ+ḍi ta bstan skyeng 'bum phrag gsum nga/'i thugs dar/ rngen/ 'bre chen shes rab 'bar gyi thugs dam rten/ gnas rnying pa'i 'bre yi /khyad 'phags bcu gsum gyi nang chan gyi gtso bo rgya gar gyi lha gser sku thub pa dmar po grags pa dang / ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis pha rol tshod bgam par bya ba'i phyir chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa pho brang sne gdong rtse'i rten gral nas 'doms gsungs par bdams par mjad pa'i thub nga/ rdo rje gdan chung pa 'di phyag tu byung bas lbi/ rnams nyams che bas thog skrod cing / 'di phyag tu byung bas na mgo bzung dge legs thams cad 'byung bas rtsa bar gyur pa'i li ma de dang / stod mnga' ris skor gsum du grags che ba'i nga/ṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi nyin byed kyi thugs dam rten bshags pa'i bde kye g.yer po che'o zhes rtags mtshan shag ces yi ge btab yod pa'i li ma gnyis dang / yar lung gi rgya lha grags pa can/ bkra shis brtse gas nga/'i kong ka na'i bde mchog dang / skyid shod kyi rgya lha grags pa can/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rgyu li dkar/ rdo rje 'chang ba dkyil krung rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i rgya gar li ma mi gcig pu kho na bod du bzhugs pa yin lags/ gzhan rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje snyems ma dang / dpa' bo rdo rje chos dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos sogs mang —225—

bar mthong ngo / /thal 'gyur srol 'byed sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis phyag bzo ma lung kha gcig la grub pa la gtso bo li dmar yum chen mo/ lha gzhan rnams li dkar las grub pa ngo mtshar ba/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i thugs dam rten yin pa de sa paṇa la gnang / sa paṇa dang 'phags pa gnyis ka'i thugs dam rten yin pa sogs 'di dang / thub pa zangs thang ma kha shas/ yar rgyab sde pa'i thub pa gser gling ma yin no/ /zhes yid 'phrog pa'i khyad par can dang / 'phyongs rgyas pa'i thub pa gser gling ma yin no zer ba'i khyad par dang / lho pa sde pa'i dus 'khor g.yer po che zer ba'i phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa dus 'khor zhal phyag yongs kyi li ma khyad 'phags so/ /paṇa chen nags rin gyi thugs dam phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa sdom pa chen po zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi li ma khyad 'phags so/ /ngo mtshar ba 'ba' zhig gi li ma'i rten bzhugs pa la/ rten bstar dkyus ring ba dbus na/ byang na rten bstar dkyus ring ba/ mchod rdzas ma na ho/ g.yang ṭi yul 'dzin (yu ring kasogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /gnyis pa bzhi sde/ rgya nag bla ma lha khang gsum gyi ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni bzhi sde'i dbus kyi rten bstar gyi gtso bor la dgon rtsa'i jo bo 'jam dbyangs/ (gsung thengs ma bdun byon pa sogs lo rgyus mang /) g.yas g.yon gnyis na gnyan lo'i byams pa yang zer/ ba ri lo tsus spyan drangs zer ba gnyis/ dpon chen rgyal bzang dang / nang chen kun dga' dpal gnyis kyi phyag tu sa skya nas byung ba/ phyis gnyan bu dgon pa nas rgyal byed tshal/ de nas pho brang bsam rtser phebs/ gcig nyug rgyal khang nas bsam —226—

rtser phebs pa yin no/ /gnyan lo'i sgrol ma gnyis bde mchog dus kyi 'khor lo ltar bkral ba/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa'i skabs su gsungs pa'i bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhal phyag yongs rdzogs ngam ring du bzhengs/ thugs kar rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan gyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa 'di'i rab gnas kyi nyin nas ngam ring tshong 'dus yod pa'i thog ma byung / chos rgyal li ma'i dus gsum sangs rgyas/ dam pa 'tshal (mtshal kakhrag ma sogs khungs btsun ma byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs so//g.yas kyi rten bstar la lhun rabs kyi grub thob brgyad cu gser zangs las grub pa khyad par can/ lam 'bras rdzong lugs kyi bla rgyud/ gnas bcu zangs sku tshogs gnyis sogs mang bar bzhugs/ g.yon gyi rten bstar la 'phags pa'i 'bul thob ma gsum gyi gcig sa skya'i she la gtsug dang mtshungs pa'i khyad par can sogs mang bar bzhugs shing / sku mdun na mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /gsum pa gsung dngos su byon pa'i rten yod tshul ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa ni gsung dngos su byon pa mngon sum tshad ma'i lo rgyus khungs dang 'brel ba'i sku rten bzhugs so/ /chu mig gi rje btsun sgrol ma/(sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gyo nag tu phebs skabs chu mig tu sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dang mjal/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa chen po brgyad sogs kyis/ /'ded pa'i dgra 'joms gnyen sgrol nyer gcig gi /gtso mo khyed kyi mig yang de dang nyid/ /dbyer med 'gro ba'i don la dam bcas mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs rigs ral gyis chu mig gi sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas gsung byon/ bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus kyi bde mchog chen po byung / /thar pa'i lam mchog /bo na nyams su long / zhes gsung byon pa tsam gyi —227—

thugs kyi dgongs pa'i tshigs bcad cig brtsams shing / nges don mthar thug la gzhol pa mdzad do/ /rong ngur smig gi rje btsun sgrol ma'i skor sa paṇa rnam thar las/ rong 0 smig tu phebs skabs/ chag rdul dri med pad ma la/ /rang byung ye shes sems dpa' ma/ /des bdag 'khor ba las sgrol ma/ /don dam bden pa'i gsung byon ma/ /gling kha sgrol ma lha klu sgrol ma dpal chen mo/ /rgya gar paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i thugs dam rten gyi gtso bo byang chub sems dpa'i snying po/ dgon rtsa'i 'jam dbyangs/ snu ru ban de gshin rje grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i sku// //'di man chad ma dper mi gsal/)

myang yul stod smad bar gsum gyi ngo mtshar gtam gyi legs bshad mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di nyid de sngon lo rgyus deb ther 'gar drangs 'dug kyang /rtsom pa po su yin dang / gnas dus gang du brtsams pa sogs mi gsal/ phyis su bod rang skyong ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u'i rgan spen pa tshe ring lags kyi phyag tu rda sa bod kyi dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe zhig thob ste bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skun khang la sprad pa spyi lo 1983lo lcags spar du bskrun cing / de sngon bskyar spar thengs gnyis pa'ang byas/ de ma dpe byas te 'dzam thang nas jo nang ring lugs 'dzin pa mchog sprul ngag dbang yon tan bzang pos shing spar du brkos/ spar gzhi de gnyis kas gnas yig 'di'i mdzad pa po jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha (1575—— 1634)yin par ngos bzung 'dug /'on kyang gnas yig nang ra lung gi rten gsum skor bshad skabs/ lcags spar gyi shog ngos nyi shu tham pa'i nang da lta'i bzhugs khang ga dza mu tig la sogs rin po che sna bdun las grub pa 'di dge slong pad+ma dkar po bdag gis rgyu sbyar/ dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs su bkod pa'i khyad par can thams cad kyi khyad par 'phags pa 'di'i rgyu la rin thang rtsi na gser zho stong phrag gsum longs pa tsam song ngo zhes 'khod 'dug pa der bltas na dpe 'di mdzad pa po 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po (1527——1592)yin pa 'dra po 'dug /'on kyang lcags spar gyi shog ngos 193nang karma bstan skyong dbang po(1600— 1603)skor 'khod 'dug pas lo tshig la bltas na rje —229—

btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung byas na yang 'gal ba cher ma mchis/ lhag par du jo nang dang gtsang pa yon mchod gnyis kyi 'brel ba thun mong ma yin pa'i khar karma bstan skyong dbang por gdeng 'jog mdzad stangs la bltas na rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung ma yin nam snyam pa zhig kyang 'dug brtsams dus ni sde srid gtsang pa nyams nyes ma byung tsam 'khel bas mjug ma 'gril ba yin nam thog ma'i zin bris lta bur snang ba ni brjod don la la yang skor bskyar skor du bris nas snang snyam/ 'on kyang rbad de gtam thag chod pa zhig mi 'dug pas mkhas pa tshos legs par dpyad mdzod ces zhu/ de sngon gyi tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dang / kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi gsung 'bum gnyis kar gnas yig 'di bsdus med/ da thengs dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis spar skrun byas pa'i rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum gyi gras su gnas yig 'di bzhag 'dug par/ de sngon rang nyid nas 'di thengs kha shas mjal zhing dogs dpyod kyang bya khul brgyas/ da res rang nas ma bskul dang len gyis zhu dag byas pa yin/ 'di'i nang sngar bcos nor song ba'am yig nor rnams bcos rkyang byas yod/ yig chung ngam ma rman bu rnams gug rtags sgor sgor nang bcug yod cing / dmigs bsal dwogs gnad can re zung rgyal spyi'i 'gros ltar gug rtags gru bzhi ( ka'adi 'dra ba'i nang du btsud yod pas/rgya che'i klog pa po rnams nas de don dgongs 'jags zhu// //khams sprul bsod nams don grub kyis rab rgyan me mo phag gi lo mjug tu 'phrul snang ga rjo la'i shar 'dab sa nag ma'am karma dgon gsar rang shag tu bgyis pa dza ya skye// //—230—
